reviews.text: Jose was our waiter last night and did a outstanding job. We spilled a drink and everyone was very accommodating and the drink was replaced immediately and the mess cleaned up. Jose was very knowledgeable and made some great recommendations for wine and entree. Highly recommend.

Everything was great. The hostesses were fantastic and went above and beyond to ensure my dad, who has to use a scooter, was comfortable. It was a real treat for us to spend a great evening together with a beautiful view, great food, and fantastic service. Everyone, including Becky and Christian, made it a very special evening.

Server barely check on us. Older gentleman, who didn’t seem like he wanted to be there. Went on Father’s Day with a 5pm reservation. Had to call other people over to assist with getting us another round of drinks. Did not communicate that they weren’t able to separate checks until the very end. Also did not communicate automatic gratuity until the end, which explained his service and behavior. For the money that was spent, wish we got better service. Food was great though and beautiful restaurant
J&S Steakhouse is an excellent restaurant with outstanding and unique dishes along with a fantastic view of the valley.  We've always been impressed with the menu on our visits.

We celebrated my parents 60th anniversary there.  They gave them a tiny chocolate cake that was a joke.  All the deserts were so tiny and frankly a joke for the prices you pay.  The steaks were lackluster and the creamed spinach was not creamy at all.  It was watery spinach.  When we complained to the waiter on the flimsy deserts he just smiled and shrugged.  We love the Phoenician and were excited to come back but were so disappointed with the food at J&G.  We will skip and go to maestros or Dominic’s instead.
Wonderful wine tasting followed by dinner at the bar. Highly recommend.

Yesterday my husband and I celebrated our wedding anniversary at J&G Steakhouse, and we had an incredible night. From the moment we came in, when we were greeted by the lady at the front desk and later by a gentleman in the front we felt  as if we were valued and desirable guests. When I made reservation , I mentioned it was our anniversary and it turned out that it actually mattered here. We were given a table for two in the best possible location with a beautiful view plus we were handed a happy anniversary card. Our waiter Jose was incredibly galant and highly professional. The menu was terrific with multitude of great choices. We finally decided on a J&G fresh salad,  crispy calamari, 16 oz NY steak and 8 oz Filet mignon, grilled asparagus and french fries.  Each one of these dishes was superb. My steak was butterflied to get it to the doneness I prefer  - it was a great suggestion by Jose. It was perfect, melted in my mouth.  Before the meal, we were served delicious rolls, and our evening was crowned with the complimentary chocolate lava/souffle cake . We both agreed that this was the best anniversary dinner we ever had - and we had quite a few...Thank you J&G for the unforgettable evening! The ambience, quality of food and an impeccable service  are unparalleled.  We are looking forward to be back!
Everyone we interacted with was professional & welcoming. We were celebrating a big anniversary.  The team at the restaurant gave us a wonderful table & made the evening very special.
Our dinner was excellent. Our server Hunter was excellent. Our appetizers were fantastic. Dinner was excellent. We will be back!

The service was good for a larger party. One of the waitstaff mumbled and was hard to understand; he touched my glass of wine where I would place my lips as he reached to clear the table. The main waiter was very good. One of the steaks was too salty. My halibut was a bit overcooked and rubbery, but still good enough to eat. Everything else was very good. We ordered a bunch of sides, and they were all great. The ambiance is wonderful as are the views. In any other restaurant, I would still have given 4.5 or 5 stars. But when you are supposed to be a luxury restaurant, the bar is set higher than usual. Especially with the price tag.
Excellent food and drinks: Every dish was perfect. Wine was delicious:
Had a lovely dinner here, and great service. The food and ambiance is terrific, watching the sun set over the desert was such a treat.
Honeymoon trip. Waitress and other managers of the restaurant were very nice and got a few complimentary appetizers and deserts!
The food is great. The noise was so bad we will not return. There were screaming kids and a very loud basketball team. Sorry to have to go elsewhere
This dining experience was truly top notch. It filled the bill as our Anniversary dinner. Our server was simply the best as well. Thank you for this wonderful evening!
J & G has excellent service and a good variety of food options
Wonderful experience again at J&G! Amazing food and wonderful service.  Always a special treat to eat there with unbelievable views.
Wonderful experience.  Great food and service.  Beautiful views.  Nice ambience.
Excellent experience! Best steak I've had in quite some time. Definitely in my top 3 for sure!

Ordered spinach and it had mint in it. No mention of it on menu. Probably should specify that. Masked potatoes were crazy salty and I love salt.  Mushrooms were ok.  Steaks were great. Becky our server was great.
Amazing service and good. One of the best steaks I have ever had, honestly!!!
Everything was superb. Dover sole and lobster and shells were the most notable dishes to try.
We love J&G!  The customer experience is outstanding.  Becky, Mike, Frank, and the entire staff took excellent care of us.  We look forward to dine again at J&G.  Thank you!

What a lovely evening from start to finish.  While a bachelorette party had the bar area very loudly occupied, the hostesses assisted in letting us know of a quiet spot on the balcony to enjoy predinner cocktails.  Our table was lovely, romantically sat.  We tarted with a delicious tuna tartar before moving on the our entrees- filet and sea bass with a sharing side of asparagus.   The filet was cooked perfectly but the real star of the evening was the incredible sea bass.   Delightful.  Truly one of the best I’ve had.  We were too full for dessert, but there were lovely choices.   Definitely a meal to remember.

Food and service where great.

We visited Friday and Saturday. Everything Friday with colleagues was top notch, service, location, etc.

Saturday with my spouse again Food and Service was great….Our location next to window was great until the bachelorette party of 14 took over the the deck, the view.   It was an early exit as this not the setting we wanted to view.  Frank it was a true pleasure.

This is a great location in the greater Phoenix area. It has a fabulous view. The service is outstanding. The food is excellent. We were there to celebrate our anniversary and they had a congratulations card when we arrived and the chief provided a desert as a gift. We have dinned at this location three or four times and the food is always well prepared, excellent and consistent. Highly recommend this steakhouse.
Outstanding! The food the servirle the wine the view all of it. A very fun night was had!
Food was excellent as always, the oysters from the East Coast had excellent flavor.
Food and service are great! The ambience is perfect! Their steak is really good!
Outstanding service, food quality, view of the area

Took my wife here for a Mother’s Day celebration! Our reservation was at 7pm that evening and this was a perfect time to catch the sunset view. Took plenty of pictures, the service was amazing! Our meal took about 25-30 minutes to prepare, which gave us time to enjoy our wine and bread with spread. The environment was clean and the overall volume was moderate with a touch of background music. I could not have been more pleased, my wife was ecstatic! We will most definitely plan another date for another special event!
Impeccable service! Incredibly delicious, high-quality, beautifully plated food. ￼We had an ￼exceptional experience! ￼
This is a fantastic restaurant and would highly recommend it

The Mother’s Day brunch was delicious but the price at $190 per person was extremely high. The dining wasn’t equal to that price point. Add an automatic 20% service charge and it becomes the most expensive meal of the year.

An outstanding experience at the Mother's Day brunch buffet -- probably the best we've had at J&G.

Almost every dish was excellent.  Some standouts -- sashimi, crab claws and shrimp, caviar.  We made the best avocado toast ever by combining crushed avocado with gluten-free bread and caviar!

The fruits and berries were beautifully displayed and fresh, ripe.  The kiwis were very sweet.

The prime rib was very tender, but the sauce was a but sweet for us.  Unfortunately, the pork loin was a bit dry and the black truffle chicken was very dry.

We loved the stone fruit salad, the charcuterie and cheese table.  Of the desserts, the Dubai chocolate bar, dark chocolate gluten-free cake, and the truffles were great.

Service was excellent.  Every server, chef and manager, hostess smiled at us and welcomed us.  This was obviously a concerted, organized team effort.  Success in every way!

The team at J&G should be proud of themselves -- kitchen and front-of-house.

Fantastic experience from
Check in to check out. Greeted by the staff and guided to a beautiful table. Server was pleasant and offered beverages. They never let our glasses be empty. The food was awesome, well prepared and abundant. The staff tried to help calm our young kids down too which as appreciated. Total cost is on the expensive side; however, worth it to not have to plan and eat whatever you want! Great Mother’s Day brunch.

Our wait team made the experience quite memorable and delightful, they were seamlessly on top of each detail. Our food was incredible and the general manager was also attentive in a way I do not often have the opportunity to enjoy. The art of the table and dining experience were unmatched! Also my sazerac was perfection.
As usual, food, service, and, ambiance were spectacular.
Food was great. View was great. Service was great. We will be coming back
Great atmosphere and food selections were excellent. Great views of the city.
The food, service and ambience is always exceptional!
Great experience overall, this time. warm atmosphere, friendly service, and delicious, well-prepared food. Everything exceeded expectations.
The environment and atmosphere couldn’t be better. We really enjoyed the food and their services. Thanks!
Our server Mike was great! Very communicative with us and making us feel at home, food was great, compliment’s to chef Pedro for the Dover sole!
Great food and service. Had a business dinner and had a great experience.

A real disappointment.  We've dined several times and the trend is downward.  Our food arrived late and one guest's entree arrived 20 minutes after others were served.  Her Dover sole was overcooked.  Our server did not check on us until we were finished.   The service and any attentiveness were poor; we felt abandoned.   The quality of the food is average.   This is a boozy, boisterous restaurant, not a fine dining experience.
Great steakhouse thanks. Very attractive service. Noce steak

Thank you for making my birthday dinner so special and truly exceeding our expectations. The service, food, views, and patio dining experience were all 10/10.

The sole fish, lobster mac and cheese, and asparagus were cooked perfectly, and the appetizer cheese fritters with jalapeños were incredible. Such a beautiful evening, and experience. We’ll definitely be back!
Great restaurant!!! Spectacular views, awesome service, amazing food and wine.  We will return.
We came here for our anniversary and loved it! The scenery was beautiful, and the steaks were cooked to perfection!
Excellent customer service!  Whole staff was wonderful!

Wonderful experience as usual!
Food and service.
Becky our waitress was over the top.
As we only eat grass fed meat at home it was wonderful finding it on the menu!!!
I had a wonderful time it was very relaxing and the service was very fast

This restaurant consistently delivers an exceptional dining experience. The lobby bar offers a stunning view of the valley, setting the stage for a memorable evening. The staff at the Phoenician is truly exceptional, providing outstanding service throughout our visit.

We particularly enjoy the J&G cocktail, not only for its delicious taste but also for the exceptional service it accompanies. Even when we arrived earlier than our reservation, the hostess and manager ensured that we were seated promptly.

Our waitress, Susan, stands out as a standout performer. She goes above and beyond to make our experience extraordinary. She remembers our preferences and ensures that whether we’re on a date or with family, everything is perfect.

In our opinion, this restaurant is the top choice for steak in the valley.

Review for J&G Steakhouse
Rating: ★★★★★

I had a wonderful dining experience at J&G Steakhouse. The food and atmosphere were top-notch, but what truly elevated the evening was the service. Our waiter, Michael, was exceptional. He was attentive, professional, and made sure every detail of our meal was perfect. It is rare to find service that is both seamless and genuinely welcoming.

Highly recommend dining here, and if you can, ask for Michael!

We had a wonderful 35th anniversary dinner celebration at J&G Steakhouse last night! Best steak I've ever tasted, all courses were delicious & the view of the valley from our table was stunning! Server Jose was fabulous! He provided great wine & entre recommendations, timed everything well & was very appropriately personable. We enjoyed the whole experience!

Truly a hidden gem! The atmosphere is supreme and inviting, the views are incredible ….you can feel the passion in every dish. Everything tasted incredibly fresh and homemade. The entire staff from entering to the wait staff is the Best it can get  A must-visit  !!!

The staff and food was absolutely incredible. 10/10 from beginning to end. Every single person that assisted us was phenomenal. From food recommendations to drinks, I was very impressed that everyone provided such amazing service. We felt welcomed, taken care of and truly enjoyed our meal. Thank you for taking care of us.

What a great way to end our trip! Our server Jose was great! We celebrated my husbands birthday and everything was perfect.  My Ny strip with peppercorn was cooked to perfection. The mashed potatoes were delicious! Set on the 5th gloor, there are breathtaking views. Highly recommend!
Good was great.  Restaurant was beautiful.  Can’t wait to come back.
Delicious food. Beautiful space. Best potato gratin we have ever had. My husband loved the rack of lamb.
This restaurant is a class act.  You do not want to miss eating there.
The food and service are outstanding. Daniel and Jess at the bar were super. We will always come back.

We are an amazing waitress,
The menu extremely well we had a beer that was 2nd and none, and the food was just amazing, so was the dessert. Definitely a 10 star restaurant.
Great food.  Even better service.  A bit disruptive with young kids going in and out to balcony taking pictures but food and view is a must - go.
Excellent experience!  Great service from Michael and team.  Great food.  Great evening views.  Highly recommend.
The best part was our waiter who was experienced and excellent. The salad portion was generous. My $82 steak came out overdone and they re-did it.
Outstanding evening with wonderful service.   Thank you, Scott, for a memorable evening!!
Beautiful view, great food and excellent service by Chris.
Great job everyone for an awesome anniversary. Thank you again.

Had a little staycation and Birthday celebration and the food was amazing, the staff was incredible and we were visited by the kitchen/restaurant manager who we had an amazing conversation with. My 2 young grandsons were with us and they catered to them like they were family. 

I ordered the Sole and they deboned it at the table and it was amazing to watch. The chef’s signature truffle bites were so incredible that even my pickiest grandson ate all of his and his brothers portion. 

The filet was cooked to perfection and everyone devoured their meal so quickly. 

I can’t wait to go back!!
Memorable evening.  Our waiter waa awesome.  Food incredible.  Will be back soon

This was our first time at J & G. Overall , the experience was fantastic! My wife and I had the wine pairing with the Chef’s pairing. Our server Jose was amazing.

We will be back very soon
Mike the manager made our visit special. Adding letters for the minimim
Excellent food and service. J&G never disappoints.
Thank you, Sarah, Nathan, Nick, and the team that made our dinner so memorable and fabulous.

Of the 2 hostesses, one smiled.  But we were seated promptly at the reservation time.  

Service by Dave and Cory was outstanding and friendly.   We asked for a Bijou, which Dave did not know what it was.  Apparently, the mixologist did, so we got an excellent Bijou prepared with Roku gin.  We gave Dave the recipe nonetheless.  Unfortunately, a half-dead fly was in the Bijou part way through the evening!  Dave volunteered to bring us back half a cocktail to compensate...

The jumbo shrimp was not spectacular.  Anemic, but adequate.

The onion soup had a good amount of Comté, but the broth was under-seasoned, lacked depth and richness, despite an ample amount of onions.

The baked salmon was good, but slightly overcooked, though not dry.  The miso yuzu broth helped considerably.  The crispy rice became soggy and chewy soon afterward.

The Dover sole was perfectly cooked.  Our tableside carver, however, was less than expert in his technique.  A bit nervous, and nowhere near the competence of our previous carver at J&G on 17 June 2025.   That server performed it in such a practiced way, his technique was practically flawless -- better than some we've seen in Paris!

We finished with the strawberry pavlova -- loaded with strawberry flavor.  And the strawberry rhubarb crumble was a meal in itself -- we couldn't finish it!

In all, service was very good.  Cory and Dave both served with their hearts in it, and always had smiles.  It's clear they enjoy doing what they do.  That's good customer service and reflects well on J&G.

Decided to try this wonderful steakhouse for my birthday! The view is absolutely stunning as well. J&G staff members went above and beyond for me. Each staff member I that passed my table wished me a happy birthday, they added a little menu insert wishing me a happy birthday, and they were so personable. Truly a beautiful experience and they made my birthday even more special. Thank you so much for all of your effort and kindness! It was an honor to dine there.
Great view. Great service. They were very nice to our kids. The steaks were amazing, as was the lobster. But the onion soup was amazing.

Service was subpar. For the price (even considering resort markup) the food is not worth it; you pay a significant premium for the convenience of staying on property. The atmosphere was quite loud considering the setting. Overall, would recommend looking elsewhere if you want an elevated steakhouse experience.
Fantastic place with an amazing panoramic view.  Go at sunset.
Excellent food. Great service. Very noisy. Second time there

We had a wonderful time with friends celebrating our 36th wedding anniversary.
The food, service and ambiance were incredible.
Our only note was so minor it’s hardly worth listing, but the asparagus was too tough.
Their apple cobbler dessert was with a trip to have again.   The green apples made its extra special.
Great food and service. Nice atmosphere and easily booked

Our dinner at J&G Steakhouse was excellent.  It is a beautiful setting and from the time we were greeted until we left the staff were very friendly and helpful.

Our waiter Scott was superb.  His knowledge of the menu was excellent, and his recommendations proved to be on target.  Scott was very attentive without being distracting.
Scott and Mike were amazing!  We had a wonderful time for our first visit!  We will be back for sure!

Wow!!! Everything was so delicious.  Steaks(filet) perfectly cooked, scallops and sides amazing.  Service was exceptional from the moment we were seated ￼.   Plus the views watching sun setting-perfect night.  Thank you

Excellent Steakhouse, with lots of options! Excellent view of the mountains.!
 Beautiful atmosphere.
 We came here last year for my birthday while vacationing in Scottsdale  and we had to come back again this year while we were here.
My husband likes his filet well done... I know, I know... no judgement, but each time it was  cooked  to perfection, not butterflied  and it was not charred to a crisp, he ate every delicious bite.  I love their shrimp cocktail ( huge) and the cocktail sauce.. nice kick!
Cosmos the perfect shade of pink!
Highly recommend for a special night out.
See you next year.. :)

We have visited J&G Steakhouse a number of times in the past and always enjoyed the restuarant, food and view. On March 6th my wife ordered salmon which is her most favorite in the valley and I ordered the 7 oz grass fed filet. We also had a side dish to split of broccoli and split a salad. All but the filet were up to J&G's high standards. The filet was the smallist 7 oz steak I've ever had, the exterior of was rubbery in texture, when cutting into with a knife, the exterior gave way instead of cutting!The steak was cooked medium/rare as I prefer and ordered but it lack any marbling and texture was dry. I also had a baked potato which also was excellent as usual.
Our dinner was fantastic. Great food, wine, view and service from Austin
This was very mediocre compared to other steakhouses
Perfect spot for a date night, a celebration, or an elegant getaway. Fantastic food with even better service!

J&G is our "Go-To" restaurant for hosting visiting guests and for a nice night out. The ambiance is great with perfect views of the valley stretched out below. Just an FYI, if you go on New Years eve you can see multiple fireworks displays from the comfort of your view table. Anyway, back to the review. The food was excellent, as usual, the service well paced (they let us enjoy visiting with our guest) and the price was what you would expect for a fine dining experience. Highly recommended.

JG’s is my go to steak house but our server seemed very busy, had to asked for missing food items. Disappointing since we had bragged about it to the couple we were with who had never been there.  My steak was not hot.
Excellent service, wonderful location, delicious food
Such a beautiful restaurant with a million dollar view!!! The service was 100%!!!
Outstanding view with equally good food and service!

Dinner for 4 excellent appetizers fois gras, truffles, crab cakes. Entrees ribeye, flank frites, sea bass, fillets all great.
Table service great. views on patio superb. 
Sat in the lounge for 20 minutes and no one waited on us for drinks so just went to be seated. Only disappointment especially with friends from Montreal.
Another wonderful experience at JG! We hadn’t been for awhile but it was so nice to see familiar menu items (tuna tartare, French onion soup, lovely filet)!

Austin was a fabulous waiter
Professional and relaxed at the same time
This place has phenomenal food and service. Atmosphere is great as well. Don’t think just steak, their fish selection is superb. Highly recommend this place
Solid choice. Good menu and well executed food. Great location.
Very welcoming staff, great atmosphere, and amazing view. The tomahawk was fantastic and cooked to perfection!!!.

Venue was absolutely gorgeous, food was alright but there was better value to food quality at other restaurants. Really you’ll never get ambience or view like that at many places in Arizona. Also the guests being able to stand out on the patio is nice, but not when you plan a sunset dinner by the window. Otherwise everything was very nice. Service was great and server was more than helpful and pleasant
Our goto place for celebrating a special occasion. Ambience is nice, staff very friendly and food is always fantastic!
Outstanding. Service was exceptional and for was on the level  few 5 star restaurants can match.

We recently dined at J&G, a place we’ve visited many times and always enjoyed. Unfortunately, this experience was very disappointing.

The bread was burnt to the point of tasting bitter, and the chicken was completely undercooked, which made it inedible. Given the price point, this was especially frustrating.
We chose not to send the food back, as we didn’t want to wait another 30 minutes or more for a replacement, but it significantly impacted our evening. Additionally, while the server was polite, the level of professionalism did not match the standard we’ve experienced here in the past.
With a bill of around $600, I believe this is a fair and honest review. Sadly, after this experience, we will be taking a break from returning.

I ate here every night during a five day conference and each evening was superb.  The menu options, service, ambience, and overall atmosphere was excellent and cheers to a fantastic option at the resort.

J&G’s is very consistent. Food is good. Noise
level varies.
We had the tasting menu and wine pairing. Fabulous!
We celebrated our 2nd  year anniversary, and it was one for the books! Food was amazing, service was great and we really enjoy our time. I would recommend 10/10 ⭐️
Excellent food and service.  I recommend the Dover sole and the cherry mule
The food, service, ambiance were all amazing. Views were fabulous. Had the Filet and it was perfect. Very pleasantly surprised. We will visit again!

Ambiance and menu were great. Should have gotten a steak but they did not charge for the chicken which I did not prefer. Friends steak frites and salmon were great. Service was great and resort as a whole is beautiful.
Excellent service and our waiter was outstanding and we had a late reservation and we were not rushed to finish at all.
Great food quality and phenomenal waiter . Thank you
Beautiful setting, fabulous food and incredible service!! Just wonderful!
Excellent food excellent service delightful evening

Awesome birthday dinner! Service was friendly and attentive. This was my second time dining here and I highly recommend it! Must try the pepper sauce for the steak. A surprise was the salt and pepper crusted baked potato - delicious! Make sure you time you red so you can watch the sunset! Great view from the restaurant.
I have been to this restaurant several time.  The experience has been great.  Not last night:  service could not have been worse.  Ruined the evening.
Food was magnificent. Service was top notch. View was incredible.

I booked J&G based on a concierge recommendation for my husband’s birthday, and it didn’t disappoint.   The restaurant staff are very professional and take their jobs seriously.   We started with a cocktail and then ordered the Chefs Tasting Menu.  They paced the meal exactly as we wanted, as we wanted to go out on the balcony for sunset pictures.  Everything was perfect.  Sunset transitioned into the lovely lit skyline.   All of the food was delicious and the staff was very attentive.  They also took my gluten allergy very seriously, and we had an amazing overall experience and would highly recommend this restaurant.
Great restaurant, the Wagyu Tomahawk steak was divine. The staff was professional, courteous, and prompt to attend to any needs. Great experience.

My wife and I celebrated our wedding anniversary here. It’s a perfect venue for such a special occasion.

We started with the oysters and the Black Truffle Cheese Fritters - both were outstanding.

For our mains, my wife enjoyed the 48 Hour Short Ribs, and I had the Filet Mignon with a side of the mashed potatoes.  Every dish was cooked perfectly and was delicious.

We then shared the warm chocolate cake with ice cream for dessert.

The staff was excellent - friendly, attentive, and professional.  They greeted us with a special card and took the extra steps to ensure we had a very special meal.

We will definitely return to J&G Steakhouse and highly recommend it to others.
As always. A wonderful experience. Thank you to everyone at the restaurant for making my 40th extra special.

While every aspect of dinner last night was a 10 out of 10, I want to take this opportunity to recognize WHY J&G is a Must Go when in the Scottsdale area.
1.  The delicacies are outstanding. It’s more than food - it’s an experience.If you’ve not had the Tuna tartare - you don’t know what you’re missing. The truffle risotto balls - addictive.  Now add a wedge, a ribeye : a filet (not me but my boys) and the oysters… all phenomenal.  If you’ve not had chocolate sorbet - I’m NOT a chocolate lover - but I’m a believer. Soooo incredibly good.
2. And not to be overlooked. The true measure of a successful restaurant lies within its leadership. Meet Frank Armanetti. The general manager. His warmth and kindness from the moment we arrived, he made us feel so special and genuinely welcomed. His presence, care and sincere hospitality - he sets the highest standard of culture and you feel it from every employee entrusted to his care. We so look forward to returning to J&G again and again.

If you are in Scottsdale and you don’t dine at J&G — all I can say is - I’m so sorry as you missed one of the most incredible dining experiences.

Grateful and excited to return!!
Great service! Michael and Quentin went above and beyond to take care of us and provide great recommendations. We would love to go back!

The filet never disappoints and it’s always cooked perfectly, medium rare for me! We did splurge on the lobster mac & cheese and it was extremely delicious! The sunset took our breath away and the service was top notch. We will be back! ￼

Fantastic food. Impeccable service
Becky was our waitress, she was fabulous.
Wonderful experience.
Best Sea Bass I ever had!
Try those cheese fritters!

I recently dialed at J&G steakhouse with two others. We had a beautiful sunset, a lovely table with a beautiful view and fantastic food and service. Our server was Scot. He was extremely professional and knowledgeable. Mike The manager stopped by our table, genuine hospitality
He made us feel very welcome
￼ We had the Dover sole, ￼ the comment of the people I was dining with was "it doesn't get any better than this"
The truffle cheese fritters were amazing. And the Foie Gras
literally to die for.

Every time we visit this place, we’re treated to one of the best views in the valley. The music and noise level are just right, creating a perfect atmosphere for relaxation and enjoyment. We’ve never been disappointed with our food choices here. And to top it all off, the staff is always exceptional, providing top-notch service.

The food is very good. However, we waited for our steak about an hour.
We didn’t have a good experience because of the wait time.
We celebrated our anniversary at the Phoenician & enjoyed dinner onsite at the J&G. The quality of the food, service & ambiance was top notch. I would highly recommend…

Haven’t been here in 8yrs but came back for my wife’s birthday as we don’t live local…flew in just to come here the service here is first class! The food is outstanding! The atmosphere is elegant and inviting! We will be back for sure hopefully sooner than later!
The filet and the salmon was excellent. The service by Austin was the best ever.

Hostess was poor in warm welcome and goodbye.  Your restaurant Mgr was busy socially talking to a
maintenance engineer employee rather than greeting us

Fix the railing taking the guest down three steps to window seats.

Food service was way too slow.

Cheers to the chef. Bonísimos.   Perfecto in every way.

Waiter assistant was poor.   Waiter was excellent.

Get rid of all the random tables outside. On the patio.

No warm welcome to the fire pit outside…no chairs around the fire pit, no heat lamps were lit and it WAS cold.

Jim Ryan
4&0-205-4281

My family had Christmas dinner here from out of town, and it was phenomenal. The service was top notch and the food was some of the best food we have ever had. We are all foodies and own a catering service back home so loved the thought put into each detail in the meal. The mushroom risotto was probably my favorite with the salmon skewers, a close second. The concierge even went so far to print out suggestions for museums in the area. Amazing experience!

It’s ’Ok’ Dining - certainly not at the level of fine. The food varied. The salmon skewers were pulpy and cold, the carrot salad was delicious and my husbands Dover sole was tasty and  nicely presented. Where our experience fell apart was being seated in a conference type of room, off the main dining room. There was zero vibe, no Christmas music or decorations and yet the main room had all of this. I made the reservation months in advance because we are staying in property. We were treated so shoddily for a couple excited about staying at the Phoenician and enjoying this restaurant. We will not be going back. As a Marriott titanium member, this experience damages their brand significantly.

We had a 7:15pm reservation and weren’t seated until 7:45pm which made us cut our dinner short since we had plans right after dinner at 9:30pm. It took the waiter 30 minutes once we were seated to even bring our cocktails after we asked if they forgot them. The meal was delicious and the ambiance was good but they had tons of servers running around yet no one was ever serving our table! The customer service needs to be improved.
Best restaurant to spend Christmas Eve with beloved family members.

Everything was PERFECT!  The holiday ambiance, friendly hostess, fantastic servers —José and Corey — and a delicious meal. The steaks, salmon, sole, shrimp cocktail, fries, chocolate cake, Camus cab…..etc etc were exceptional. Thank you for making our Christmas Eve so exceptionally special. I’m going to make my reservation for next year!!!!
lovely restaurant, great view, becky our waitress was great.

We chose the J&G Steakhouse to celebrate our 25th anniversary.  It was a wonderful experience.  We were warmly greeted at the front desk and immediately escorted to our table.  Even though the restaurant was busy it did not feel crowded.  We had a great table with a view of the valley lights.  My husband had a Caesar salad and the 8oz filet mignon.  I had oysters on the half shell and the grilled lobster.  Both meals were good.  The filet was cooked to my husband’s satisfaction and the oysters were fresh and delicious.  The grilled lobster had a nice smoky flavor.  Desert was on the house and consisted of molten chocolate cake and caramel ice cream.     The atmosphere was very pleasant and the service was attentive without being overbearing. This was our first visit to J&G’s. We will definitely be back.
It is always good at J&G’s at the Phoenician. We go regularly.
Ordered my filet medium & they torched it.  No pink at all.

J and G always delivers! The food is excellent, from sea food to great steaks, they have it all at J and G. It is an older restaurant in a very established hotel. Has the best views in the valley. The service is excellent from employees that have been there a very long time. That says alot! I love the wedge salad, the bone in rib eye and do not miss the Compte cheese, scallop potatoes! J and G is always a must when I am in Scottsdale.
Excellent service!!  Ceaser salad was mediocre because the dressing had little flavor. Steak was cooked perfectly but the flavor was good but not great. Tuna tartare was outstanding as usual!!
We had dinner with friends to celebrate the holidays and everything was perfect!  Our server, Suzanne, was charming and attentive - and we thoroughly enjoyed our evening!
Uniquely Awesome , scenic, with pristine views of the city.

Hospitality is a concept unfamiliar to the host staff. We arrived 7 minutes early for our reservation to be told to wait in the bar and we would be seated closer to our reservation time. A bar with a solo musician playing at a volume far too high for a restaurant of this type. Instead I walked through the restaurant to the restroom and observed dozens of empty tables. We were seated 7 minutes later and then waited 25 minutes for a cocktail. And the restaurant was fully staffed. We were asked no less than four times if it was our first time visiting - it was the first, and the last.
Everything was amazing! The au gratin potatoes are a must.
We were treated royally for my birthday by Mike and his assistant, Nathan!! Very attentive and helpful with decisions for our dinner!!

We had outstanding service by Becky and a delicious meal of ribeye, filet, lobster Mac and cheese, and Brussels sprouts. I would probably skip the French Onion Soup next time, as it didn’t have the traditional melted cheese on top (it was more mixed in) - but still a great meal!!
Food was great. Marco the Manager was amazing. But our server was very slow and forgot to bring drinks. Very unapologetic. Like she didn’t care just there for her tip.
Just outstanding. The service was outstanding. Thank you for such a good time.
Date night. Classy, elegant and beautiful. Great for serious business meetings.
Wonderful experience. Becky, our server, was absolutely delightful.  The view, the food, the ambience, and the service were all impeccable. Will definitely be back!

We understood this was the top restaurant at the Phoenician Resort so we saved it for our last night there.  What a disappointment.  I love a good steakhouse and this isn't one.  The steak was just OK.  The pace of food delivery was very fast, not a relaxing experience.  We won't likely go to this resort again, but if we do, we'll skip J&G Steakhouse.

We always love coming to J&G's, this is an outstanding restaurant. This was Thanksgiving evening so I assume due to the number of guests in attendance service was hectic for the reason our broccoli wasn't very hot, but everything else was excellent as expected from this restaurant. I don't believe you can get a much better steak anywhere in the valley.

We had a wonderful time at J&G. The service was very good, and we very much appreciated the time they gave us to have a relaxed dinner. Our biggest complaint with so many restaurants is that they seem to want you in and out in 60 minutes. We love taking our time over dinner, slowly making our way through the courses and sipping our wine. J&G allowed us to do just that! They never rushed us in any way. The food was great, and we will definitely be back soon!

Had a great time for Thanksgiving brunch. Food was eclectic and lots to choose from. Perfect venue at J&G steakhouse space. Live music a plus. Only wish was one glass of bubbly/mimosa included in price. Staff was attentive.
Food and service were great! Appreciated the knowledge about gluten free choices. Overall was a great experience.

A very nice restaurant. The service could have been a little more efficient. I think high class establishments should discourage young children from being present in the evening. Wines that are not available should not appear on the menu.
Wonderful food, ambience & service. Will definitely be back!
Loved the sword fish and the soup  so yummy.  The fillet was very good.

What an incredible experience at J & G Steakhouse! We celebrated a birthday dinner there, and everything from start to finish was exceptional. The atmosphere was elegant yet comfortable, creating the perfect setting for a special night. The staff went above and beyond, offering warm smiles, attentive service, and even a thoughtful birthday surprise that made the evening extra memorable.

The food was outstanding, every dish was perfectly prepared and bursting with flavor. The steaks were cooked to perfection, tender and juicy, and the sides complemented the meal beautifully. The cocktails and wine selection were equally impressive, and the dessert was the perfect finishing touch to an unforgettable dinner.

J & G Steakhouse made the celebration truly special. It’s clear the team takes pride in every detail, from presentation to service. This is a place that knows how to make guests feel celebrated. Highly recommend for any occasion, especially when you want to make it one to remember!

The service is impeccable, the tables are beautifully spaced apart, so even if it’s full, it feels like a private location and the food was perfectly cooked. I highly recommend this restaurant. It’s a little on the pricey side, but definitely worth it!
Delicious food delivered with exceptional service. Amazing views. Go for sunset.
We had a wonderful evening. The food was top notch, the service was amazing. The view was fantastic.
Food is consistently fantastic paired with exceptional service by Jeff and assistants.
Had anniversary dinner with table by window. Everything was perfect including the meal & service. Highly recommend coming here.

Classy with a great atmosphere and excellent service.
Food was prepared excellently with attention to detail in both cooking and presentation.  Not intended for people on a budget.

I was able to have a wonderful dinner with my daughter to celebrate my 50th birthday on our first night here The Phoenician. Austin and Cory provided exceptional service. The meal was perfect! I highly recommend!

It’s always been my favorite spot and I always ask for my favorite Server from MI- Austin as he makes our dining experience so special
Will be back

Great food, fantastic service with restaurant having great ambience.  My wife and I shared the wagyu ribeye which was delivered to our table and sliced for us.  Views from this restaurant are superb.  We look forward to returning.

Dined as we were staying at the Phoenician for a conference and celebrating our anniversary. We always love a good steakhouse and were excited to give this a try. Ordered the french onion soup, chicken parmesan and a bone in ribeye. The soup was ok and the ribeye good but the chicken had a very off taste. Disappointing given the price but the service was absolutely outstanding. Each member of the staff was knowledgeable and attentive. The dessert they sent to go was excellent.
Great location at the Phoenician. Enjoyed the grass fed Ribeye. Quiet and refined atmosphere.

Always enjoy this steakhouse for food, service and of course the view. Unfortunately there was no food service on the patio but we were given an excellent table with a view inside. Jeff, our server, is always top notch.
None of us felt like having steak that night. Three of us had the seabass which was very good. Also really enjoyed the heritage tomato salad which I split with my husband.
Great fun at the bar!  Bartender is a really nice person.

When the wife has a craving for J&G, you’ll never see any push back from me. Top notch service, stellar food & views that are second to none.

Their new duck rolls are exquisite with two pairing sauces. Think - the Ratatouille  scene of Remy experiencing grapes & cheese - a palate musical!

Wife loved the Salmon, mash potatoes & chocolate cake. In her words, “couldn’t get enough”.

My Tomahawk & grilled jalapeños were perfect.

Great date night!

Always enjoy J&G. Great service, great food, wonderful view. We had the shellfish platter to start and the lobster, oysters, shrimp and mussels were delicious, but the 2 clams we did not like the flavor so we always like to give feedback so they can check and taste for quality but the manager insisted on comping the entire platter. Certainly unexpected and we stressed it was not necessary. Our entrées, bread, black truffle French fries were all superb. Very nice Halloween dinner! Only thing we would have liked more is if they had the patio open for dining. Ron and Martha

What a wonderful experience again at J&G Steakhouse. Service is amazing and I have to say that the quality of service from the Hostess to the servers was unmatched! Frank is an amazing GM and makes us feel special every time we eat at this truly top notch restaurant! Thank you for making it a special birthday dinner for us!
Great birthday dinner!  I had the NY strip, and it was cooked perfectly.  Service was excellent.  Great view.  Would definitely recommend for a special occasion.  I will return.
Been to this restaurant many times and love everything about it. However, our steak was not as good as it used to be . I would definitely recommend. Yes, I will go back . Great for date nights.
A great evening for our anniversary with friends a great night.
I had the sea bass and my husband had the filet. Outstanding food and service!
This was our second visit. Kudos to the chef for a fantastic meal. The steak was cooked perfectly.. Service was fantastic.
Food quality was not up to the level of the pricing!  Great ambiance, great service, but food was just mediocre.
Our meal didn't meet our expectations! Our server and her team were excellent but unfortunately our food was below average!

We found it hard to get refills on iced tea and more sweet and low and more water and it wasn’t that packed out and there were someone helping our waitress, but it just seemed like we waited and waited and waited  the
￼ Swordfish with excellent the potatoes with that were very dull no flavor had had lots of salt and they came cold
Service was slow. 2.5 hrs just too long. We enjoyed the meal though.
Our dinner and experience at J&G was amazing! Cannot say enough good about this restaurant best steak we have ever had, and the service was outstanding!
Excellent in every way. Mike is first class and we look forward to our next visit!
We celebrated our 1 year Anniversary here and from the service to the ambiance to the food it was nothing short of amazing!

El servicio excelente y la comida es una delicia   El
Lugar es toda una sofisticación
Excellent food & service with a great view and ambience. One of my favorite places for a special evening in the area.
The place was amazing. Service was great so was the food and the view.

We loved every minute of our evening! Jose, our server, was absolutely perfect—warm, attentive, and incredibly accommodating to our 5-year-old twins without ever compromising the elevated feel of the night. The kids’ meals were great, and it was refreshing to see true care taken with their dining experience as well.

The miso seabass was quite literally the best we’ve ever had—melt-in-your-mouth perfection. The steaks were cooked flawlessly, and the tuna tartare was a standout with its incredible sauce. Jose’s wine knowledge added a special touch, making the evening feel like an intimate date night even while dining as a family.

A perfect blend of luxury dining and family-friendly hospitality—truly an unforgettable dinner. Patrick the manager was also so inviting and friendly , a wonderful night !
Mike was amazing as well as Hunter our server.  It was my mom’s 98th birthday and they everything very special.

The views were amazing with the seats we had. We came to celebrate our 40th wedding anniversary. Everyone we met congratulated us on our anniversary which was a very nice touch. The food was very good and the service was impeccable. They brought out a complimentary dessert after our meal. It's been 14 years since we have been there we moved back east. We now moved back and will frequent often. The place is still amazing. Thank you on a great 40th anniversary dinner.
From the moment we got to the hostess stand to when we left , My friend and I received impeccable service from the wait staff, manager , hostess etc.. definitely would come back again
Wouldn’t go back again five star expense without a five star experience
The tuna tartare was the best I’ve had and the service was amazing

This was our first visit to J&G Steakhouse, and our family of seven thoroughly enjoyed the experience. The steaks were cooked to perfection and seasoned beautifully. The grilled onion grilled cheese was outstanding — it could easily stand alone as an entrée when paired with a salad.

The sides, served family-style, were flavorful and well-prepared, with the potatoes au gratin and lobster mac and cheese as standout favorites. For dessert, both the chocolate lava cake with coffee ice cream and the toffee cake were absolutely delicious.

Service was excellent — attentive without feeling rushed. The bar area offered a great spot for a pre- or post-dinner drink, and the terrace provided a stunning view of Phoenix, perfect for photos.

We’ll definitely be returning!

Had a scorpion on the seat next to my 12 year old daughter and wife who both freaked out. Server came by with a napkin and kill it and walked away. We were offered to move seats. No “I’m so sorry”, only memorable comment that was made was, “welcome to Arizona”. Spent over $500 but not offered a desert, drink, or anything comped. Love the Phoenician in general. Just upset with the way it was handled.
Service was excellent. The food was also very good as always.
Always a great dining experience. Our Anniversary staple for cuisine and atmosphere. Thank you J&G.
The experience was amazing for our first time our waitress was very attentive and friendly and informative with everything on the menu
Jose was incredible!! Our table & view were perfect & the manager made us feel like family. Special restaurant.
Patio was closed for repairs, but view still inside was amazing.  The service here is spectacular and the food, although pricey, was very good.   The oysters were amazing.

Delicious dinner & outstanding service!  Wife’s sea bass entree was very tasty while I enjoyed the Filet Mignon.  Wedge salad, cheesy potatoes, etc were all very good.  Carrot cake desert also very tasty.  Great place to celebrate birthday, anniversary, etc.  Restaurant was a little noisy & pricey so might want to review their website & menu prior…
Nice ambiance, views of Papago and city amazing, Scott was very knowledgeable, steak was fine to perfection.
Made my partners birthday super special with an excellent view. Lovely dessert. Christopher was great.
Disappointed. Food quality was fine, but only average. Service was excellent. Noisy table nearby detracted from the experience
Amazing views, great place to watch the sunset and have a glass of wine. Service is outstanding. Food is great.
This is our second visit within the last six months and we love it here. The service is amazing and the food is so great!
Excellent service. Very attentive staff. Food was outstanding. Presentation was on point. Steak cooked as ordered and not over-priced. Would definitely return.
Excellent food & service. Beautiful setting, quiet and relaxing .
Michael provided excellent service and we had a very good time! The Dover Sole is excellent!
The dining experience was exceptional . View was magnificent ￼and food was excellent cooked to perfection.
We enjoyed our dining experience at J&G- the service was outstanding and the food exceptional. Kudos to the chef and the entire team for a lovely dinner.
Jose n Nate were amazing.  Highly recommend! Celebrated r 16th wedding anniversary ❤️.  The sat us by the front window and was amazing n beautiful.
Went for anniversary dinner. Waiter took excellent care of us. made sure our needs were met. Even gave us a special anniversary dessert.
Some of the best steak (bone in filet), asparagus and mushrooms I've ever eaten.  Asked for medium well. Came out medium.  Perfect.  This is my own trick.
Top notch service and food. Never disappointed there!
Beautiful spot - good food and  comparable pricing to area restaurants with NO view.  Jose was attentive but not hovering .  Great job.
The view was nice, and that was it. My steak came out cold - the potatoes gratin and lobster mac weren’t very good. I didn’t like my whole meal.
Best 50th birthday dinner! Food was excellent service was top notch, and the environment and view were incredible. Thank you!
Not everything they list on the menu online will be available. Crab legs and parmesan are two examples.
It was so good and our server was absolutely incredible!
Truly a fine dining, elevated experience. Too bad all diners didn’t pay any attention to the “ smart casual” dress code.

Absolutely great experience! The service was excellent and the food was delicious! The ambience is perfect for any couples looking for a romantic night out. I can’t wait to visit Scottsdale again and J&G.

We enjoyed our time at J&G.  Great booth seating looking out over the valley was stunning.  Service level was good.  No cocktail menu which we thought was odd considering the bar and level of restaurant pricing.   My daughter had a good mocktail, my wife had lemon drop and I had a martini all good.  French onion soup and calamari was awesome to start. I has the NY strip perfectly done but not the best cut.  My daughter had the chicken with she loved and my wife just a salad as she is vegetarian.  They had one vegan dish but it would have been nice to have a vegetarian dish as an option as it will limit our interest to come back.  Valet is free if you get the ticket stamped so don’t forget to do that or you’re looking at $48 charge.

This is our second time coming here for our anniversary dinners.  This experience was better than the first.  Our waiter was fantastic and the service was just as amazing.  We had a view facing the window towards the back balcony and it was so beautiful when the sun was going down and the lights came on in the pool area.  The food was delicious and they even gave us a card for our anniversary.  We will definitely be returning.

There truly is no more exquisite view of the desert sunset than at J&G Steakhouse. Now add the delicious cuisine and superb service and you’ve got yourself an incredible experience you’ll want to repeat again and again. The fresh seafood / the tuna tartare - the flavors in this one dish are like a symphony - and the truffle cheese fritters are beyond addictive! And the Mac & cheese - sooo good. Every dish cooked to perfection and paired with a wine that enhances the flavors perfectly.  Chocolate sorbet is a must to complete the meal. And I really don’t even like chocolate. It was THAT decadent.
Me and my wife had a great experience celebrating our anniversary at J&G restaurant. The food and service were excellent. Austin was our server and he did a fantastic job.
Nice place, excellent views, good food (although pricey).
The only complaint we had was the very bright lighting at our table unable to be dimmed. Everything else was great.

The staff ensured we had an amazing experience for our anniversary!!!! Our table a beautiful view  and the hand written note were beautiful touches to an elegant evening. We will definitely visit again when in the area!
Excellent service, variety and quality of food was exceptional, the most amazing panoramic view

Relaxing, good selection of foods, good service, enjoyed the views, our 55th anniversary was worth coming here,
thank you
The experience was amazing. The layout is beautiful and the manager Michael was so kind throughout time there. We took beautiful photos on the balcony as well. We will definitely be back!☺️
We had a great experience with everyone and the food was amazing!! Thank you all
The food and service were both excellent. The view from the restaurant was incredible

Went here for a birthday dinner and everyone was attentive and kind. The food was delicious and I love that they have the grass fed filet option, gluten free bread option, and steamed broccoli option. Loved the heirloom and tomato salad too. Just a great experience and a more beautiful view.

Sort of a mixed bag.  Beautiful setting.  The service, salads, sides and drinks were great.  The four of us each ordered grass fed ribeye steaks.  The steaks were unremarkable.

They were not particularly tender.  Not particularly juicy or tasty.   My wife’s comment on the way home was that she expected the steaks to be the highlight of a night out at a quality steakhouse.  Instead the main entree really neither added nor detracted from the meal.
We sat at the bar and enjoyed amazing food and we were looked after by Daniel the bartender who is fabulous. We had a visited a year earlier and he remembered us which made us feel very special.
We had such a nice evening eating here. Everything was great. Food was delicious, the service was incredible, and the restaurant and views were gorgeous. We will definitely visit again!
Great food and stellar service. Ambiance was exactly what we were looking for. Thanks for a wonderful experience!! Will certainly be back.

This was a birthday celebration for my husband.  It ranks up there as one of the b st meals we have had.  He is already looking forward to next year.  Mr.Armanetti stopped by to make sure everything was perfect.
It is pricey, but that should be expected.   Service and food were excellent.  A very nice view as well.
Always great food, service and ambiance! Love us some J&G!
Everything was great!  Our waiter was excellent and very attentive. The food was delicious. We had the Dover sole and filet mignon

For $ 1,400 for 6 people, I was unimpressed.  The food was good, not great...good.  The service was terrible.  Sat down, took 20 minutes to give a drink request, 30 minutes for them to bring bread, and we kept having to ask for stuff.  When you go to a high-end restaurant, you should never have to ask for stuff; it should be offered.  We had one server, not the customary 3 that is at most restaurants of that ilk...you could tell she was overworked and understaffed.

I live in Scottsdale so it was a staycation for us, but if you are coming from out of town, there are SO many better steak restaurants not but 2 miles down the road.....Go to a Maestro in Scottsdale and you will be thoroughly pleased, and probably will save a few bucks.

It was my daughter engagement dinner, and the restaurant was eh!
From the moment we walked in until the moment we walked out everything was 5 star. The service, the food, the ambiance, and of course the view. One of my favorite restaurants I have ever eaten at.

If you want to have a special dining experience, visit J&G Steakhouse in Scottsdale. We have been going there for many years when we want to celebrate a special occasion.  The view is superb, the dinner phenomenal and service is excellent.  I would highly recommend, you will not be disappointed.
Thank you for making our 20th anniversary so special!  The food was excellent and the service amazing.  We will be back again for another great experience soon when we stay again at the Phoencian!
Overall it was just ok. Biggest disappointment is we waited forever for our food and my medium rare steak was charcoal. Probably won’t go back.

We visited J&G while on staycation at the resort! Our server Michael was wonderful and the food was exceptional. The corn fritters were surprisingly our favorite. 10/10 dinner and can’t wait to come back.

Our food never came - the wait staff was absent and even a manager we requested to speak with never came back with our food nor provided a status update. People next to us who were seated a half an hour after us received their full dinner before us. It never arrived.
It’s better than an average hotel restaurant, but I would expect significantly better quality food and service for the price point.
Fantastic food, great views of the mountains, and an awesome staff!!!
We love this place! And Mike the manager is always so welcoming!

Favorite restaurant in all of Phoenix. Came here the first time we stayed at the Phoenician and make a point to always come back whenever we’re in town. Love the food, the service and atmosphere. 10 out of 10 every time.
Great food and impeccable service!  Highly recommend!
My favorite steakhouse in AZ reasonable price for a fine dining experience. The service and food is a 5 star experience with an amazing view of the camelback landscape.

We had a wonderful evening!  Food, service, and ambiance all exceptional!  Everyone was so friendly and accommodating!  The staff is so very thoughtful!  It is definitely a pleasure to spend the evening together with family here.
Great food. Service was excellent. The view and atmosphere was great!
Excellent service and out of this world Steaks!!!  Would definitely recommend.
We went here on our anniversary and they sat us in the best spot and our server was amazing!! The filet was to die for. Will definitely be back!

This was not a high end steakhouse on the evening that we dined.  The service staff seemed poorly trained.  We felt unimportant.  Even the general manager passed us by twice without even acknowledging us to visit  with another guest seated ten feet from us.  On the third visit he stopped.  We sat at our table for 10-15 minutes after we had finished.  The server walked by several times without even looking at us.   At that point I saught out the GM to discuss our experience.  Again even after a frank conversation with the GM inviting us back on him, which I declined, he came to our table and informed us that he was reducing our check by $100.   If you were willing to host us again why not just pick up tonights check.
Noting the food … my wife’s salad was delicious and my corn gazpacho was nice although it as described to include lump crab of which there might have been a teaspoon. We split a filet that was not finished well and over salted.   We could not wait to leave.
Incredible service and incredible food! the ribeye was fantastic.

First and foremost, I truly wish I could have given this restaurant a 4- or 5-star rating, as it is undoubtedly a beautiful and well-regarded establishment. However, there were a couple of experiences that left me disappointed.

The primary concern was the behavior of the General Manager, Frank Armanetti. While I observed him personally greeting several tables throughout the dining room, he passed by mine multiple times without so much as a greeting—even after making direct eye contact. This lack of acknowledgment was both noticeable and disheartening, especially considering the high standard one would expect from such a reputable restaurant.

This visit marked my first time in Scottsdale, AZ, celebrating my mother’s birthday and unfortunately, based on this experience, it may be my last time dining at this particular restaurant.

On a positive note, our server, Corey, was truly exceptional—professional, friendly, and attentive. However, it did take approximately 45 minutes for our food to arrive after placing our order, which added to the overall disappointment. I did have a conversation with Frank immediately after the meal. He apologized and explained that he tries to greet everyone, and that it was certainly not his intention to make anyone feel excluded. On my next visit, he personally gave me his business card and asked that I contact him directly so he can ensure a more personalized and positive experience. I appreciated his willingness to follow up and take accountability.

All in all, while there were a few bumps in the experience, I do appreciated the effort made to address my concerns.

It wasn’t what I expected for a high end steak house. Felt like a throw back to the 80’s with their menu especially the sides. Sides were a bit overwhelming with their taste (mushrooms and lobster mac). We never really got to eat the steak. The first round was overcooked to well (requested medium). Second round wasn’t much better. We ordered filets and they were cooked on a grill instead of a skillet so the outside was going to be over cooked anyway. Didn’t have the filet texture. More like sirloin. Bernaise was reheated so the egg was “broken” and sauce was stiff. I was really excited to bring my family here for dinner on our last night of our trip to Arizona. Disappointed that we didn’t enjoy our meal. I’m sorry I had to write this review. Was hoping for a better outcome.
Went to dinner to celebrate our engagement and the staff and service were exceptional and made our celebration special and memorable.

Hunter and Quentin were a wonderful service duo. So attentive! Hunter recommended a wonderful wine and Quentin made sure that my little guy loved his kids chicken by getting sauce and Parmesan and creating a whole new dish! Just great young guys! Fabulous place to eat. Beautiful views.

We were greeted promptly and seated by the manager.

Our service by Michael and Chris was attentive, and they seemed to enjoy their work, which is very important to see,

The Caesar salad was very nicely dressed, and well-seasoned.

The chilled corn soup was excellent.  Quite sweet, but not too much lemongrass, and it was complemented very well with heirloom tomatoes and lump crab meat.

The filet mignon was perfectly cooked.

We enjoyed the fries, but we felt it could be browned a bit more, and slightly crispier.

The Dover sole was beautiful, and expertly deboned tableside.  A French technique that was a joy to watch.

We also enjoyed an affogato.  The cheesecake was also well done.  But it lacked textural contrast with the strawberry lychee sorbet.  Adding the tuile from the affogato significantly improved the cheesecake.  The sliced strawberries were lackluster, and detracted from the appearance of the dish.

In all, a very good dinner.

Combination of food - value  - staff and ambience (view) is as good as it comes.
Nothing compares to it in the valley.
The food was not great. Overcooked steak and sides not good. Beautiful restaurant and view.

We enjoyed a quiet dinner - just my husband and myself for his 55th and my 60th birthday.  The service, the view and the ambiance here is amazing and impeccable!  Had the seafood tower, calamari, a steak and the lobster Mac-n-cheese.  Probably wouldn’t do the seafood tower again as I’m not huge fan of raw seafood and there was only 1/2 a lobster - so splitting that wasn’t much, but the shrimp and mussels were great!  The steak was good, not best I’ve ever had though.  Calamari was tasty and the Mac-n-cheese was VERY rich!  The birthday dessert (molten chocolate cake, salted caramel ice cream was delish and probably the highlight!

Good wine list too!
Great! Yummy food and the ambience was beautiful. Had plenty left over to take home!
We celebrated a birthday and they made it special. The service, food and ambiance were top notch. The view was breathtaking
Our server , Jeff, is really outstanding!  And the food is always delicious.
Service is great! The view is spectacular! The food is phenomenal! The Dover Sole is the best I’ve ever tried, highly recommended!
Seated 50 minutes after our reservation and service was abysmal. Everything was just super slow, refills, food order, drinks, etc.
While the steak and fish were very good, we had better food and service for half the cost at the other restaurants on the resort property.
Classy ambiance & great food especially the onion soup
Very friendly staff. Food tasted excellent . Fantastic ambience with the balcony fire pits. I definitely recommend this place.
Absolutely wonderful staff and dinner experience.
It was my nephews graduation celebration and everyone and everything was wonderful!

Exceptional service! We went to celebrate newly getting engaged and we were treated with such great service! The food was 10/10, the sat us in front of the balcony which had amazing views! It was absolutely perfect!
Amazing service!  Jose is the best waiter and made the night wonderful!  Food was fabulous as always!!
The food week special was not good. The flank steak was grainy.
Great views  Outstanding service Fantastic food
The service was exceptional and food was delicious. Special thanks to the maitre di’and our server who were the best of the best!
Delicious meal, beautiful view, exceptional service!
The food tasting menu was amazing and spectacular view , the bartenders made custom drinks and they were delicious too.
Great experience. Will be back.

The food and service was excellent. Becky and Melissa were fantastic made it a perfect evening. Had a beautiful view in a quiet corner and a special birthday desert. I had the salmon with snap peas, husband had the bison and the edamame risotto was delicious. Only complaint was that the restaurant was too cold, especially the bar we were freezing in the bar area.
We always enjoy coming here, food and ambience top notch - if you like Dover Sole …. J & G make the best!
Wonderful experience. We decided on the chefs special and everything was spectacular! We will be back.
Fabulous meal with an outstanding waiter, named Jose.
Everything is always amazing. Views are exceptional

Everything is top quality. Raw bar shrimp perfectly cooked, smooth remoulade in addition to cocktail sauce and saltines on request. Caesar salad is solid. The scallops entree was superb cooked perfectly. The standard tenderloin filet very, very tender and flavorful and the au-gratin potatoes a nice scalloped/au-gratin hybrid. Carrot cake creatively made and presented with carrot sorbet!  Wines were excellent and expensive. $380 for two including 3 glasses of cab. For a special occasion but on our visit the spacious patio was closed.
In town for our second anniversary, I got the sea bass cooked perfectly, my wife got the filet a little over cooked for medium. Atmosphere was fantastic. Would recommend.
The food, service, views and atmosphere are outstanding!  Our new favorite restaurant in Scottsdale!

Great service, brought family for a special dinner as we visited Phx.
It was a lovely place with great food.
We had a great anniversary dinner at a beautiful window table.  Our meals and the service were top notch!
My wife and daughter dined here recently and loved it. They said I had to dine there as well while here for a conference.  I’m so pleased to have done so. Amazing service and delicious food!
Great service, nice ambiance. Steak a bit over cooked, not very flavorful. Too much sauces and dressing on both salads and appetizer.  The strong made it nice but food was ok.
Outstanding experience delivered by the J&G staff!  Amazing attention to details, service, and food!  Our favorite restaurant in town.
Absolutely amazing! Perfect steak, sweet, kind staff. Not a thing I would change.

I recently dined at J&G Steakhouse and was thoroughly impressed! The ambiance was elegant yet cozy, making it perfect for a night out. The steak was cooked to perfection, juicy and flavorful. The staff were attentive and knowledgeable, adding to the overall fantastic experience. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a top-notch steakhouse!
Excellent food, excellent service, great view! Highly recommend

We loved the food, service, wine and view. Our first time here, be we will be back and refer others. This is a great restaurant that for some reason never turned up in our searches. What a find - we love it!!!! Ron and Martha
The food and atmosphere at j and g's is awesome. However, it is very expensive.

Came here for a milestone 30th birthday. The the appetizers were the calamari and tuna tartar that were delicious. Followed by Filets, hanger steak ￼, lobster, mac & cheese, and baked potato. Everything was great. The service was second to none!￼

From the time we walked in the door till the time we left this was a wonderful experience.  We were greeted by a very friendly host staff and immediately seated.  Our waiter was prompt, quick, friendly and very knowledgeable of the menu.  The food was outstanding, and the scenery was even better.  The General Manager Mike was exceptional and made the experience even better.  I would Highly recommend.

This is not a moderate option. It is expensive. The food was good but not exceptional.  The views however are wonderful and our waiter was nice. For 3 people with a couple glasses of wine each and tips it was more than $500.
The food was superb. Our head server, Michael, was fantastic. It was a great anniversary dinner that will be remembered.

We had two colleagues here for a couple of days, and they had never seen the Phoenician Resort, so we went there for dinner. Love this place in the Spring and Summer. SO many flowers planted as you drive in and when you get there. Walked around the cactus and art garden, then went to the J&G Steakhouse. Service was impeccable, the food was outstand, and we could hear each other an talk all through dinner (getting so tired in the increase of music at high volume across the Valley). Walked out on the J&G patio to see the lights before heading out. They loved the place and it was a wonderful evening.
The service was disappointing. My husband and I hadn’t been there for a few years. We were very excited to return. It seems our server was more interested in getting us out than having us be served.
The waiter was great and this place is just so beautiful

Restaurant is beautiful but food was not worth the price!Caesar salad was not at all good, dressing was mostly a mustard flavor, hard store bought type croutons, poor quality romaine! Filet was nice however was served on a cold plate so it was not hot when served! The salmon was Very salty, also not hot and very bland! The dinner rolls were dry! 
If you’re looking for a great steak dinner go to Dominick’s in Scottsdale!

We tried some different items from our usual rib eye and a wedge. We were pleasantly surprised. Oysters were fresh fresh and tasty, edamame risotto was perfectly seasoned and al dente, wagyu skirt was tasty and tender accompanied by maybe the best fries ever(kept hot and crispy because they’re served in a cast iron small container) and did I mention homemade ice cream and sorbet? The best
Michael was the best! His service, along with the food and view, made for an unforgettable evening.
Service was outstanding; steak was some of the best I’ve ever had & the au gratin potatoes a must try! Highly recommend!

Beautiful resort and location! Our Server was great but we were absolutely shocked at the prices for what you received. A 3 ounce cocktail $21. The lobster mac & cheese (side dish) at $39 with three tiny pieces of lobster and the rest consisting of very low quality shells and cheese sauce. Each member of our party was provided with one small basic white roll that appeared to be very mediocre. It’s unfortunate that these hotel restaurants feel the need to be so outrageous in their pricing. I guess they are primarily set up for business expenses not the general public.
Living in Phoenix, we often forget the lovely resorts in town. J & G is on the top level of the Phoenician resort. Gorgeous views. Quiet ambiance. Great food and service.  Very special.
Beautiful place , great food and exceptional service.
Beautiful setting, excellent service and steaks.  "pepper condiment" sauce was great for my filet.  Loved the lemony Caeser salad dressing.

We love this restaurant and always go for special occasions. The food was great however, This time the service was not great.
Our waitress never came by to see if we wanted anything. At one time we wanted more wine but she was no where to be found. 
Usually we have had excellent service but this time we were very disappointed.  A restaurant of this level should have attentive service
Five star excellence ! We were treated like royalty.  The food was excellent.  Wow- there is still excellent service out there.

J&G Steakhouse did not live up to hype.  I had heard so many great comments about the restaurant my expectations were high.  I you are staying at The Phoenician Hotel it's a convenient restaurant.  I would not go out of my way to go there while visiting Scottsdale.  There are so many other great restaurants to go to besides J&G Steakhouse.
We had a wonderful dinner tonight. Our waiter was very attentive as was all the staff, his suggestions were spot on, and the food was amazing. The ambience of the restaurant is incredible.
Very nice, good food, good menu, great service by Becky

It was a little noisey.
 Booth table was too big for 4 people.
Too much nutmeg in the spinach
Great service
I loved sitting inside at the round table last night! The lobster shells, cheese fritters, and tuna tartare were to DIE FOR! Amazing service and ambience too. Thanks for a wonderful experience!
Amazing views of the valley at sunset.  We ate in the bar - our server was great.  Menu made deciding on our selections difficult.  Great wine and rum selection.
Our waiter was excellent.  Provided great recommendations and was attentive.
Terrific dinner and fantastic service!  We really enjoyed both our dinners during the week.
Mix delicious food, excellent service, spectacular views of the Phoenix, and you have the ideal anniversary evening. Thank you.
Nothing special and server was very loud and always in a rush
Views are beautiful. Steaks were average. Service was excellent at our table. Bar service was slow but bartender was always polite and curious.
Very good service, very attentive and knowledgeable of their menu. They accommodated my wife & I for our 11 year anniversary and did not miss a beat. Food was perfect with a view to match it.

This was our second time to J & G. The first time was five stars everything was perfect. This time the food was a little off, the steaks were great but all of the side dishes we ordered were bland and needed something a little extra. Everything also lacked salt… will still come back for the view and service, but will try different sides next time.

Michael, our server, was great.  Very helpful and a wonderful personality.  The food was super as well, and you can’t go wrong with a steak at J&G.  This was a business dinner, and I would certainly recommend J&G to others, especially if you are staying at the Phoenician.
Fabulous evening all around enjoyed by our entire party

Juan and Dominik were outstanding as our servers. The tuna tartar was a great appetizer and the presentation of the main course was fabulous.
It was a great place to celebrate our anniversary!
Excellent food and exceptional service. Our server was fun and knowledgeable! Great ambiance as well.

Lobster Mac & Cheese was overcooked and overpriced, Brussel sprouts had pecans thrown on as a afterthought, steaks were cooked ok and flavorful, Sea Bass had a too sweet miso glaze drizzled on and needed to be broiled on, service was great
It was a retirement celebration dinner for my husband.
The manager and our server were both exceptional and very kind. Incredible steak and mashed potatoes! ￼
One of my absolute favorite Scottsdale steakhouses!
Excellent food and atmosphere. Would highly recommend

Ambiance and food were wonderful. Servers were very attentive, though orders were confused. Then our waiter disappeared for 30 minutes after we were ready to pay. No corkage/outside wine allowed, and gratuity included? Not appreciated. Found out too late that our valet was comped.
Maybe we were just unlucky? Still a nice evening.
Dined here for our 21st wedding anniversary. Everything from the food to the services to the ambiance  was top notch! We would happily return.
The food was absolutely amazing! The service was top notch, and the ambiance was stunning.

The Scallops MC, grilled asparagus, and mashed potatoes were outstanding!  Glasses of Duckhorn Chardonnay and Sonoma-Cutrer Chardonnay paired very well with the meal.  The Apple Cobbler was a fine dessert.

The waitstaff was exceptional and the views of the city are spectacular! Though I would love to rave about this place, there were two major issues with the experience.
