First, the team forgot our salads, so our dinner was a little unexpected when it came out…. and second, the steak (a fillet ordered medium rare) was considerably overcooked- I am guessing almost well done. Though I usually would have sent it back, it was a birthday and Valentines weekend celebration and I just didn’t want to delay sharing  dinner with my group.  Given that this is a steakhouse, I would have thought much more care and attention would be made prior to sending a meal out of the kitchen, especially a steak.  I had heard such amazing things about this place, unfortunately the food didn’t live up to the hype.
Food was delicious and staff is very nice! Beautiful scene! Highly recommend dining her!
Fantastic service as always and delicious food!

The bar and bartenders were fantastic.  Once seated service took a very long time I felt like we were being ignored.  My filet was fine nothing special.  The Brussel sprouts were inedible.  The potatoes were the only good thing.  We had to track someone down for another drink and for our check.  In my opinion I would not recommend or return.

Great food, service and ambiance.
Makes for a perfect evening out!
Bad Waiter, very expensive food, nothing special, disappointing desert. Great view from the dining room.
Es un bello lugar con una bonita vista desde el balcón, el servicio y la atención fue muy buena. La comida se demoró bastante al punto que tuvimos que cancelar el último plato. Volvería una vez más
The service and food was amazing had a great time and great customer service I would definitely come back
Seem to be a poor kind of steak. Ordered the New York strip￼ medium, and a came well done
Good food, great service. Manager introduced himself and conducted a pleasant conversation with us. Overall a very nice dining experience.
The meal took 4 hours for a small size group. Food was undercooked and drinks took 45min+. Too loud to hear the person seated next to you to make matters worse
We love this restaurant.  Perhaps, because of the SB, it was very noisy. Last night, which is not typical.  Becki is a great server, and Frank a great manager.
Food was ok but an amazing view and service! It was a nice vibe
Great food and great services. Highly recommended

This is a beautiful steak house, views are gorgeous. We’ve been here many times. The food: steaks were not great, we both had the boneless ribeye. Meat was very tough, lacking flavor. Bernaise sauce was whipped, fluffy, did not have a tarragon flavor. Risotto was awesome. 
We both had Knob creek Manhattan’s, excellent. Only thing to note, the cherries were mushy, not great for an outstanding cocktail. Fabulous wine list, great wines by the glass.
It was a wonderful experience. Food and service was perfect.  Will be back again.
This place is just outstanding. Top notch service, fabulous food and spectacular views.
Our sever was very good and the GM went above and beyond to accommodate. Will definitely go back soon.
Celebrated my wife’s 60th at J&G and staff were excellent, food was excellent, very thankful and grateful for making it a wonderful evening.

From the moment we arrived, we were well cared for by every person we met. Our table was one of the most coveted looking out at the panoramic views of the cities. Dinner was divine! We started with oysters and New England clams and for dinner we ordered the sea bass and special bison steak with chef’s famous au gratin potatoes smothered in Comté. Our waiter, Kevin, convinced us that we had room for dessert and highly recommended the apple compote with cinnamon ice cream which did not disappoint! A lovely 20-year tawny to celebrate the evening and we left with smiles and warm, happy memories. Top notch service from beginning to end!

Very classy restaurant with amazing service! The quality of their steaks were amazing, however, they were cooked as though an amateur chef was on duty. They lacked any form of salt/pepper and were essentially room temp. The $20"oscar style" is not worth it at all. The seafood had to come out of a can and the 1/4 cut pieces of asparagus were a bit odd.

Sadly this place has really fallen off.  A favorite date spot of ours,  the wine list was a shell of what it should be with our waiter telling us “check back next year it will be way better… the reserve list is frozen and we can’t go in there and get bottles.”  In addition to that, one of our steaks was extremely “chewy.”  The food quality seems to have changed and we won’t be going back anytime soon :(
Great location, ambience, staff. Over priced a bit.

Phenomenal service by our waiter, Chris! We celebrated my husband’s birthday last night and we were blown away. I was apprehensive about J&G because we have never heard of the place. Our go-to favorites were booked - Maple & Ash, Bourbon Steak, Toca Madera… J&G will be added to our list of favorites in Scottsdale. We had the most amazing table, right on the glass overlooking the sunset and then the city lights. The bone in ribeye was cooked to perfection. I loved the grass fed filet. The crab cake appetizer was delicious. Bourbon selection was next level! After dinner we headed down to the thirsty cactus where the bartenders were amazing and hung out by the outdoor fire pits. 5 stars all day! We will be back soon!
Chris was a fantastic server!  Greet food and ambience!

The food was all good except for our steaks were very under seasoned. It is quite a bummer to have such great cuts of steak and to not get the flavor you hope for. Our server was VERY slow. She was kind but I expect better, as we were waiting for our check for 20-30 minutes.
Very nice atmosphere. Service was very good. Food was way below average filet mignon 12 ounce very tough and chewy. Side dishes, or just average was very shocked with the quality.
Everything was wonderful. The service, the atmosphere and the food all superb.
Food never disappoints. So happy the bone in filet is back on the menu.
Service was excellent, lamb was a little over cooked. Otherwise, all our other plates were excellent.
We had a fantastic, sophisticated dinner here. Gabe went above and beyond to make our experience wonderful. 10/10 recommend

This place was beautiful!  Perfect steaks, mashed potatoes to die for, choc cake was delish but very small.
Our waiter was super informative and very friendly.
I would highly recommend for your first night at the resort.  Top notch!
Excellent experience!  Celebrated our 35th anniversary and and we were treated like royalty!  Chris was our server and was so friendly and attentive. Can’t say enough good things about this place!

Love this place have been many times

Most times experience was good.  This time on New Year’s Eve which we have had many here not the  first time ! It was disappointing.
Booked in mid Nov for new years well in advance
Had to still wait for a table over 30 min not acceptable!  Staff is very pleasant as always and manager was very nice but steakhouse vibe was not up to its standard and very little staff to deal with the night.  Seems like they had there C team on as the A &B  team must have been out celebrating.  Food was good but way too slow.  Our server was a pleasant older lady but felt sorry for her as she looked like she was covering for a lot of tables so she could not service us properly or come by to check in on us and if we needed anything else.  Because of there understaff C team our 9 pm  reservation took till midnight to finish and pay and thus we missed our countdown to New years at a different location
Cost for the who experience was not worth it as it was an $850 dinner for 4  and 3 hours to get through it
Like I said this is not our first visit and we never experienced this disappointment before.  Best to celebrate new years somewhere else next year if they can’t have there A team
S
Great spot. Prettiest view in the Valley. I have never had a bad experience here and can't wait to go back!
Excellent food and service.  I Highly recommend this

Our server, Daniel was excellent. Everyone here is professional, very friendly and well versed in service. Our food, drinks, dessert...everything they make in house and it was incredible. We had items like Tuna Tartar, their house made steak sauce, in house made cheesecake. All was exceptional.
Dining at J&G Steakhouse was amazing! From the greetings through dinner and afterglow was exceptional!  Highly recommended for any special occasion or holiday.
Outstanding dinner and service! Giovanna was attentive and made our night perfect!
Excellent food and wine along with fantastic views.

This is a great restaurant for any special occasion or date night. The view is breath taking, the ambiance is wonderful, the service is beyond compare and the extensive list of steaks will have you mezmerized as will the bill at the end of the evening, but all is well worth the visit. The wait staff especially Austin were great.
We couldn’t place our order for 30 mins. It took that long to come with non alcoholic drinks as well. The food was decent, nothing spectacular. The service was very slow and disappointing.

The service was slow and not attentive. When we queried about the status of our entries (over an hour since last course),manager said “this is a three hour dining experience “ - no apologies. Food was good not amazing - hotel was actually highlight - great property

Sat us in back ‘cry room’ even though we made reservation weeks ago and normal restaurant space had plenty of seating. Up charged us for wine - we ordered a certain bottle but waiter brought two types out and said they were similar priced, ended up paying $225 a bottle and thought we were paying $80.
Onion soup was lukewarm. Dover Sole was outstanding. Service was great
Everyone is very nice and ￼polite. Beautiful scenery nice place to take pictures. ￼
We did the Classic Tasting menu and every course was delicious.  Service was delightful.
Delicious food, great service, and nice venue. Yummy!

Food and service was exceptional!  Only complaint would be management let a guy wear his ball cap.  Very distasteful for a restaurant of this caliber. Other than that highly recommend.  Austin was a great server.

It was X-mas.  Restaurant was fully booked. Despite this, the service was prompt and attentive and we did not have to an unusual amount of time for the food to arrive.  The Dover Sole was perfectly prepared and was served with Grenobloise sauce that was the best I’ve ever had.  The entire experience was outstanding.

J&G is our favorite place for special occasions.  Third time there this year.  They were overrun on Christmas Eve.  The bar area was woefully understaffed.  Our table was ready 30 minutes late.  But our server Jeff was fantastic and made up for the very rough start in the bar.  And they comped our drinks from the bar without prompting.  The bar server is great - but he was alone with full dinner tables set up for Christmas Eve and a crush of folks waiting for tables.  I felt sorry for him.  Jeff told us that it was the busiest he’s ever seen it in 11 years. Management should have seen this coming.   It the food was great and we enjoyed ourselves.  We will be back.

I absolutely love coming here the service is outstanding the food and atmosphere is worth it the ambience is amazing the scenery is gorgeous everyone I encountered is friendly and helpful the owner walks around talking with us makes me feel welcome and wanted and wanting to keep coming back 😀 thank you so much j & g steakhouse for amazing times

It was so on point so flawless. For many of us, we don’t mind spending that much money. We want to be really great and worthwhile last night so we epitomize that I thought I got a bargain. I think I spent about $480-$500 for dinner and I thought I got a bargain. The service was so professional by Austin. Everything he did was so top top professional, his assistant whose name I did not ask was great at pouring the water taken care of the plates, never intrusive always perfect. The food was presented and prepared so tremendously so delicious and for Mike to come out And gracious with his presence and ask us how it went was so so nice. I just can’t wait to go back this was first class top-of-the-line world class service. What can I say?
Wonderful food. Wonderful service!!  Spectacular view!!
Great service and good view with a very nice view.
Fabulous service and food,  beautiful view.   Top notch👌
Always love J & G! We have never had a bad experience here. Service, food and ambiance impeccable. Thank you!
Outstanding service and food.  The food was delicious, cooked to every guest's preference, and the entire dinner process was a pleasant experience.

I had the most perfect night due to the dining experience here. The staff was so friendly and attentive, directed us, took our pictures outside, and gave us some tasters while our food was cooking. I would absolutely go again! Food was amazing, tasted very fresh and perfect portions.

My sons and I picked the Phoenician steakhouse because when I’m in town, I always take my boys to a steakhouse. We arrived a few minutes early and we set a seat within five minutes.. Jeffrey our waiter and Chris, his assistant or excellent throughout the evening. there was a delay with getting our food because of a large party which was fine. Jeffrey explained it to us now the good part my one Son and myself ordered the 24 ounce porterhouse cooked medium. It was absolutely fantastic tender juicy cooked perfectly we had cream spinach, mashed potatoes and mac & cheese, which were all fantastic. The mac & cheese came out super hot and the taste was perfect. My son wanted calamari as an appetizer which I thought was OK. The cocktail shrimp were good not great but good. It’s the main course at the Phoenician that it’s fantastic. I have to tell you the food was . The sites at the Phoenician were very reasonable. I believe the queen span was $12 as was the mac & cheese and potatoes. That’s a bargain no desert for us just a decaf cappuccino, which was very good. the ambience is nice with seats pretty far apart from other people it’s not that loud in the restaurant, a wonderful view of Scottsdale from the windows. Jeffrey and Chris made sure that our needs met well done Phoenician

Booked an early dinner in order to appreciate the sunset. (it's December) From the moment we arrived we were treated as special guests, made to feel cared for and our every request was accommodated. Including taking our photos out on the veranda. David and Melissa were an excellent team and their service and food and drink suggestions were spot on. Overall a perfect evening that met and exceeded my expectations.

Waited to be seated outside of reservation. 2 of 4 menu folders had no menu inside. Food was mediocre. Sole was not prepared at the table as described and was tasteless. New York steak was tough and overcooked. Best items on the menu were scalloped potatoes and Maryland Crab Cake. Parking validation was invalid upon leaving the parking garage.
ALWAYS good to come here …. they never disappoint
Food was inefible. What a disappointment i do nor recommend.

The evening started well. We were greeted nicely and they acknowledged my husband’s birthday. Sat at a nice table and were promptly greeted by our server. Unfortunately, almost immediately our server was also assigned to a large group that just entered the restaurant. At that point, we felt somewhat ignored, especially after observing how the other servers were taking care of their guest at their tables our servers assistant, Buser, worked very hard to help us, but she had other responsibilities too. We asked that our steak be medium, but it was well done which was a little disappointing but by the time someone came to check on us, we had eaten about half of it. The brussels sprouts were so so. The tuna tartare was nice and the rolls were also nice￼.
For that type of restaurant, I expect a little bit more attention to detail, and at least the stakes cooked to your liking. Because the buster worked hard, I tried to give credit to where credit was due in the ratings.
Outstanding service and great food. The sea bass is outstanding. A bit on the pricey side but worth it.
Thank you for helping us host our birthday dinner. Amazing service and food.

Becky was our server she’s 10/10. Came so often to check up on us. Even offer to take a picture at the back door she was spectacular she’s a keeper!! The food was average. I expected a steakhouse to be 10 out of 10, but our steaks were dry and no flavor, we ordered crispy calamari as a appetizer and It was a bit oily. We also got a mac & cheese on the side but It wasn’t so cheesy more watery side but at least it was better than the steak we got. ￼ I don’t think I’ll come back or recommend anybody, but at least it was worth it a try. ￼
Great food. Had the prefixed Thanksgiving dinner and well worth the value. Will return to try other items on the menu.
Loved it.  Thank you for making our anniversary special.

I have had much better steak elsewhere.  My gilet mignon had no flavor.  I think they gave me grass fed instead of regular without asking me which I preferred.  Was told the sides were enough to share with 4 people and they were not.  Calamari appetizer quantity was also a single portion.  The view was spectacular and we were seated at a very nice table.
Absolutely Fantastic.  Food, service and atmosphere beyond exceptional.  I will definitely be back.
Great environment, staff was extremely nice and helpful. Highly recommend for a great night.

Must have been short cooks because it was 30 minutes between courses
🙏🤷‍♂️

Came to celebrate a birthday and was greeted with a personalized card . 
Jeff and his assistant Aliyah were spot on and attentive . 
Very knowledgeable server- polite and gracious. 
We each had the tasting menu and shared a bottle of Oregon Pinot Noir. 
The food was timed very well and was very tasty. I highly recommend this restaurant for any occasion . 
The experience here will not disappoint.

Kudos Jeff to a wonderful celebration at J&G.

Service was slow.  Drinks were weak.  Rolls seemed to be a day old not soft and warm more firm and cold.  Food was okay.   The restaurant was beautifully decorated for the holidays but other than the ambiance they totally missed the mark with their food and service this time around.
Our servicer was fantastic, food was amazing, the ambiance was inviting, and the staff friendly.

Our experience at J&G Steakhouse was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we walked through the doors, we were treated with top-notch hospitality. Becky, our server, was not only attentive but also kind, funny, and incredibly knowledgeable, making the evening even more enjoyable.

The food? Absolutely unforgettable. The heirloom salad and tuna tartare were standout dishes—I can’t stop thinking about them, especially the incredible Russian dressing. The steaks were cooked to absolute perfection, and the sticky toffee pudding we had for dessert was the perfect sweet ending to a phenomenal meal.

We were so impressed that we’ve already planned to return during our stay. J&G Steakhouse is truly a must-visit!

I came to Scottsdale to celebrate my birthday and we went to the restaurant the evening of my birthday. The staff were attentive and wonderful with their service and recommendations. The food and cocktails went simply amazing! I would come back again for the experience and food.
We had the best experience at this restaurant. ￼ The service was impeccable, the food was delicious and the view is breathtaking.
Jeff our waiter was absolutely outstanding, he made our experience absolutely amazing!
Great meal and service. Everything was incredible! We’ll be back.

Sunday evening in November so the restaurant was not packed but still lively.  Server was attentive and offered good guidance.  Scallops, steaks and the potatoes au gratin were excellent.  The house salad was generous and very good.

Excellent, excellent, excellent!
Food, Service, Ambience!
All the best!
We wentneantingbthe
Food was exquisite and servers very attentive. We enjoyed our evening very much!
It was perfect for our 9th anniversary.  Beautiful location, meal and gracious service.
Excellent food excellent service, really good food

Overall have very mixed feelings about this restaurant. First of all, it was very noisy.  To accommodate our request for a quiet table, they sat us in the bar area. For sure this was less noisy than the main dining area, but not really conducive to what I would call a fine dining experience. TV's on showing Sunday night football with patrons shouting out when a notable play was made. 
Food was very good. We shared a Caesar Salad, Steak, Lobster Salad and a huge Baked Potato. It was all very well cooked and tasty. Service was good. But we had indicated we were celebrating our Anniversary at the time we made the Open Table reservation, but the Restaurant took no note of it. As I said earlier, very mixed feelings. Definitely did not feel like a special restaurant or dining experience.

Austin was the best waiter!! So very knowledgeable, personable, polite, all around nice man. Highly recommend the tuna tartare. Steaks done to perfection! Manager accommodated are table request. Perfect evening snd delicious food. Thank you!

Very special 
Couldn’t fault anything, from the wonderful food to the service.
Highly recommend the lobster

We’ve been here in the past and loved it. This last visit wasn’t the same experience. The quality of steaks were subpar at best and the service was no where near as good as it was our last visit. Waitress was very fast to leave our table without gathering all information and cut and dry. We didn’t get the level of service reflective on the bill. The support staff was sweet as could be and very attentive.
Delicious food, great staff, comfortable and cozy atmosphere.
A lovely dinner !! Great view. Excellent service!!
Had a wonderful anniversary dinner. Everything was great and our waiter, Chris, was wonderful. All were friendly and helpful. Highly recommend for anyone having a special occasion celebration.
Celebrating 11yr Wedding Anniversary! Perfect table to watch sunset and special anniversary dessert treat from the Chef! Exactly the romantic date we were looking for.

The food and service was excellent although the restaurant was fairly empty which didn’t give much ambiance. We were well treated by all the staff and our steaks were cooked perfectly. ￼
There are about five tables in our area that were all celebrating birthdays, and we all sang to each other. It was quite entertaining. We would return for good steaks again.

Absolutely amazing!! We chose to dine here for my mom’s 71st Birthday. Such a special occasion was celebrated in style with captivating views, exquisite food, exceptional top tier service and elegance everywhere. The staff were above and beyond impeccable! Absolutely kind, professional and caring. The delivered luxurious service and the most impressive experience. Truly recommend 10 out of 10!!
Overall very disappointing. Food did not meet all the hype.
Exceptional service, ambiance, food + views. Hard to go wrong here. Everything is delicious and great drinks as well.

I’ve  dined in many steakhouse and am a major investor in one

This was probably the best steak I’ve ever had. Very impressive. Service was outstanding. A little disappointed that they advertise cherries jubilee and actually no longer offering it small issue but was looking forward to it.
Well worth it. I would highly recommend  J &G without any hesitation. Well done
Everthing is excellent about J&G, from the food, the view, the ambience. As soon as you enter you know you are in for a 5 star experience.
Food was top tier! I would love to go back, it’s pricey but so worth it!

Anniversary dinner. Sat next to three thirty-somethings FaceTiming their friends. Every other word out of their mouths was f—- .   They were speaking very loudly with full volume
On speaker. Cell phones should be banned from dining room. Behind us a table of fifty-somethings who had been over served speaking very loudly about their terrible online dating experiences. What happened to decorum in fine dining restaurants? Aside from unfortunate table assignment, the food, which has historically been good was horrible. From the appetizer to dessert, every course was bad. We will not be dining again at J&G. On a positive note, the atmosphere and view are delightful. Not enough to get us back there, however.
Amazing Experience and will definitely be back again. Waiter was great!

Food and ambience were great. Service was somewhat lacking for a dining establishment of this caliber. There was not a lot of attention to detail that I would expect from this place. Our waiter although pleasant did not add to our dining experience.

Had a wonderful dining experience here with excellent service and delicious food.  The view from the patio is amazing and complements the dining experience.  The steaks were tasty and cooked to the proper temperature.  The staff was warm and welcoming as well.
Absolutely beautiful restaurant with superior service.  The filet was tender and cooked perfectly.  The potatoes au gratin were delicious.  Best experience and food in many years!
Wonderful is not a good enough word! We loved it!!!
Thank you, Frank, for taking care of us on our Anniversary. J&G is always an amazing place to dine. The food is spectacular and talking about Chicago with you was a blast!

Spectacular meal , first class service and delicious food. The Sole was the best my wife has ever had, my strip steak was perfectly seasoned and done. From beginning to end one of the best meals we’ve ever had. Make sure to pop out on deck for an amazing selfie! Highly recommend! And Austin and Nathan didn’t miss a beat!
Restaurant and waitstaff was very nice and accommodating. Food and execution of it was subpar, especially for the price
Steak and seafood were great! Sides were always very good! I didn’t like the ginger margarita but my husband did. I would definitely go again!
Always a great experience when I dine at J&G they have a lifetime repeat customer thanks for the love will be back soon..
Great place for a romantic dinner. Great views and some of the best service we’ve experienced in a while.
Service was best in class, great wine options and food was really good too. Bring a wearable in the summer as it can be a little chilly inside with the AC. Great dining experience.
Great experience! Will definitely return and hopefully they will have the baked Alaska next time! Tuna tartare was superb!

We had a lovely Anniversary dinner. Chris, our waiter, was so friendly and personal. He made our evening extra special. The steak (filet mignon) was amazing as were all the "sauces" that accompanied them. The champagne for our Anniversary was a real treat and we finished our meal with your fabulous carrot cake. Thank you so much JG Steakhouse for a beautiful celebration! We also will cherish the photo Chris took of us in front of the pool (on the balcony). Thank you again so much!
Amazing. Cant wait to come back. Had the best time there with my family and kids.
Always a great experience … service and food excellent!
This restaurant was fine but the other restaurants on the property have better service.
Food great, except the bread/rolls served before dinner were equivalent to store-bought.  Fresh-baked would have been better.
An amazing intimate dining experience. Food, views and service were exceptional. Jeff was outstanding, charming, informative and super helpful

The food, service, and ambiance are all that you would expect from a high-end steakhouse. The views were spectacular.  Everyone in the establishment was courteous and friendly. I had the Halibut, and my husband had the Filet mignon. Each dish was amazing. The best part had to be; the restaurant was pleasantly quiet, and my husband and I enjoyed great conversation with our meal.

We will definitely be back!
Always a great experience. Food is amazing and so is the view
Service and food were excellent. We were seated exactly at the time of our reservation.
Amazing view , service , and the noise levels are the lowest of steakhouses in the valley. Steak was cooked perfectly apps were on point!
Staff from the moment my party walked in were angels. Truly an amazing birthday because of them.

I took my girlfriend here and we thoroughly enjoyed the evening.  We were a little early and got drinks at the bar before being seated.  The dining room has a great view of the night skyline.  We got the wedge, split a bone-in ribeye, asparagus, and mashed potatoes.  Everything was amazing.  We finished with desert and earl grey.  The e service from everyone was fantastic.
Incredible dining experience. From the food to the service, we loved it. We stayed at the bar after dinner and the bartending staff was fantastic.

The Phoenician has many fond memories for me but I had not been to the J&G Steakhouse.  The same gorgeous view as the lobby floor but with a fabulous steakhouse.  And the QUIET ambiance will make this a must-go-to for guests as well.

We come here every year for our anniversary
We love the  excellent service and food . Beautiful view of the city. The salmon was delicious however my steak was not . I chose the boneless ribeye and it was not tender cooked perfectly but not great eating. That’s the first time ever  in all the years I’ve been disappointed. Everything else was excellent. Need to change rolls to  focaccia or something else besides the Parker house . Martini was perfect and  not skimpy . Overall great restaurant highly recommended

The service Chris provided was exceptional.  He was friendly, professional and anticipated our needs without rushing our dining experience. Chris also recommended a few of the house favorites.  The steaks and halibut were cooked perfectly and were very delicious.  It was an amazing meal and lovely evening.

We dined at J&G to celebrate my husband's birthday.  Had the tasting menu.  It was excellent.  The service was superb.  Our server Giovanna and her assistant Nathan were attentive and informative about the food and the wines.
Great service and food.  Would definitely go back.
J&G Steakhouse was the perfect place to celebrate my wife and I’s anniversary. The entire staff went above and beyond to make it a special meal. The food, staff, and service were all excellent.
This was the best steak I’ve had in a very long time! I got the 7oz filet. And the view is pretty amazing! Great service!
Becky took great care of us. She provides great recommendations.
Austin and Melissa were outstanding. I had my 2.5 year old son with and they did everything to make us comfortable and entertain him!
Great food, service and atmosphere! I will definitely return!
Loved everything about this restaurant! Can’t wait to return
Your experience here will not disappoint! Go during sunset if you can, well worth it. $1M views! Best dover sole in any western state. Really great dining experience!

We were here to celebrate our anniversary. The attention to detail was nice and the food was amazing. Austin was our server and he brought us a special anniversary dessert to our surprise. Such a great experience!
You pay for the view, service and delicious food. If you want to spoil yourself or someone special, J&G will definitely do the trick.

The food is absolutely outstanding, you can really tell the chef puts his heart and soul into ever ingredient in the dish, and the presentation is amazing. On top of all that you have a beautiful view of Phoenix from camelback mountain
Amazing food and equally amazing service.  Food flavors were delicious.  Food was perfectly cooked and every attention was given to detail.
When we visit Scottsdale we always make a stop at J&G one of our favorite restaurants!

Its always a lovely experience eating here. Staff are extremely knowledgeable, helpful, and, friendly. The seafood options are wonderful. I normally get the whole lobster, and, it's always prepared wonderfully. My hubs normally sticks with the steaks, and, he has never complained. And, of course, the view is spectacular.

Wonderful service and wonderful food. The icing on the cake was the view. We were thankful to be there when they had live entertainment which was great. Added to the calm and enjoyable vibe. Had a great time
Delicious as always. J&G has been our go to for years and favorite spot for steak. Never disappoints. Service is great as usual too
Excellent food and even better service. We were celebrating our anniversary and they made the evening special.
austin  the waiter did a great job, service speed was right on , never waited for a course

Exceptional anniversary experience-
The team here did a fantastic job curating our experience for our wedding anniversary and ensuring our children had a great time. Our server was excellent and we will be back!
Our waiter Jeff(sp?) was incredible, he really made our night!

Amazing meal with my friend. Good wine, oysters to die for, ribeye, and wagyu meatballs among other things. Jeff our server was exceptional and it’s a joy to be remembered. The team there is fabulous and the view is spectacular. Treat yourself!
Excellent food, service,  and view. Great for date night.
... phenomenal meal, refined ambiance & unhurried attentive service atop the Phoenecian with breathtaking views across the the East Valley ....
Wonderful setting with outstanding view. Fabulous food. Best of all was the service. Our host Mike was on point from start to finish. Our server, Becky was excellent. We look forward to returning.

It was an amazing experience! We love this restaurant, the food and service is top notch. We appreciated greatly the wonderful service by David and the GM Frank! Thank you for creating such a memorable experience at your restaurant
Staff was great. Setting was great. Food, way overpriced and not very good at all.

Our party of three had a fantastic experience at J&G. The service was excellent, and the chef uses top-quality ingredients. The oysters, lobster, clams, shrimp, and mussels were exceptionally fresh and well-prepared. The Wagyu beef was tender, moist, and full of flavor. This is classic cuisine at its best, offered at reasonable prices. We will definitely return. The Phoenician is fortunate to have such a talented team at J&G Steakhouse.
Great terraced view and Service. Like all Steak Houses in town now, prices are Excessive.
The ambience and service were great, but the food was subpar and overpriced.

Jeff was an absolute rockstar of a server for the evening. We came with 2-very tired young kids and he made sure to get them squared away with drinks + food. Cocktails/wine were great and food (from apps of oysters to Ceasar salad to main course of filet mignon and Maine lobster) was great as well. Jeff was very busy but he always made sure to check in on us. Thank you for a great evening!
the steaks were not cooked properly everything else was just okay
Chris was the most gracious server. Attentive, knowledgeable, and catering to our needs and requests. Above and beyond with excellence, and with so much class.
Beautiful restaurant with exceptional views!! The food was amazing! From our starter, Tuna Tartare to our steaks that were cooked perfectly! Staff and servers were wonderful too!

My wife and i had a wonderful meal at J & G. Steakhouse.  This was our third time dining there and we have enjoyed the food, ambiance, stunning views, great service and amazing food. Highly recommend you dine there for a special occasion or if you want a delicious meal with friendly and attentive service in a non stuffy but opulent setting.

J&G Steakhouse has become our FAVORITE restaurant in Scottsdale for a fine dining experience! The overall attention to detail from the management to wait staff to chef's staff is second to none. It's very apparent the whole team has a great care for their performance a d environment. We have dined here now 4 times since the beginning of the year and each time has been a five start experience!

We have been to most of the fine dining environments in town during this same time, and this has been our favorite place repeatedly. The combination of the exceptional service, delicious fine dining food, and beautiful resort views are the best in town.

We have enjoyed our time here so much we have even chose this establishment for our WEDDING DINNER. HIGHLY RECOMMEND giving this place a try as they are clearly dialed in to excellence in 2024!

It was awesome! They helped celebrate our 49th anniversary and gave us a free dessert that had Happy Anniversary on it!  Giavona was a fantastic server and she was assisted by Nathan who took a picture of us for us and was also awesome!  The general manager came by and gave us his card.  Great place to eat!!  View was beautiful!!  Can’t recommend this place enough!!

Steak was not cooked properly and had poor taste. Server had zero personality and although we asked well in advance for a good table due to celebrating wedding anniversary we got a table facing a post and had to ask to be moved.
Great service, great staff  and great view. Food was just OK for a high-end steakhouse.
This has become one of our favorite steak houses now that we’re local.  All around 5 stars…great food, great service, great atmosphere.

I was expecting a comparable experience to what we have had at Capital Grille or any other upscale restaurants. First and foremost, we were very overdressed for a smart, casual dress code. In addition, everything took an extraordinarily long time, including water service. Capital Grille as an example, water will be a quarter of the way down and someone will come by and fill it. By the time someone did come by and asked, we were already closing out our tab. Our waitress was friendly, but again everything took a considerable amount of time. In addition, the potatoes probably had at least a full stick of butter melted on top of an already buttery mashed potato dish. We ordered half a lobster and six oysters which were tasty. The other thing that I was turned off by was that the manager was very chatty and friendly with every other table and ignored us nearly the entire time until finally he realized  that he should try his best to be cordial. In comparison to the experience we had the night before at Buck and Rider, this experience at J&G was a disappointment.

My dinner at J&G Steakhouse at The Phoenician was exceptional. The ambiance was sophisticated with stunning desert views, and the service was impeccable—attentive and well-informed. The meal itself was outstanding; the Tuna Tartare was fresh and flavorful, the lamb chops were perfectly cooked, and the sides like scalloped potatoes were decadent. We finished with a divine warm chocolate cake. Overall, it was a flawless dining experience, and I eagerly anticipate my next visit.

J&G made are Anniversary very special ! When we were arrived we were congratulated on are anniversary . Every one said hello and welcome us . The seating was beautiful with a spectacular view ! The ambiance  was just right are waiter Jeff was on top of it took care of so  well . The food was absolutely amazing cooked to perfection! Thank you so much for making are anniversary and are evening such a remarkable night !

Fantastic location and service. The restaurant is located at the top of the Phoenician with great views of the valley and resort itself. My wife and I had the tasting menu and really enjoyed it, and we were especially impressed with the flavor and presentation of the cheese ball and corn ravioli. We chose to do the wine pairing as part of the tasting and were underwhelmed. We enjoyed the champagne to start but were very disappointed in the Pinot Grigio that followed. With hindsight we would have preferred to order a bottle of wine instead. Great overall dining experience, we thought it was relatively pricey though.
Love J&G… it’s in our top 2 of steakhouses so far in the greater Phoenix area. Perfect attentive service, great tasting steaks and accompaniments. The view is amazing…
Always feels like a special occasion whenever we come here.  Ambiance, service and food are top notch.  Thank you.

Amazing as soon as we entered the restaurant.  Spectacular view, bartenders were fun and knowledgeable, and the meal and server were outstanding.  I've been to all the best in Scottsdale, and this is definitely top 3.  We will definitely return!

Overall it was good but the steak that my wife &  I ordered medium well (pink on the center) was over done and a little tough! For grass fed beef from Australia it was not high quality. The lobster was good, french fries were great, salad was good, margarita’s were excellent. Server was good, ambiance was very nice!

Great experience, Laurie W and Richard are an amazing team. We couldn’t have asked for better service. The food was fantastic and made with perfection. Overall we loved our experience and will definitely be making this a regular visit.
An absolutely amazing experience, the food was incredible and probably the best service we have ever received at a restaurant
11/10 reccomend this hidden gym.  our server was awesome.
Food was fabulous and so was the service. Becky did a great job, taking care of us and was well informed on menu items. ￼

I had the lobster, and, it was delicious. Hubby had the grass fed filet Mignon, and, said it was excellent.  We had creamed corn ,and,  the salt and pepper baked potato.. both were excellent. I had the shrimp cocktail, great. Hubs had the wedge salad. His opinion, it was ok. We shared the cherries jubilee...yums
Great ambiance and service. Great place to celebrate a special occasion. Will definitely be back.

Great! Food was delicious. The diver scallops were a perfect addition to my wife’s steak. Loved the crab oscar on the filet. Ambience, cocktails, and scenery- some of the best in Phoenix metro. We went for my wife’s promotion dinner and we’re glad we chose J&G to celebrate at. Would recommend 10/10
Amazing as always! We love the food, service and ambiance
Excellent meal and service! Highly recommend the filet and au gratin potatoes!
My favorite restaurant in town!! Always great food and service.  Thank you

From the moment we stepped in, Frank the manager, greeted us and welcomed us to the restaurant. We had an amazing view of the hotel grounds and city from our seats. The serving staff was personable, friendly, as well as professional. We felt the food was absolutely delicious. Being such a nice restaurant, I felt the value was also much better than I had expected.￼

Outstanding experience. Started off with a martini in the bar. Gabe was a pleasure as he informed us about certain tequilas and good convo. Then Jeff and Quinton took great care of us in the dining room. I had the Sea Bass and my wife had the salad and Lobster Mac & Cheese. All was exceptional. Great view, great service and delicious food made for a wonderful night out in Scottsdale!

First of all , the elevator from parking garage to restaurant is unbelievably complicated .
the restaurant have a nice camel back mountain  view but the only soup on the menu is not available for the night and food is just ok , i can get better service & food quality for the price I paid .
Beautiful views and amazing food. Staff isn’t very accommodating to the neuro divergent
Great food with a phenomenal wait staff. Would return!

i’ve been to the steakhouse number of times in the past. The past two times I’ve been there. It has gotten better and better than the last. It is fantastic. There have been some significant changes to the service and food that have made all of the difference. Of course you cannot beat the ambience in the view.
Staff was fantastic.  Ambience was lacking a little but we had a great time and food was great.

Beautiful space with a lovely view. The food was perfectly cooked and the ginger margarita was delicious. Our server was so lovely. We were there for an anniversary and they definitely made us feel special.

We have been dining at J&G for years, both when we were staying at Phoenician, and now that we live in AZ. It is a top notch exquisite dining experience. The view is spectacular, and the food is amazing. It is on the pricey side with everything Al a carte, but for those special times, highly recommend.
Usually a great experience, but this time both our steak and baked potato were undercooked

The restaurant was fantastic.  Great food and atmosphere.  The views looking out at the city and mountains were beautiful as well.  It’s an expensive place to eat, but worth it for a memorable dinner.

Everything about this visit was fantastic, and I mean everything. The hostess was friendly; bartenders were helpful and pleasant; wait staff was efficient, offered great suggestions, and was very attentive. Even your support staff (we used to call them bussers, but I don't know the terminology now) were polite and attentive. Without question, this is the best run establishment I've ever visited. Your management staff is doing an excellent job. 

And then there's the chef. The attention to detail in every little thing is amazing. The other staff speak with reverence about his ability to select cuts of meat. Every single thing we ordered was absolutely fantastic. This may be the best meal I've ever had.
This was the best experience! Anazing views and amazing food! Service was excellent.

Wonderful views and a delicious dinner! The tuna tartar is a great starter, enjoyed steak and sea bass (highly recommend if you like seafood with a little kick), and the chocolate cake is a perfect small portion. Staff was super friendly and professional and gave perfect suggestions. Great for a date night:)

We are staying here and they told us it was really good so we decided we’d go. We aren’t very pick eaters but I would advise not to eat here. It was not worth $300 that we spent and we left hungry. The lobster was slimy and cold, Mac and cheese and lobster Mac and cheese were not even fast food grade. French onion soup was inedible. The service was alright. Don’t waste your money and go pretty much anywhere else. Super sad because the restaurant and resort itself are gorgeous and we loved everything else about it.

We had a fabulous evening at J&G.
We are on 3 and a half week road trip through the south west to celebrate my 59th birthday and had chosen J&G for our ‘slap-up’ birthday dinner and are so glad we did - thanks to all at J&G for making it so memorable.
Service was impeccable throughout and special thanks to our server (apologies for not remembering his name - he’s the former Grand Canyon rim-to-rim runner!) for great wine recommendations and for ensuring our steaks and scallops were cooked perfectly to our liking.
The combination of the killer sunset views, perfectly pitched live music, attentive service and some of the best steakhouse food we have eaten in the States (and we’ve previously eaten at many landmark restaurants in both the North East and Texas) made for a perfect evening.
If we’re ever lucky enough to visit Scottsdale again we’ll definitely be back - thanks again.
Staff was amazing Food was really good. The view was amazing from the patio. Drinks were tasty!

Hi. Food was not hot.  My so called Waygu was charred.  So dry and tasteless. Couldn’t eat it.  They actually could of used any meat since it was blackened n charred.  Fries were dry and cold.  My gf food was taken away and never boxed up.  They made her a new one to take but still. 
All food served was just ok. 
Not hot.
We can’t wait to get back to J&G. My wife was so happy about the full experience
Such an amazing experience and Mother’s Day. Hands down the best staff/hospitality that I’ve ever had in Phoenix since living here. 10/10
The food was delicious, and our waiter as well as the others helping him did an awesome job! Drinks were great too! We had sole, filet mignon and a ribeye. Sides were broccoli and potatoes au gratin.

Great food  

Greatest crew

A very goid experience

Wonderful view from the top of the Phoenician Hotel.  Service was friendly and attentive.  Portions were large.  Only disappointment was the fois gras. However, the restaurant graciously took it off the bill without even asking.

Had grass fed 7oz filet and my wife had lobster. Had calamari for appetizer. It was good boy great. Calamari had a heavy breading and dipping sauce we didn’t love. Lobster needed heavy butter for flavor.
Excellent Steakhouse!! Filet was so tender. Service was impeccable. Thank you Chris! So very nice that they acknowledged our special occasion—engagement of our grand daughter!

Outstanding cordial service.
Tried the Tuna Tartare, and Cheese Fritters as appetizers: Elegance in every bite!
For Entree: The Miso Sea Bass…Great pleasant surprise for a Streak House!

Service was wonderful.  Manager, Mark, introduced himself as soon as we sat down and also came by to do a quality check after our entrees arrived.  He personally asked for my valet stub and had it validated for me.  Our server was always available but not intrusive.  I live nearby and will be back to enjoy J&G soon.

We loved this beautiful restaurant with delicious and well prepared cuisine. The wait staff is very professional and knowledgeable, but also very friendly and welcoming. The ambiance, beautiful decor and stunning view make for a very special dining experience. Of course we had steak and it was tender, flavorful and exquisitely prepared.
Excellent service. Excellent food. Great views. Wonderful dinner
We waited three hours for food. Something happened and the manager kept coming to the table apologizing
Chris was amazing accommodating for our toddler and the food was exceptional
Food was very good but still over priced.  Back room is not as nice as the rest of the restaurant.  Service was excellent

First timers for us to try the J & G Steakhouse! It was a great experience overall! My wife and I went to celebrate our 39th Anniversary.

We had a great meal, (we each had our own filet mignon), cooked to perfection.
Cheesy Potatoes and Asparagus, all great
Service was great, thanks Michael J!
The bartender made me a "Boston" Whiskey Sour...Great!

We didn't get a table right by the window to really soak in the fabulous view of the valley... but maybe next time.
Outstanding restaurant with top notch service and management.
Becky was a wonderful server.  We had a great experience.   We usually dine here every time we come to Scottsdale.
We had the prix fixe menu. Everything bite was delicious, especially the asparagus risotto!

Well this was the flagship restaurant here at the Phoenician
I must admit everything was spectacular
The grilled bone in filet was matched by a slow cooked
Wild salmon with rhubarb glaze
All just delicious
The starters of littleneck clams and tuna tartare was amongst the best I have had
Kudos
I’ve been going to J&G for years and I still think it’s the best restaurant in Phoenix.  The food and service is always perfect.
Great staff and excellent dinner. Overall five stars

This was by far one of the best dining experiences we've ever had. Our server, Austin and the rest of the staff were very courteous and knowledgeable. Only thing that would have topped it off would've been if the outdoor patio was open to sit at but the view was beautiful and the food was amazing especially the rolls, NY strip and cheesecake! Would 10/10 recommend if in the Phoenix area.
I highly recommend  J&G Steakhouse. Excellent food, service, ambiance etc… Perfect establishment for celebrating special occasions or just an evening out.
Really a superb experience at the Phoenician resort in Scottsdale.  Great design and ambiance.  Excellent menu variety and quality of food and beverage.  Outstanding service and good value for the $.

Everything was great from the cocktails through the pairings with wine
Our waiter Chris was awesome
Tuna Tartare and Dover Sole were outstanding.  Broccoli was an excellent choice for side.
Perhaps the best service and dining experience I’ve ever had at a high-end restaurant, and I go to many of them. I would like to commend the staff for service that went above and behind.￼
Great food , service, and overall fine dining experience !

Everyone there gets it right! Service is spectacular, the food is absolutely magnificent and delicious, and you can’t beat the ambience and views for a beautiful night out. Thank you to everyone for making this such a special place to go here in PV and Scottsdale
While the restaurant was lovely and the food was good, the service was ridiculously slow. It really took away from the meal and the evening. Overall, I would not go back.

Sad setting with scarred wobbly table with no table cloth. Heavily used glassware. Poor drink preparation. Cold risotto. Wines on list not available. Only highlight was well cooked filet. Halibut was awful with horrible overpowering mushrooms. Desserts were also sad.

Nice valet parking service though.

Beautiful venue with scenic views, but gets loud when entertainment begins.
Very attentive service, but request for medium rare filet was more like medium.
Very comfortable banquette seating, and romantic atmosphere
Mike and Suzanne were incredible all throughout, can’t thank them enough
It was our 20th wedding anniversary and wanted something special with a view that made all the requirements the way we were treated and the food was excellent

I am originally from NJ. We have excellent food there. Arizona in my opinion, not so much however!  J&g’s is amazing!  The bone in rib steak and the scallop potatoes are better than any steak house I’ve experienced in NYC. Except Peter Lugers 🤣. Seriously the best in the valley. It is a pricey restaurant but no more than I would expect in NY or at any fine dining restaurant. We loved it!

The restaurant was gorgeous and they had great service. Drinks were pretty good! However, the food was disappointing for what we paid. Underseasoned and over cooked filet, etc. Out of a table of 7, everybody was disappointed with their meals. :(
Been here several times! One of my favorites in the valley!

My girlfriend and I spent our 5 year anniversary here, I have requested a table with a view of the sunset and for a nice quiet intimate spot. And they have exceeded my expectation of my request. This is a very elegant and romantic spot to, have a nice evening. I will always recommend this place. Thank you for your service and making this a memorable date for us.
Fantastic dining experience! Would recommend to all my friends and family. The view was amazing.
Delicious food and fabulous staff. Went with husband and three kids (14, 12 and 9).  It was a beautiful view. Menu was fantastic, steaks cooked to perfection.
Amazing! Delicious! Lamb and Seabass were delightful. I can’t wait to go back.
Incredible wine tasting and pairing, one of the best dining experiences I’ve had so far.
The view is great, food was good, service was very good!
We had a nice dinner and a lovely view. It was still light out, but imagine it’s better at night seeing the night lights.

Muy recomendable lugar para cenar,  todo
Lo que ordenamos delicioso, me gusto mucho la ensalada de heirloom tomatoes, también recomiendo los calamares para empezar y el salmon espectacular. El servicio impecable, todos fueron muy amables haciendo mención especial  de la mesera que nos atendió.
Es un lugar para regresar.
We have amazing drinks, food and service. The views were phenomenal if you go right before sunset. Can’t wait to go again!
My steak was over salted, but was quickly remedied with a new one

Best dining experience of my life! Our server, Chris, and the manager, Mike, made my husband’s birthday dinner the most memorable yet! They went above and beyond to celebrate our birthday boy, as well as to accommodate my gluten sensitivity. This is our third timing dining at J&G, and we are looking forward to our next meal there because it is truly superb!

Delightful dining experience.  So much so, that we took a bigger group later in our trip.  Steaks were excellent and cooked to perfection.  Our waiter was exceptional.  The hostess even accommodated our larger than expected party.

One of our favorite dinners in a long time. Jeff, our fabulous server complemented our dinner with his personality, knowledge, authenticity as these were valued and only enhanced our experience. The salads, oysters, & the halibut were off the chart good along with my husband’s steak. Individually pairing with bubbles and red wine….what else can be said, delicious & memorable!!

Outstanding service from server Jeff, who spent plenty of time with us describing wines and food. He is a real pleasure and was welcoming and helpful throughout. We took his suggestions and had superb oysters, followed by the best tuna tartare we have had. Then sea bass with an amazing, tasty crust. Jeff made sure we relaxed and enjoyed a leisurely dinner in a setting with a gorgeous view. A wonderful start to our stay at this gorgeous resort. Thank you Jeff

I ate here while I was in town for work. I asked to be seated outside and the hostess stated that outdoor seating was full for the evening. Three other parties were seated outside after I was seated indoors. I mentioned this to the manager and he didn’t have an excuse for the employees behavior. Additionally, there was a baby screaming for almost 20 minutes two tables over from me. It seemed the restaurant staff was very adamant about seating all guests close together, I assume to make it easier on the wait staff. The experience overall was terrible. Although the food may have been good, I couldn’t enjoy it due to the loud screaming baby and the unfair treatment by the hostess. I would never dine here again by choice.
Wonderful food, beautiful views, excellent service, and great experience.
The wait staff at J&G went well above and beyond to make our anniversary dinner special! The food was amazing, great champagne/wune/cocktail list and wonderful ambience!
A nice quaint steak dinner with a great view. Definitely would go back.
Awesome night at the restaurant. Service and food was awesome

We had an excellent experience at J&G. The meal was cooked to perfection. Service was outstanding. We’ve been customers of theirs for many years and we’ve never been disappointed. Granted it’s pricey but well worth it.
Beautiful restaurant and fabulous live music. We had a great time

Want to open it up with a recognition of the staff and hotel. Incredible staff and great hotel. Really wanted to love this place, but the food and overall cost was frustrating. Steaks cooked very poorly for being a so-called “steakhouse” and incredibly pricey. Appetizers were poor and watery, especially the soups. Would not recommend getting any soups here. Sides were also very watery and flavorless. Don’t mean to write a negative review here, but the food was horrific. We were really excited to try the food, but extremely disappointed by the food and cost. Food was very, very bad and they somehow found a way to cook each cut of the steak in a worse way than the previous. They might want to add some flavor next time. Not sure if it was a one-time experience, but you could not pay me to come here again. I don’t know if I would’ve paid $20 for it, much less $500. Loved the service, place was fine, but food and cost were not there. Thank you staff, but cooking needs to be fixed; along with the prices. Wish this place the best. Incredible hotel, one of the best, but place needs some reworking.
Excellent steaks. Great shellfish. Jose was an excellent waiter. Great experience.
Yummy food with exceptional service and a beautiful view!
Excellent service, delicious food - would recommend 10/10
Amazing restaurant and experience dining at J&G!  The staff is amazing, we love Becky!
Fantastic food and ambience. Our server,   Suzan, was amazing! She was warm, friendly, professional, knowledgeable, and attentive. Highly recommend!!
Excellent all around. Staff so friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. Very attentive. Pretty views and nice and quiet atmosphere. We had the tasting menu with wine pairings. Highly recommend!

Food was descent but the service was terrible and the only plus was the Shrimp Cocktail and wedge being good. Steak was not even as good as what I’ve had at Texas Roadhouse to be honest, not worth the 250$ for my lady and I. The view was pretty and our waitress was nice but just awfully slow and didn’t care for us at all and seemed to be very fake towards us, exhaling and rolling her eyes etc... We are a young couple but make great money and we felt judged for being young, felt like the people there weren’t used to a young and successful couple. I wore a collared shirt and boots with nice jeans and was side-eyed the entire time, just zero hospitality. I have been to at least 15 steak places near this level of $$$ and none have treated me nearly as bad. Never going back.
Outstanding meal ….  I would go every time I’m in Scottsdale
Exceptional in every way.  Service, food, and environment always meets or exceeds expectations

Friendly and attentive staff without hovering. Remembered food allergies and did not need repeated reminding which always makes the evening more pleasurable. Steak and seafood selected were cooked properly. Really lovely gluten free dessert that wasn't just ice cream or creme brulee made the evening extra special. Will book again next time we are in Scottsdale.

Absolutely Amazing Best Birthday Ever!
Highly recommend
The food, service and ambiance were all excellent!  Even the bread was beyond the ordinary!  Beautiful views atop the Phonecian.
The atmosphere was very professional and calm! 10/10
They made our anniversary so special! Such a great place to celebrate any little/big moment

We had the most wonderful experience! Every ounce of food was incredible!! The golf carts were backed up so we made it to our reservation late on the property. The staff welcomed us with a bottle of Prosecco for the inconvenience and were so apologetic! They went above and beyond even when the transportation issue was not their fault. The waiter/waitress was so kind and welcoming and we literally had the best night! Will definitely be back on our next trip! Thank you for a wonderful evening!
The steak was messed up numerous time.  Finally just had them return it and take it off the bill.
Exceptional views, food, and service! A must do for dinner if you’re in the area.

Great experience all around.  Food was fantastic, the service was great and it was a wonderful birthday dinner for my girlfriend.  Even got a complementary dessert at the end.  A great restaurant for a special occasion.

The ambience is perfect. A window view overlooking the city lights and the beautiful property. Our server was absolutely fabulous added to the experience!! The value was very good. Drinks were made well..
It was an overall great night and a great experience
We had a wonderful Anniversary Date night experience. Very attentive and food was amazing!

My sister and I enjoyed our last night of our girls trip at J&G and loved the experience.  Excellent food, we had oysters and calamari for appetizers and Sea Bass for the main course.  The toffee pudding for dessert is to die for.  Great restaurant and worth the money!
We had an absolutely wonderful dinner for my post birthday celebration. The staff could’ve been nicer and the drinks were excellent.
Had a very special night for my husbands retirement dinner. Thank you for the wonderful food and memory. Everyone was excellent at thier job. We will be back!
Beautiful experience service was amazing,food do great and tasty...
Great views. Great service and great food.  Servers were very attentive.  Made a birthday celebration special!
Outstanding from start to finish. Best filet I’ve had in a long time. Server was the best.
Great service, great food. We will definitely be back!!
We had excellent service, friendly staff, delicious food. The steak was cooked perfectly and appetizers were delicious.
It was a very nice time with excellent food. The vibe was very nice and it felt calm as we ate. This place is outstanding and definitely recommend.
The ribeye’s for the price were very chewy. The noise level due to a large group was obnoxious. A group that size should have either been in a room or away from other guest. We couldn’t even talk.
Great steaks with Superior service. Chris, our waiter, is at the top of his profession.
The steak was disappointing. Service was amazing!
Definitely a good place to enjoy a romantic dinner

While there found a cricket in our drink towards the end of our meal. Yes an actual damn cricket. Should have taken a photo because the floor manager tried to lie about it after he took our drink to the back to inspect it, for a reputable 5 Star Restaurant expected a way better experience and was definitely not expecting something like this to happen. The server made my woman feel uncomfortable the entire time after we said something. Great atmosphere and amazing views, but for a first time experience. Not the way I wanted it to go especially for a valentine’s dinner date.

Amazing dinner with exceptional service!
Highly recommend based on food and views!

Our server, Becky, and the rest of the team were very friendly and attentive. Great group and great spot for a nice dinner. Frank, the manager, was present and checking tables frequently and was a super nice gentleman. They absolutely lived up to the hype!
We always stop into the steakhouse whenever we are in the Phoenix area. It’s probably in the top three steakhouses in my personal opinion. The staff is excellent and the food is amazing.
Excellent service and the food is always great! !!
Service was great food was disappointing especially for the price. No flavor and chicken was rubbery. Will not be back.
Service & management was so increidble! we had an amazing time and food was so good!
Food was awesome, everything was brought out quickly and the staff was extremely polite and quick to check on us. Great restaurant.
Excellent service. The ribeyes were delicious. The salads and sides are big enough to share.  It was a great experience.
We enjoyed a wonderful meal. Austin was our waiter and made it a special night. Can’t wait to return.
Great view.  More menu selections than most top-end steakhouses.  Food was perfectly prepared.
Better than ever!  We go back whenever we can, and are grateful for the smooth service, the delicious food and the friendliness of the staff.

My friend and I enjoyed a wonderful dinner at J&G Steakhouse in The Phoenician. The hospitality here is outstanding. Our server Austin was a Rockstar professional. Flawless service and hospitality. The food was amazing and prepared to perfection. The Chef here has talent and the flavor profiles of the food we enjoyed were well balanced and delicious. The host Samantha was gracious and welcoming. Two managers Frank and Mike both spent time talking to us and making us feel welcome. This is how an experience at a fine dining steakhouse in a beautiful resort should be. I highly recommend dining at J&G Steakhouse.
Stellar service, Amazing food and the perfect ambience for our special day!

Everyone was on point at The Phoenician and super helpful and had correct information no matter who you asked. The J&G Steakhouse was amazing! From the drinks, to the bar tenders, the gorgeous views and the food, everything was fantastic and perfect.

Birthday dinner with my love. Absolutely one of the best dining experiences ever, and I’ve traveled all over the world. I can’t think of anything I would change. A drink at the bar because we were a little early and a great hostess to seat us. That was followed by fantastic service, a greeting from the GM and a spectacular dinner. This is what fine dining should be, amazing at every turn!
Waiter seemed drunk more interested in hanging out with large tables.
A lovely spot for a birthday dinner! Every dish we had was delightful.

We had the most memorable and amazing evening! The service was IMPECCABLE from the moment we walked in. Our server Jeff went ABOVE AND BEYOND as well. The food and drinks were delicious, but if we didn’t have Jeff, the entire experience wouldn’t have been what it was. He rocks and we hope to come back having him as our server again in the future.

Bill presented and thankfully I looked as 20% was automatically put on but there was no mention of that when presented the check.   Service was not acceptable and the one order out of 6 was sent back due to wrong cut of meat vs the actual order.  I was there a year ago and it was stellar but not now.  Probably the reason there were tables available.
Great drinks, great food and great views. Went for a birthday celebration and they really make it special
Our waiter, Jeff knew his stuff. The food was excellent and the service provided was exceptional. We had the tasting menu with the wine pairing and would highly recommend both.

Excellent dining experience from start to finish!  Chefs special Bone in Filet was seasoned and cooked to perfection!  Lobster and Au Gratin Potatoes were delicious.  Hands down best wedge salad with strips of bacon and a dreamy dressing, if we thought it could get better we were served dessert for our anniversary..molten chocolate cake and a salted caramel ice cream that quickly became top desserts in our dining adventures.  Our server was so attentive and friendly.  Fabulous evening A+++
Worth the wait. Arrived early needed to sit until staff ready. Wouldn't recommend a 5pm reservation

Apptizers - Scallops were not grilled enough. French onion soup was very basic. My bone in filet was nearly well done and wifes was MR and both ordered Medium. At a steakhouse like this you have to nail the temps. Brussels were not good at all. barely any lobster in the mac. Had carrot cake and server asst says ice cream melted im sorry. WTF! Go get new ice cream!! Server was good but pace of meal was very slow.

I think it could be a great experience with this special venue, however, they should have sold small plates.  Have a fixed menu to not overburden the kitchen  The hors d'oeuvres were anemic.   I heard people asking if they can order food.    The wine, however, was excellent.   They should have a qualified marketing or wine maker from the vineyard to talk about each varietal and pairing with food.  I've been to a number of these around the valley and was disappointed at this one.   Charge $25 more per head and feed the people and have a good wine rep there and, lastly, I wanted to buy some at the event and No Go!!!

Wonderful experience
Great food, done perfectly
Excellent service, great views while dining

We booked a 645 pm reservation.  We were promptly seated and greeted by our server Jeff.  He was great. He advised us on several selections.   We placed appetizers and our meals at 7:15 pm.  Appetizers came back reasonably quickly.  However our meals took over an hour. We were served at 8:30 pm.  Quality of the food was very good.  We felt that the kitchen was extremely slow! Several servers checked on us and were friendly.

The overall view and quality was great.  We were offered a complimentary dessert as it was our anniversary.

Evidently the kitchen had lost our main course orders. We were waiting forever! We watched other tables that had been sat well after us receiving there main courses. We spoke with the serving, manager and then the server again and there response was it would be another 15 minutes, which was more like an hour. We were entertaining a very good client from the UK and the dinner was an absolute disaster.
Exceptional service was provided by all of the staff that interacted with us. The wine and food were exceptional, as well. When in the area next, we will dine here again.

A high end steakhouse should have excellent food and amazing service. This place has neither. There are only four cocktails on the menu and the bar lacked the ingredients to make two of them. Even getting a canned beer took ages. The fish and steak were good, but the sides were a mixed bag. In summary the place is either lacking staff or lacking management oversight.

My cousin and I enjoyed are wonderful dining experience.  The food was fabulous and the service was excellent.  Austin, our waiter, knew the choices, ingredients and verified all was right.  Great views and ambiance as well.  Definitely would recommend.
Outstanding in every aspect.  I can’t find anything to say negative about this place.  Great grass fed filet.  Outstanding sides.  Service is always exceptional

Consistently amazing culinary experience. By far, our favorite restaurant in the east valley. However, quite disappointed that the tasting menu is now only available if the full table orders it. I will never eat that much yet my husband has always enjoyed it.  Especially with the wine pairing. Was told that it’s no longer allowed post-Covid. What does that even mean?!?  Let me tell you - it means the chef has become too important to accommodate his/her guests. We would have spent far more had they accommodated us - oh well.  The manager, Frank, is a wonderful addition to the team and goes above and beyond to ensure each party receives an experience. But even he couldn’t make the tasting menu available to us.  Our waiter was new - talked a LOT! Got the order incorrect. He has much to learn, hence 4 stars for service.
Really enjoyed our meal, service was excellent and the ambience was good. A little loud at time as there was live entertainment but on the whole a most enjoyable experience.

Great from start to finish!  Beautiful view and our server Chris was fantastic!  We split salad, filet - which comes with three delicious sauces - and brussel sprouts!!  Excellent.  Great wine list as well
Great service and excellent food.  Beautiful restaurant to celebrate our anniversary.

I had a very nice business dinner at J&G steakhouse. The service was excellent, the food is commensurate  with some of the finest steakhouses I’ve ever been to. Don’t let the fact that this is a steakhouse in a hotel dissuade you, this is truly an exceptional restaurant. All of the staff were kind, responsive and just overall excellent.  The view at sunset is amazing!
Calm and very quiet place to for an intimate dinner date! Totally worth it depending on your reason for the visit!
For the mebu price, the meal could contain more veggies, when served, not just two pieces.

My fiancé and I went to J&G’s for our 6th year anniversary. We ordered the sweet and sour pork belly app, slowly cooked salmon, filet mignon, half order of lobster, and the warm chocolate cake. Everything melted in your mouth. The flavors were incredible. The people were very kind and attentive to our needs. If you haven’t been, YOU HAVE TO GO. 5 stars across the board
Fantastic meal, service and setting. Highly recommend.
Very nice spurge or for a special occasion.  Very good steak and service was outstanding
Excellent service by Suzanne. Perfect meal great wine pairing recommendation. Had a spectacular evening and beautiful setting.

We went fNew Year’s Eve which we have done in the past, but this time was disappointing. Our food was just okay and one of our steaks was cold. It appears our main course order was not put in timely so it was very delayed. Everything was just off. We had guests in from out of town and we wanted them to have e good experience and it just did not happen.
We didn’t get seated on time and waited almost 40 mins to get our dessert. Poor service and overpriced food. Would not return.
Enjoyed the overall experience . The steaks we had were amazing and the view was excellent. It was a great way to celebrate the new year.
The entire evening was great. Service, food and atmosphere were perfect. Highly recommend this for a nice dinner occassion.
We had a wonderful dinner for my sisters birthday. The servers gave her a card when we were seated and brought out gluten free bread and dessert for her.

Great experience! It was a great evening
Service was exceptional and food was delicious. Thank you for the great service

Won’t be back   Was seated at a table all the way to side that had no ambience, sleepy part of the restaurant, near the side service door   Super small pours of wine, like half a glass, for $39 per glass   Just felt ripped off and won’t be back

Overall excellent experience. We loved the seasonal butternut squash soup we had for our first course. The grass fed filet entree was delicious. Perfectly prepared. We thoroughly enjoyed everything, the ambiance was great, live music and amazing views. Excellent service topped off the evening. Highly recommend.

We stayed at the Phoenician the day after Christmas and booked J&G for dinner that night. The experience was excellent.  Service is as you would expect, highly professional and attentive. We asked for a wine suggestion and it was perfect with our meal. We started with the crab cake, and oysters which were both terrific. I had the Filet, hubby had the Prime NY. My filet was truly exceptional, my husband didn't care for the NY which was disappointing since it was prime. Apple cobbler for dessert was delicious.  Overall, I highly recommend J&G for an excellent dinner experience.
Our server was fabulous! Food was excellent! A must when in Phoenix!
Chris is a terrific waiter!  Very knowledgeable, and was very helpful and assisting me with selecting my dinner.  I decided to do the tasting menu.  It was outstanding!!

Our table was so dark you could not see the food or the people at the table.  When we told the waitress she laughed and said “this is our darkest table”.  Made for an awful experience with family we hadn’t seen in a while.
The food was cold, the person who delivered it didn’t know who had which steak but said “they are all well done”.  Uh no, we asked for medium.  Steaks were cold and overcooked.  We asked for steak sauce and they brought everything but the sauce we asked for and the waitress said “everyone likes these sauces”.  But that isn’t what we asked for!  For an upscale restaurant this sure didn’t deliver.  Oh, and we checked in at 5:25 for our 5:30 reservation and were told to sit in the bar and “have a drink” while they prepared our table.  When I finally went back ten minutes later and asked why we had to wait for a 5:30 reservation when they were seating others she said “our waitress wasn’t ready”.
Such a beautiful place. Our waiter,Scott, was very but not overly attentive. The food was all done the way we asked. Especially enjoyed chilled lobster and shrimp cocktail. Made our Christmas
Wonderful dinner for Christmas Eve and our waiter was amazing! The Tuna Tartare and Sea Bass were amazing.

When I book for a special occasion, being my wife’s BD, I am not doing that to get a free dessert, but rather to get a nice table. We felt like being in the middle of a cafeteria. The first two wines we ordered were out of stock even though one was supposed to be available by the glass. So wine did not arrive with the meal. We received the heel end of the last by the glass bottle, about 3 oz each to hold us over. The server told us then about 5 times how we were not being charged for the glass of wine ( but of course were for the bottle we ordered in replacement) and reminded us incessantly that we were getting a feee dessert. Subtle as a crutch that she wanted to be tipped more. Food was OK. Table side server was untrained. Very much miss the tablecloths. We just felt that standards that used to be superb have now lowered to decent hotel standard. We have been many times before, but not rushing back.
