Good resort restaurant but not worth a trip for a special night out.

Good for the most part, except waiter forgot to put in one of our side dishes and once we told him he disappeared for a while….and made no offer to offset the mistake….that was disappointing , but was otherwise good…
Food was the most delicious, cooked and prepared, presented perfectly. Servers were attentive and helpful.

First time dining at this restaurant, heard a lot about it from friends and acquaintances, but never tried. Came couple of days before Christmas Holidays to soak up the festive atmosphere, and try some delicious food.
First of all, huge applause goes to the waitress Jiovanna who took care of us, along with Norman who helped clean the table. The waitress treated us like family, provided us with fabulous recommendations, constantly kept checking up on us, and comped us a dessert when my husband was not very pleased with his meal. She made the entire dining experience very special.
Food was interestingly enough fabulous, and very mediocre, at the same time.
Sea bass dish our waitress recommended was absolutely incredible, whether it was infused with butter and spices, or cooked in some sort of magical delicious way, it is unknown, but I tried the fish all over the world, from Moscow to Amsterdam, but never tried anything like this. Lobster Mac&Cheese was fantastic as well.
My husband loves meat, and of course, being at the steakhouse, ordered a steak. It was not prepared correctly, and to his satisfaction, hence waitress comped us a dessert. Overall, nice ambiance and superb service, not so pleased with quality of the steak, everything else was great.
If you’re not looking for a fabulous steak at the steakhouse, well worth the try/other dishes.
Not a cheap experience, but Everything except the steak, was worth the price.

Food was good (not great). Broccoli was a bit undercooked and one of our sides was brought when we were already half way done with the meal. Restaurant was VERY noisy and didn't have the elegant feel that we expected.

J & G's Steakhouse was amazing! The ambiance is so relaxing and the view from the restaurant is incredible. Our servers were attentive and very nice. The food was very good! I highly recommend the splurge for this if you want a nice restaurant in Phoenix. I hope to go again in the future!

We know a great steakhouse and this is not one! Not worth the money. Steak was cold, server was like a robot with no personality, no ambiance, just overall disappointed and it was also my Birthday dinner. We loved the resort though.
Outstanding meal, service and ambience. Caesar salad was excellent and steak was perfect.
Food was delicious and service was great definitely would recommend.
Food & service was excellent.  Noisy because of the openness of the restaurant.

Enjoyed a holiday dinner date at J & G Steakhouse. Overall, a lovely evening. The hits include excellent service, and a great wine list. The misses include the French onion soup which was a major flop, and our entrees (lamb and sea bass) were fine, but nothing notable. We would return for the view and the service.
The food and service were EXCELLENT!  Aside from the VERY loud and at times inappropriate large party of people behind us who were obviously over served it was a perfect meal

Good was good but the service was the worst we’ve ever had there. They weren’t insanely busy so not sure why we waited 15 minutes for a corona. Oh well. Paid too much for the meal to have slow service!

From the moment we arrived until we picked up the car from the free valet service, everything was perfect.

The hotel and restaurant were expertly decorated in a traditional holiday style.  The menu was creative with something for everyone.  The staff lead by Manager Frank was exceptionally well trained and authentically friendly.

Of course the food was fresh and well prepared.  Overall we enjoyed  a wonderful dining experience.  Thanks
All around it was a great experience. The quality was great and the service was excellent.
Exceptional restaurant.  The grass fed filet is amazing.  Service is impeccable.  Views around sunset are awesome.  It’s a little pricey but worth it.

Best experience ever!
Becky our waitress was a Gem! She made the whole experience amazing! Quentin (not sure if I’m spelling his name right) cut our steak beautifully and was so thoughtful and attentive.

I can’t recommend this place enough. It was one the best experiences I’ve ever had.

For all the hype, the experience of eating at J&G is incredibly lack-luster.

The staff is incredibly enthusiastic and friendly, and the service was exceptional.

There was live music in the bar area, which at first seemed great. However, we were seated fairly far away and the music was still so loud it was difficult to carry a conversation at the table without constantly asking each other to repeat what was just said.

The menu is really why this steakhouse is not my favorite. Nothing on this menu stands out as signature to the restaurant or special. We may as well have eaten at Outback for a quarter of the price.

The kids menu is incredibly basic: pasta, grilled cheese, chicken. There are no options for children to have a high quality meal unless you order from the adult menu.

We got the chilled shellfish platter to start. It looked lovely, but really was not great. The condiments were lacking and overall this dish was a disappointment.

At our table we got the salmon and two different steaks Oscar style, grilled asparagus and roasted mushrooms. Everything was cooked alright, nothing was over the top delicious.

We passed on desert as nothing really stood out.

Overall, we had a nice time and decent food, but we will not be returning. This restaurant did not impress. There are plenty of other options in the area that have the wow-factor this restaurant is missing.
Thank you for making our engagement so special! It was the best.

We have been long time returning guests at this restaurant. I was disappointed by the noise and loud ambience. There were screaming toddlers, and a general feeling of some chaos. The food is really good, but there have been really no changes in the menu in the last few years, so I was a little bored. It is always been my go to for my anniversary, but I think I’m gonna try something else next year ￼￼
Fabulous service, wonderful drinks and food. Gorgeous view.
One of the best restaurants I’ve been to. Greta Food, service,ambience . Our waiter Jeff made it even a better experience . Thanks !

From front to the waiter to the food runner 
Amazing service
The food was excellent. The vibe was great with amazing views.

Excellent service, good food and environment.
Crab legs are in good quality
Love the service, food and views. They have da special greeting card ready for our anniversary. Highly recommended for special occasions.
Our server needs some additional training with communication and manners.
Waiter was amazing! Food was okay. Views incredible
Steak was great.  Chicken was fabulous.  Mac and cheese was on point, and honesty I could have went for the Mac and cheese and been satisfied.  Staff was very attentive.
Most beautiful views I have had at a restaurant! Food was amazing. The sea bass is to die for a definite must try! Amazing date night/ special occasion spot!
Professional service from Jeff exceeded expectations, backed up by the world class kitchen’s sourcing, execution and presentation!
Great food and superb service. Ambiance is fantastic and noise level is low making the the dining experience relaxing and enjoyable

We had the most amazing anniversary dinner!! From the moment we arrived the Manager & hostess welcomed us in wishing us a Happy Anniversary! David our server an all the wait staff were fabulous going over an above the norm to make our evening special!! Our meals with fantastic & delicious!!
Thank you

Disappointed  
. 
Waiting for a call back from the manager to share the details of our experience.
Michael is a great server, intuitive and very engaging.  Food quality was excellent.
AUSTIN is the best. Top tier server. He knows his job and does it well.
Moscow mules were weak so got a double and couldn’t tell the difference from a single
Food, Service and Surroundings were all excellent - highly recommended.
Outstanding food, great ambience and great service
Great meal.  The Dover sole and sea bass were excellent!  Service was great.  Definitely would return.

Do not miss the tuna tartar - their signature dish.   Grassfed beef filet was delicious, perfectly cooked and one of our party had a birthday and they gave us great complementary desserts, Service was spot on, and they moved our table away from a noisy party, which was great. Austin provided great service.   ￼

The ambience and service were second to none but the French onion soup was not their best. The lamb and Brussels sprouts were notable and the lobster was slightly over grilled .
Definitely a repeat but reticent to visit the French onion soup dish again.
Food and service was outstanding. Had to wait 15 minute for our reserved table. Complimentary drink for the wait would have been nice.
Looking forward to eating there again! Everything was delicious.
Very lovely evening. Service was excellent. No room for dessert. Diffenily be back.

The sides were significantly better than Mastro's (we were there last week).  The restaurant was run better, too!  The steak was amazing (especially with the crab & asparagus on top! This was our first time, but not our last!

I love the ambiance of the Phoenician. It’s a beautiful resort. We were married yesterday and had our wedding dinner at J&G Steakhouse; everything was perfect. The service was outstanding. Thank you for a lovely evening.
Excellent drinks, food, and service. Always a wonderful time when in.
Great service, amazing views, great service. Definitely will be back
Good food with a great views of valley and city lights
Austin was a great server and very attentive throughout our meal. It was a great experience!
Service and food was great. Looking forward to coming here again next time we are in Scottsdale.

We spent Thanksgiving brunch here (first time ever visiting the Phoenician) and it was outstanding. Impressive selection of dishes and everything was delicious. We ate at lest $300 worth of caviar which alone was worth the price. Elegant, quiet, and just perfect.
Great food, views outstanding and the service top notch. Overall a great place!!!
Place is the best steakhouse in Scottsdale. Food, great wine selection and the service was outstanding! Will be going back for sure

We had a lovely evening!  The food and service in the dining room was excellent. 
The only disappointment was when we went to the couches in the bar for an after dinner drink, we waited 10-15 minutes and decided to leave because nobody ever came to ask for our order. 
Other than that, everyone and everything was outstanding!

Great dining experience! My husband and I dined here for our anniversary and truly enjoyed our experience. If you arrive before sunset you can take in some of the best views you can get in the valley. Their Mezcal “loosey Goosey” was the perfect blend of smokey, spicy and sweet. We both loved the Filet mignon and ordered the grilled asparagus and mashed potatoes…all were spectacular! Our server David was very kind and treated us to a anniversary dessert. The ambience was perfect for a romantic evening. Will certainly return again!
Food, wait staff was outstanding. There was nothing that needed to be improved upon. We are making another reservation shortly.

I made a reservation for my girlfriend's birthday and everything went flawlessly! 

Atmosphere is classy, pristine, and comfortable. The hostess was very flexible in accommodating seating preferences (I would definitely recommend a window table considering the view). Our server, Chris, was kind, attentive, and very considerate of my girlfriend's dairy allergy. 

All of our food came out fresh and hot, cooked well with excellent flavor- I would especially recommend the pork belly appetizer. We also received a complimentary molten chocolate cake to celebrate. 

Excellent experience overall.
Lobster and Steak  were way overcooked. Sides were very average.

Honestly I have been to many fine dining restaurants, many even more pricey than this one and often Michelin Star. That is one thing I will give them, the prices were reasonable. The food was ok also for the price point and the view was nice.

What wasn’t so nice was the service. We arrived early and they weren’t able to seat us early, which was fine. What wasn’t fine though was they basically forgot about us and when I went to check in if we were still going to be seated for our original reservation it seemed like I was bothering them for asking!

The waiter was nice but clearly overworked. He did not check in on us frequently. When we were done with the food and wanted boxes I asked him for some and he said he would box it up and we watched as he worked getting desserts for other tables for about 10 minutes. Finally, we had to ask another server to help as we were ready to go. I know he was busy, but mngt should anticipate having additional staff on hand to make sure the guest experience is not impacted by having less staff.

Overall, based on service - I’d not return or recommend.
Brought back great memories of a birthday party we had there several years ago, working with Elena Torres. She was truly outstanding as a planner.
Always the best of nights out!  Michael our server was terrific!  The food was to die for!
Our server was fantastic! The manager also came and greeted us multiple times. He didn’t have to but he did to make sure that my daughter and I had a good time. For sure will be a return customer!

My steak was not good, I ordered a boneless ribeye medium rare and it was well done, everything else was outstanding. I will definitely go back and I will definitely recommend it to friends and family.
Thanks

Everything just perfect. Food outstanding—we shared a large NY sirloin, Brussel sprouts and chopped salad. Steak was one of the best we’ve ever had. Cocktails excellent as well. Gratis dessert for my wife’s birthday also great.
Service from David and his team was impeccable—great advice on the steaks, attentive throughout the meal and expert carving of our steak tables-side
Atmosphere and views spectacular.
In short, this is the perfect special occasion restaurant.
An amazing meal.  Great service.  A perfect evening with a stunning view.
Service and bone in ribeye were both amazing. Would highly recommend.
Very disappointing. Food was overpriced and mediocre at best. So many better choices in the area. Save your money.

Not the same experience or quality food as other $$$$ steakhouses in the area. We ordered everything at once yet waited almost 30 minutes between appetizers and entrees. The calamari was a tad chewy, the steaks were basic, the 1/2lb Alaskan Crab order was much smaller than we have had elsewhere, felt like a joke. We had a birthday dinner and service staff did a great job bringing our our cake.
Way over priced for unremarkable food.  I had a very chewy lobster.
Very nice environment and the food was excellent. Great venue for a large gathering or event.
We always go here when in Scottsdale,  never disappointed..

Great views with beautiful ambiance. The service was impeccable from start to finish. The food was all delicious from the raw bar to the steaks and sides. Highly recommend for that special dinner occasion.
The best steak house I’ve ever been too. View is amazing! Waiter was awesome! I will definitely be back! No question!

Jeffrey was our lovely host/server and he made us feel so welcome, as did the entire waitstaff team. The hospitality was evident the moment we walked in the door and the space is BEAUTIFUL! We were stunned with the views from every table and how they look out onto the scenery; there is truly no “bad” seating. The food was excellent - Jeffrey coursed out our meal and although we had to leave to catch a show, we felt like our experience was still so special. We had the sea bass, filet, french onion soup, macaroni and cheese, and the truffle fritters. Wow. The wine list is also impressive and Jeffrey made great recommendations for a red. From one service industry person to the whole team at J&G’s, THANK YOU. We will be back!
We celebrated our wedding anniversary of 36yrs here.  We had a very tasty dinner.  Chris our waiter and all assistants were very pleasant. Really lovely view to top it all off!
Food was delicious, must try the Waygu. Drinks are strong and good. Views from the restaurant is beautiful, definitely at night. Great place for a romantic date night.

Service was great!  Wine selection is great! Food is a tad over priced but that’s a resort restaurant for you. A bowl of buttered noodles and a side for kids is $15.00.  My child wanted an additional serving and when our server went to ask the chef if she could ring some penne in a la carte the chef told her he would make more penne but he was still charging me $15.00 for only pasta.  I actually laughed imagining how pompous the chef is to have a policy like that!!

We celebrated the last night of my sister's bachelorette for dinner on a Sunday night. The service was above and beyond our expectations. Our waiter made us feel special and important. He made excellent recommendations for wine. The food was so delicious!! If you are a steak eater, I would highly recommend. The view was also unbelievable, really added to the ambience.
Excellent experience that made an enjoyable evening. Thanks,
The service, food and atmosphere were exceptional!!

from the moment our waiter Jeff greeted us. We knew we were gonna have a good evening. He was awesome. The food was magnificent. It was a lot of fun. I will go back. We had everything from shrimp, cocktail, salad, steaks, lobster, espresso martinis. Everything was fabulous. The best thing was the green apple tart cobbler. Whatever it was called it was amazing ￼
Excellent food, great service, and a wonderful location.
We had the tasting menu and it was great.  The wine list was deep and we found some values.   Service was excellent
Service was slow. Wait time time between appetizer and main course was long
Nice waitress. Good food. Not too loud but good atmosphere.

This was a bit of a surprise.  I had not dined at the Phoenician since 1990, so basically a "new experience".    The location is quite picturesque at night.    A casual elegance is perhaps the look J&G has.    Our server was very attentive and knowledgeable and the staff overall very polite and very professional.    When I asked the location of the men's room, a staff member literally walked me to it!    The food was my big surprise.  The tuna tartare was fantastic and unique.   Almost EVERY fine restaurant is serving this dish these days, though not like this one.   The sauce highly unique and ultra thin radish slices a perfect way to top it off, literally.    I had the grass fed ribeye and it was divine.   I'm a huge steak lover and enjoy 3-5 of them each month.   This was amongst the best I've had anywhere.
The food was excellent and the staff was amazing. Definitely worth the experience and you can’t beat the view this restaurant has to offer. My husband and I can’t wait to go back!
Amazing experience, servers have great attention to detail. Gave my mom a fantastic birthday experience. The food and service 10/10! Highly recommend

Our experience at J&G was fantastic.  The steaks were cooked to perfection, the salad fresh and tasty, and wine list was great.  The service was attentive and personal.  The dining room is beautiful and we were seated by the window to enjoy the gorgeous view.  (We had wanted to dine outside, but that option wasn't available the night we were there).  To top it off, the prices weren't exorbitant for a high end steak house.  Would definitely go there again.
Our server Austin was great.  Steaks were perfect temp.  Apps and side dishes all perfect.

Our experience started off super well and then at the end we felt like we were forgotten about. I loved my dish (sea bass) but my husband’s steak was dry and chewy. Views were awesome! It was a dinner experience with two stories.
One dinner plate, steak, was overcooked. Should never happen in a steak house.

If you’re in to fine wine this place has one of the best selections worldwide. Menu is great service is impeccable. 

Ck1

The food was pretty good, but not exceptional; for instance, it we had a 12oz filet. The filet itself was seasoned nicely, cooked perfectly, but I realized it missed that nice carmelization (grill marks) that I would have expected from a grilled steak, which is what the menu said.

The worst part was that dinner took 2.5 hours for myself and my wife. From the time we had an appetizer (cheese fritters) to the time we got our steak was about an hour in total. We were never told why, they didn't offer us anything for it, and our server kept kind of trying to avoid us. (I will seem, our server's assistant was REALLY funny and engaging, and she was delightful).

I have to say, we stayed at the Phoenician, and dinner was the only low spot for the stay. My wife in fact said "I'd love to come back to the Phoenician, but probably skip the steakhouse."
No comment…steak was over cooked and forgot several items on the order

This was such a disappointment. I have dined there twice before and had excellent meals both times. This was a special occasion with my daughters and granddaughter  to celebrate two birthdays and it was a splurge for all of us. 

We were seated promptly, and the appetizers came quickly and were  very good but it was downhill from there. We waited over an hour for our food, and there was never an apology or indication of what was taking so long because they weren’t very busy. I ordered the salmon and specifically asked for medium+ and it was not even warm when it arrived. I couldn’t finish it. The Brussels sprouts were underwhelming and not  warm either. Two of the girls ordered the parmesan crusted chicken and although it was OK, certainly not worth ordering again. One daughter did enjoy her steak however.  The shrimp cocktail was good as well as the oysters, but the rest of the entrées and side dishes were definitely subpar. Will have to think twice about going again.

We love J&G and enjoy celebrating milestones or even just doing a special date night at this restaurant.  We were there recently and had an excellent experience.  They were extremely busy but you wouldn’t have known it.  Service was top notch.  The food (we ordered heirloom tomato salad, steak, shrimp, carrot cake) was fantastic!!  Best steak we’ve had this year.

I was delighted to hear the server say Jean Georges.  I’ve been to Jean Georges inside Aria in Vegas so many times and this place has a very similar menu.  The service was a little slow at first but my date and I enjoyed the conversation time we had.  The bread was ordinary but fresh made.  We split the tomahawk and it was phenomenal.  I got the sticky toffee pudding and she got sorbet for desert.  Our cocktails were great and the bottle of Malbec was outstanding.
Service was good, food not so much.   Had the chicken, and there was nothing to it.  No sauce, or flavor.
The view and ambiance were incredible.  The wait staff was very fun and accommodating.  We would go back again.
Had an amazing time!  The food and service was impeccable!

Beautiful facility and setting. Upon arrival we’re seated at very good table but when a large group arrived and was seated next to us the noise level became overwhelming. Kudos to the staff, however, when without solicitation our waiter offered to relocate us mid-dinner. Superb service will lead us to return despite some downsides on this visit.

Beautiful location for drinks but our dinner was awful.  It started with the water girl, she spilled an Out a half glass on to my PAPER placemat.  This is not a white tablecloth type of place.  Steak was not prepared as requested so they took our shrimp and lobster back to the kitchen to keep warm, steak was returned medium well but was lukewarm, no sear looked almost gray.  There was a fly the entire dinner and they had no remedy.  Dinner was just ok I would not recommend.
A beautiful venue, outstanding service, and the perfect medium rare steak.  Fantastic restaurant.

Very ordinary dining experience. Staff though efficient are not polished, at least not for a property of this standing.
As a steak house this was so a disappointment as the food was very average.
The cocktails lacked imagination.

Was quite disappointed with the heirloom tomato salad dish. It’s quite tasteless snd could probably added Balsamic glaze ir something, in my opinion.  
The peppered steak my partner ordered was ‘ok’. The Halibut I ordered was ok, I think it’s a little overdone, not quite ‘melt in your mouth,’
I had halibut the last time I came and was amazing! Not the same experience this time around.
All in all, enjoyed the atmosphere, and the company I was with. I think the prices are very high for what they are worth. 
We wont be back. 
Thx
My birthday celebration was exceptional there! The service and food amazing!
The food, service, and view were all absolutely outstanding.
Great dinner! We had the tasting menu with wine pairings and our server Becky with the good hair was fantastic!
Nice restaurant, very good food, very good service
Sat at bar waiting for our table. 8 staff members a round us never ask if we wanted a drink. Sat at 8 pm and waited one hour for our meal

The "Drops of Saturn" cocktail was really good, had 2!  The homemade angel hair pasta was bland, needed at least salt.  Our steak and halibut were excellent.  Cooked perfectly.  The salt & pepper baked potato was okay.  Did not like the creamy corn.  Service was a little slow.  Was a very nice experience.
Very nice spot!  The tuna tartare appetizer, side mushrooms and the service were fantastic!  Our entrees could have been warmer, prices pretty high.
Loved our meal at J&G Steakhouse at the Phoenician.  Service was lovely.  If you go, you have to try the tuna tartare!!! Simply amazing.

We were immediately seated and we had glasses of water within two minutes.  The bottle of wine, a zin, was a nice lightly chilled temperature (NOT room temperature, THANK GOD!!!!) . Our orders were taken and delivered within a few minutes. The steaks and sides were perfect. Our water glasses were never empty. However, as good as the food and drink was, the service was simply exceptional. Giovanna was absolutely stellar. When we go back to J & G, we will ask for her specifically when we book our reservation.
Great place!  Great food and amazing staff! Beautiful view.
Suzanne is an amazing server. She made sure we were taken care of and had a memorable birthday celebration. Thank you to J and G for making it a wonderful and delicious birthday dinner!
Loved the atmosphere, food and service. The view at night is lovely. Simple, clean dishes that taste outstanding.
The food was delicious and the service was great.  They even surprised me with a birthday treat!

Steak was poorly cooked. I ordered the bone in ribeye. It had no sear on it and came out well done. I sent it back and requested medium, came out again with no sear, rare and barely any seasoning. The manager took it off the bill but was a bad experience overall.
WOW!! Everything from the service, ambiance to the food was amazing. J&G steakhouse should be on all foodies menu 🤤

Bartenders and drinks delightful! Beautiful view and ambience. Delicious food. The only reason I rated the experience poor was because of the service. The server was abrupt, inattentive, passive aggressive and seemed annoyed by our party. If I come back and she is assigned to my table, I will ask for another individual. In all fairness, every other experience at J&G has been great and this seemed to be an off evening. The GM of the restaurant called me as soon as I logged a complaint and has committed to making our party of 4 whole.

i had high expectations for this place because it was recommended by few friends. the pricing wasn’t worth what we ate. lobster was dry, and we waiting 2 hours for our food when the place wasn’t even packed
Best food and service we have had in a long while. Our server Jeff was phenomenal!
Really enjoyed the city lights from the patio area
This iconic restaurant never fails. From the minute you walk in are transported to a beautiful and memorable dining experience.

Noisy kids everywhere running around the restaurant. No white tablecloths, but definitely white tablecloth pricing. The food was ok, not bad, but definitely not worth the price. The view from the restaurant is what makes it tolerable. I might go back just for cocktails or appetizers at their bar to enjoy the view. Servers were polite and attentive. We were disappointed in the food quality.
Outstanding dinner experience!  Good, service, and atmosphere were phenomenal!

This was my first dinner at J & G and it was fabulous! Oysters were some of the best I have ever had - mix of east and west.  The salmon with carrot sauce was amazing, the sauteed spinach was delicious and Becky, who helped us, was friendly and recommended the best cocktails (Ginger Margarita). The views of Paradise Valley were beautiful too. A definite repeat!

The best birthday dinner experience I have had. Service was fantastic, loved our waitress, so kind and attentive. We got sat with a view just as requested. They even made me feel special for my birthday with a card and dessert. I recommend to anyone wanting a special dining experience. Will be back again! Thank J&G!
Food is really good, but service can improve for sure..
Very consistent, food and service is top notch. I had the lamb, wife had steak. It’s our go to special place.
Excellent food and wine menu. Great staff. Highly recommend if you’re staying at the Phoenician!
Oh my gosh!  The food was fabulous.  View was outstanding.  Service was outstanding.  It was a wonderful experience for all.   We will be back!!

Great food. We loved our steak! The service was excellent and all the staff were amazing! It was my husband and I’s wedding anniversary and the staff made us feel really special. The ambiance was also very romantic.

We had out of town guests who were visiting Scottsdale for a long weekend the first time after their marriage and we wanted to make an impression.  After taking them to the sites of Carefree/Cave Creek, a day in Sedona and a home cooked meal, we decided a dinner at one of the finest resorts in town with a magnificent view would be the perfect way to end their stay.  

The drinks were divine, the appetizers enjoyed by all, the main courses prepared to perfection, served by an attentive and friendly waitstaff.  I'd noted on the reservation we were celebrating a special occasion of the recent marriage of our guests although this was apparently either not noted or no special arrangements are made to accommodate such occasions which I'd been anticipating.  Regardless, the four of us had an enjoyable meal and evening.

A wonderful evening starts with the view and the comfortable distance between tables. The waitress was most understanding of the 3 and 8 year old wanting to verbalize their own orders. We received our drinks quickly and the Potion 9 was fabulous. All the meals arrived timely and cooked perfectly. Waters filled quickly when needed as was frequent checking on our satisfaction and additional requests. Yes it was expensive but a wonderful evening for all our family.
Great service, delicious food and awesome views!  I would definitely return.
It was very good food, and very good service. Highly recommend this to anybody.
The obvious is the view. It was spectacular. The steak was spectacular and the service was spectacular.  That’s all I got to say about J&G.  We will be back.

Food was ok but not worth the premium prices. Creamed spinach literally seemed like warmed up frozen spinach with cream poured over it. Utterly flavorless. Entrees were fine but really nothing special. The view is nice.
Exceptional food and ambience. Attention and sincerely friendly server Becky made it beyond 5 star!!!
An absolute awesome night. Service was top notch and food was off the charts. Very much recommended

I came here to celebrate my 7-year anniversary, and they did not disappoint this was one of the best steak houses I've had to pleasure to experience. Jose was phenomenal at guiding our experience throughout the night. Our meals were extremely delicious and wonderfully plated. I would highly recommend this restaurant to any loved one. Jose was able to provide wonderful recommendations and assisted in making this night truly special. The whole staff celebrated our anniversary from the front desk leading all the way to receiving the bill at the end of the night. To finish our meal they brought out a special dessert and I was blown away by the taste and complexity of the dessert. Jean-Georges lived up to his name with this restaurant; this was a truly unique experience and I look forward to coming here for many more years to come. The views from the balcony were incredible while enjoying the meal and the night exceeded every expectation.

Our server, Austin, was attentive. Our steaks were cooked to perfection.  The fries were the perfect amount of crispy deliciousness.  Our other sides, sautéed spinach, and creamed corn were perfectly prepared.  All in all, it was a lovely celebration of our friends' anniversary.  We will most certainly return.
Amazing experience for my gfs birthday! Awesome service and delicious food!

Simply the best restaurant in the PHX/Scottsdale area. The food is exquisite and the service is impeccable. It’s not just a meal - it’s an experience. We’ve been dining here for years and it’s always a ‘must go’ when we travel to AZ.  If you’ve not been- book a reservation, you will not be disappointed.

This place was amazing. The ambience is elegant and romantic without being over the top pomp and circumstance. The waitstaff took time to know my name before they came to the table and they were very knowledgeable about the menu. The food was absolutely amazing. My wife is pescatarian and also eats very clean so it's hard to find places that serve seafood with great flavor without using salt and butter. J&G did an amazing job. Great atmosphere, great food, and great views of the city. Highly recommend it!

My wife and I celebrated our 3 year anniversary at The Phoenician and it was amazing! We had dinner at J&G Steakhouse and the whole experience was top notch! Jose was our server and he was very friendly, warm and amazing at what he does! We will return in the future and we highly suggest dining at J&G Steakhouse! Thank you Jose!
10/10 recommend for an amazing experience. Outstanding service and ambiance with impeccable food!

The meal was outstanding.  My wife had filet and lobster and I had the lamb chops.  Everything was cooked to perfection.  Even the next day as a microwaved left over, the filet was one of the best I can recall.  The mushroom and chili dish was the perfect side to go with the meat.
Highly recommend. Food was outstanding. The view is awesome. Our server Jeff is the best!!
Great food. Excellent service.  Beautiful views. Quality craft cocktails.
Great experience! Service, food and atmosphere. Impressed with the gluten free accommodations and mindfulness around guests needs.

The ambience, the view and the food were all excellent.  The dover sole was marvelous as was the rib eye my husband ordered.  Jose recommended a bottle of wine that would complement both the fish and steak. The staff made celebrating my husband's birthday special. We will definitely be returning.
Staff, service, ambiance on point. Could not have asked for a better experience!

Fish oversalted, steak slightly over done.

This trip was disappointing at best. My wife’s halibut, including garnish, was badly oversalted. My steak was okay, but would have been better if cooked at a proper medium rare. Oysters to start great as usual. No complaints with the waiter, but food runner could have been better trained.

One of the best tasting dining experiences that we have ever had. We are from Scottsdale, so we know anything associated with The Phoenician has to be world class. We were not disappointed. The ambience was classy and ritzy. The steak was tender with two wonderful sauces, the bread rolls were moist yet delicate, the shrimp presentation was artistic, the herb chicken was aromatic and tasted out of this world. The kitchen staff served our dishes - not just the waitress. World class.
Unfortunately, we were disappointed with the food, the steak was extremely tough. The service was excellent, as well as the bar. Staff were very friendly.

Food was delicious. Really delicious filet with great smoke flavor. Ambiance was fine. 

The waiter was terrible. He tried to pass lemonade off as ginger ale. Very slow, very hard of hearing or needs things to be repeated several times. 

Celebrated an anniversary and while we don’t expect anything, he offered no complimentary dessert for the occasion. 

For the amount we paid, I would not return.
Food & service were great! Our server presented us with a card and a very nice dessert to help celebrate our wedding anniversary.
Greta good service and views, would definitely visit again.
I ordered the salmon and it was prepared more blanched than seared.  I like mine crispy on the edges.  Not a lot of flavor.
Excellent wine! The cut off the way it was excellent, Pittsburgh rare was precisely made to order!

J and G Steakhouse was amazing! From the moment we walked in, it was such an amazing experience. The staff was very kind and they provided a great experience for my 2 anniversary with my girlfriend! The food was delicious and very tasty all the way from the shrimp to the dessert. This place is a great spot for special occasions! Thank you J and G Steakhouse for going above and beyond!
David was exceptional. Wonderful dining experience.

Amazing views, service & food
I can’t recommend this place enough

I appreciate the resort casual dress in the summer in Phoenix, that being said, there seemed to be no minimum standard enforced for a very nice restaurant. The service and food were good. I was most impressed by the young lady that worked the patio (as a server) seating at the bar downstairs before dinner at the Thirsty Camel. I don’t recall her name, but she was top notch. The valet guys were very good as well.

We came to celebrate my husbands birthday with some friends and we had a fabulous time. Ambience, service and food was delicious- we will definitely come back!
The music was a little on the loud side and we all had a hard time talking above the music level, if that could of been brought down a notch or two it would of been a better experience- Thank you!
Phenomenal steak and food! Waygu Tomohawk is a MUST HAVE

We came to celebrate Father’s Day and an early retirement celebration for my boyfriend’s mom. We all thoroughly enjoyed the night from start to finish. Austin was great, professional and personable; a perfect balance of the two. We enjoyed dinner and the property so much that we booked a staycation in a few weeks!

We celebrated our 25th Anniversary tonight at J&G Steakhouse at The Phoenician. The location and view are the best in the Valley, bar none. The food was really wonderful. The atmosphere was perfect, exactly what we were looking for. But what made our night special was the service that we received from Giovanna our server. She was superb! She was so gracious, her timing and her conversation with us made our celebration so memorable.  
Please make sure that you hang on to her. She is a gem and has a lot to offer the younger staff that are learning the business. She is an outstanding ambassador of the restaurant and of The Phoenician! Well done everyone!
Sincerely, Michael and Lisa G - Lakewood, Wa
Great good unique flavors the seasonal appetizers are worth ordering

Our server was very attentive until she got busy which is understandable. Cocktails were good, pricey. Had to request bread service. Fantastic Wagyu tomahawk tableside service. Steak carefully cut and prepared the way we liked it. We do know that it was very overly priced at $180. Prime bone in ribeye was just regular tasting, nothing special. Overly priced as well. There are other really good steak houses that will serve a much better ribeye either a much lower price or same price but tastier and much special. My son liked the lamb tbone. We ordered 3 sides (creamed corn, mc and cheese & mushrooms) which were all good. Desserts were okay.  Overall, decent dinner if you dont want to get out from the hotel resort- but might not come back.

We have been to this restaurant, three years ago, and now coming back this time the food was not good..￼ my steak was cooked, salty and over cooked. The crabcakes had too much sauce that is sugary, and the calamari was too much better on. It …The service was very slow. We wish we had a better experience because we were there celebrating our anniversary….

Service was extremely slow. Reservation was at 8pm. Showed up early and didn’t sit until 8:25. Drinks took over 30 minutes to come and our waitress never asked for what we wanted for food or any questions about the menu for about 45-50minutes. We didn’t start eating till 10pm…. 2 Hours from our original reservation. I was starting to fall asleep at the table. Our waitress didn’t even take our order. The person that was assisting making the tables took our order. We were staying at the Canyon Suites and to compare that restaurant to the suites is beyond me. Not a good anniversary dinner. We were so hungry that we ate our food in 5 minutes while we asked for the check right when we got the food so we wouldn’t waste time with a chance to get the check by the time they were closing. Waitress didn’t seem to really care about us or forgot about us basically. For that type of money, I would have gone somewhere else. Very dissapointed in the quality of service. Will not be going back and do not reccomend.
I took my boyfriend here for his birthday dinner. We did the tasting menu and everything was super good! Great value as well.

The food was really good but the service was poor.  Our steaks came out cool and when we mentioned it to the waiter he got upset and sent over the manager.  We were not unhappy before but he made it into a bigger deal than it was and acted rudely toward us after that. We had to wait on refills for the drinks and took forever to get the bill. They did comp one of our steaks and gave us free dessert.  We did not ask for anything and we were just telling them the temperature of the steaks.  The food took forever to get to us and that is why our food was not warm. The food was excellent as far as taste but the service was poor at best. The manager did apologize which was nice but the waiter continued with the attitude. We were in that restaurant for 2 1/2 hours waiting.

Loud music for the size of the dinning room, I also was not impressed with our service, we had to pour our water and wine because of either lack of training or just didn’t care about what the black tie service means.

We had a 6:30p reservation, arrived at 6:20 and were seated promptly. We started with a cocktail which was delicious and then ordered a bottle of wine and the tasting menu which consisted of 3 appetizers, main course, and desert. There was a 20 min wait between each- by the main course we both were tired of waiting. Our steaks were both over cooked when they arrived and other than the tuna tartar the food overall was mediocre. Our waiter was wonderful (it’s not his fault the food wasn’t great and timing was off). Both the waiter and manager acknowledged the lag time between each food item/course and did take care of our initial cocktails but the food and experience was not worth an almost $500 bill. To give you an idea of how long we waited between courses, we didn’t leave our table until 9:45pm!!! Just over 3 hours for a dinner is just insane. There are too many other wonderful places that have wonderful food.
Great food and service. Along with beautiful views. Absolutely worth it.

Service by Glovanna and Juan was excellent -- attentive and professional.  Dishes came at a steady pace.  Unhurried, but just right.

The Caesar's salad was nice and fresh.  The corn soup was beautifully smooth and filled with sweet fresh corn and lump crab.  An excellent refreshing soup for the summer.

The halibut with black bean vinaigrette was outstanding.  The fish was perfectly cooked.  The black bean sauce has a distinctly Chinese personality, reminiscent of the steamed whole fish in Chinese cuisine cooked in a black bean sauce.  Just the right amount of spice, and nicely accompanied by potatoes and thinly sliced baby zucchini.

The lamb T-bone was more medium than medium rare.  Could have used a sauce with it.  Too bad we didn't order one.  It's interesting that the fish tonight far outshone the meat in a steakhouse restaurant...!

The sauteed spinach was perfectly cooked and seasoned.  Went well with our dishes.

We ended with a sticky toffee pudding and coconut ice cream.  The latter was surprisingly mild but refreshing.  

We also had the passion fruit pavlova -- a passion fruit sorbet encased within a crisp meringue shell.  Not easy to do.  The sorbet was extra tart -- very good if you like it that way.  The meringue was a bit too sweet for us, but needed it to cut through the acidity of the sorbet.

In all, a nice evening, until a loud party came in and got seated behind us.  Their laughter and chatter were so loud, we could hardly hear our own conversation.  We exited soon after that.
Xlnt service & food Best Martini
Tasting menu was superb! Filet was perfectly cooked.

Everything was PERFECT. From the location and its amazing view, the food, and especially the service. Everyone is so lovely, I don’t remember having a service as good as the one I had at J&G in my entire life.

Great food and atmosphere! The filet mignon was delicious and cooked exactly how i ordered. We also tried the oysters, calamari, Mac and cheese, and asparagus which were all so all amazing. Can’t get a bad item here!

Subpar at best. Views were decent but that was about it.

Food was tasteless service was slow.
Great food, and a great restaurant overall! Highly recommend!
Amazing dinner! Food was so good and the service made us feel incredibly special!  Great anniversary dinner!

Our first time coming here. From start to finish everything was a great experience.  Wide menu selection. We will return.
Awesome experience from reservations and timely sitting time and wait. Very good food and wait staff are friendly and always interacting with smile. Highly recommended!
Amazing experience every time we go here… Highly recommend.

Always great steaks and service here , and the view
adds to the atmosphere, had a great meal of lamb and short rib , superb taste , service great

Great food and service

Great ambiance, outstanding service and food. Highly recommend the restaurant

Very disappointed
The food was so delicious! Service from Austin & the team perfection. We had a wonderful evening.

I wish the service, execution, & food quality rivaled the ambiance & view.  From the moment we sat down our server was trying to get us to order. The wine I ordered from the list was no longer available.  They then attempted to upsell me on bottles that were $50 to $100 more than the one I wanted.
The crab cake appetizer was very good.  The Wagyu tomahawk was properly seasoned but had larger pockets of fat that you don't normally see in Wagyu.  The sautéed spinach was so overly salty it was inedible.  When we mentioned it to our server he said he would tell the kitchen but made no attempt to fix it. Normally in high end dining there is a  floor manager, GM, or AGM making the rounds to make sure everything is up to standards.  This is not the case here & it shows.

My husband and I went here a couple weeks ago to celebrate our anniversary, and it did not disappoint! We had such a great table with an amazing view. Our cocktails were amazing- my husband got one from their menu, I had a dirty martini that was delicious and perfect. You MUST order the black truffle cheese fritters!!! I would go back just to order those with a martini ha! Our steaks were cooked perfectly, and we were presented with a chocolate dessert for the occasion. We enjoyed the entire evening! Fabulous- top to bottom. Food, service and ambiance were 5 star

Our appetizer the calamari was bland and off-putting. I ordered the NY strip asking for it to be med rare. It came out well done. Had it sent back when it came out again it was blue rare. Returned it and didn’t order anything else because I lost my appetite. The managers were very nice about the situation and took it off our bill however they were very pushy trying to get me to order something else. While I appreciate the gesture my husband and I didn’t appreciate the constant interruptions at our table. It was as if a new person would come to our table every couple minutes to make sure we were enjoying our experience. Overall the staff was nice and very attentive (a little too attentive) however the food was terrible, I’ve had better food at dive bars. Not worth the price at all. Only thing I would go back for was the view.

We had an outstanding dinner while staying at The Phoenician Hotel . The food , service and atmosphere couldn’t have been better . Our Sea Scallops and Dover Sole were perfectly prepared as were our salads and sides . I highly recommend J & G for any special occasion .
Great steakhouse. Best steak of my life so far. Would highly recommend

Great experience. I will return. We loved seating outdoors because of the beautiful view.

Loved this place! The views are gorgeous. The food was outstanding, service was excellent and we will definitely be back! I wish they’d update their patio with nicer furniture/armed chairs for a more comfortable and upscale feel but the interior was gorgeous.

We stayed at the Phoenician for our anniversary and were fortunate enough to get reservations. The view, ambiance, and most especially the food and service, were exceptional. My husband had the wedge salad. Its presentation was different from what we’re used to, however, the flavor was amazing. I had the JG Salad, which was also very good. The dressing was the perfect combination of tart and sweet. We both got the 8 ounce filet. The sear was excellent and they were both cooked to perfection. My husband likes his cooked medium rare and he usually remarks that it’s usually more medium. It was a perfect medium rare and he was so pleased. My filet was a perfect medium. We got broccoli and Yukon mashed potatoes. Both were very good.

Our cocktails were also exceptional. I’ve been on the search fro a restaurant that can make a good lemon drop martini. I’ve finally found it! My husband’s Old Fashioned was also very smooth with the right amount of bite.

We highly recommend JG Steakhouse. We are fortunate to live in an area of the country with several exceptional restaurants and were pleasantly surprised to find the JG Steakhouse surpassed our expectations.

Celebrated our 5th wedding anniversary and the staff was amazing and clearly went the extra distance. Very professional, very well trained, every staff member clearly demonstrated a servant heart. Top-notch operation - these guys have their act together - and the food was excellent.

We celebrated Valentine’s Day early at J&G steakhouse. The service was great, very attentive. 

We chose to get the wine pairing special along with a crabcake and some asparagus. The black truffles were excellent, the tartare was a lot more avocado and very little tuna. The mushroom risotto was mediocre, not buttery like you would expect. There was an issue when our filets came out, both were over cooked, but they were nice enough to replace them quickly and , there was an issue when our steaks came out, both were over cooked, but they were nice enough to replace them quickly and and comped a few items from our bill. 

Overall, it’s not a bad place, great atmosphere and service, but for the price point, I would say, Mastro‘s, or Flemings would be better for that same price.

Very elegant, well served dine place with class
Mike, Paul and Susan I believe were amazing. 
Thank you for being so pleasant and kind.
Beautiful setting but food was a disappointment. Meat not particular tender and lamb T bone was mostly bone. Afraid just Not worth the high price.
Business dinner for owners
One of the best steakhouses in Scottsdale hands down. Our steaks were cooked to perfection and the signs were very good. The service was out of this world. We highly recommend it hands down!!
This was my second time dining here and it is so elegant and calm. Definitely one of my favorite place to dine.
Great food!
Excellent venue. Will book again.
For the price it was not the best steak that I have ever had.
EXCELLENT… always first class!

The greatest of all time

This is the second time I've dined at the J&G restaurant at the Phoenician.  Both times the view was great, the service was great, the food was great, the experience was great...it just don't get any better 'en that.

Very disappointing. The food was generally very good. We started out with a very good crab cake and shrimp cocktail appetizers. The salads that we had were excellent as well (heirloom tomato, chopped, and wedge). My dinner companions all enjoyed their filets. Mine came and as soon as I cut into it my waiter immediately noted that it was undercooked and took it away. It looked actually looked like it may have been a bad cut of meat, but I assumed the chef would notice that. The same piece of meat came back having been seared. The manager literally stood over me while I cut into again and asked in the most condescending way whether it was now "too my liking." I had ordered my steak medium rare and when I cut into the double cooked piece of meat again it was still quite bloody. I was completely taken aback when the manager then said "if you ask me, it looks medium rare" but if I wanted, I could send it back "again." I was literally speechless and told him it was fine. But it was not. I took a bite of the mushy mess that was now clear to me was a bad cut of meat and asked my waiter to please come take it away. I let our kind, helpful and attentive waiter know what happened. He was apologetic and sent a second manager who was also apologetic and offered us desert and after dinner drinks. The original manager, who was so insulting, never bothered to come back and apologize. In the end, without a steak in my belly, the four of us had the pleasure of paying $500 for our meal.  Next time I am in need of a steak I will head to Durants.

Amazing fine dining experience.

We had wine by the glass...was a Cote du Rhone...went perfectly with the steak. Had lots of flavour and beautifully balanced.  Service was very courteous and not overbearing and the music wasn't blaring.  I would recommend this restaurant for any special occasion.

The staff is superb as well as the food. We did the table tasting which had 5 courses

We had a blast! The service was impeccable. The tomahawk ribeye was delicious. We were pleased with the ambience and view. Outstanding experience overall.

We had a beautiful birthday dinner last night. Everything was perfect except for filet mignon. It was a little dry. But everything else was delicious. It was my husband’s birthday and the entire staff knew and gave him well wishes. That was a nice attention to detail.

We had a very nice quiet dinner at J&G.  Service was prompt and attentive.

The chopped salad was very fresh.  Very nicely seasoned.
The foie gras terrine was rich.  Loved the ginger jalapeno-apple compote that came with it.

The sea bass was beautifully seasoned with a miso yuzu glaze.  Flaky and delicate, and cooked perfectly.
The 14 oz American wagyu ribeye was also cooked perfectly.  It needed the green peppercorn sauce to help it along.  But we thought the sea bass was actually a better dish overall.

The ticket dispenser at the self-park garage was jammed, so we entered without a ticket.  When we asked the hostess at J&G how we would be able to leave, she blindly repeated that the slip she gave us that had the QR code to validate the ticket would give us free parking.  I don't think she understood we didn't even have a ticket to validate.  Had the gate not been left open when we exited, I think we would not have been able to leave so easily with just a QR code on a piece of paper.

Getting to the restaurant is also bewildering.  The elevators from the garage do not take you there directly.  They also have buttons most would be accustomed to.  You have to follow the directions posted once you use their touchscreen, and patiently wait for the right elevator, trusting it knows where you're going.....  Not a good start to the evening!

Food was amazing! Delicious crab cakes, filet mignon and rib eye steak were cooked perfectly. Our waiter Jeff was very friendly, attentive and gave great recommendations.  Anniversary dessert was complimentary …most amazing warm chocolate cake and ice cream!!!

I love this place. It’s the last place I got to spend with my dad before he passed in 2018. He loved the food here and yesterday I celebrated his birthday here and the staff was amazing went above and beyond to ensure it was the best service ever!!!! I forgot my waiters name but he was amazing , that surprise birthday cake made me cry it was so thoughtful and heartfelt. I will forever remember this place.

I think they are afraid to use any garlic.  Will be back again for another try.

We accidentally ended up here for my birthday and let me tell you there are no accidents and it’s exactly where we needed to be! Everything was 10/10. We had the crab cake to start and the Wagyu steak as our entree and it was outstanding! Both just melted in your mouth! The apple dessert was our favorite! I could go on and on! Just go here and I promise you won’t regret it! I’m so glad we ended up for my 30th birthday dinner! They also have a balcony with the most beautiful view to take pictures! Go during sunset and it will be picture perfect! Thank you so much Paul and J&G! It was a beautiful experience! We will definitely be back when we come to Scottsdale!

The lobster was creamy and rich, the filets were perfectly grilled and included the best Bearnaise that we’ve ever had. Desert concluded with a 40 (not 20) year old port and warm chocolate cake.

We felt very lucky to have been in Scottsdale and to have chosen this restaurant for our celebration.

Our future travel plans will include a trip, or at least a side trip to Scottsdale in order to visit J&G again.
Everyone was friendly, from the hostess, to the waitress, even the manager walking around speaking to the customers. The food was well prepared, the view was breathtaking.

I have come to J&G for both work events and happy hour for many years.  But last night was a first date for me and we both enjoyed everything very much. The steak was not the quality I was expecting. It was also undercooked

What a view and the food and service were incredible! Jeff was our server and had an awesome personality and made our experience really special.  The steaks are melt in your mouth and the wine and cocktails are fantastic!
Jeff our server was amazing and made our 1st time here special! We went to celebrate my husbands birthday and he went above and beyond to make it special!
Amazing! Enjoyed the meal and the view. Service was fabulous.
Wonderful high end dining experience. Will be back!
This was a great experience for my wife's birthday dinner from the appetizer to the dessert. We will be returning to B&G as we have a regular rotation of restaurants we enjoy & visit.
Bar was a disappointment. The Phoenician is a convention center
This was our first time there. The steak was probably one of the best in my whole life. It was so good. The service was outstanding. Already planning another trip
Service and food was perfect!

Dinner portion of the Sea Bass was poor. It looked like a chicken nugget on the plate. For $40+ the value was not there. The quality was good but lacking in portion size.

I would recommend J&G but tell them to avoid the sea bass.
Everything from the food, ambience and service was phenomenal! We will be back!
Excellent food, carefully prepared. Great presentation. Service could not have been better. Attentive staff but not hovering. Great ambiance
Waited to long for our table.  Had reservations

Best steak and lobster I've ever had. Our waiter, Micheal was awesome! He made us feel so welcome, comfortable and made my gf feel special on her birthday. What a great experience, she'll definitely remember her birthday dinner!

Sat on the patio, wonderful weather and views 
Service was friendly and attentive without being overbearing.Wagyu filet oh so tender. All beef cooked to specification. Fine wine list. 
When I made the reservation I indicated special event, birthday. No acknowledgement was given. That was bad form.
Great food and fantastic service
One of the best course tasting restaurant in town (shoulder to shoulder to cafe monarch)
Wonderful staff.  We’ll trained friendly delightful. View magnificent. Thank you especially to Rihanna and Melissa.
The filet mignon is my favorite to order from here. It's seasoned and cooked exactly the way I like it.
Outstanding food and service and the view was amazing!

If you like to feel special, go to J&G at the Phoenician.  From the drive up to the building, the walk through the lobby, the ladies at the desk, the waitpeople, the food and the view—everything is absolutely perfect.

Loved the place

The food was great and the service was wonderful. Loved the patio and the atmosphere. The only complaint is 75 a plate and still had to pay for sides.

Pompous manager had to be asked 3 times to see my wife about their bait and switch on wines (4 bottles ordered in 2 years and all were incorrect vintages or they did not have an tried to replace with an inferior bottle). Jeff was outstanding as our server, food was perfect - tremendous experience overall!!  Great spot! :)

Staff were friendly and helpful with decimos about the menu. 
Food was excellent!  Lobster Mac and cheese is a must!!
Amazing experience for our anniversary! Service was phenomenal.

Food was excellent.

Great view great service great food. 
I highly recommend it
Dinner was wonderful.  My family has severe nut allergies and they were very attentive to prevent cross contamination

Fabulous experience at J&G Steakhouse at the Phoenician.  Gorgeous views and sunset, comfortable terrace seating, food was excellent and Lori, our server was great!  Highly recommend for a special occasion - we will be back!  Thank you!

Food was not what we expected or worth the price.  My husband was anxiously waiting for the Tomahawk steak for weeks.  We splurged for our 20th anniversary.  He said the burger he had the night before at the Rehab Burger Therapy was better than his steak for $130 less.  Disappointing.
Was lovely both nights, we also appreciated them recognizing  my husbands service in Vietnam war. We will return.

We enjoyed a wonderful meal on the splendid terrace overlooking the valley lights below. The French onion soup and sea bass were cooked to perfection and chatting with the friendly staff was fun. Thank you!

Waitress was very nice but unfortunately poor service. I had to beg for a water, beer and wine for my wife. Hate to say it but want to provide honest feedback.
Stunning setting and views; outstanding service and food.  We loved every minute. Perfect for a celebratory dinner.

We ate here 5 years ago and I have not forgotten what an exceptional experience it was. I am not a steak person but the seafood offerings are great. It’s a wonderful beautiful place to eat with exceptional service.

A delicious and lovely evening!!!
Food and service were amazing !!
Amazing experience from beginning to the end. The food is fabulous. A must do

Jeff was amazing! Server assistant (I can’t remember his name I’m sorry) was amazing also! And food was amazing!

The manager was so nice and chatted with us for a little while.  To be honest the whole staff made us feel comfortable and welcomed. We will be back soon!

This is our go-to place to celebrate our wedding anniversary. Come to Scottsdale once a year and this place is always one of our dinner options. Excellent food.  Top-notch service. Waitstaff/host/bartenders were outstanding. Austin was our waiter tonight - super attentive. Thank you Austin.

Outstanding food and service. 
Wonderful views. 
Piped music was awful but then a live performer played and was great.
Our birthdays—great dinner
Very pleased with our visit. The food did not disappoint. Our servers as well as the manager made sure we had everything we needed! Looking forward to going back

The restaurant and view was beautiful.  Our waiter Jeff was outstanding!  We had the sea bass and 8oz filet, both delicious and cooked to perfection!  We shared the fries, snap peas and asparagus.  Highly recommend!  Worth the price and you won’t be disappointed!  Perfect to bring out of town guests they will love the view!
It was my bday celebration and I Didn’t even get a small cake 😞

The service at J&G was amazing. Our waiter, Rihanna, was fabulous. She definitely makes the visit worth your while, however the food was subpar and had poor presentation. Food was overpriced for what you get
Very nice meal and experience

The meal was excellent.  We ate on the patio and the view was fantastic.  Server was attentive without being intrusive.  And that is very much appreciated!  Drove an hour to get there but we will return!
Amazing dinner, service, views !!!

The ambience was beautiful and service was great but food took very long to come out. Steaks were just okay. No whoa factor. We were terribly disappointed. A $300 dinner should have been much better. No comps were offers except for cheese balls that we didn’t order…my husband wasn’t happy for his bday
The food was great, the service was excellent, and we had a fantastic birthday meal overlooking the city.
It was amazing!!!! Already wrote a Yelp review too with pics!!! Loved every thing about it!!! We will be back

Great experience The food was definitely some of the best steaks and seafood we have ever had, however as far as the service I feel like when I asked for things to be boxed up that the server  should’ve done them I shouldn’t of had to do it myself at the table. Server was super nice but gave me a Dennys vibe unfortunately. Yes I’m aware how that sounds 😢. Pricing was absolutely great for the quality of meat/seafood that we received and the preparation and presentation of everything was well executed!
Amazing food and atmosphere

Lovely restaurant with great views within the elegant Phoenician resort
The service was simply outstanding. We had an event to go to after dinner and they paced our meal perfectly without us every feeling rushed. The Wagyu steak was to perfection. Overall a great experience
Thank you Jeff and Melissa for great service!!!
Great waitress, perfect cocktails in the lounge, excellent food and good wine.  And the view is divine!
Server was amazing!!
Always great!  A perfect evening 👌🏼

Most enjoyable.
Suzan was an extraordinary server! Ambience was incredible and glad we could enjoy the sunset during our dinner.

Our server, food and view were amazing. It was a plus that I walked out as a fiancé!

Bit of a wait to order. Also, food was very good but not prepared the way I requested. Couldn’t send it back because our server did not show up again until I was almost finished. Lack of service may have been due to staffing issues due to Covid.
Wonderful food and view! Our waiter was very attentive and the service staff was amazing!

We attended dinner here for my husband’s birthday and unfortunately his steak was under cooked potatoes were not that good and we had to ask several times for the waiter to bring us lemons. Looking forward to hopefully giving it another shot.

Great evening! Although behind my chair was  the traffic line for wait staff. The floor was not stable and I felt the chair rock and tip backwards with each pass of the staff. Tried to reposition but to no avail.
Great place to celebrate our 20th Wedding Anniversary. Thanks for making it special!
Fantastic Anniversary dinner for me and husband. They went above and beyond and included some nice touches to wish us a happy anniversary!
The steak was outstanding. Our server was very good along with all support staff. I would definitely refer people to eat here. Thank you. VDLP
Michael was incredible and very personable. Made our experience even better!
Excellent food, service and ambience. Highly recommend.

The food was terrific and the view spectacular.  The service was friendly and helpful.

Excellent food and our server Lori was outstanding highly recommended
Long wait for reservation .. when restaurant was not packed at all .. so many empty spots . Shrimp cocktail got steakhouse was large .. Not jumbo or colossal like most .. otherwise decent spot

Beautiful ambiance, great waitress and so so food. My salmon was good but potatoes was barely warm. My husband's steak was ok. Mac and cheese was delicious. Most nice restaurants when you mention an Anniversary or special occasion they come up with a little something extra, not the case here.
Excellent wait staff and the manager checked on us several times.  The New York Strip had not one piece of fat or gristle.  We were very pleased!  Great view and excellent food.

Good.  Prime strip was well aged, perfectly cooked, and tasty.  No need for the side sauces.  Tomato salad was really good.  Best tasting tomatoes I have had in a awhile.  The portion on the tomato salad was a little small.  The steamed broccoli was good.  Healthy and steamed to the right temperature.  

The host was fantastic and checked on us at least 5 times and made sure our valet ticket was validated.  Can’t say enough about him.  He went above and beyond.  The other service was a bit spotty.  At times the waiters were overly attentive, but they missed a few basics like refilling our alcoholic drinks and asking if our food came out right.  The waiters were super nice though. 

The place was really nice with an awesome view but they had an awkward set up for some of the tables including ours.  The French fries were bad.  Over cooked and very little flavor.  Could have gotten better fries at McDonald’s.
Very good meal with excellent service. The views are amazing and it’s a great dining experience no matter the occasion.

A perfect 10. The ambiance, the service, the presentation and the quality of the food were all perfect. The attention they give you is beyond anywhere else I have ever been. The steaks were all soft and cooked to perfection with just the right flavor. Highly recommend!

I always enjoy dining at J&G, and this was no exception. My only negative are the prices. Everything is al la carte which of course drives up the total dinner per person cost. The food is superb and the views are spectacular, only recommendation is make sure you want to splurge on dinner, as you will dining there.

We are regular customers of J&G Steakhouse - and went there last night with good friends to celebrate the holidays.  The reservation had been made several weeks in advance with a request to sit in a booth by the windows in the main dining room.  Upon arrival, we were led to a table past the dining room at the very end of the building in what was obviously a banquet room.  The noise level was so loud due to a very large party that we could barely hear each other.  The server came over and explained the menu to us.  One of the members of our party had been thinking about the crab legs and asked the price which was $120+.  She was about to order them and requested that each couple have a separate bill so we didn't have to share the bill when she was ordering expensive wine and a very expensive dish.  The waitress rudely told us that it was not possible to do that.  We could only have one bill.  As a result, she did not feel comfortable ordering the crab legs and expensive wine - and instead ordered something similar to our party.  Since we frequently go there, we know what to expect in terms of the meal.  However, it did not meet our expectations.  The $35 chicken dish was a la carte and included only the chicken and 1 asparagus spear.  The portion size had been greatly reduced and we had to pay an additional $12 for mashed potatoes that were watery and (I think) swimming in butter.  We have always enjoyed this restaurant and supported it during covid.  However, given our latest experience, we will not return.
Great view, service and food.  For a high end experience, this is hard to beat.

The steak was good, but the side dishes were very underwhelming. We frequently go to Dominicks or Mastros, and J&G's didn't come close to those, as far as food or service. My wife called the manager to express our concerns the following day, and he said that he was busy, but that he would call her back the following day. He didn't bother to call her back as promised. When you spend nearly $500 for a nice dinner for 4 people, you expect the entire experience to be wonderful. That was not the case with J&G's. I can't see us going back, and definitely would be recommending it.

Definitely the best restaurant I have ever been too. The food and service was amazing, and our server, Jeff Cardwell, was easily the best server I’ve had. Always knew what he was talking about, made great recommendations, and was fun to talk to.
Unbelievable wagyu steak, perfect service. Potato Augratin are a must!
Excellent as usual; very attentive staff and top notch food

1st time at J&G and the food was delicious.  We had the iceberg salad as part of our dinner.  For the main entree I had salmon and my wife had a crab cake.  Both were delicious and served hot. Awesome food and service

Amazing.  Great food, great service, great ambiance.  It was a bit noisy for us, but that’s probably showing our age.  We’d go back in a minute.
Great evening with Stunning sun set to go along with the dinner.
You won’t be disappointed by service, food or atmosphere here!
Excellent as always. Table next to us was very loud and obnoxious through no fault of the restaurant. Just kind of hampered the experience a bit. Amazing place though and will attend again.

We opted for the Tasting Menu together with the Wine Pairing. We were not sitting close to another table so we were good to make those yummy noises when you're so happy to be eating whatever it is that you're eating. It was that good!

Amazing meal and service. We were celebrating our babymoon and were welcomed with a handwritten note. The food was perfect - we had the truffle cheese fritters, lobster, wagyu steak, and potatoes. All 10/10

The expansive views of the valley are world class.  
The service and food are both outstanding.
Very tasty food, especially if you like cheese. Lots of vegetarian options as well as steak and seafood. Beautiful setting. Reasonably priced for high-end dining. Perfect for special occasions.
Great atmosphere and service. We enjoyed celebrating our engagement here. The only thing that I would recommend improving is the flavor of the steak. It was bland. The sides were good.

Lamb was undercooked but otherwise nice, would be great with some mint sauce.  Overall the food was good, but not what I had hoped for, I wanted wow and pop, which I realize is difficult in today’s high quality chef world ..though J&G have the opportunity to create wow, will management and their chef permit the next phase of evolution?

Our server and her support team members were all very polite, professional and helped make my birthday extra special. Overall, we enjoyed the evening beyond expectations and didn't feel rushed at all. Can't wait to go back!

Excellent food great ambience fairly expensive though
Family visit
Food and service was top notch. One of the best steaks I have had!
We brought our teenage children here to celebrate their birthdays & had the best dinner! The food & drink were all so delicious!! Great service & atmosphere!!
The best view and food ever. Steaks are like butter
The service was slow and the food took a long time to arrive. The chicken was over cooked and dry. However the ribeye and mashed potatoes were great!
Fantastic evening. The wagyu steaks were incredible and the service was spot on.
View was amazing,service was wonderful. Food was very well prepared- French onion soup especially good.
Great service. Outstanding quality of the steaks. They made our anniversary dinner special.
