Wonderful service and really great food! Would highly recommend and definitely return next time we visit.

I showed up for my 815 reservation at 650.  I know i was 1.5 hours but I had not eaten. The place was empty so I asked the hostess if I could be seated.  She said she’d see what see can do mean time I could sit in the bar.  At 815 I went to the hostess to be seated.  The place still wasn’t to crowded she told me no table for me and to wait another 15 minutes.  I am not good with bad attitude people so I took my business else where.  I love the JG chain but will never be back.  Then to top it off they reported to open table I didn’t show up.  Tacky.
Always fantastic  love this place
Best part of our dining experience was our server..  Food was okay.  The servers assistant reached in front of us several times.
Great food, great service, and great atmosphere! Loved it.
The service was way beyond my expectations and the food was amazing. They had a table ready for two with an amazing view.

It was a very special evening and our waitress was very helpful. I had the appy of the Tuna carpaccio, which was  excellent. My boyfriend had the French onion soup.  For the main I had the fillet which was cooked to perfection. Loaded baked potato and creamed spinach topped off our wonderful meal.

Excellence from the moment we arrived.  Pure enjoyment for my wife and I.  We love fine dining!   Has become one of our top 3 best !  
Thank you

Great ambience and view of the area.  Food is good but not great.  Shrimp cocktail was really good.  I had the 12 oz filet that was ordered to be medium and was closer to medium well in the center and well done on the ends.

Had a wonderful dinner! Jeff was absolutely AMAZING! The entire evening was just wonderful and we were treated like Royalty. I want to say it was one of the best dinners we’ve ever had! Beautiful location, great food, unbelievable staff.
Everything was fantastic, if I had to make a complaint only the scallops werent very good. But the steak, lobster, appetizers and dessert were great. Service was top notch.

Worst experience in 6 years of eating here. Had not been since the pandemic closure. The food was absolutely awful. The filet mignon I ordered was so thin I had to ask if it was truly a filet (zero seasoning). For a place known As a steakhouse it’s ridiculous to be serving a 1/4 inch filet - well done to boot when ordered with a warm red center. The Mac and cheese which used to be divine was pedestrian and flavorless while the wedge was not chilled and came with a whisper of dressing. The only two things that went right were the ginger margarita (sublime still) and the cheese fritter appetizer.
Jeff was outstanding.
Anniversary dinner
Great ambiance and good!  Laurie was the best server!!!

Our reservations were at 8:30 PM. I felt rushed towards the end due they were closing at 10 PM.
Service was amazing. Food was great and the outdoor seating and views were perfect!

The view on the terrace is spectacular. The interior is also very nice. The wedge salad was awesome. The waitress and bus service at our outdoor table was very good. My less than stellar review is mostly about the kitchen. A steakhouse must be able to provide a properly cooked steak. I order medium rare always. The waitress knew as soon as the plate hit the table that the steak was medium well to well. She didn't even blink when I called her over. They took the steak back, however, left my wife's entree and the sides on the table while we waited for a new steak to be prepared. At a quality restaurant, all food would return so all at the table could enjoy the meal together. I don't think that is much to ask of a restaurant. Next steak was prepared properly. An extremely meh experience for a really high ticket.

The service was great but the food was less than impressive comsidering the price.  My wife's first fillet was dry and chewy. Her second was better. Mt ribeye although flavorful was extremely chewy for $70.  The decor is old and worn in need of a remodeling. We will not return.

We enjoyed the tasting menu at this beautiful restaurant.  Wonderful views out the expansive windows and balcony.
The black truffle cheese fritters were great!  Crispy on the outside; filled with flavor and gooeyness on the inside.  Small enough even for one bite each fritter.
The tuna tartare came with a generous layer of guacamole and a nice ginger marinade that gave it great tartness.  Just right!
The Parmesan risotto had a nice creamy texture balanced with mushrooms filled with flavor.
The filet mignon with half lobster was a simple surf and turf presentation compared to the other dishes -- very straightforward.  The fillet and lobster were both beautifully cooked.  Drawn butter and the Bearnaise were perfect accompaniments.
The warm chocolate lava cake with caramel ice cream and tuile was a great finish to a wonderful meal -- not too sweet.

The service was attentive and very professional.  Loved it!

Overall, this is much less expensive compared to a Cafe Monarch or Reserve (which, granted, is at a different level), but head and shoulders above Elements at Sanctuary all round in both food and service.
Food was just ok - We expected 5 star food and nothing was really that great for what you're paying. Great service. The restaurant seemed a little tired.
Awesome birthday celebration ambiance

Expect to be treated based on how much you look like you’ll tip.

Food: excellent and flavorful; fish and steak are equally delicious; you should not feel compelled away from dubious menu items — everything is excellent.
Ambiance: view makes this restaurant worthwhile, plan an earlier meal
Price: food price is fair for what is offered, drink price is very good for location
Service: My wife and I are 24 y/o. Our waiter treated us as such — focusing on other tables, disinterest in our orders, exceptionally long waits between drinks, and so on. Very dissatisfied with our waiter. However, our secondary wait staff (bus, host, bar, kitchen, etc) was phenomenal.
Excellent service and food.  Seated us early when requested.  Steaks perfect!
Excellent dining, with beautiful views. The food was beyond superb and the service was unmatchable! This was by far one of the best dining experiences that we have encountered.
Outstanding service with an excellent menu.  View and ambiance is very nice.
We had a fabulous anniversary dinner on the patio and it was so good we went back to the restaurant again before we left.  Love the bacon it is a winner!

Great meal on a wonderful evening.
Amazing food, service and ambiance. The view is beautiful!!
Absolutely beautiful view and delicious food! We celebrated our Anniversary here and enjoyed everything! There’s even a guitarist playing live music which was very nice as well! 10 out of 10!!!
Lori was an outstanding server!!!  We definitely will be back.  My boyfriend said the Iceberg Wedge Salad was the best he has ever had!!!

We had the best waiter known to man - he was so knowledgeable about the menu, the wine, and was great with our kids. It was truly a picture perfect evening with a beautiful sunset view, and all of the food was delicious. We had the wagu filet, sea bass, shrimp cocktail, truffle fritters, and the brussel sprouts and lobster Mac and cheese side and the lava cake dessert. 
A must-do if you’re in the area!!!!
Excellent food and service!

For the price tag ($600 for 4pp) at J&G, I would not return, but I am assuming the long wait for our table (30 minutes after our reservation) and slow service was being caused by Covid labor shortages.  Beyond the service issues, the food was pretty good....just not top of the line that would be expected.

Jeff was our server, we enjoyed his Sense of humor and personality. He did a great job as did all of the staff.
The food was well prepared and delicious.
Amazing experience! Great food! Superb service! Can’t wait to go back! The tuna tartare and the risotto is amazing! All the food was prepared perfectly! Definitely a place to go to again!

The quality of the beef was average for the price, but the rest of the dishes and sides were fantastic. The black truffle cheese fritters were amazing and the brussels and lobster mac and cheese were delicious. We will definitely return just to have more of those!
Very good food!
great food, awful service staff

I have a dairy allergy, and he was very good about suggesting options for me and creating a night for us to enjoy. It was a little chilly in the restaurant, but we enjoyed the treatment. I ordered the filet minion, and my friend ordered the sea bass. Both were delectable. Absolutely outstanding. Will be coming here again!!
My husband, son and I had the tasting menu.  Every item was amazing.  We definitely have to go back to try more.

We started in the lobby with an amazing service from a nice young lady.  We went up for dinner and didn’t realize they have a nice quaint bar, private with great views.  I would of preferred that bar a lot less quiet.  We started with crab cakes, it was awesome, a ten, delicious sauce, and fantastic crabmeat.  Our dinner was Seabass and NY on bone with lobster, plus a side of asparagus.  The asparagus were HUGE, perfectly cooked.  My wife’s Seabass was amazing, perfectly cooked, extremely taste.  The NY was not my favorite cut, my bad, but the lobster was soooo good.  They had three amazing sauces to go with the NY, I didn’t need that, I’d prefer to taste the flavors of the meat.  My wife loved the sauces though.  Overall:  Quiet, great views, excellent service, temperature was good and not so good but I’m bald, It was better then ok.  I have had many, many worst occasions with blowing air on me, this was not the case.  I think a vest would have been perfect.  Price $$$$ expect to spend $200-$350 for a couple
Beautiful ambiance, amazing service and great food! It was a perfect combination for a memorable evening.
Came for dinner our first night at the Phoenician. The views are breathtaking.
Excellent service, delicious food, and perfectly cooked steak.  Can't beat the views.
It was an amazing experience and the food was absolutely amazing!! Few is unbelievable!!

The food was great but it took 20 minutes before we were greeted. It then took an hour before we even received our first order of drinks. The place is beautiful but due to the level of service received, I would not return.

My wife and I had dinner for her birthday and our 15 year anniversary. The food is spectacular, the service was impeccable, and the ambiance was perfect. I'd recommend J&G to anyone for a special occasion.

Requested a table by the windows so we could see the view- we were seated as far from the windows as possible looking out. This was our first visit here and I picked it over capital grill because we have been there a few times. Our waitress made me feel as though asking questions was a pain and didn’t bother telling us about the specials until after  told her I was gluten free. So the taste menu was not an option with the gluten full items.  My husband had black truffle fritters and loved them with the Cabernet. He also had the Dover sole which was ok- they debone it tableside which takes a few minutes and was done after serving my wagu filet.  Of course I wait til my husband is served to eat.  The sole was boring at best until we added some of the Augratin potato’s with it.  That was better.  The filet was wonderful I added the blue cheese to it and could not have been happier.  The roasted peppers were excellent also.  We were given the choice of sparkling or bottled water we selected bottles at $9 a bottle. Never forced to buy water before in a restaurant. They half filled our glasses then did not refill again til we bought the second bottle. Just my opinion when 2 entrees 1 side and 1 glass of wine cost over $260 I should of been comfortable asking questions and the timing for deboning and serving should have lined up.

The side dishes and bread were outstanding: the tomato and roasted peach appetizer was superb. But the entrees themselves were average and overpriced. It was disappointing. Also, the portions were huge for a resort where people can’t bring leftovers home: it’s a waste.
Very nice and the steak was cooked very well.  You can’t go wrong with this restaurant

Great restaurant.
Great food & ambiance.

Not cheap, but, well worth attending for any special occasion, or just when you want to get out & have a 5 star meal!
Great service & great food!
Came in town to visit our son who lives in Scottsdale.
Views are Exceptional!  Food is Incredible!!   If you are lucky to enjoy the seasonal citrus lobster salad, its Incredible.

Went here for our 10th anniversary. Special night deserves a special meal. Definitely regretted this choice. Waitress brought out the wrong drink. Long wait between courses. Medium steak came out well done. Took 20 min for manager to come over and sides were already cold so didn’t quite make sense to wait another 20 min for a Jew steak to be made up. Just overall a total disappointment. Longest, worst, overpriced meal and unfortunate it was for a night that we hoped to be special.
Wonderful food and ambiance.  Our waiter Jeff was phenomenal.  Outstanding night out!

Our server was  amazing!! The steak was kind of dry, I’m

Salmon was phenomenal!  Great views.  Great service.
Lovely anniversary celebration. Amazing food and ambiance!!
Incredible experience - best meal, beautiful views, impeccable service and treated even more special because it was my birthday!

For the price I would recommend somewhere else.  The service was mediocre.  Waited like 30+ minutes for our entree after getting our appetizer without any word from the waiter. The caeser salad was not good.  Drinks were empty for periods of time.

The place should of been better.

It was our 25th anniversary . The halibut had no flavor . Needed to lemon it over and over to give it some. The waiter took a long time to come back to our table between visits.  The busboy helped a lot.

Need a better explanation of the tasting, 5 course meal.  This was our choice for the evening and we were not real pleased.  The fish was just not edible, had a gritty taste to it and didn't look appealing at all.  The lobster was uncooked and had to be returned.  Asked for medium on my steak and it came back medium rare.  Waiting on the next course was maddening, absolutely maddening.  Here's why:  Our reservation was for 5:45.  We got coffee and our cake at 8:10.  Two and a half hours after we sat down.  You can do the math as to how long it took from one course to the other.  Cost for our night out and dissatisfaction:  $275.00.  Ambience.  Nice.  Servers.  Nice.  Good night out.  Yes.  Best meal ever:  Not on your life.
Really bad service but the food was incredible. The tasting menu with wine pairings is very well done.

Me and my husband went here for our anniversary dinner. We both got the sample dinner of everything. Everything was delicious our favorite was the tuna hands down. Service was okay, for the ambience and food I thought a little more attention on the servers parts would be better. They seemed rushed.
Great food and ambiance … service was excellent  ~  Jeff did a great job even though the restaurant was busy 👌🏼
Great service and food!
The request I asked for in a month advance, I did not get.
My husband and I came here for dinner on our ten year wedding anniversary. The food was AMAZING and the service was wonderful as well. I would definitely recommend J&G to our friends.

Our server Michael was excellent but he was obviously short handed. It took over an hour to get drinks from the bar. Somehow, the staff lost my husband’s birthday cake that had been delivered earlier that day by the bakery. 😔
Fantastic staff, very helpful and attentive.
Great atmosphere with excellent fine food and very good service

Ok .food pricy but the view ok good.....
Yes I will go again

Every time we come here it’s our favorite. Our waitress was so accommodating and we enjoyed every min of our experience.

Awesome Lamb.  Would like to try some fish dishes next time.  They looked great.

Excellent dinner and beautiful view of the city at night

Excellent view, attentive staff and incredible food. From appetizer to dinner, and through to dessert we were amazed at the quality J&G bring. Food, excellent, 6oz Australian Wygu awesome.

Beautiful views. Great food. Excellent service. Perfect choice for our last night in Scottsdale!

Absolutely incredible experience with a view! The food was perfect and well portioned. We got the special and it was well worth the price, which was reasonable! Will definitely be coming back here. The staff and service was also amazing.

J & G was fantastic as always. Food is amazing and the view is wonderful. Definitely recommend.

When we arrived the live music was pretty loud but the set ended about 10 minutes later. 

Our waiter was professionally snobby it felt like. He didn’t do anything wrong by any means, but his demeanor wasn’t vibing with us. 

We started with calimari, shrimp cocktail and French onion soup. The shrimp and soup were awesome. The calimari was too thick, overcooked and kinda gross. 

My wife got chicken, I got steak. Portion sizes were more than fair. Good tasted delicious but the entrees are all you get. We added a baked potato for $10…come on. 

Overall I think that for the price, it should have been better. My wife made the comment that everything is about 10% too expensive for what you get and enjoy. 

The views, awesome.

Recommend the filet mignon, it was a healthy size cut, prepared exactly as ordered.  The steamed broccoli with lemon and grated parmigiano was delicious.
Had a great time having dinner with my son. The steaks were amazing and temperature to perfection. Staff very friendly and the service was outstanding.

Overpriced horrible food… my ribeye steak (cooked rare) had zero flavor. I was complaint to my table when the manager overheard me and took offense. I tried both and they were horrible and since when does a steak need BBQ sauce… it’s like they knew it was a tasteless steak before they served it. I also ordered the lobster Mac and cheese… it tasted like it was soaked in the ocean for a couple days then added even more salt. I should have used it to season the steak… it was so salty no one could eat it. This was an anniversary dinner and I could have just gone to a Brazilian Steakhouse and spend way less on delicious food. Very disappointed and I will never go back. The manager explained that they are doing something different and I said I understand because most places serve good food. My girlfriend had the lobster and cream spinach. She described it has bland and dedicating. My daughter had the steak frites and said her was delicious. But one out of 3 dishes isn’t with the $400 check. You can literally go anywhere and get good food way cheaper… save your money and try a good restaurant.

 I Would highly recommend this restaurant is very consistent and the musician that night was great.

The Tuna Tartare...DELICIOUS! The filet and snap peas...WOW!!!! Austin was the best!!! Thank you for such an incredible dining experience! Mark, the manager the nicest!!! Sooo happy!!!
The prices that were charged were not what the menu stated,

Definitely paying for the views only here.  The food is average at best.  Caesar salad was WAY too "lemony".  The parmesan crusted chicken was not good at all.  Steaks are decent.

Outstanding,

Okay, “value” will always be a point of contention in a place like this. Sure, it’s expensive at a glance, but to me, it’s worth every penny. We started with a few perfectly scrubbed (beautiful to the eyes) very tasty oysters...then moved  to a delicious sea bass and one of the best dense, meaty strip steaks I have ever tasted. Excellent food, service and atmosphere.  Loved it.

Tables were fairly close together but when we got up to use the restroom they were all over us to wear a mask.  Just makes no sense when you are walking 15 feet.  For a dinner that was so expensive I just thought the service and attention should have been better. We celebrate most special occasions here. I asked immediately if We could be seated at the larger table fir 4 facing the window and was told it was reserved for a 4pp. Not 2 min later a 2 pp party was sat at the table I asked for. So after they were seated I asked the diners if they reserved for 4 pp. They responded with the fact they didn’t even have reservations. Lets just say I wasn’t too happy about that. There was also a 4pp table seated behind us that were drunk and loud and left little to be desired in regards to ambiance. I lasted 10 min before seeking mgt and requested a different table at a different area and was accomodated.
This is the ultimate steak place and it has a wonderful view.

The server was very nice and food was fabulous!
The Crab Cakes and Sea Bass were amazing.
The Tasting Menu ($92 per person) was the perfect combination of all the items that I wanted to sample.    Service was excellent and each item on the tasting menu was delicious.

Great staff, great service, great food and a great view, it really doesn’t get better than dinner at J&G Steakhouse. I put on the reservation that we were celebrating our anniversary and Patrick Norton and his staff made us feel special throughout the night. We had a great time and can’t wait until we can go back.
Anniversary

Seated 20 min late. We had to ask for kids menu.  We had to ask to order wine. Offered coloring book for our 4 year-old by hostess but then had to ask for it again but they were out of colors.  They were out of the ribeye and porterhouse.  We ordered a 2017 Cab abd was brought a 2018. Waited 30 min between finishing appetizers before we received our steaks  - both which were mediocre (prob comparable to Outback). 
Positives were the Sweet Pea Soup that was amazing but served only slightly warm.  As we left, the bartender gave each of us a free glass of wine due to our poor experience.  My son did like his cheeseburger from the kids menu as well.
Our dinner was excellent! The food was amazing! Definitely recommend!
Nice location, very nice view, relaced atmosphere.  great for date night or hang out.
The food was amazing, the waitress was amazing and the views were fantastic! I took my wife to celebrate our 20th anniversary and it was perfect! Glad I chose J&G Steakhouse!

Upon our arrival they tried to seat us ah a high traffic area next to a service station and the door to the patio.  We asked for a different table and they accommodated us immediately. The food was excellent, but the temperature in the dining room was quite cool; I was sorry I hadn't worn a long sleeved shirt.
The food was fantastic! Do not miss the potatoes gratin.

We loved our dinner experience at J&G!  No matter where you sit, you will have a nice view of the Valley!  The service was fantastic - not stuffy just very nice people.  The food was wonderful!  Very tender and flavorful steak and great sides!   We will definitely be back!
Our anniversary dinner.   Perfect.
Great......thank you
My wife and I's favorite restaurant in Phoenix.  The patio seating at sunset is AMAZING, and the food is to die for.

The star of the show, their steak, was quite mediocre, particularly in light of the price point.  Did not have a ton of flavor which was very surprising.  I’ve had much better steaks for way less than $60.  Ambiance is classy and service is attentive.
Everything was amazing! My husband and I as well as my children enjoyed our meals, the view and the service was outstanding!

It was nice to have quiet time to discuss business at 5:30. It got a little too loud to hear each other talk towards the end of dinner. That was the only downer, but the energy was amazing. Otherwise the service, food and ambience were great!
It was phenomenal. Food was great, service was top notch.

The food was amazing, but the wait staff was almost too attentive. The minute we put our forks down they were clearing our table. We received our dessert and instead of giving us time to eat it they were filling our water glasses so we had to wait to eat the dessert. Odd timing and we needed more space to eat our food instead of constantly having someone coming to table grabbing dishes the minute they thought we were done. At one point my son still had the food in his mouth and he needed the dip bowl and they took it away! The food was excellent but I would not go back.
Friendly staff and amazing food! We trusted the servers recommendations with the Tuna and Seabass, they did not disappoint.

I’m sorry to say that we did not have an entirely good experience at J&G. Although we LOVED our table outside overlooking the night lights in the valley, and the servers were attentive and warm and friendly, the food was where it all fell apart. 
We ordered two simple dishes: Steak Frites and the Cheeseburger. The steak was the toughest little piece of meat I was ever served in a high-end steakhouse. The cheeseburger, ordered “plain and medium rare,” came out grey, overcooked and soggy with veggies piled on. Truly disappointing...
On a bright note, the gratis birthday dessert was fantastic — thank you.
Our Server was David, excellent service. J&G is pricey but for a special occasion highly recommend

Both steaks we ordered were cooked exactly as ordered (bone in rib eye and a filet). Flavor was outstanding and the sides were ridiculously good. One of the best meals I’ve had in years. I will be going back. High end steakhouses don’t come cheap so you’ll pay for it but if you can afford it, it’s to die for. On meals that good, you can’t sweat the price.
My girlfriend and I celebrated our six month anniversary and we got a hand written card and a free dessert from J&G celebrating us! It was a beautiful experience with awesome service from David!!
Celebrated our 15th anniversary. Received card when we arrived and had exceptional service and delicious food. Thank you for making our evening special.

Unfortunately our waitress never returned to ck on us once food was delivered.   Steak was overcooked and tough.  Very bad experience.....especially watching our waitress looming around and watching us like a spy.  Very bizarre behavior.   Manager did handle and we appreciate him and other staff.
Super fabulous dinner.  The bake potato is so good.  Great staff,  waiter and filet was great.
Well done on all counts. Excellent menus for both red meat and non red meat lovers.
Beautiful restaurant and great service. Thank you.
Great food, great service! Excellent place for dinner!
Always lovely, elegant and professional.  One of the few restaurants still practicing social distance - we felt safe.  Food was excellent and live music very enjoyable.

We attended J&G Steakhouse to celebrate my boyfriend’s birthday and had a really great time. The service was phenomenal, and not the just waiters/waitresses, but everyone. The Host at door who greeted us was even kind enough to take a pic for us at the end of dinner and she captured the winning shot. 🙂
Fantastic view,  food paul was great

We had a birthday celebration.  I say moderate noise level because at times, a table of two girls close to us were so loud we could not hear ourselves.  

It was a wonderful experience and first time there.  We will return.  Laurie and the other wait staff were very attentive and not rushing us.  

Thanks

Everything was just perfect 😍😍
Especially the food and I got a free dessert for my BD
Awful experience ... would never go back.
Great food and drinks! Can’t wait to come back!
One of the finest steakhouses in the Phoenix area.  The food, service and views are extraordinary.

Service was terrible. Food was subpar.  There was a table next to us that was extremely loud.  Yelling and the restaurant couldn’t control them. We were entraining business associates.  It was  terrible experience all round. We will NOT be back.

The food was very expensive for what you got.   I had lobster and it was ok.   My potato, sides are not included, was not soft and flakey like a baked potato should be.  My daughter had Filet mignon and it was cooked as ordered.  The French onion soup was ok but not amazing and the same for the Caesar salad.  We had to ask for water repeatedly and were never offered second drinks for our other beverages.  Our overall dinner took 2 hours for a party of 2.   I had requested a table by window as we were celebrating my daughters birthday and I had made reservations weeks in advance.  They sat us in the middle of the restaurant overlooking the bus station and other tables. For a $230.00 dinner for 2 it did not live up to expectations.
What a beautiful place!  We had a blast and enjoyed our dinner very much.  The service was a little slow but we weren't in a hurry.

The view was amazing!  We both ordered the Sea Bass it was brilliant!  The flavor was exceptional, our server was phenomenal!  She was previously the guide for the hotels Camel Back hikes!!! She was a fabulous server! She had a beautiful name that I am struggling to put on paper! We will come back for sure! Thankyou!

Definitely a place catering to resort guests.  The place just feels so different from it's initial days.  The professionalism and gracious service replaced by such variation in service, makes you wonder if there are any standards set by management.  Food is great as always, but J&G is NOT a Jean Georges.  It is a Marriott food hall with a JG badge on it.
Jeff, Dave and Patrick did an incredible job. Top notch. Food...nothing short of amazing. The real deal.

The dover sole here is pricey:  $66/person, but we found it a bit heavy and overcooked. The remainder of dinner was fabulous but the fish was disappointing. You should be able to cut Dover sole with your fork, but I needed my knife.

The heirloom tomato appetizer was phenomenal, heirloom tomatoes with a Russian type dressing and some onions that have been fried on the top. Very very good.

The service is great, we had Austin for our server and he was very good and they work very well as a team.

Food and service perfect. Lovely anniversary celebration with the help of staff and chef ! My wife had chilled lobster and a butter perfect Chilean bass and I had perfectly prepared Dover sole. Having half bottles of wine available also appreciated. Capped off w gratis anniversary desert, also delish. Wonderful experience all around.
The food and service were excellent. We would eat here again without question. The background music was good a bit too loud for us.

The food was outstanding. The view is always spectacular over the city. Only thing is the service was sometimes sparse. They would not come by as often so for a drink, appetizer, meal, and dessert, expect a 3 hour dinner time.
Excellent service. Great set up and views from the restaurant.
Very good steakhouse and atmosphere.  I would come back- a little pricey but the food was very good.
This was my boyfriends birthday and he had the best time! Paul was our humble server and Patrick the GM was amazing.

The view from the dining room is awesome but, what we came to enjoy was the food, which was not awesome but rather mediocre at best.  Started with the ahi tuna appetizer, which was good but nothing came with it except your dinner roll, which is not appropriate.  Perhaps some flatbread chips or crackers?  We both had the small filets and shared the brussel sprouts.  The steaks were nothing to visit again for as both lacked a good char with grill marks and were overdone.  Birthday yogurt dessert was good but who wants yogurt on their birthday?  Overall, the view is great but the steaks at Steak 44 or Fleming’s r much tastier and grilled to perfection.  Maybe it was an off evening in the kitchen but, for us, no need to visit again when there r better options in the Valley.

First meal in a restaurant due to travel in a year. Food was awesome and staff very attentive. We also felt very safe here, they clearly have moved tables to distance the diners from one another which will limit the number of reservations. Clearly safety is more important.
Service was excellent • definitely recommend
Delicious food, beautiful views, friendly staff! Will definitely return.
Amazing atmosphere , amazing food, amazing staff. Jeff was taking care of us for the night and he was absolutely amazing. The experience was great, will be back again.
Met every expectation and did not disappoint. The Staff were very knowledgeable and the service was amazing what else can you say Will return!!!!
Anniversary
Great food and great service
Food was awesome. Atmosphere was unbelievable, in t did get noisy towards 8:00-9:00 due to singing at the bar. This is a restaurant that you want to go on a special occasion. The service is great!!!
Celebrated my birthday... the view was fabulous, the food was great and the service was amazing! Will definitely dine there again in the future!
An overall great place to dine.  Great food, friendly staff and beautiful views.

This is such a beautiful hotel with wonderful service, unfortunately the most overpriced, average food and meal I’ve ever had.  VERY average and poorly cooked expensive steaks.  Just blah tasting food.
The service and food were world class. It was very apparent that there is a high level pride taken in hosting every customer.
Jeff our server really set the stage for a great night. Well done.
Excellent quality of food and excellent wine list. We really appreciate the personalized service.
The Tomahawk steak was the best I've tried. I would gladly recommend the steakhouse to many of my colleagues. Also, the service was excellent, the food and sides were served fashionably on time.

Had a wonderful dinner.  My wife had a lobster cocktail and I had a shrimp cocktail.  We split the 24 oz porterhouse and creamed spinach.  Meat was prime....delishous (our dog reaped the benefit of the bone... packed and shipped via my suitcase!  The rosemary bread was great and the martinis were perfectly done.  Perhaps the best part of the meal was the carrot cake..... outrageous!  Would have loved to sit outside.....great views but unavailable.  Next time!  Highly recommend!!
If you have an opportunity to go here for dinner, the 30 oz. Wagyu Tomahawk Ribeye is absolutely amazing!
Celebrating 5th anniversary!!  Service from all staff was great and our waitress was awesome!! Will definitely be back! Glad we came!!

I had to send my steak back twice.  It was over cooked.  Very.  Never order the mushrooms.  They are awful.  Our waitress had too many tables.  She was running back and forth.  We had reservations and still had to wait 20 minutes.  Will never return. Huge disappointment.

The view, the staff, the food - everything was fantastic. Their attention to detail was spectacular, down to the adorable jars they used for their sauces. The food presentation was beautiful and tasted even better. The sweetest lady served us, I wish I remembered her name, but she continued to surprise us with complimentary items for us to try and she was so sweet and never made us feel rushed. Expensive, but outstanding 2 hour dinner worth every penny and second! Keep in mind portions are larger than expected.
The food, service and view were all amazing
We had an amazing experience and meal! Great ambiance!!
Everything was perfect. Quiet, elegant and the food had so many flavors. The waitress was very sincere and pleasant.
Beautiful views, great service, but facility is showing it’s age.
They did a wonderful job celebrating my daughter’s birthday. Made her feel very special

Amazing! Our waiters name was Jeff, he treated our table amazing and gave us the best experience visiting Arizona. He took his time explaining everything and the food was AMAZING. Definitely recommend! And the view is beautiful!
Amazing view & food, kind & attentive staff-  highly recommend! (I had the Dover Sole & shared the warm chocolate cake and carrot cake- delicious!)

Over priced food but the service and staff were very kind and welcoming. The French onion soup was the best thing we ordered. The veggie sides were the most disappointing. With all of the other dining options in the area, you’re better off leaving the resort for dinner.

Will go again but................
J&G at the Phoenician is fantastic looking restaurant. 5th floor overlooking the resort and Phoenix lights in the background. All the employees are great. Well all except the individuals in charge of cooking the steaks. 4 steaks for the table of 6. 2 of us ordered medium rare. Presented with well done, duh? 
Kinda of baffling for a steakhouse to mishandle the $65-80(retail)piece of meat. 

Other than that, it is marvelous darling
Waiter was excellent, Super great service and not intrusive great wine recommendations.
Ambience, views and amazing culinary choices... J&G Steakhouse

Our waitress Laurie and all of the staff was so great and very attentive. The whole experience was amazing from our view to the service to the food. Everyone went out of their way to tell us happy anniversary and it was such a nice gesture. Thank you!
Great service in the lobby bar and during dinner. Food was excellent.
Great food, service. Wine list and wine service was excellent. David & Peach provided great service. Peekytoe crab cake was over the top.
It was amazing.
First time staying at The suites and eating at this restaurant. Nice vibe, great views, friendly service. Tables well distanced.
Service and ambiance were delightful and menu offered great choices from seafood to steak. We enjoy small plates and there was a great selection to choose from.

This place was amazing! My son has special needs and they were so sweet to him. They answered his million questions and were engaged with him. The food was amazing and all the staff were super friendly.
My husband and I had an amazing anniversary dinner while staying at the Phoenician Resort! Good and service was outstanding!

We dined at J&G two years ago to celebrate our 2 year anniversary and happened to be in town again this year for our babymoon and we knew we HAD to go back. 

Needless to say, it was just as amazing as we remembered. Every item we ordered was incredible and the service was great. 

Try the crab cake and the chocolate cake!

Thanks for a perfect end to our babymoon.
Beautiful view, great service and delicious food! Definitely will be back!

We dined here to celebrate a 30th birthday while visiting the area. From the service when you check in with the hostess to the waitstaff everyone was extremely friendly and attentive. The food was great and cooked to perfection. They even gave my husband a card and cake for his birthday

Very nice dining experience.

Suzana was excellent.
Fantastic views, extensive wine list, excellent cuisine and attentive service.
Everything was great! The food, service, and the music. My girlfriend really enjoyed the ambience.
My husband and I brought our daughter and son-in-law for dinner. Everything was delicious!  Service, food and the view were all spot on!  Going back again soon!
This is a fantastic steakhouse with great service, wonderful views, and a romantic setting.

We’ve dined at J&G’s often and usually select it for very special occasions. This visit was for our wedding anniversary on New Year’s Eve. We noted that in our reservation and had a special request for table. Not only did we make our reservation months in advance but we arrived 1.5 hours early to sit at the bar for pre-dinner cocktails. And yet when they sat us for dinner it was a small table stuck at the end of a booth area with no view. When we requested to be moved they put us in a back room with a couple large group tables. One of those was occupied by a family with children that ran around the room with no parental control. We finally had to request another move and the third time was the charm we got a very nice table overlooking the outside. Why did we have to put up with so much frustration?

After that our service was great and the food was great as usual. Too bad we had a damper on our special occasion.
Wonderful dinner at J&G! Highly recommend to anyone visiting the area.
Everything was perfect and our server Jeff was amazing!!
Music way too loud!  good food but pricey, as is the wine list.  Somewhat snooty atmosphere
Great food great service and outstandind service
GREAT PLACE TO HAVE A HOLIDAY DINNER.SPECIALS WERE  WONDERFUL, AND SERVICE WAS EXCEPTIONAL

My family enjoyed Christmas at J&G Steakhouse. Food was outstanding (prime rib, filet mignon, NY strip and salmon). Cooked perfectly and delicious. Service was very good. Ambience was amazing as the views are gorgeous and seating is very comfortable. Hotel and restaurant felt exceptionally safe and clean. We will definitely be back!
Best Christmas Eve dinner we have had!! Staff was friendly, the food timely, and had a great table with a view. 10/10 experience!
Food, drinks and service was impeccable. The staff was friendly and paid attention to every detail. All meals were enjoyed. Will definitely go again!

Amazing food, atmosphere, service but a tad pricey on the food. This is a once a year special event or occasion restaurant. It was our Christmas gift to each other. Expect to spend over $200.00 for dinner or don't go.

Food was disappointing from what I remembered in the past. 
Could not wait for this place to open. Ordered a steak which was not up to standards. Too many fantastic steakhouses in Scottsdale to be disappointed. 

I do hate placing bad reviews but this was disappointing.
I would not go back.
One of the best experiences we’ve ever had. The food was unbelievable, the service was impeccable, and the views were spectacular. We will definitely be back anytime we are in Scottsdale!
Birthday Dinner
Always a great experience. Incredible Customer Service and simply Fantastic Food!

Amazing experience, ambience set the mood for a date, able to talk and really enjoy the scenery. Allowed us to experience the outside patio which was a beautiful view of the city. Would highly recommend.
Service and food was great. Everyone made us feel welcomed!
Food was just ok for the price.  Not impressed. Best part about the evening was the view and location.
Amazing restaurant....Paul our server was very attentive and helpful. Managers checked in our dinning experience a few times thru the night. Music was wonderful touch
The food was someone one would expect from Applebee’s.
J&G never disappoints.  Was a nice celebration for my Mom's birthday.  Thanks J&G for making in memorable.
Friends 50th spa weekend was fantastic! Gorgeous setting, awesome food and service! Was so happy it was lively with a 9:15 reservation 😀
Great service great food ... best bread 😀
Everything was incredibly excellent!!
Good experience.  Food was very good and steak was cooked to perfection.  Nice ambience and great view of the city.  I would recommend it.
Anniversary 30
Great steaks and stellar service!
Great service, ambiance and views!  Food was average.
First experience and by far meets above expectation. Will definitely recommend and will be for sure returning! They made my anniversary dinner perfect thank you!
All around a very great experience.  Austin was a great server, and the food was phenomenal!

Unfortunately we were disappointed. We were out celebrating my birthday. It was too loud. The food was as bland, the steak was mediocre. I have been to many steakhouses and my husband and I were simply not impressed.

No matter how good the food is, poor service can ruin the meal, as did our waitress that was inexperienced and distracted, which may have been management’s fault, by not providing her enough support. Terribly disappointing
Great place to eat and watch the sunset! Steak was amazing and The shrimp cocktail was amazing. Don’t forget to get a roll because that was good as well.
Anniversary dinner and we were treated very well.

From the moment I walked in J&G, it was breathtaking I was very happy they were open for my birthday trip to Phoenix. From the gracious host who seated is to the amazing waitstaff, the phenomenal food and dessert, I am overjoyed that I picked this place to celebrate my birthday. They also had a musical guest to sing and play he was amazimg. The music wasn't overbearing to the ears, the song selections were appropriate! The view? Amazing......they were not doing outdoor seating but we were able to take pics and still enjoy the view. If I am ever back in Phoenix, I will be dining here again. Great service. Great food.
Great experience.  Waiter went above and beyond.  Very helpful personable.
Great food and great drinks

Our waiter was older and not in touch or able to manage mixed ethic couple.  She had an in appropriate  opinion and it affected our service, other than that we loved the food . 

We are planning a larger event and would consider planning it here.
It was really great to finally be able to eat there again after their 5 month closure!!  Such a special venue 👌🏼

My husband and I celebrated our 33rd wedding anniversary at J&G and were lucky enough to have been seated at an outside table overlooking the magnificent pools of the Phoenician Resort, as well as the city lights.  The steakhouse just reopened after an extended COVID forced lockdown (8 months) and are doing an amazing job with keeping people safe, guests and employees.  The social distancing they've implemented is actually more than required.  All employees wear face masks and gloves and all areas inside and outside the restaurant are constantly being disinfected.  Our waiter, Austin, was extremely knowledgeable about both the food and wine menu, was friendly and attentive, and made us feel like royalty.  We can't wait to go back to J&G and the hotel itself to enjoy, what we feel, is the most beautiful resort/hotel property in the Valley.
It was a lovely dining experience. Austin was our server & could not have been more accommodating. Our special birthday celebration dinner was a success!

Staycation at the Phoenician.  Beautiful evening on the deck with spectacular view.  Food was outstanding.  The crab cake was all crab with a crispy outside under a citrus and ginger broth.  Tender and flavorful steaks cooked to perfection.
Everything was cooked to perfection! Breathtaking views of the mountains and city with a birdseye view of the pool!

Everyone was so helpful and friendly! I came here for my anniversary and there was a card for us at the table when we arrived. Numerous people came around to ask how everything was, and it made us feel like they genuinely cared about our experience. I couldn’t have asked for a better night. I loved the place, the people, the setting, and the all around vibes. Will definitely be coming back here again!
Wonderful as always.

The best in the Valley. Best view, best food and fantastic service. We don’t drink but with dessert and coffee after dinner it was about $100 per person. As a frugal person, it was worth every penny. My 2 sons and I were treated as if we were the only people in the restaurant. Absolutely magnificent.
To much money for poor food and service. Would not go to ever again.
In all the years we have been coming to spring training J&G is consistently excellent.   I could not recommend this spot more if you are in Scottsdale.

I’ve dinned here  every time I visit Scottsdale.  The food is amazing. I had the mushroom risotto as an appetizer. It was creamy cheesy and full of exotic mushrooms. I also had the pork belly . It was crispy on the outside tender underneath . I  also had their chopped salad. My husband had the salmon and he loved it. Beautiful views from the restaurant and the service was good.
We enjoyed dining at your restaurant  very much and look forward to doing so again when we return to Scottsdale.

We celebrated my husbands birthday with his elderly parents and it was so enjoyable. It wasn’t too loud for a steakhouse which sometimes the older folks don’t like. The views are spectacular!  The food was amazing!  Loved the lobster and peppercorn steak. Also enjoyed several desserts. One of the best dining experiences in the valley. We live here and will partake more often!!!

We were in the lobby and had asked the server to let the restaurant know we were there.  When the table was ready we would go up.  He said no problem.  They never got notice.  They have our table away. Guests of the hotel, why wouldn’t they call us?  They did seat us eventually.  The service was slow but food was delicious. They need improvement on water service, improve, 1 hour between salad and meal removing dirty plates.
Amazing restaurant, Best Rib eye steak ever. Awesome service. Would certainly go back for a special treat. If it wasn’t so expensive I’d be there every day.
Birthday dinner celebration
Great environment. Spectacular view of the valley. Top notch service. Delicious food!

Such a great place for a celebration dinner.  Definitely a worthwhile adventure; the food and service are well worth the price paid.  I would have preferred a quieter dinner, but it wasn’t nearly as loud as some places can get.  Plan to go at sunset and enjoy the view!

Celebrated our wedding anniversary here. From the reception thru to the ordering, the wine and the entrees and desert it was an awsome experience. Some of the nest steak I ever had. Will definetely go back again.
Fabulous food and even better service!! The view was spectacular also!! Totally recommend!!
Beautiful setting. Perfect for a business dinner (which was my purpose), date night, or with family. Stellar food and service.
We have never had a bad experience here. Service and food are always fabulous.

Lovely ambiance with horrible service.  The combination couldn’t be worse.  The wait staff could use some serious training. My husband’s steak came out and 10 minutes later my Dover sole arrived. By the time my fish arrived the watered down creamed spinach was cold.  For desert, the waiter brought my husband’s cake but forgot to bring my cappuccino.  
All in all, the food was just mediocre.  With all the other wonderful restaurants in town, why settle for mediocre food and horrible service.

We are staying at the hotel and booked a reservation at J & G for our anniversary.  When we arrived, we asked to be seated in one of the multiple open tables that were located near the glass view windows.  But to actually get that table, we had to (politely) argue with the front of house staff.  (I will note that the tables in that section did not fill up to full capacity the entire time we ate at the restaurant).  I'm not sure why this was such a process, but it was poorly handled by the front of house team.

As for the rest, the wait staff was good.  The food was tasty.  But a poor front of house team clouds everything.  

My advice?  Go somewhere else next time.  Good steak is easy to do.  Good front of house service should be too, but that escaped J & G.
Absolutely amazing meal! We will be back for sure! Service and food both amazing!
Excellent service!
Terrific service

Waitress was great. Everyone was VERY attentive. Dining room is beautiful. The beets with goat cheese were amazing! Highly recommend (and I generally don’t like vegetables!). Steak was good but considering the price should have been great. Doesn’t compare to Del Friscos or Maestros quality

The food was the best part but service  needs improvement . For the price tag , I had hoped for a more relaxed dining experience where dishes were not not removed before we were all done . The experience of getting there was NUTS!
 If you are not a hotel guest,you may never find your way with lobby on third floor and elevator controls on the outside. Disappointed that outdoor seating  was not available on a beautiful evening and only 4 tables with view were available inside. I would not recommend with that price structure ontop of it .
Valentine’s Day
Loved the atmosphere here. So beautiful with excellent food and service. Don’t miss the crab cake appetizer or the risotto.
We've been to many of the "best" dinner joints, and this one may very well be our favorite so far. Such a great experience!
Fabulous restaurant! The food was amazing as  well as the view! Couldn’t have asked for a better evening! We will definitely be returning!
Absolutely phenomenal!!
Loved J&G!! Beautiful restaurant. Made me feel very special on my birthday, Ula rocks!

Right from our pre- dinner beverage at the bar the service and friendliness was top notch . As we were seated for dinner the service remained at the highest level . We had some large parties around us due mostly to a convention / conference being held at the resort . This created a loud atmosphere, however we understood as we have been at those large sittings in other venues . All round excellent experience. Cheers Gord and Sue Mcintosh.
Awesome atmosphere and delicious food.
Classy place. Great date restaurant.
Our go to spot for birthdays
The waitress was amazing.  She was friendly, funny, engaging and made you feel like you were being pampered, but without intruding into your privacy.
Great location, ambiance and scenery, especially for the Phoenix area. Food and service were great, as were each of the menu items we ordered. I recommend.
J&G is hands down the best steak in town.  Amazing grass fed filet grilled clean with a little bit of olive oil.  The over roasted beet side dish is also divine

Was a little disappointed with the food and also we ordered the 2017 Caymus off the menu but they gave us a 2018. Price point is the same I think, but the 2 years taste different so it would’ve been nice to have been notified of that before we ordered it. We might’ve ordered something different. Feel like they tried to substitute without informing us.
It was wonderful!!
Everything was wonderful. The only issue is that I ordered filet to be medium rare. It was served medium well. Very disappointed.
Excellent food, service, and wine. Not to mention the incredible view. Thank you for a lovely evening!

Our hostess amy was exceptionally nice!
Love the food, ambience and patio fireplace seating!

One steak was great the other was sub par
The service was poor

I’ve been there numerous times and this is the worst experience I’ve had there - question is, is this the new normal ?

Disappointing from the start. We were sat in a 70% empty restaurant, but put next to a very loud table, even though it was an anniversary dinner. Our appetizers were not great. Onion soup with a peel in it. The calamari was under fried and over battered. Our ceaser salad was good. Our entrees were good,
Mine being the filet with king crab (not worth $135) my wife’s the NY strip. Our server was un-attentive. Staff walking around on their phones, it just wasn’t a high end steak house as advertised or priced. I would stick to the classics, Mastros or Steak 44 before coming here. It’s absolutely not worth it.
Awesome experience, super service and that view!

My brother and I come here annually for Barrett-Jackson auction. We always spend our first night at J/G.  The food is always great like the service and we always start with 3 dozen oyster followed by lobster or a great steak. Wine selection is first rate.  It’s located at the famous phoneian  hotel and the ambiance is awesome. Well worth the money!
The entire experience was delightful. And thank you for our dessert to celebrate our wedding.
I'm so glad that I chose J and G Steakhouse to celebrate my husband's birthday. The level of service was outstanding and the food was extremely tasty!
Our waiter was fantastic! Food was great! Have rebooked for our next trip to Phoenix!
The service was great, food great and view was fantastic!

Every once in awhile you really just want to go out and splurge on a nice dinner. You can certainly do that here so be prepared to pay but it was completely worth it. On a side note, while the hotel does charge for parking, the steakhouse will validate for you. When you are seated one of the first things you notice is the wonderful view of the valley below. My server was simply amazing as she was very friendly and attentive. I ordered a bison ribeye with a chili glaze along with the mashed potatoes on the side. Let me say, that steak was absolutely amazing. It was perfectly cooked and putting the chili glaze on top made it that much better. The mashed potatoes were light, fluffy and just wonderful. I will certainly be going here again.

Everything about our dinner was absolutely outstanding!  The service, the views, the food...just wonderful. We ate out at 4 of the other top rated dinner restaurants on Trip Advisor during our visit and J&G far exceeded all of them. Just so good!

On a positive note, the vodka martini was very good, my wife's Cosmopolitan was excellent and wine by the glass was a decent pour.  My wife's  soup was watery and somewhat tasteless.   Her risotto??? She ordered the appetizer portion but the bill reflected an Entree very high price.   I ordered the beef special for the evening @ $60.   It was was worth much less.   I doubt if we will return even though we are local.  For Marriott, we are Lifetime Platinum.
Great venue for New Year’s eve. They never tried to rush us out in favor of getting more diners through. Fantastic band playing! By far, one of my favorite steaks & places in the Phoenix area.

Went on New Year’s Eve and was concerned that we would be rushed and the food wouldn’t be great. Our party was over the moon about the service, food and atmosphere. We had a great night! From appetizers to dessert we were not disappointed. Our waiter was exceptional and didn’t rush our evening.Will definitely be going back.

We love to dine at J&G when we visit our daughter in AZ. We celebrated an early New Year’s dinner with her and as always was top notch. Food was great, we had seating overlooking the valley, and our server, Amy, was simply the best. Highly recommend!
In town for one of the college football playoffs. Great meal! Great service.
Great food and David was a great waiter. We will definitely dine here again if we come back in town. Thanks for a great experience

I love this restaurant, I am a regular . This time i did not quite love the environment that much : we were seated next to a large family with two small children. The kids were running around and screaming and crying . It kinda felt like a kindergarten cafeteria . At one point a kid around 6 yrs of age or so was stretched out on the floor by my feet.  Not ideal for a nice J&G's dinner.
It was an absolutely wonderful experience! The food was magnificent, the service was great and I will definitely be back!
J&G Steakhouse is an excellent dining experience for the holidays.
Exceptional
Always on target.  Only neg was the use of our dinner to train a server to debone a fish.  Otherwise charming evening.
Staff was excellent. Food was excellent. If I could ask for one thing is that the live entertainment was a bit lower in volume. Overall it was excellent. I will return!
Food was good. Service was good. But certainly nothing mind-blowing or memorable about the experience.
Outstanding food quality, great service and server, will return soon!
Beautiful setting, first class service, delicious food.

The location, the setting and the view were all outstanding.  Our server was a bit aloof and there was an unusually long wait between courses and from the end of the meal to receiving a check.  The food was quite good but we have had equally good, or better, at other restaurants for a much lower price.  I might consider J&G again for some VERY special occasion but not for an ordinary dining out dinner.
Amazing food and wonderful staff! The restaurant was absolutely beautiful and the view was amazing.
Birthday celebration
Nice date night. Food was very good overall.
Outstanding  food, service, and atmosphere.  Would definitely recommend.

Delight sunset dining with a delightful staff, very attentive and excellent wine menu. All four courses were just excellent and the blood red orange sorbet with cheesecake was unbelievably delicious!! A must visit when in town.

Food was good and portions were large. Steak was cooked properly and was tender and tasty, dover sole was perfectly cooked and delicious!  Decor somewhat overdone in our opinion. Service was competent, but when we complained about a very noisy group of 12 seated adjacent to us, nothing was done. On the other hand the glass of champagne we each had as an aperitif was madeirized or off in some other way; a second glass was the same but we did not send it back. Nevertheless we were NOT charged for it.

J&G was our choice for an anniversary celebration.  We started with cocktails at the well-known Thirsty Camel bar in the lobby.  It was an exceptional experience!  Particularly enjoyed the Thai Fighter- vodka, Malibu, basil, and other yummy ingredients.  Cannot wait to try it again.

The steakhouse has a nice atmosphere- energetic, nicely appointed, AND, you can hear yourself think!  The service was 100% on the mark, and there is an excellent wine list.

Only 1 type of bread is offered, a roll that is only okay and not worth the calories.  The real standout of dinner were the sides- excellent salad, fabulous roasted beets, and wonderful parmesan risotto.  

On to the steaks- Surprisingly, not the best.  The meat was of an okay but not superior quality.  We both had filets and they were not flavorful.  Once again, Capital Grille is my standard and the steak is significantly tastier.

Since it was our anniversary, we were treated to a great chocolate lava cake with caramel ice cream!

Food was average at best and service was below par for this price point. We ordered appetizers, salads , steak, salmon, for 4 People.  I would rank J&g has middle to lower middle of all the high end steakhouses in Phx

We enjoyed a wonderful anniversary dinner at J & G! Both the hostess who seated us and our server wished us a happy anniversary as they greeted us. Our server was personable and friendly without hovering. We were seated at a table with a great view of the city. 
We started with glass of New Mexican sparkling wine and a delicious mushroom soup. We each enjoyed entrees of filet mignon, which was perfectly cooked and served with three different sauces and grilled shishito peppers. We also shared sides of asparagus and broccoli; the asparagus portion was perfect, while the broccoli portion was more than we could finish. We accompanied our dinner with a bottle of Dos Cebazos red blend, which was a perfect accompaniment to the filet. As she was clearing our table, our server commented that, "Something delicious this way comes." A few moments later, our complementary dessert was served, a pumpkin cheesecake with a scoop of honey ice cream and a ribbon of chocolate emblazoned with "Happy Anniversary." A really lovely anniversary dinner!
Originally, just old friends getting together after a couple of years. Discovered during dinner it was also their Wedding Anniversary...Always great getting together with old friends...

FOOD.  Good but I expected to be blown away.  Living in Houston, we have a local steakhouse with an awesome wine list.  Having lived in NYC and having heard "Jean-Georges", I expected J&G to be world class.  Certainly better than the local place anyhow.  Nope.  Steak was good but required the special side sauces to be better than good.  The special salad, warm carrots with goat cheese and pine nuts, was good but had gratuitous avocado (it's Phoenix, you have to have avocado even if the flavor profile of the rest of the dish has nothing to do with it?).  My husband's foie gras apparently tasted less rich than others (and was the pate sort instead of the lobes that he prefers), and also had a gratuitous chutney that added nothing.  
SERVICE.  Was awesome.  The waitstaff recommended a reasonably-priced wine that went very well with the meal and met my description of what I was looking for.  I'd have spent double but they didn't push the higher priced options.  Great food recommendations also.  It is a pet peeve of mine that waitstaff will respond with a "they're both good" when asked which is better.  Not the case here - did come with a "this is my personal preference and yours may be different" but that is fine.  Also, attentive without being obtrusive.  Perfect.
AMBIANCE.  Very pretty space.  Pretty loud, however, so I wouldn't recommend it for a place to catch up with a friend you haven't seen in a while.
Amazing beautiful place
We love Jean George but the food here is NOT up to JG standards.
Our server was amazing. She was very friendly and made it a fun evening out.
We had horrible service. We waited over 2 hours for our food, and we had 2 young children with us. The steaks were good, but our experience was ruined by the incredibly poor service.
Excellent food service and ambiance. Fairly expensive but good quality
We had an amazing dinner at J&G. The food was top notch. Our waiter David and the support staff were all outstanding. The setting and ambiance were excellent. We will definitely go back.

We had dinner at J&G Steakhouse for our wedding anniversary.  This was the first time that we have eaten there and it was fantastic.  The moment we walked in the hostess wished us a Happy Anniversary.  Our server and the manager both wished us a Happy Anniversary.  The service was tremendous and the food was fantastic.  J&G treated us very well and we will definitely go back.

A number of issues, too many to list, led the Manager to comp our meal. My wife and I were looking forward to this as our last dinner in Scottsdale, and as we were staying at the Phoenician, thought it would be convenient and delicious. Really disappointed, we will not dine here again on future stays.
Fabulous! A gorgeous restaurant at a gorgeous resort!  Fantastic service! We had a great time!
Outstanding service, food, ambiance and an incredible view!  Make sure you ask for a table outside on the balcony.
Amazing. This was an anniversary dinner and she was amazed, really made the night.
Favorite spot in Scottsdale
Excellent service.  Food was amazing
Awesome environment. Great views, phenomenal service and great steak. Will definitely be back.
Was pretty much ignored by the wait staff.
for a hotel restaurant... superb... and fabulous staff
Spectacular sunset balcony view backdrop to a first class dining experience.  Steaks done to perfection.  One of the best foie gras terrine you can find in the US.  Service is top notch.

My experience was amazing. The perfect choice for my birthday dinner. The food was delicious! I love crab legs and it was so awesome the crab came cracked and ready to eat. My steak was delicious and tender. My bday dessert was outstanding’ 5stars
It was nice. Service could have been more attentive and servers better equipped to answer questions about the menu.
Have been there many times. Worst steak and disappointing this time. Flavorless. At these prices not sure I would return unless they would comp me to make up for 4 bad steaks and $350 bill
We set outside with a beautiful night time view of the valley and our steaks were perfect.
Celebrating a birthday! We splurged and did the tasting menu. Wow!

Service was not good. Waitress thought she should tell jokes about my non drinking.  Wasn’t funny.  Appetizer and meal took quite awhile to arrive.  The placements were removed before dessert was brought.  Birthday celebration so a free dessert was brought to the birthday person but I was never asked if I wanted to order dessert.  Person with iPad walking around and giving orders and seemed annoyed.

There was an issue with one entree not being placed and when three of us had our food served we choose to wait for the 4th entree to be served.  The server was very gratious but the Manager was quite obnoxious and told the three of us we should go ahead and eat and not wait for the fourth guests filet.  The three of us who had food told the manager that would be rude to eat in front of her.  He asked us if we wanted our food put on the warmer.
The manager put it all on the server.  The manager should have come over and told us what accommodations were going to be made for our total inconvenience .  They did make accommodations for our meal but the manager was totally out of line.
I waited several weeks to write this review because I wanted to write a fair review
Fantastic food service best steak in town. Amazing service. Over and beyond what you would expect.  The views were beautiful. Such a great experience.
Very good experience we loved everything

Great food, but our waitress was always making jokes and acting weird every time she came by the table. Even showed a picture of her mom to the table next to us. In comparison, last time we ate there the waiter was very attentive and meticulous. I see that he was still there. Wish he would have had our table the other night.

We came in to celebrate my husbands 50th birthday! We are both Native Arizonans but had never been to this restaurant before. Amazing views! Amazing food! Amazing service. Zach took exceptional care of us and was on point with everything!!! Attention to detail made the experience extra special. We will definitely be back again and would highly recommend to friends and family!
Anniversary
Waited 25 minutes before someone took our drink order. Ordered our steak medium and it came out well done. Way over priced for the quality.
Excellent like always! Beautiful ambience,views, service and outstanding food!
Between the impeccable service, attention to detail and astounding food quality, the evening was a hit!
Beautiful view of Phoenix. Awesome food and great service.
Such a wonderful experience! Staff was exquisitely attentive and supportive, the food was delicious and the aura of the restaurant was romantic and private. Husband and I will return!
I enjoyed dining here. There attention to detail and service is great.
Always excellent
I absolutely loved this place!  Everything was wonderful, from the food to the service and the ambiance. Wow, just amazed thank you for your excellent service.
Host was not kind
The restaurant was spectacular. The service was very good and the food was wonderful. I would not hesitate to go back again. It made our anniversary really special.

We dined at this restaurant while we were staying at the Phoenician resort. We were looking forward to it and had high expectations based on the reviews that are posted here and also the reputation. We were overall disappointed in the experience. There were four of us and one of the steaks was overcooked. I will say that they removed it from our bill which we appreciated. A few noteworthy items, one is we ordered a chopped salad before dinner and they brought it out late with the dinner. However, the worst part was that it looked like they just put a bag of lettuce onto the plate and nothing else. I wish I would’ve taken a photograph because it was so confusing. I have had far better chopped salads at fast food restaurants. Additionally the rolls were not served warm and seem to be days old, not fresh. This is a small thing but at a restaurant of this caliber you expect more. Another detail that was confusing is that they had paper placemats at the tables. This seemed cheap in comparison to the rest of the ambience here. And, considering you are there for a fine dining experience. 

Overall, for the price point of the restaurant.and the Jean Georges reputation it fell very flat and we were disappointed.

Took a wonderful girl to one of the most scenic restaurants in Arizona.

Best.Date.Ever.
Great view and fantastic service. I had the grilled lobster which was cooked perfectly. Hubby had peppercorn steak—a little over cooked but ok. And the dessert was amazing.

I ate dinner here and will recommend to friends. My dining partners and I shared food that made the experience that much greater. Our server, Amy, was great as well. She gave honest feedback on menu items and gave us time and space to enjoy ourselves. If you’re looking for a place for wonderful views of Phoenix and great food, stop by this place. Located at the Phoenician resort.

Not the best food but it was pretty good.
The ambiance made up for it for sure!
We sat out on the balcony and it was perfect.
Everything surpassed our expectations. Amazing delicious unique food. Spot on service. Nice view. Can't ask for anything more.
Amazing location. Stunning views. Friendly staff. Excellent food. Thank you for a wonderful evening.

We sat outside on a balmy evening and it was delightful. Shared a dover sole, plenty for each and those good Comte potato's.  Potato's good but not great; seemed to have been scooped into casserole, topped w/cheese and put under the broiler for a minute, as opposed to baking en-casserole.
Sitting outside provided benefit of lower volume level of music; a good thing for us looking for super club softness, not boom-boom discord.
The dover sole is the draw for us; noteworthy!!
amazing service loved everything about this 5 star restaurant
Great view, excellent service and nice atmosphere for business discussion.  Menu was more limited than I would have expected however.
Took my mom for her bday dinner during Restaurant Week and tried the special menu. Everything was delicious and the view was spectacular. Will definitely come back with my husband!
Not the best steak

Steaks took 45 min to come out and were very over cooked (my medium rare steak came out medium well). It was obvious they had sat in the window a long time. Took another 20 mins for them to remake a rare and medium rare steak. So we sat there for over an hour between our oyster appetizer and our dinner. The 2nd ribeyes were ok temperatures, but they were tough, under seasoned, and not very good at all. We have been to many fine dining steakhouses in many large cities, and this did not compare to quality we expected. We will not be returning.
Beautiful restaurant and very professional service. The food was delicious and nicely presented.   Extra bonus, was the 3-course restaurant week menu.

Food left something to be desired; steak was over cooked and asparagus salad was clearly out of season - seasoning in general was subpar. We’ve been to Jean-George’s Inn at Pound Ridge and this is a far cry from that level of quality. View was beautiful and the staff is excellent.

This was my secondmd time coming to J & G Steakhouse. The staff is very friendly and they make you feel welcome. The ambiance is amazing. The view is breath taking. I would definitely recommend coming here to eat. I know i will be coming back.

Steak was grossly over cooked 
A fish dish had no taste 
Service waitress didn’t recognize my wife’s presence in usual “proper order”
Awesome place with fabulous food, impeccable service, and a wonderful staff.
This restaurant is absolutely worth every dollar!!!

The view was spectacular. We all loved our cocktails. The service was ok. But the food was a huge disappointment. Overall, it was Bland. Dishes were Cold when they should have been warm, and the dessert was burned! Not a little browned but blackened and inedible. We won’t waste our time here again.
We have been there several times over the last number of years. The food is always fantastic. We went for restaurant week. We had the steak and fish as usually very tasty and more reasonable cost.
Service impeccable, food delicious, cocktails tasty, view beautiful.
Jeff was so kind. Had a great experience.

Our special anniversary dinner at J&G was absolutely fabulous.  We started with the charred corn ravioli - not sure just what to expect, but it was delicious, served in a lovely pesto sauce and garnished with cherry tomato halves.  We shared the dover sole grenobloise, which was deboned tableside, and was just as wonderful as it has been in previous visits. We shared asparagus on the side, done just right and accompanied with a lemon slice. Our complimentary anniversary dessert satisfied our chocolate cravings with a lava cake and accompanying ice cream and other chocolate trimmings.  Even in the resort off-season, the restaurant was quite busy, but the nicely separated seating areas kept the noise level comfortable and easy for conversation. This is our go-to spot for special occasions.
We had one of the best dinners we have ever had here! Our server, Jeff, was amazing and the food was delicious!
Our waiter, Zack, was awesome! We dined on a Monday night so not many patrons and therefore a quiet evening. French onion soup was probably best I’ve ever had. Overall a great experience.
Beautiful ambiance!
the Waygu for 2 was the bomb, Robert was a great server and knowledgeable

The Phoenician is an unbelievable resort and J&G couldn't compliment this place better!  The food was incredible and the new remodel is stunning.  The entire staff, especially our server Amy, was 5 star!  We will be back!

Bar area was awesome.  Had a drink before dinner.  Dinner was great too, but once they started playing live music in the lounge, it was way, way, way too loud for my taste.  Had to focus to listen my partner sitting right next to  me.  Will definitely go again, just hopefully the music will turned down a few notches.
Average meal at best. Limited selection.
From the first touch at the Hostess Stand to the end of the evening, It was magical...Food was awesome and the service even better.  A Great Special occasion place...we will be back!
Beautiful steakhouse, amazing views, best service!  Be sure to ask for Amy, she’s fabulous!
My only complaint was the music was too loud. Other than that everything was perfect!

This is a beautiful restaurant with amazing views overlooking Phoenix. The service was excellent and the food was delicious. I have dined here several times over the years and it has remained consistently top notch. Great for date night or anytime.
Awesome place!

We were in from out of town for a special event and J&G was recommended to us. We couldn’t have asked for better. The view was absolutely stunning and the food was amazing. The service was a top-3 experience in our opinion. Ask for Amy - she is the best.
Wonderful service, wonderful food. A real fine dining experience.
Excellent service, fantastic food - always a pleasure dining at J&G.
First evening of week off in Phoenix - terrific!
Beautiful views, excellent food and top notch service! The servers have consistently done a great job at making our dining experience one of the best.
Great atmosphere and location. Amazing views and the food was great. Amy was an awesome waitress and really made the experience.

Service at The Phoenician was excellent; ambiance ok; the food was terrible. We ordered the most expensive on the menu with added lobster tail, the heirloom tomato salad. Both were recommendations. The cod was terrible - in fact we both got sick from it. We have had perch and walleye on a Friday night fish fry that far exceeded the cod. The salad was fair, the corn ravioli was poor. Even the presentation was not great except for the desert. Would not go back or recommend. Appreciated the experience, but next time I'll listen to the locals and go somewhere else. Sorry Phoenician. I wanted it to be a great review!

So this place is beautiful. I’ve been there three times recently. The food is top notch. The view is best in town with the possible exception of Elements. We did not have a pleasant waitress. The hostess, host and managers were all very kind but she brought the mood down. When you are paying $100/person you expect only the best. Also I was already down on the service and when the check came they charged me for refills of my Arnold Palmer. Maybe that’s normal but I hate getting nickled and dimed.
