I think this place is worth going to but I hope your server is more pleasant. And order tea if you want free refills as they explained the lemonade mixed with tea makes it a nonrefillable drink. It’s the little things that make the entire experience the best and they missed it by an inch.

We enjoyed the meal.  Meats and appetizers were great.  Sides were a mix of very good and why can’t you get this right?  It was our anniversary and the restaurant and staff did a very nice job of recognizing this and surprised us with a wonderful desert.

The noise level was a bit of a negative.  There was a large group celebrating a birthday.  They were loud and the f-bombs were a spoiler.  It should have been managed.  When they left the restaurant quickly became what it should be.  Casual and romantic.

All in all there is no doubt we will return.

This was my wife's and my first time to the J&G and it was nothing short of spectacular. The food was simply amazing. The ambiance was good. The location is impeccable. And our staff, Candice, made the entire evening that much more special. She was pleasant, professional and just a joy to be around, making small talk when appropriate, making us laugh more than once, and meeting all of our dining needs. Thank you for a fantastic evening!
A grand and lovely dining spot at the resort and we were proud to celebrate our 19th anniversary there!
The food and the staff was amazing. I enjoyed the restaurant the view was memorable.

First time to J & G.  Overall just average food nothing that stood out that would bring me back. I honestly have had better tasting food at Capital Grill and Preston's.  The prices are basically the same. Service was extremely slow over 2 hours for dinner. UHH  The views of the city were beautiful and very clean looking facility. Nothing wowed me to come back again!
Food was great and service was excellent
The chopped salad and corn ravioli were amazing. The bartender was friendly and so was our server. Our entire meal was very good.

We had several of the fish dishes and they were really tasty and of good quality. The drinks wete good as well.  My only complaint is that the restaurant was freezing cold. I don't understand why most restaurants do this. You come in from excessive heat and they have it turn down to 60ﾟ or something and you can't stand it. I practically feel like I have to wear Winter clothes to go out to dinner in the summer here. Our server was quite helpful and efficient. I have no complaints about the place except next time I think I will bring a parka.

We asked for no mussels on our seafood app. and to be replaced with oysters. We did not get the extra oysters. We said something our waitress. When she cam back she explained to us that someone in the kitchen said they had given us extra oyster's. Not true! We both ordered filets. One was to be med and the other med rare. They both came out med well. The bus boy cam over and asked if I would like to have another drink (Bacardi and diet), I said yes. He came back with a coke. I can't have soda unless it's diet. 
I was not pleased with our experience. The waitress was very nice. I will not recommend J & G to my friends. For what you're charging the prices are to high. When your prices are what they are then your customers expect a bit more.
Everything was great, from the view to the food to the service. Top notch!!!
The service and food was deserving of a 5 star rating! I have never been disappointed coming to dine here!

Beautiful location and the service was very good. The dinner rolls that began the meal were good and the desserts that ended the meal were excellent. The problem was what was served between. We ordered the three course meal. I ordered the watermelon gazpacho, not very tasty. Companion had the charred corn ravioli, extremely salty. A very long wait before the entrees arrived. We both ordered the flat iron steaks. These were, without a doubt, the worst steaks that I have ever had. The steak knives provided had a difficult time cutting through them. I managed to finally cut four bite size pieces, one of which I had to spit out. I gave up at that point and looked at companion's plate. What a mess. She had worked very hard and hadn't been able to cut through much of it. Server offered to cook us some fillets, but didn't want another long wait. We ate our desserts and left. Cannot recommend this restaurant. One star for ambience.
It is a wonderful experience with great atmosphere and impeccable service!  Great night!
We were hugely disappointed.  Meat over cooked with no flavor, environment too loud and poor service.  We won’t return.
Our experience was outstanding from the moment we entered until we left. The staff was very friendly, humorous, fast, efficient and worked hard at satisfying our every need.

Very good food. We found it a little to dark and had problems reading the menus.
My father-in-law who has travelled the world said the Dover sole was the best he’s ever tasted.
Every steak was cooked to everyone’s requests.
Very happy Scottish family
We had a Caesar salad, a crab cake, and a halibut entree. Of course the food was fresh and cooked properly, however the flavoring wasn’t inspiring and bold. The pairings were average.

Service was great. Walked in the door and was treated very well. Nice music playing in the back ground and a beautiful view of the city from the patio. 
J&g brisket burger was amazing! 
I’ll be back for seconds.
Terrific view and not as pricey as you might expect

Steak was well done instead of medium.  Sent it back but my food did not come back until my companion was finished 20 minutes later. By that time I did not want to eat alone.  If he had waited for my meal to arrive his dinner would have been cold.  Ruined our evening out.

We were celebrating our anniversary and we high expectations of this restaurant the food was okay but our server was slow and she appeared to have a poor attitude times between courses was slow 
There was management going around speaking to customers but this one went to every table spoke to customers but never came to ours seamed to pay more attention to a table of females ! One manager did come to us and at that time everything was good but it went downhill from there.
We wanted to finish wit an Irish coffee our server said she could do that but we wanted Baileys in ours she served these up but they were cold and no cream on top we drew that to her attention so we asked for the bill she went got the bill and left the Irish coffees on the bill we said we are not paying for cold coffee she took the bill away and came back with an adjusted bill threw it on the table and walked off I said to my wife that was just rude so I said I am going to pay at the reception so we went up to the desk and then the rude manager came over we gave him $200 and I said the waitress we had had a bad attitude he just looked at the $200 vouchers and said okay you are good to go no apology nothing !!
We also noticed during our meal that a table behind us was also having issues !
Just a waste of $200 and a rude Server and Manager
Never Again at this place. 
We get better service at Flemings
KkCelebrating one year of exclusive dating.  It was by far, the best food date for both of us.

I am surprised I don’t come here more. The ambiance was awesome. View is amazing. Service was great. Leaned toward the over attentive but prefer that to being ignored. I had the tasting menu which I highly recommend. The chocolate cake was great. My friends ordered the sorbet which I would stay clear of.   Overall I highly recommend this restaurant.
Took my wife to J&G Steakhouse for our 20th Anniversary. Had a great time! Ambience is wonderful and food was excellent!
If you’re ever in Scottsdale Arizona you must have dinner here. We loved all our choices especially the Bison prime rib

Amy and the rest of the wait staff are wonderful and SO much fun. The food is very tasty and cooked to perfection. The couple extra perks brought out to make the evening extra special for my son and I was a very nice touch and extremely thoughtful. And then, of course, there’s the view. Just beautiful at sunset. It’s the off season so is not quite so busy right now. I highly recommend this steakhouse for an upscale, yet not stuffy, fun night out.

We were expecting more from J&G. There are so many superb steakhouses in Phoenix/Scottsdale. This does not measure up. Disorganized service from the hostess to the server. Seemed like a lack of training and management oversight. Steaks were very good, no complaints there. We had to look for an alternative server to order a bottle of wine as ours was harried and busy elsewhere. Wine list could do with more options under $100. Huge disparity in Cabs from a few under $100 to a jump to $150 +. With so much competition in fine steakhouses J&G really needs to tighten up.

Went there to celebrate our friends upcoming wedding. It started off well. Appetizers were good, we got seafood platters. After that service went down the drain. Took over an hour to get our entrees. A couple of the steaks were over cooked. Didn’t even get an apology. We were there over 3 hours to have dinner. So disappointed. They ruined our plans and what was suppose to be a great night. I don’t think I’ll go back. Spend your money somewhere else.
I came been back for the oregano / chili lobster. I have never had lobster with seasoning before and it was fantastic. Good sized lobster and worth the money!
Our dinner was good. Service was outstanding. Our table had a beautiful view. This made our birthday celebration even more special. Thanks J&G Steakhouse…
We had a lovely dinner this evening... the view was amazing, service and food were excellent!

Amazing service ambience and view was nice as well . The food was fast fresh and taste great. They showed a lot of value to the customers and for my wife birthday thanks again J&G Steakhouse we will be back again.

I’ve had better steak for a fraction of  the cost that they charge here. The potato described as “big as a boat”  and big enough to share was disappointing. Did not seem very fresh and was undersized for two to share. The asparagus was excellent. The chocolate molten cake was “ok”, I’ve had better on the cruise ships. The waitress although nice enough seemed to be trying too hard to impress. All on all, the dinner was nice but certainly not worth the cost. Would not recommend or return to this restaurant
Everything was outstanding except the service; I definitely expected better at this price point.

The service, and specifically our waiter Jeff, was excellent.  Food was mixed.  Dover Sole was wonderful.  New York Peppercorn steak was cooked to order (Medium), but some parts seemed a bit tough.  Filet was the same.  Chocolate sorbet was excellent.  But overall, enjoyed our visit.
The summer special was wonderful! Excellent food and service!
Awesome! Nice experience!

We waited forever for our entrees. When we questioned, we were told the kitchen was backed up. Really, the restaurant was only 1/3 full. Filets were over cooked & placed on a plate with 3 peppers rolling around. Ridiculous for this price point.

J&G Steakhouse was by far one of the best meals we’ve shared together. We visited the Scottsdale area for our 2 year anniversary and couldn’t have been happier with our night. We got a hand written Happy Anniversary card, a window seat with an amazing view, and an anniversary dessert. It is on the pricey side but we were prepared and happy to pay for the excellent meal. Thanks so much for a memorable night. Our waiter was Zachary, I believe, he was incredibly professional and knowledgeable. Couldn’t be happier.
Waitress Amy did a wonderful job treating my friend with a birthday surprise.  We will be coming back.

We had a wonderful dining experience at J&G.  We were celebrating our daughter’s 22nd birthday, and the staff couldn’t of been more friendly and accommodating. Ask for Amy, she is a wonderful server and has a great personality. The food is great, ambience perfect. Enjoy when you want a great meal or special occasion.
Very attention and great service.

Excellent restaurant to celebrate a special occasion.  Ambience was fantastic, with a great view.  Service was not rushed, and all servers worked as a team and were attentive to the table without being asked.  Food was fantastic, and loved the gazpacho.  Wine is a bit pricey, but very extensive list.  One of the best experiences we have had dining in Scottsdale.
It was my husbands birthday!!! Wonderful from start to finish

It was just ok. My steak was overcooked, but I didn't want to ruin the evening by sending it back. We were celebrating our anniversary and my husband's filet turned out just fine. Sides were lukewarm. The shrimp cocktail tasted like frozen shrimp. Service was nice. View was amazing at sunset.
Great food great service. We have been here multiple time since moving here and we are just blown away each time. Great food (great chef) great atmosphere and the service is impeccable.

Loved everything but the lobster. Much too small for a restaurant of that caliber. Would have been exquisite had the restaurant gone the extra mile on this dish in line with the rest of the menu/ambience

This was our first visit and we were amazed at the level of superb service. Very attentive staff. Exceptional dinner. And those fabulous views of the city. Wow! We'll definitely be back on our next visit to Scottsdale!

J&G is one of our favorite places.  The people are friendly and accommodating.  We asked for a special table and they accommodated us.  Our food was prepared perfectly with attention on flavor and plating.  Ambiance is great!

Our server my have been a little inexperienced, however, she tried her best to make the experience enjoyable.

Food was delicious! Filet was perfectly.cooked, bison ribeye was perfectly cooked. Outstanding meat. And let me just say that if I could do a snow angel in any food it would be in the mashed potatoes. Delicious! Although, it is followed by a snow angel in the coconut sorbet. Wonderful dinner. We will be back next time we are in town. Thank you!
Amazing food and amazing service!
Excellent in all respects.  This is a great place for a special occasion meal.
We had a wonderful meal served by Ula and Darius.  Food, atmosphere and service were exceptional
The steak was out of this world and our server was impeccable!  Great experience!

The assistant server was a better role through out our dinner service than our server. The server left our table unattended, was short, talked across our table to another and mistakenly ordered 3 sides @full charge instead of a vegetarian medley on one plate. 
For a Wednesday evening with hardly anyone inside it took almost 2 hours on a 2 top. 
The food was excellent and the assistant server was on point. The host station was welcoming when arriving and had noted it being a celebration.
Attractive dining room with outstanding views!  Service and food were excellent.  Menu featured a number of interesting options and specials.

I went to dinner there with a friend 2 weeks ago.  It was so delicious that I brought my husband back for dinner this past week.  The service, the dinner and the view was great.  I highly recommend it!

I had dinner with a friend and the food was delicious!  There is a spectacular view of Camelback Mountain and Scottsdale from every seat in the dining area.  I'm taking my husband there for dinner tonight!
Birthday dinner. We enjoyed the 5 course wine pairing menu and our waitress did a fabulous job of timing our dishes and explaining each wine.

Wonderful evening at J&G Steakhouse! Unlike other steakhouses in the area, the noise level in the restaurant is comfortable. Combined with the beautiful views, the atmosphere is lovely. We availed of the $45, 3 course summer menu and the food was outstanding, as was the service. We'll be back!
Everything was terrific.  The icing on the cake is that the wine was 50% off and was excellent.  Definitely will be back.....and soon.

Hands down the best steak house is town!! We take clients all over the Valley to celebrate and J&G Steakhouse is by far our favorite!! The view is amazing, the food is amazing, the entire experience is off the charts!! Thank you for always taking care of us, can't wait to go back!

The J&G steakhouse is the perfect a fine dining experience for couples. The food quality is excellent and everything from the initial arrival to departure feels planned and prepared perfectly.  The food, wine, and service are all first class.
Father’s Day

Great restaurant and property. The staff was very attentive and helpful. Great recommendations on menu and never had to wait for anything.  The staff was very professional and knowledgeable, will def be going back again and again.

My husband and I celebrated our anniversary at J&G Steakhouse. Our experience from the first drink at the bar in the lobby, to our surprise dessert at the restaurant was outstanding! Mandy, our very friendly and thoughtful server at the bar made sure J&G knew it was our anniversary. Our table was next to the window with beautiful views of the AZ sky and mountains! We were able to relax with our glasses of wine and enjoy the ambiance.  Our server Ula and staff went out of their way to make our dinner enjoyable.  We shared an iceberg salad, asparagus risotto and a very flavorful filet mignon. What a pleasant surprise when the chocolate lava cake and ice cream arrived! I can’t forget to compliment our valet when he asked if we wanted our picture taken in front of the fountain when we were leaving. I would definitely recommend an evening at The Phoenician for an awesome experience!
The spectacular sundown view is hard to beat.  Her to imagine a more attractive Vista.
Excellent. Beautiful atmosphere and top notch service. My steak was perfect.
The tasting menu was wonderful... We highly recommend it for a lovely special occasion dinner out.

Food was great as always and the service was outstanding. The ambiance is like no other. This is actually affordable and the tasting menu is only $60 something. Even the leftovers were neatly packed and you pick them up on your way out.

It was my first time coming here. I wanted to take my mother & brother out to a nice restaurant in town as it was their first time in AZ - wanted to show them the best AZ had to offer. We had crab cake for app and I was not loving it very much. It had too much lemon taste to it. We had steak and mashed potatoes and I must say the potatoes were one of the best I've had and the steak was delicious. However, I was not impressed with the experience - maybe because it was a Wednesday night? Anyway, will try coming again with my husband.  Here is a picture of the view outside and of the cute rolls they give.
Everything we ordered was delicious. Salad, steaks, sides, dessert, cocktails and wine all good. Courteous service. The best meal we have had at the Phoenician.
Food and environment was awesome!!!! Not sure our waitress was all that thrilled but who cares?! We loved it anyway! Best Cosmo over ever had and bison ribeye!!!!
Food is always delicious and Zac our waiter is amazing.

Nothing was particularly bad but nothing stood out in any way. At this price point there are just too many dining options in town and when it comes to premium level steakhouses this one just doesn’t measure up.  
Everything was fine—no opportunities to specifically complain, but it was all pretty average.
Best Filet I have had in Phoenix
I had the gluten free chicken- not great! Very loud group with kids next to us.
Great food with great views!!

for us it is almost 100 miles round-trip to have dinner at J&G Scottsdale.   That said, we go there for most of our special occasion dinners.     It is a lovely setting.   The food is outstanding, well worth the trip.    Nice decor, excellent wait staff.    Have not had a poor experience yet.  It can be somewhat pricey, depending on what you order, but we keep coming back for more because we enjoy it so much.

Daughter’s birthday. Amazing service and personal attention. 
Cannot recommend enough!!
It was awesome! From our waiter to the food! Will be going back soon!
Excellent! We’re only sorry about the rear wall of “mountain mirrors “... most unfortunate. Otherwise, the renovation was lovely, although the former design was wonderful.

There was a group of 6 of us celebrating my engagement! We had the “tasting menu”. . . One of the best meals I’ve had, start to finish. The view and ambiance were perfect. We also stayed until 10:30pm, when they closed at 9. . Our server Austin was amazing, he never rushed us, or made us feel like a burden. Excellent service and excellent dinner, highly recommend.

Walking into the restaurant I immediately felt excited. We arrived a little early for our reservation, but within a minute or two they sat us. It wasnt near the window, but I think it was still beautiful to see the resturant and we still got a view of the city. Our waiter David was amazing from the start, appeared open and ready. And congratulate me from the beginning and the end of the night. Food was delicious and the dessert really topped it off. Perfect for an anniversary or a celebration
Good. But very expensive

Our waitress, Annie, was terrific.

All 6 of us loved our food.

The view was outstanding.

Thank God the couple with the crying baby got her simmered down . But at first the crying was very annoying.
Amazing! I came for my birthday and it was an awesome experience!
The only thing we would change is the place mats....very up scale restaurant with paper place mats...couldn't believe it.  Everything else was excellent, wonderful quality food, and great service!

I booked about a week in advance to help celebrate my parents visiting us from the UK. Had a great experience here last year. Wish I could say the same this time. 

When checking in with the hostess, we were told there was only a table open in the bar or on the patio, despite 90% of their restaurant tables open. This made no sense. A manager came over and reiterated we couldn’t have a restaurant table due to a “large party” coming in. This turned out to be one table for 10 people and the vast majority of their tables remained empty all night. This just set the night off in a bad direction. 

We selected the patio table (which was too hot for my step-father who wasn’t feeling well) although the service from Jeff was truly excellent. He even explained why no-one had figured out how to switch the ceiling fans on after a renovation. Another management fail!

All in all, good food and service (from Jeff) but the experience was ruined by what seemed to be lazy and/or incompetent management. You expect more when paying $750 for a meal for 4!
Asked for a table with a view of the mountains and even though there were plenty of empty tables  , we seated at the farthest table away from them

Beautiful restaurant! Breathtaking views!  Food was amazing! And our server Amy, was such a integral part of our fabulous experience!  She was attentive and knowledgeable and so much fun!! Loved it cannot wait to return! May even do a staycation this summer!
Waste of money. Loud obnoxious guests that staff wouldn't address, 45 minutes between appetizers and main course. Plenty of outside seats, but not for the guests in the restaurant.

I asked for an outside table, the view was very pretty. Service was very good and attentive, down to having our oyster plates turned so we don't have to reach across plate. I came for lobster only to be told they were kind of small. When you spend well over $200 for dinner, I need big lobster, I settled for a bison ribeye instead. I also heard the rooms were very nice as well. I won't be back for lobster, but for the atmosphere I may visit again.
Two out of six steaks were very over cooked. Asked for med rare and got well done.

We were traveling with another couple and staying at the Canyon Suites (part of Phoenician Hotel).  J&G was an excellent restaurant, especially when you consider it was part of a Marriott hotel.  We all ordered Halibut (we had too many meat meals on trip).  The presentation was excellent and it was a good sized portion.  The ladies thought the Halibut was a little dry and called the waiter over.  The waiter immediately brought out 3 small dipping plates (different dips).  The ladies stated this was perfect for the Halibut.  The waiter then notified the manager, who came over to discuss the situation.  We explain how the ladies thought the Halibut needed some additional sauce and the 3 small dipping played should be part of the service.  He indicated that he would talk to the chef.  It should be noted that the men just ate the Halibut as it was served.
Amazing views and ambiance. Great service and food

AWESOME! Our waiter was so nice. The food was delicious. Very happy I chose this for my first meal in Phoenix. Got the 12oz filet which was delicious and the sauces complimented it nicely. Ambiance was very nice as well. Food came out at a good time! Would definitely come again next time I’m in Scottsdale.
The view was also exceptional! We had a very nice evening under the stars with an after dinner drink!
Beautiful views of the mountains and lights.  Decor is elegant and food was so good

There were six in our party and everyone raved about the food and service.  The view is spectacular so it was a perfect trio of food, service and ambiance.  This is a unique and luxurious dining venue.

Great Porterhouse Steak and Dover Sole -- the service is first class
Great for any occasion.
Highly recommend J&G's. Service was top notch and food was fantastic.

My friends and I absolutely loved our meal at J&G. I ordered the tasting menu, everything was incredible and I was surprised by the portion sizes. I was able to share most of my dishes. I'm not a dessert fan but I loved the caramel ice cream! The view from the restaurant was beautiful as well.

I cannot say enough great things about this steakhouse. Our server was absolutely phenomenal. She was great at giving recommendations and knew the menu backwards and forward. Both of our steaks were cooked to perfection. And the food was all mouth watering. We both agreed the next time we’re in the Phoenix area we’ll have to make a stop back here!
Our waitress Amy, was the best. Her wit made our night.
Beautiful restaurant and food presentation was very good. The food was equally tasty. If the weather is nice, ask for an outside table- the view is incredible.

Mind blowing steakhouse at a 5 star, 5 diamond resort. the service is perfect, from being at your table exactly when you need it, to knowing the entire menu with ingredients for allergies, and excellent presentation. Recommend getting the wagu tomahawk steak

The service and food were impeccable. My only complaint is I made the reservation a month in advance for my husband’s 60th birthday. I requested a patio seat or view, but we had an obstructed view, disappointing.

We dined at J&G for the first time, to celebrate our 1st wedding anniversary.  It was the perfect choice.  The food was delightful, the view was beautiful, and the service was perfect.  We enjoyed the evening, and highly recommend J&G.

Hello,

My wife and I was in town visiting from Chicago on a weekend getaway. So we decided to dine with you. Everything was was amazing from beginning to end the meal was a little pricey $300 tip included.
Outstanding! Excellent food, Service, views and ambience!
Service was extremely slow and the restaurant was not that busy. Our reservation was at 5:15 PM. Took over 3 hours to get through a 3 course meal. Not sure I will return.

Of all the restaurants in the Phoenix area, J&G Steakhouse consistently delivers top-quality food and service.  The kids and I actually had the same waiter we had during our last visit.  Although he initially comes off as rather proper, he's wickedly efficient and helpful, and has a dry sense of humor that's fun and uplifting.  If you want a dining experience you can count on to be good, J&G Steakhouse is the place to go.

We sat outside and the Az weather was perfect. Beautiful sunset and a view of the city. We ordered the oysters, Kumamoto and blue point which were briny and tasty. We then had the filet and it was buttery smooth the sauces outstanding, asparagus risotto, potatoes gratin, creamy with comete cheese. A delicious, beet salad with yoghurt, crispy onions and roasted hazel nuts and herbs. 
All was amazing we ate there 3 nights in a row!
Birthday dinner. Everything was fabulous from start to finish. Food was as fabulous as the views.
Wait staff extremely knowledgeable and helpful with menu selections. There was a bit of a wait for the main course which was disappointing but the wonderful staff made up for that for sure.
Loved it! Great food and beautiful venue
We opted for the tasting menu.  A few bucks more than most entrees, but well worth it.  Fish was delicious and steak was perfect.  I also opted for the wine pairing and it did not disappoint.
Family vacation

For this being one of the top steakhouses in Arizona, I was extremely disappointed.  The food was bland.  Minimal seasoning and I am salt sensitive, so for me to feel this way is not good.  The steak had no flavor at all.  For the price, it just wasn't worth it.  The spinach was also bland.  The risotto and shrimp cocktail were fantastic.  The views help salvage the night.  Sat on the patio and it was spectacular.

So glad we gave it the third try.  Our first two visits were mediocre but this time every dish was exceptional.  My rare bone-in ribeye was perhaps the best steak I've had in the valley.  It was thick, perfectly grilled and deliciously tender. Husband's Dover sole was de-boned tableside and he LOVED it.  Side dishes and the salad were excellent also.  Looking at the calendar to see when we can come back.
We has great food great service and great ambience.

It was so goo the night before we had to go back for more...
French Onion Soup, very nice.
Heirloom Tomato Salad was delightful
Dungeness Crab  was wonder ..so were the Block Truffle Cheese bites...
One of us had  the Filet  OSCAR style and it was cooked perfectly.. 

Skip the Strawberry Rhubarb ...not there best attempt...lots of crumble not much filling...
Its a nice experience,  and the live music  is awesome.  You will enjoy the atmosphere.
Love this restaurant and will be back often

We had the best experience you could possibly imagine..
My Mom tuned 101.5 while in Scottsdale...and she was honored by the hotel and the restaurant with a very special desert and a signature plate..in J&G Steakhouse and also a sweet surprise in our room her favorite Chocolate and Nuts...
My compliments to the Phoenician...

BTW - the lobster was perfectly executed..and the service exceptional...

Dallas
Excellent service and food is amazing. I was my bday. I will recommend to all my friends.
service, ambience, quality food, solid wine list
Great Experience! Paul was awesome
Absolutely wonderful. The food and service was amazing and the view was fantastic. Really made for a great birthday dinner.

Initial service very slow but food was served timely after order was taken. The au gratin potatoes were delicious and the broccoli was perfectly steamed, but the bread, calamari, crab legs and filet were just average. Pretty setting!!
Always a favorite. Beautiful views. We had the tasting menu with the wine pairing.  Each course was perfect along with each wine that accompanied the course. Just a beautiful meal.

The atmosphere is very nice and slightly "hipper" than a traditional steakhouse.  The menu is fairly typical of a steakhouse, although I was surprised to not see creamed corn as an option.  Our server was very nice and very friendly.  She truly engaged with my kids, which was nice to see.  The biggest complaint that I had revolved around the kids menu and the lack of a kids size steak option.  My kids like a good steak, but at 10, 11 and 12 years old, they are not going too eat, nor would I allow them, a 12 or 14 oz steak!  Even the smallest Filet, which is very rich, is 8 oz.  They need to make a 6 oz filet available as a kid's option
WE BELONG TO THE PREFERRED DINER CLUB AND GET ONE ENTRE FREE. WHEN THE BILL CAME THEY ADDED A $45.00 SERVICE CHARGE TO THE BILL. SO THE ONE FREE ENTRE WAS NOT FREE.

The tuna tartare was excellent. I ordered the cauliflower steak for $24.00! It was not cooked well and was just a quarter of the head- not a “steak”. It was pretty raw so very challenging to cut and eat. The flavoring did not go through the entire cauliflower so parts were totally flavorless.
Service was excellent and beautiful ambiance.

Outdoor seating was limited because hotel occupancy was not high so we could not sit outside...none of our 4 different meat choices were cooked to the requested temperature...had to send back and still was not correct. 
Overpriced for quality...will not return
Impeccable service great food.  It was the ultimate dining experience.  Bravo to everyone who works at this fabulous restaurant!

The views and service were great.  I had higher hopes for the quality and taste of the food.  I eat at steakhouses all over the country and was not too impressed with the food here.  I would seek other steakhouses in the area.  Our server was great!
Service was painfully slow for our party of five. Others that arrived after us were served before we were. Wait staff was courteous, and food very good, but not memorable.
Amazing time went there to proposal to my girlfriend. The restaurant was very accomkdaying
Food was excellent, all around!  Nice atmosphere--only reason I didn't rate noise level better was a happy hour group came inside and made a ruckus.  Good service and great view!
You can't beat the view, complement that with great food and you can't go wrong.

J & G steakhouse was a really nice patio experience.
It is not a go to place, but, once in a while enjoyable.
would recommend to try  if gonna be the in area.
Could be a lot better.
Steak was literally Sizzler/buffet quality. Awful. Service however was very good.
Outstanding service, tasty food and great view of the east valley. A few too many young children for my liking but they were not seated next o us.
Great food and great service....... a little pricey but worth it!
It was great!

Food was great, service was great, a beautiful atmosphere, but when a baked potato is ala carte and costs $10, that’s exorbitant and borders on the rediculous. We had 2 steaks, 3 drinks, one salad and one order of mushrooms and our bill not including tip was $203.
Food was very average for such a high end place.  Almost seemed like it sat for some time before served.  Never a good thing for a steak.

We went for my husband's birthday, the restaurant and the view were amazing! It's truly stunning! The service was very fast, however the waiter was attentive and slowed it down. We got a wine pairing with our meal and we learned little to nothing about them or why they matched our food, which was disappointing. The food was good, and interesting, however it did not match the price tag. The fish was on the overcooked side, the rice a tad under-cooked,  and the choice of dinnerware for the food was interesting. Almost all of it came in bowls and it was hard to eat out of due to the shape. Overall a pleasant experience, with the desert and the tuna tartar being the stars of our meal. Due to the price tag of a full course meal, I would not repeat it. Though we would go back from drinks and appetizers any day. The view of Phoenix truly is stunning!
The food are fantastic ,the view are so wonderful.
Birthday celebration. Food was excellent!!

Incredible food. Incredibly disappointing service. Been here many times, even with my young children. Waiter was visibly annoyed with servicing children, difficult about food accommodations even though we had guests with dietary restrictions like high blood pressure. The real mvp was the bussed who was much more helpful. Wouldn’t bother trying other options on Phoenician property. We had service debacle at each.
Great food and atmosphere
Memorable restaurant with exceptional food, attentive staff providing first class service, topped off with a wonderful view-especially when dining at sunset.
Wonderful view of the mountains at sunset food excellent and good choice. Server was lovely and very good but busy

Wife and I had wonderful tasty steaks. I had a great large filet mignon perfectly cooked medium rare. I thought I would have some leftovers. It was so good and could not stop. The mushrooms was also good. Several different types. It may have been a little too pink but deeelicious.

We love this restaurant and my husband and I go for all anniversaries . This time We went with friends for a birthday/anniversary celebration and it was terrific as usual. Food, drinks, service , atmosphere could not have been improved
Sides arrived late. Food was just okay for price. Service was not great. We had a table with a beautiful view.

Very Very Loud In Bar Area Which Can Be Heard In Dining Room. Food Was Good But Slightly Disappointing The French Onion Soup $12 Was Very Bland & The Choice Of Cheese Was  Really Difficult too Eat. Scallop Potatoes Good But At $10 Way Over priced. Wines Extremely High Priced We Eat At Other Prime Steak  Venues More Bang 4 The Buck.
I think the restaurant was a little understaffed. It was hard to get drinks timely.
Outstanding! The service was impeccable. The wine selection fantastic. Consistently a five star experience!!
Excellent!

We always visit J & G when we're in Scottsdale,  because the atmosphere can't be beat, and the food is delicious. We were on the deck by the firepit and the view of the resort is spectacular. The onion soup and heirloom tomatoes were outstanding, as was the steak. If you want a memorable meal, visit this steakhouse.

My husband and I had a perfect evening at J&G Steak House at The Phoenician. I would like to say thank you to the entire restaurant staff for such a memorable evening. It turned out to be my husband's final meal, he died early the following morning from a massive stroke.

Entrees were great however our side dishes were all cold and by the time we received replacements we were done the entrees.

The ambience is nice and the view is great especially at sunset.

Martini was made incorrectly and served in a wine style glass, ordered it as ice cold, its was warm
Wine by the glass offer, anemic at best.
Servers were outstanding, seating and view were top shelf, food good, I have better steak at CapGrille or other high end chains
Lovely birthday desert

This lovely restaurant poised at the top of the Phoenician Hotel offers amazing views as well as excellent service and great food.  I had the Dover Sole which was presented tableside and deboned.  My husband enjoyed a steak which is his favorite.  We also loved the tomatoes with crispy onion and Russian dressing.  It was a relaxing and elegant evening in Phoenix!

The service was the best part. Our waiter and other staff were not only attentive but very friendly. Of course, being at the Phoenician, one can anticipate to pay a large amount of money for routine foods, but those foods should be on the north end of the scale. The best tasting part was the birthday dessert. The filet was sirloin tender, not filet tender and the oysters were sandy and gritty. The martini was good, the Old Fashioned was not stirred and there was nothing on the table or in the drink to stir with other than the butter knife. The wait staff was gracious and caring and timely. I would go back to be served by those guys but not for the food.

Reservations were difficult and hostess was less than amenable.  Initially reserved for 7 and tried to change to accommodate 1-2 more guests ; even at a separate table was totally fine. Stated there was no way the restaurant could adjust in that time frame maybe a late sitting three hours later.  I went back to Open Table and saw they had two reservations open within 15 min of my original booking and booked that .  All great due to Open Table!
Thanks for your assistance
excellent food & service.  beautiful view !
Slow getting our food. Crab cakes are a must. Would try this place again.

We have been going to J and G since it opened, as guests of the Phoenician every year. The food was good but not amazing, relative to other steakhouses. The porterhouse house steak was just ok but the tuna tartare was really good.

From the moment that we arrived, our dining experience was fantastic. The service was impeccable. Our waiter was personable and attentive. And the food! The vegetarian in our party loved the menu selections. And our steaks were cooked to perfection.  I would come back for the butternut squash soup alone. Everything that everyone ordered was delicious. All of that and the beautiful view of Phoenix too? A+
Love the Phoenician and the wonderful ambiance of J&G Steakhouse.  Service was exceptional!  Food great.  All enjoyed with a beautiful view from our table window.
Excellent menu choices.  Beautiful presentation of every dish a d all items were delicious
Everything about J&G was excellent. The food was perfect, the wine divine and the service was superb.
My husband and I are still having date nights (even after 51 years of marriage). This is a perfect place for such occasion. The view, the food, the service and ambiance were all perfect.
The service was the problem. The waitress literally acted like we were not there most of the night. The food was excellent and the wine was wonderful.

Parker House rolls overcooked hard & dry, not soft & fresh,  complimentary appetizer a pleasant surprise, the wedge lettuce salad under garnished with dressing that was immediately fixed.
Entree's didn't satisfy but maybe it was an off night for us. My red snapper was served on cubes of squash with a strange sauce taste not to my liking nor the broth to put on it. I should have substituted mashed potato's and simply sautéed the fish.  Serving size smaller than desired but.....
My wife's short ribs were not only browned but the exterior was blackened and quite dried out. Gave the impression of being cooked long ago and kept in the fridge to be warmed when ordered. Sauce  no aromas of sizzling hearty food.
  We'll stick with our favorite dover sole in the future.

Food was very good, the atmosphere good, view excellent and the service was okay.  For the cost of the meal I was expecting better attention by the wait staff.  Our reservation was a 6:30 so the restaurant was not very busy but still service was lacking.  I would recommend the restaurant to those who are looking for an upscale experience as everything is expensive, but we knew that going in.
The place and views were stunning! Our waiter was wonderful. We mentioned we were newlyweds and they brought us dessert! We had an awesome time and are looking forward to going back.
We had the tasting menu.  Food and service were outstanding!

Such a luxurious sexy dining room. The food is high quality and well presented (table side Dover Sole) and the wine list is packed w hidden gems (2004 Radio-Coteau Syrah!)  Service was on point without being intrusive. The three of us enjoyed every minute. This is my go to restaurant when I want to indulge. 💗💗💗

We ordered the lobster tail, red snapper and NY Strip. Party of 4. The person who ordered the lobster tail said it was the best she ever had.  Everything was outstanding. Food and service. Great wine bottle selection. All price points.

Everything about this place is amazing. The service was spectacular. So friendly. They gave my dad a birthday card! The food was perfect. We had steak and the salmon. Delicious. The area was great. A great night celebrating my dads birthday
Food was excellent. View was great. Felt very private.
Restaurant was not busy, but put us at a table that I was seated on a half booth. Waiter was slow to ask us for drinks. Overall experience was average.
Lovely views, food was delicious. I took my wife there for her birthday and she love it. After dinner they treated her to a birthday dessert which was amazing!
We had a wonderful dinner to celebrate my fiances birthday! The staff made it a perfect and special night.

We really wanted to like this place and it was so disappointing. It is like a Sizzler trying to play at being a high end restaurant. The steaks were absolutely horrible, the brisket burger is chalky at best, the rolls were stale, the wedge dressing is not typical blue cheese, but horseradish flavored, and the Mac-n-Cheese is like Stouffer’s. It was a $300 lesson learned that we will never repeat.

We had a lovely evening enjoying spectacular. Views and wonderful food.
We had the peppered 16oz New York steak
It was perfect in every way😍
Calamari was very rubbery and the fries were cold and stale. Other than those, everything was great
Lets see; paper place mats, no table cloths, loud noise, loud music, heavy chairs difficult to move when seated, bus staff too quick to pick up plates, but excellent food.
Another great dinner. Wonderful staff.

Lousy food. Tuna guacamole tasteless, fois  grass cold uncooked, store bought just awful. Brussel sprouts covered in sugar. French onion soup tasted like dish water. Place was cold and sterile. Wait service was borderline adequate. Most of the staff very inexperienced for a supposedly fine dining restaurant. Save your money go anywhere else.

We recently  had a birthday dinner at J&G. This was our first visit since the large Phonecian remodel. 

Before we made reservations, we checked the menu online, and were pleasantly surprised at the number of gluten-free options, and that they are so easily identifiable on the menu. Also there are many ways to eat Paleo here. We are mostly Paleo and definitely gluten-free, and we find it hard to dine out. Most places you are lucky to find a couple of items that work without lots of eliminations or substitutions but here we could order from almost half the items on the menu.

The food was excellent and we can't wait to return.

We were so impressed with our entire experience, from being greeted to being shown to our table and of course the table service was just right. Friendly but not overly so, and prompt and attentive without being fussy. Formal but not stuffy. It is sad but few restaurants offer proper service anymore. 

We especially appreciated that our server waited until both of us were done with our entree before removing the plates. It is a real pet peeve of mine when plates are being cleared while others at the table are still eating. 

We also appreciated the respectable distance between tables so that you have a sense of privacy which is always desired, but especially for date night or a business meal. 

We plan to put J&G at the top of our list!
Wonderful, one of the best steaks we have had and great sauces. Ss
Excellent food and service. Great for date night. Pretty views as well.
Great service,food,surroundings & overall ambiance.....!!

Reception was quite friendly. 
Waiter was so so in terms of warmth. More there to get the job done and it didn’t seem that he was enjoying himself. 
Food was good overall. Cocktails were decent. Tuna tartare was very good. Little neck clams were good. Tenderloin was good. Sides with the steak were average (broccoli, Brussels sprouts, asparagus, mushrooms, fries).
The restaurant has a nice aesthetic. The view is quite nice.
Overall a good restaurant but we didn’t have the pleasure of the outstanding service that other reviews have commented upon.

Food, service and ambiance were outstanding. We were celebrating a birthday and an Anniversary. Albeit a generic card, it was a nice touch that the restaurant presented us with happy birthday and anniversary cards.
J AND G ALWAYS GOOD FOOD AND ALWAYS GREAT ATMOSPHERE

My brother and I were out for barter Jackson auction.  J&G has always been on our list for dinner. It was busy and the service was a little slow for this kind of place. We had steak lobster and two dozen oysters. All was really good but not great this time (like our trip last year). Funny we had the same waiter this time from last and he remembered us. Good guy.

J & G steakhouse was very good all the way around, except , of course , the prices
and value...which is the only reason we do not go regularly.
beautiful restaurant at a fantastic resort and a very enjoyable time.
would recommend under the right circumstances.
My husband and I came for a birthday dinner. It was a pleasant experience overall. Food was kinda salty, otherwise we enjoyed it.

Fantastic steak and the sides were just as good. Service excellent and view is amazing.
One criticism, we were charged $8 for water when we just asked for still water at the table - when paying so much for the food this seems like a ridiculous money making ploy.

We really enjoy J&G Steakhouse. It has beautiful views of the Phoenician resort and has a nice bar area. The food is excellent. I would put the Dover Sole up with the best I have ever had! However at $66 for Dover Sole it better be outstanding. Here is our only complaint, this is a restaurant with 5 star food, 5 star atmosphere, and 5 star prices yet the table has tacky paper place mats, REALLY! I know it sounds petty but it is just so out of character for restaurant of this caliber. PLEASE get some real table clothes! Hard for me to take J&G seriously when the waiter is crumpling up paper place mats in front of me. Outside of that nit pick it is an excellent place to enjoy a nice meal.
Very lovely restaurant with good food and comfort Add in exceptional views and company and a great evening guaranteed!
Service was excellent. Steaks were delicious. Will  be back again!
Ahhh-mazing! Food, wine, ambiance...plus the live guitar play..all on point! Will definitely be back again!

Service was excellent. Everything looked beautiful. Vegetables were overcooked. Meat was flavorful and cooked according to our order. Side sauces were all a little off flavor wise. To be fair, I prefer just salt, but our table ordered the side sauces so I tried them. Not bad, just that the spice combinations in the sauces were not well balanced. Everything seemed fresh to me, and looked very nice. Cocktails were well done.

Sadly, so very disappointing for a high end steakhouse serving prime cuts....1 one the steaks was overcooked, second was so tough, it was returned....lobster dish was presented nicely but, that is where it stopped as it had very little flavor and was about the size of a jumbo shrimp....of the 4 meals, 1 was good.  Second bottle of wine we ordered was out of stock, should have been told the one we ordered was last one as we indicated we would probably order 2.   Service was good enough but, could have been more coordinated.  They started busing table when 2 of the 4 were still eating.  Just too many little things made this a very weak dining experience....on the plus side, it was new, modern and nicely appointed with a great view....BUT, @ $60+ dollars for a prime steak, I expected better.
Perfection as always. Service, Cuisine, Hospitality.  We miss it so much in D.C.
Outrageous price a basic martini,$22.  19ounce rib I steak wasn’t 19 ounces.  Not really tender, over cooked.  Dessert was poor.  Coffee was not hot.

New Years Eve, live music, the place was hopping! We arrived in time for our reservation but needed to wait an additional 20 minutes until we got seated. Very nice table just next to the terrace with a great view over the city. Service was very friendly and attentive, food arrived hot and was nicely presented. They also offered a four course menu for the special occasion which looked excellent, however we went straight for the steaks which were prepared very well. The restaurant handed out some trinkets  for the New Years Eve celebrations which was very nice. The other thing we noticed was that the underground parking has improved significantly versus prior visits, even on a night like this it was no problem to find a parking spot.

Great normal service. Let us keep to ourselves while only interjecting occasionally.
Jidori Chicken was spectacular. Great place for an adult evening out. View from balcony overlooking the pool a must see at night.

9pm reservation on 12/30- lovely setting
Service was great - knowledgeable, attentive and a bit reserved
Food was very good
Prices are a bit high
Did not adhere to a request for a birthday cake for my wife - but worse was that they did not care to inform me till the dessert was to be served after dinner
Food was good

Of all the steak restaurants in Phoenix to choose from, we chose this one to celebrate a very special evening with our family over Christmas.  (Party of 6 - $550 bill).  The evening was a complete disappointment, starting from when we sat down. 

It took 30 minute for our cocktail order to be served. It was a very simple order - a bottle of wine, a bourbon and a coke. We had to ask for bread service (consisting on placing a cold roll on a plate) 3 times before we received bread.

The restaurant was only half full, but the service was horrible, especially considering the fact that this place holds itself out as a high end restaurant.  Our bottle of wine was out of reach of the table and the waiter was very remiss on refilling our glasses. Our glasses were empty often thorough out the evening and due to the lack of good service, we had difficulty getting them refilled. 

The food was overpriced and the portions were skimpy. The "Side dishes" (i.e. starches and vegetables that you typically see in a steak restaurant) were barely sufficient to serve one. We had ordered two for the table, thinking they would be adequate for the four who wanted sides, and each person ended up with a small spoonful of food.

The food quality was mediocre. Four persons in our party had the 8 oz filet and ordered it medium rare. Each steak was overcooked and bland in flavor. The other two in our party ordered the lamb chop special. It supposedly came with broccolini but I was unable to find any on my place. The sauce that covered the chops was overpowering and muted the taste of the chop.

Although it is minor, I thought that the paper place matts on the table looked cheap and reminded me of what you'd see in a coffee shop.

I did not complain to management at the time of the meal because I did not want to put a pall on the evening and make others in our group feel uncomfortable. However suffice it to say, I will never return to this restaurant again and will encourage others to avoid it.
Great but food/sides could have been better

While the service was very good and I have nothing but praise for the staff, the food was just adequate.  Certainly not up to it's namesake. Clearly not the most expensive restaurant I have visited, it was one that lacked any sense of value making the prices seem exorbitant; particularly the bar.  And the paper placemats that were wadded up and thrown away as we finished eating-------give me a break!

This was our 2nd time dining at J&G. We were here 2 years ago the same time and had a great experience our first time. This time, it was not so good. The food was very good, but not very special or on par with other steak houses in my opinion. We had the jumbo shrimp cocktail, truffled cheese fritters, and heirloom tomato salad which were all very good to start. I ordered a retro fashion which was made with Makers Mark and bitters, but the drink had way too much bite and was not prepared very well.  More on this later. 
We all had steaks and a few sides. The steaks were prepared well and cooked to the right temperature although they were warm, bland and lacked flavor. The sides were steamy hot and delicious, but they were served in these tiny little iron skillets that were way too small which made it difficult not to spill food all over the table. Unfortunately the service was lackluster. Our waitress was not engaged and lacking personality as if just going through the motions. We were never asked how our steaks were prepared and overall it just took away from our dining experience. So back to my drink. When I advised our server that I did not enjoy the drink and had it taken  away, I was offered another drink, but I did not want anything else, and was never offered to take it off of the check. Just goes to show you the level of service that is just not up to par for the prices they charge you. 
Oh well, next time we are in Scottsdale we will look elsewhere for a steakhouse.
Outstanding food, but we waited a really long time for everything.  It seemed as though our waiter was slammed the whole night.
Every part of our evening there was excellent ng service, food view, ambience, everything!

We waited a long time for someone to even come to the table. My cocktail had the wrong liquor. The server totally forgot the first course we ordered to share. 3 of 5 steaks were lukewarm and over cooked. I live in NYC and   I was extremely disappointed as Jean George’s New York restaurants are much more reliable. I could never recommend this one.
We had a great time. Always a wonderful experience and food is just amazing.

Everything was quite nice.   It’s a fantastic hotel and restaurant.
I ordered Dover Sole and am suspicious that it was sole, not Dover sole which is lighter, thin  and almost flaky.  My sole was rubbery which tasted very good but I doubt was Dover sole.

The views are beautiful, and we were there on Christmas Eve, so maybe it is normally better.  Food was just so-so, service was just so-so.  Very doubtful we will ever return.  There are so many excellent choices in Phoenix...why bother with this one.

Absolutely top notch service. Went for a birthday dinner. All of the host/ wait staff came by the table to wish a happy birthday to my daughter. The food was fantastic. Perfect portion size. I highly recommend!

Amazing food.
Need better acoustics.  The noise was way too loud for having an intimate conversations.

Our service was only second to the quality of our food. We enjoyed the entire experience. Kudos to the entire staff!

Joy&david

This was my 5th time dining and a consistent experience for the earlier visits though a bit disappointing in this case.    Bread was stale,  appetizers subpar, side dishes mediocre and steak Underwhelimg.     Servers non enthusiastic and in one case a appetizer was thrown on the table.    Had indicated that I was celebrating the birthday of my wife on the reservations which was not done and had to prompt this to the waiter as he handed out dessert menus for at least somewhat of a thrown together birthday dessert.       $400 for a dinner for two should have had a bit more of a wow factor.    Probably my last visit as better reviewed and comparable steak houses abound.
Very nice restaurant. A pity it was already too dark to see the city view from the elevation. Food was excellent and service prompt and courteous.
The view is what makes this place very special. My server was also on par.
Phenomenal food, did the tasting menu.  I'm originally from Chicago and this food was right up there with the best I've had in Chicago.
Miserable attention by receptionist and Patrick.  Excellent table service (Jeff) and spectacular food.

The food was ok. The evening started out ok but we quickly saw less and less of our waiter. I was also disappointed that after the waiter encouraged me to try the spicy purple sweet potatoes that he never came back and asked if i liked them or noticed that I didn't eat them and offered me something else instead. I was also very disappointed after I took my dessert to go and walked back to our casita to discover we were not given any silverware to eat our ice cream and cake with. We were really looking forward to this dinner but the reviews we had previously  read actually turned out to be fairly accurate in that the dinner was overpriced for the quality of food.

Food was great but service was definitely sub par. Meal took over an hour to come out and when it did the waitress told us it was because the table across from ours took priority (?) not a great message to send.
Too noisy, but food was excellent

Fantastic experience! We decided to get the very affordable tasting menu and it was definitely a great choice. The service is impeccable and they are very attentive and happy to answer questions or give recommendations. Thee food...I have no idea where to start...outrageous flavor and gourmet style presentation. I hate beets and the beet risotto was my favorite. We will definitely be coming back with friends and family.
The food and service were outstanding. The room is beautiful. The loud so-called music ruined it for us. Will never go back on a Friday or Saturday when there is live music.

We had a fantastic time enjoying the view and the staff was most personable and accommodating.
I have already recommended it and will visit again.

We were married at this restaurant in a private room one year ago today . The staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome and feel special  . It’s still a magical place with amazing food and my wife are I were in bliss
Celebrated an anniversary.  The food & ambience were wonderful!
Thanksgiving
The place is perfect!  Their tuna tartare is the best in the country!
We have eaten at this retiring for many years. They never cease to please us with their selection of food and service. The atmosphere is classy for classy people.

Great place to eat!  I had always wanted to come here and finally got an opportunity to do so.  Had a 10th Wedding anniversary celebration and they did an awesome dessert for the couple.  Great food and will be back!  Thanks.

THEY DID THE RIGHT THING: We had reservations, but after waiting 30 minutes for a table we asked how much longer.  The staff had no idea.  I asked whether they thought it would be 5 minutes or another 30 minutes, but again, they had no idea.  I complained to the manager that there were empty tables,but she indicated those areas we not staffed.  So we finally got seated about 40 minutes late.  But then it took forever to get our food.  The food was good, although I thought the portions of the sides could have been bigger.

We complained to the manager again and she indicated she would take care of us.  At the end of the day she picked up the cost of our steak and a bottle of wine.  Now and then something goes wrong, and I get that.  But they stepped up and did the right thing.
The service was slow from the moment we sat down to the moment we received the bill. The ambiance was just ok for it to be 7th year anniversary.

J&G really pleased all 6 of us and that is hard to do with 2 very picky eaters! 4 of us ordered the Red Snapper and 2 had the Dover Sole. Sides selected were spiced purple sweet potato (very different in a good way), salt and pepper baked potato (an easy favorite), creamed spinach (creamy but not sickening).   The Caesar salad was beyond good and the wedge was split to feed 2 easily. Hit, ask for more of the butter roles, Yum! Service was great and she was funny. They were really busy but didn't rush us either and that was good because we had lots to talk about. We used the Fine Dining card and that took off a chunk of the bill. That too was good. We are going back during Christmas with friends and plan on having High Tea on New Years Day.

This is a great place for a special meal.  The food was excellent, steaks were especially good, cooked the way we like them and the service was great. Austin made us feel at home, was attentive, answered all our questions on the food choices and always had a smile.  I will definitely be back and will recommend.

The food at J&G is excellent and table service is very good.  We did have a bit of a bad experience in that we booked a table on the patio but were informed when we got there that a party/event had reserved the whole patio.  These things happen but we should have been called in advance to let us know we would not get what we requested.  A high end (and expensive) restaurant should do better than just "sorry".

Wonderful dinner with my husband. Views were unbelievable. I ordered the tasting menu and I am so happy I did, it was very reasonably priced and the food was delicious with a beautiful presentation. Our server was very knowledgeable and friendly with lots of helpful suggestions. We will be back!
A restaurant of this quality deserves linen tablecloths instead of paper place mats.

Very disappointing!! Made reservations for anniversary . Seated at a nice table and Waite staff was good although slow. My wife and I both order steaks -cooked medium and confirm this was a warm pink center . My steak arrived very well done after sending it back it arrived cold in center basically raw !! The third time it returned rare ! By this time my wife had completed her meal and I ate a rare steak!! I guess it’s too much to expect to have a steak house know how to cook a steak!! My wife steak was done correctly and they did comp my steak. Really ruined a otherwise perfect day. Very disappointed ! Who never recommend Mastros for same price would be a better option as it is near by
It was our anniversary so we decided to have an early dinner so we could watch the sunset.   It was great.   Food was very good and our waiter was the best

What a disappointment!! My reservation was for 6:45 pm, we arrived a few minutes late, but they weren’t busy. We were seated promptly, the girl came and brought water, then we sat. And sat, and sat! For over 40 minutes, no waiter, no food, nothing! I wanted to get up and leave. Finally the water came and took our order. We ordered 2 entrees, 2 sides and one sauce. Can you believe it came to $225?!! It was over an hour before our food arrived. A server brought it and left. Our waiter never came over to ask how was everything so if I wasn’t happy or wanted something additional, too bad! We were there a total of 1 hour 50 minutes, the food was good but not “oh my gosh” fabulous. The most overpriced meal I have had. I might have had dessert, but it wasn’t offered so I don’t know if they even have desserts, but at that point all I wanted to do was get out of there. When I got home, I was still hungry! That’s a first, I just spent $225 for dinner (2 people) and left hungry? Not a good omen. The atmosphere is lovely, beautiful view at night, gorgeous hotel, but no hotel personnel in sight. 
No one said “good night, thank you for coming “ and escorted us to elevator, 3 staff were standing by the desk conferring with each other. I get better service at Cheesecake Factory at a quarter of the price! The waiter needs to be retrained, horrible service!
We love dining at J & G... the restaurant is beautiful, the staff is very professional and the food is delicious.

Hotel guests. Captive. 2 hostesses, one Grinch, but great server who quickly
Recognized off wine. 
Food average 
Price $$$$
But - if you are staying at Phoenician this is Best option and views are amazing!! Bar staff great too. Share pri fix dinner. Cheers

It was a very nice experience. Quiet, clean, great food, nice staff.  I would have loved if they gave us a choice of where to sit, but other than that I have no complaints. :) Would definitely go again/recommend it to others.

We love J & G Steakhouse at the Phoenician.  We must do as it is a 100 mile, 2 hour round trip to get there for us.    Their Dover Sole is divine.   They have wonderful food.   My guests and I are all seniors and unfortunately with the loud music from the bar and a loud group who sat near us, it was hard to hold a conversation.    We usually dine around 6:30 to 7:00 pm, and leave around 9:00 pm.    It is pricey, but the food is worth it for special occasions.    The view out of the windows is great.
Ambiance was perfect!
One of the best dining experiences we have had in the valley!

Several of the previous reviews I read were on point about this place. Ordered my fillet medium rare, which came out medium well. Sent it back, and the second steak came back cooked more that the first one. Sent that one back too...
At that point I gave up on them cooking a steak. Entire experience was terrible. The way management handled the situation also was unacceptable. Plenty of other great places out there, don’t waste your time or money here! Go to Steak 44 instead, or anywhere else for that matter. FAIL!!!!!

Best crab cakes I’ve ever had.  The steak my husband ordered was a perfectly prepared medium rare.  I had a delicious Dover sole, which was deboned at our table and served with a great butter sauce.  We ended our dinner with a fantastic carrot cake with housemade cream cheese ice cream and carrot sorbet.  Our server made great recommendations for apppetizers and main courses. She didn’t hover over us but showed up at appropriate intervals!   Great food, service, and a phenomenal view!

We were celebrating our anniversary. Our server, Brian was superb! Friendly, funny and accommodating as well as well versed. His “sidekick” Thomaso was same.  Great place! Food was excellent and great pours of wine! Plus, a wonderful choice of anniversary dessert. Yum!!! As you see, can’t say enough! We will be back our next visit to Scottsdale. Thank you!
We love J&G the service is excellent and the food is superb. Patrick, the Manager always takes the time to chat with us and ensure that our experience is exemplary.
Just okay. Food was nothing special but drinks view and waiter was amazing
Food was excellent. So as the local beer. Service was great even if the restaurant was busy.A wonderful experience!

Its a very nice place and the service was good but, the waiter told us about the special for the evening and then came back 15 minutes later to tell us they didn't have the special and that they were having trouble sourcing veal and that was the reason. Next, I asked about the two different lobster dishes on the menu and he was concerned that they may not have lobster and after he went to the kitchen to check, again no lobster. So I asked him why on a Wed at 7:30 PM they would not have the special they were promoting and not have ANY lobster when they have it on the menu twice and there were no good answers. I ended up ordering the Ribeye steak which was done correctly temperature wise but was very dry, so that was a disappointment. As it was my anniversary and my girlfriend was having a great time and wasn't present for some of these questions I was asking the waiter, we stayed and I made the best of the evening, but seriously guys, a $700.00 dinner should have gone much better than that, huge disappointment......

Steak was poorly cooked
It took very long to even hear about what was going on
Loved everything about it.  We went for our anniversary, the food  was delicious and the view was great.

Not a very good experience. It was our 35th wedding anniversary. I asked for a romantic spot where we could see the beautiful skyline. They put us at a table that was away from the view and way too small.  My filet was overcooked and had too much blue cheese on it. It devoured the flavor of the streak (blue cheese is strong; a little bit goes a long way).  The mushrooms were dry and flavlorless. Service was awesome. We were well-attended to by Zack and the rest of the crew.  This was our second time at J&G. We will likely not go back.
Amazing meal and service. Ula waited on us and she was outstanding. Ask for her!  Taylor Attwood too. To detail was superb. Best anniversary dinner ever!
This is one of my favorite steakhouses! The view is incredible in the evening time, very romantic, and the food is delicious!!
Servers where fantastic and very friendly . Made my wife’s bday experience great !

We had to ask for lemon for our waters twice. Both of our steaks had to be sent back --mine was under done, his was overdone.  Taste was fine, nothing special or particularly memorable. 
Service was good, and the views of the Valley were beautiful.
Ambiance and view was amazing. Food was delectable and drinks exquisite. Highly recommend J&G for special occasions and taking visitors for a great meal and view of the valley.

Food was excellent as usual, and love the newly remodeled décor. However, service was very lacking.  It started off well, but when the restaurant started to fill up, our waiter basically disappeared for long periods, at one time he was gone for 25 mins.   It tarnished an otherwise great experience.
The dinner was delicious and the views are fabulous.
Drinks are outrageously priced! Like, way and service was super slow.
Good seating, fantastic view at night, beautiful location. Well worth the trip.
great dinner. if you want any review, stop with the 50 character requirement. i will do a more thorough review when i want.

Went for restaurant week for my wife's birthday.  Parking was confusing and the restaurant difficult to find.  We were greeted and seated promptly (with a birthday card).  Clam chowder was tepid, the steak ordinary at best, but the Apple crisp dessert tasty.  Probably won't be back

We went for restaurant week and thought it was ok - not great.  If the purpose of restaurant week is to get people to try new restaurants, then it worked.  If the purpose is to get people to go back, it didn't work.  They might have been short staffed because the manager is who finally came over to our table, after a bit of a wait, to get our drink order.  She was very nice and checked back later to see if we needed more drinks, but we had to refill our own glasses from the bottle of wine we ordered (not a big deal, but at most nice places the waiter will refill your glass).  Two of us ordered the shrimp ceviche and it was excellent.  Two ordered the clam chowder and I don't think either got a proper bowl of soup.  The bowls came with the cream in them and then the waiter had a pitcher to fill the bowls with the broth and the clams.  One bowl got 3/4 of the broth and a few clams, the other bowl got 1/4 broth and most of the clams.  Either use individual pitchers or the server needs to do a better job of dividing.  Two ordered the salmon and both thought it was undercooked enough to be considered sushi.  Two of us had the flat iron steak which was a generous cut and cooked perfectly to the temp ordered.  For dessert, two ordered the green apple cobbler which was delicious!  However, it was not a cobbler, but a crisp.  Had I known it was a crisp I would've ordered it as I prefer that to a cobbler.  I got the warm chocolate cake which was ok.  Overall the food was decent.  On a side note, the two couples split the bill and paid with credit card.  Both cards were double charged.  After noticing the next day we called and they were very apologetic and fixed the error.  I'm not sure we'll go back.
The bar service was good intill we got to our table ans it was horrible
Fantastic service only drawback was food was a little slow to come out.
An outstanding dining experience with friends. Couldn’t have been better.
Beautiful view!  Food and service were were good.  Expensive.
BEST IN REGION, WORTH DRIVE IF NEEDED, AMAZING VIEW, GREAT FOOD, SPECIAL ATTENTION, MANAGER TAYLOR HANDS ON AND HELPFUL
Service was extremely slow. I have never waited so long to receive my entree after an appetizer.

I've dined at J&G several times and have also arranged for business related dinner events on more than one occasion. In short, I've always liked the place--and its one of the places my wife and I have frequented for special occasion meals. Our recent visit was different--and candidly, it might actually turn out to be our "last" visit. We made a reservation for our anniversary for Saturday night. As always, the place is lovely and has one of the best views in Phoenix. Because we weren't really starving (typical for summer nights in Phoenix), we wanted to enjoy the quality of J&G's offerings--but manage our intake by sharing all of the courses. We shared an appetizer, a salad (these two came out in the wrong order), a steak and a couple sides. J&G was gracious in providing a lovely dessert gratis for our celebration. In short, we ordered food for just a bit more than one person (by sharing)--and our dinner tab still came to around $140 before drinks. The salad portion turned out to be too small to really share ($18) and the 19 oz bone-in Rib-eye steak we shared could not possibly have weighed in over 8-10 ounces (around $60 I think). Toss in a bottle of middle-of-the-road Pino for another $100 and we were out the door for $245 (not counting our 20% tip). This was a perfectly adequate meal. However, since this town is filled with places that sell vastly superior steaks (City Hall, Steak 44, Ocean Club, Dominics), we honestly felt as though we made a mis-steak here. Service at J&G is provided by a large number of very friendly people, but the coordination of our meal, from start to finish, was consistently awkward as we were visited by no fewer than six individuals during our visit. Again, all nice people, but the end result was a confusing and disjointed service level. You'll spend about the same amount of money at the other steak places mentioned above--but, in exchange for that money, you'll get a substantially better meal and experience.

One of the very best upscale restaurant in town with a fantastic view of the valley 
The tasting menu is wonderful 
The staff will take take of you from the very beginning to the end
A must!
The sole was perfectly cooked and seasoned. It melted in your mouth. Shared as an appetizer. Both of our steaks were a  bit past medium rare but were excellent.
Great view, service and food
Great service and experience from the first person that greeted us till the last when we left.

This was the most terrible experience. It took forever to get service and my $50 steak came ice cold. I sent it back and the waiter barely acknowledged it. We didn’t let the poor service bad food and high prices ruin our night but I can not recommend this place to anyone looking to have an enjoyable evening.

My husband and I celebrated his birthday, we had an excellent time in a beautiful, relaxing  place with breathtaking views. 
Food was so tasty,  we loved the flat iron steak which was cooked to perfection, the service was great and friendly. We had memorable time. 
We definitely would return may be with other friends.

We recommend the J&G resurant to our friends and family.
A must go whenever in Arizona. Tuna tartare is incredible. Sad that they will be closed next time I'm here.

There was a birthday party for an eight year old with 4 other children who were  treating J&G like it was Chuck E Cheese and it ruined the atmosphere for us considering it was our anniversary and it was 7pm. Neither staff or parents did anything!
Anniversary

Decided to try restaurant week menu for variety.  BIG. mistake.  Rolls stale, kids burger bun stale burger was cold very small and overdone even the fries were very old and cold as well?... Ravioli starter a bit bland and once again.....COLD!!!!  The crab salad starter with Yuzu was good and portion decent.  Steak was tough but cooked correctly.  Desserts were great.  Used to enjoy J&G for ambience and view but food was so dissatisfying and we were disappointed.
Service timing was
The food and service was phenomenal. Totally top notch. Highly recommended.
We always love going to this restaurant. The menus never disappointing and each meal is a culinary treat. We look forward to returning soon.

My sons steak tasted old and we sent back. 
They were very nice about it
Service was excellent.  Food was good,  all but the steak.   They just don't know how to sear a fillet...yuck.  no flavor,  cooked horribly
