We just love the vibe at J&G.  And the food is great too!  Servers are knowledgeable, friendly and fun.

My husband and I visited J&G Steakhouse from Toronto to celebrate our wedding anniversary and babymoon - our experience was truly phenomenal! Everyone we met congratulated us and did their best to make sure our experience was unforgettable. The food was delicious - hands down, the best steak we ever had! Make sure to try to the warm chocolate cake dessert! We will definitely return when we come back to Scottsdale!
Service was initially slow. Steak was overcooked and sent back. They prepared another steak cooked perfectly but rather tasteless.
Surprisingly disappointing. Service was slow. Mother's Day menu very small and steak option was tough.

I think J&G is way underrated.   The food was fantastic and the view incredible!  We did have some issues with the service.  Perhaps it was an off night for our wait staff.  We will give them the benefit of the doubt and will definitely return.
AMAZING AMZAING AMAZING

Extraordinary meal.  The service was unobtrusive but attentive - every need was anticipated, so we never had to ask for anything.  The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and the steak cooked perfectly to order.  Clever craft cocktails and a wine list without equal.  The starters, appetizers, soups, and salads were beautiful presentations of classic flavor combinations, and the mains were spectacular.  We will definitely recommend J & G Steakhouse, and our server, Paul.  It's an amazing dinner out!

Everything about J&G is 5 star.  The amazing view from the bar and the dining room is worth the trip.  Our NY steak, tuna tartare and warm chocolate cake was prepared, cooked and presented beautifully and was delicious.  The service was attentive and gracious.  Would highly recommend this restaurant especially for a special occasion.

The execution by the kitchen was far from good. All but one item was served cold. Cold French fries next to a nice steak   Cold sides? How can this be a JG restaurant? 

Waitstaff were very well trained and did a great job, but the evening was a big miss due to the food. Very surprised. I’m certain that had we brought this to the attention of our servers they would have made it right. But, we have a reasonable expectation that in high end restaurants the attention to detail in the kitchen is a given. We do not believe patrons should have to play a roll to ensuring the Food is acceptable. Service requests yes, or an item or two, but a complete dinner for a table served cold? Bummer.
Excellent service and great food. Will be back again. Amazing view and ambiance too.
Great food and service with an amazing view

This dining experience can best be described as tired and unfortunate.  This Jean-Georges restaurant with a supposedly reasonably accomplished Chef de cuisine , disappointed.
Tasting menu with pairing was adequate at best.  Most unforgivable, the ‘ocean bass’ was noticeably past its prime.  
Our server was perfunctory in his approach to us and to describing the courses and wine pairings.  He had to be reminded to bring us our first pairing after the course arrived.  (This wine was a cloyingly sweet reisling that he described as dry.)  Wait staff seemed more interested in conversing in groups in full view of the few patrons who were there.
Our table was without an overhead light source.  I could barely see my wife, and had to use my phone flashlight to see the food.

Cost was $100 per person.  I really expected more from a Vongerichten restaurant. One of the best meals of our lives was at Jean-Georges in NYC several years ago, before he started to build his ‘empire’.  Seems he is in it for the dough his name can generate.  Pity.

Good for an above ordinary experience.  A bit overpriced for the overall experience.  Located in the Phoenician resort so may be good if you are having a large party event.  The interior ambiance is  ok.  Probably a better experience if outside seating on the balcony/patio is available.  The food is good.  Overall experience is good.  But, it is overpriced for the décor/ambiance and overall experience.

Food was ok, service was slow since didn't seem too busy. I have been here a few times before with a large group and had better experience.  I'd still recommend the place due to food is good and the view is amazing!

Went to JG in NYC when I lived there and when I found out that there was one in Scottsdale, I immediately made a reservation.  Food was excellent, service was great, and for the quality, was not bad on price.  Go here knowing you will get a fantastic meal!
Loved the bar. Loved the view. Even better, the food and service was amazing
Always amazing! We had a great time and the food and service were wonderful as usual.

Enjoyed the food and service highly recommended-when I come back to Arizona I will make sure I will dine again - the view also a plus - we had a server named Candice she was so informative about the food I give her a high five

We had a lovely dinner at the perfect outdoor table with a view.  I had the filet, and my husband had the New York strip.  Both were absolutely perfect.  The scalloped potatoes and mushrooms were also delicious.  Service was exceptional from the valet parking, to the cocktail lounge, to dinner, and finally back to the valet who offered us a bottle of water for the drive home.  We would definitely recommend J & G Steakhouse for a special evening!
These guys consistently have great food, attentive service and breathtaking views.

Good food! Great view
Sauteed Spinach was 100%

The setting was very nice, the valet was very helpful, the service provided by our waiter was surely exceptional, and the food tasted very good. The decor and lighting inside is amazing and the view of a Phoenix night skyline was more then worth the price.

Our dining experience was compromised,if not ruined, by a party of seven . Some were extremely loud and behaving as if they were in a sports bar vs what I considered a fine dining restaurant.
The staff was very attentive and accommodating. The food was really good.
The steaks (filet and NY strip), scalloped potatoes and outstanding appetizers we're outstanding!
Sat outside.  Everything was about as expected. Pretty good food. Pretty good service.  But just a great location. Super nice to eat outside.

We went to J&G for my childhood  friend's special birthday.  The service was very professional.   The food was very good and the atmosphere is very pleasant.  When the waitress found out it was my friend's birthday she treated her to a desert of her choice.  There was also music entertainment
In the lounge.  Save this one for a special meal with a special person or persons.
My family and I had a wonderful evening.  We had a teen  and he learned a good bit about fine dining.  The wait staff was excellent.  The food was outstanding and nice presentation.
Nice outdoor seating. Excellent service.

We have dined at J&G for many years, making it an Easter tradition with my family. It usually is excellent. Unfortunately, this year was was not. Our server was pleasant and spent a good amount of time tending to the table. The food however was way below prior standards. My husband  started with the beet salad and completely enjoyed its flavor and presentation. For his entree, he had the salmon. The piece of fish was very small and sat on a bed of runny mashed potatoes. The vegetable was snap peas. Not what I’d expect for $32.00 on Easter Sunday .My chilled lobster tail was just okay. I can get much better at Buck and Rider, but shouldn’t be able to because J&G is supposed to be THAT restaurant. My Ahi tower was atrocious! The tuna was ground down to pablum and when the server brought a spoon for me to eat it, I completely understood. It was runny and clearly not good quality Ahi, as it would never be prepared that way. My daughter had the best experience by having the petite filet, however, the macaroni and cheese side was not the same quality and flavor as what we had earlier in the week at Southern Rail. My daughter and I both had the Caesar salads and although they come with far too much Parmesan cheese ( I realize most would not complain about this) it was lovely! The wine - a Pinot Noir was excellent! Recommended by our server who blurted out the suggestion as soon as we said we wanted a Pinot, even though we had picked one out that was a better value. For $90.00 our server had the lack of awareness to suggest it was a reasonable price point and that he would “never pay more that &100.00 for a bottle of wine.” Well, I will tell you, we never spend that kind of money on a bottle of wine, not because we are cheap or cannot afford to but because we don’t have to. The wines being produced today are better than ever and an establishment like J&G wouldn’t have a bad wine on the list. So for me it was an over step. Hope the renovated space improves everything.

J&G matches Scottsdale's other premium steakhouses in food quality, but lacks a soul.  The spectacular views are a big plus for J&G, but in all other respects the dining room has that non-descript resort restaurant feel and energy.  I would certainly consider J&G for a business dinner or large group, but never for a "night out," when I want the restaurant to supply some of the fun, energy and excitement.

The wine list at J&G is a bit problematic, as well.  By and large it features very young bottles from big name vintners, but at astronomical prices.  I settled on a bottle at the mid-point of their range, enjoyed it thoroughly and then went out the following day and bought a few bottles locally for 25 percent of the price.  I guess they are using a "captive guest" pricing model.

I live nearly across the street from J&G and wish they would aspire to being more than a competent hotel restaurant.  With a little vision, J&G could rival Steak 44 and Mastro's.
Very wonderful! On Easter, the 3 course meal was excellent.. generous portions and very impressive.  The views are fabulous!

First impressions make a difference. Hostess didn't notice the crumbs and such on the chairs - we had to wipe them off ourselves while she watched. Bad impression. Then the waiter asked us if we wanted our favorite drink from last time we were there, which was only once. Good. I ordered the pea soup which tasted only of parmesaan, so I sent it back and got the tomato salad, which was very good. The fois gras tourine was delicious. We shared the Tomahawk rib-eye. Small and very fatty for $130. Creamed spinach was great. Overall, it was just pretty good.
"Jersey Jeff" our waiter was fun and very informative. Great job!
Great food beautiful ambiance
Food took over one hour to come out.  Steak was well done VS medium rare.  The place was half empty so not sure of why the service was so slow.

We’ve dined at lots of JG restaurants around the country. However we’ve never had an experience like the one we experienced this evening.  First we selected 3 different wines, none of which was in stock.  Next we waited for over 30 minutes our meal to the served and not one person came to our table to inform us what was going on. When the food finally arrived the diner getting fish was served first while the other two of us waited for our steaks as minutes passed...very awkward. The food was good and properly cooked.  When we complained to our waiter he sent over one of the assistant managers. She told us they had a large dinner party that night and that was the reason for the problem. We appreciated the explanation but it just was not the JG dining experience we have come to expect. We left disappointed.
Food and service were superb. Beautiful view.  Everything was excellent.
We made a last minute reservation and were not disappointed - great steaks and salads and sides. The bartender was great.
Red wine was too cold. Medium rare steak was more on the medium side. We were placed within 6 ft. of a serving station. Not pleasant. Beautiful view, however.

I thought the service was slow to attend to us. Then they arrived the order was incorrect.  After that, my bill came back at 500 dollars when its total was supposed to be 300.  Kind of messy for such a high end restaraunt.
Everything was absolutely perfect: the service, the food, the music the views! Thank you!

Every bite was outstanding. The view is breathtaking. The overall atmosphere is formal but comfortable. The staff seem to enjoy their work!!! The staff was knowledgeable, friendly and efficient. 
This is a “must do” in the Phoenix area!!
We brought our friends and they were impressed with the service and beauty of the Phoenician!

Very poor service. Unfriendly. Not mean just absent. Very disappointed. Beautiful view. Delicious food. Terrible service. Long periods of time with no food on table. Unapologetic server and manager. Assistant was kind but no explanation why it was so long.

Absolutely fantastic food. The chef is amazing.  Service was excellent.  We were seated by a very large business group and they were extremely loud and behaved as if they were the only table in the restaurant.  Unfortunately it ruined our otherwise wonderful evening.

Went to watch the sun go down, restaurant faces East.
Good menu, great smells but they can't execute.  Dover sole for $66?  Got Lobster and 8 oz filet.
Roasted lobster was so dry and overcooked the claw meat was inedible.  "HOT" spinach was cold.  Pretentious at best, overpriced for sure.  Too many children at dinner, 3 infants and then two teens with cell phones texting their parents at the same table next to us.  Tis a pity, so much potential there.  Would try again.
Nasty hostess.

Arrived early and sat at bar for cocktail. Great Martini!Thank goodness for that. Had told hostess where we were but had to find her to get our table. They tried to seat us at a very small 2 seat table between 2 groups. Having used Open table we expected better. It looked like everyone declined the table. After requesting and getting another table we sat and ordered a appetizer. Food was ok at  best. Not hot(filets) and sides. Ordered 2 glasses of wine and waiter came to pour. He poured my wife’s first like it was a taste then preceded to pour mine then started to walk away. I had to ask him to pour my wife some more and more for me. After he walked away we realized we should have asked for how many oz.s we were supposed to receive by ordering by the glass. Not impressed by service and definitely not worth the price

After following J&G Steakhouse on Instagram for quite some time, dining here was a must during my recent vacation to the Phoenix area. My boyfriend and I were blown away from the moment we walked in - the view was absolutely beautiful! Raul took great care of us and Robert the bartender was wonderful (we’ll be looking for your Manhattan mix when we get back to Wisconsin!)
The flavors were unbelievable. Everything was perfectly prepared and beautifully served. I can’t wait to dine here again!
Thank you for an unforgettable experience!

They beautifully accommodated my family which included my elderly Mama with a wheelchair. Service was  incredible - every one of them. Professional, knowledgeable, helpful but not stuffy. The view was wonderful from the patio at sunset. The food was simply amazing; one of the very best any of us have had. A special, special place.

First time to this restaurant. We were very pleased. We wanted to try something new for dinner in Scottsdale and we weren’t disappointed. The atmosphere is really nice and sophisticated. The view is gorgeous. We had a rainy evening believe it or not in the desert and we still had a fabulous view over looking all Scottsdale with a gorgeous fire pit roaring next to us while standing on the patio. My favorite item was their sweet n sour pork belly. I’m kind of a pork belly snob....and that pork belly is in my top two that I’ve ever had. Very tasty and very tender and lean. I loved my short rib meal. Our collection of sorbets were fabulous. Can’t say enough about our server....she did a fabulous job and truly a pleasure to interact with. We kid around a lot and she was right in there with us joking around. It made our table very relaxed and at ease. We have already told other local friends about J&G Steakhouse since our visit just a few nights ago.
Spouses birthday

58th birthday, steak was wonderful, tender and cooked perfectly. Heirloom tomato salad was good. Giant onion rings batter was odd. Disappointed in the missing asparagus risotto I remembered from last year this time.
Great food, great service! Love the view! Definitely recommend.
We were greeted by a very friendly woman who then had us seated. We had outstanding friendly service at all times. Food was delicious and beautifully presented. We so enjoyed our evening. Thank you.
We went here for our anniversary. Was beautiful, great food, great service, made a special dessert for our celebration. Very happy!

Service was horrible from the minute we sat down at the table. Food was very good but hard to enjoy with bad service. There are many great steakhouses to choose from in the area so for our next steak dinner we won’t be choosing J&G.

First of all, the restaurant is beautiful!  If you want views, this is your place.  Unfortunately, we found the service to be lacking:  although a person who appeared to be a manger stood by, we sat in the bar for 15 minutes before we finally went to the counter to order for ourselves.  When we saw live musical entertainment setting up, we cringed, not because the performer was bad (he was very good, actually), but because we have found in this hotel that the music is too loud for conversation.  We were seated in a faraway corner, but not to worry—there are plenty of speakers.  Our dinner waiter was stressed with too many tables, and too many of them big tables, so we did not get the attention we expected from a restaurant in this price range ($$$$). In his haste, our waiter recommended we order our steaks medium well if we wanted them to be pink inside, but they were overcooked.  We would have sent them back if we could have caught him.  Everything else was very tasty, though, especially the J& G salad.  Since we live in the area, we will probably give J & G a second chance, but on a week night when it is not so crowded.  Overall, we were disappointed in our experience here.

We were staying at the Phoenician for my sister’s 60th birthday and dining at the restaurant was convenient for a Saturday night. Views were spectacular at sundown. Server was very flexible and did wine pairings with our ala carte selections. Tuna Tartar was really delicious— we ordered a 2nd one for sharing. Entrees were the black cod (really delicious!!!) and the beef tenderloin. Service was attentive.. ask for Jeff as your server.
Jack our waiter was excellent.

Miserable ambiance. Super loud. Table next to us out of control. Yelling screaming clapping. Took hours for our food. This is NOT fine dining. Server got our CC and didn’t give us proper receipt. Ran up to us and treated us like thieves. I asked for the manager and some absolutely obnoxious very young and inexperienced woman claimed it was her. She continuously talked over me and interrupted me. She wouldn’t let me the GUEST speak. She was rude and condescending. After enough of her idiocy my wife said Let’s just leave. On the way out she was loudly spouting disrespectfuly to my back “if that what you want to think” and other rude comments. I uttered some profanity and left. Ask yourself is it worth spending $300 plus for two people to be treated rudely in a absurd frat boy atmosphere? NO. I have been there many many times over the years. The food is now cliche and the atmosphere horrible unless you are a drunk 30s frat boy. Management is useless unless you like to guarantee that interaction with them totally ruins your night. Rude and untrained in the least and aggressively offensive in reality.  The guest should be heard as well as listened to, especially after miserable service and management that could care less about you enjoying your experience. All they had to do is look in their reservation system to see that I have dined her e multiple times. They must be planning on only serving drunken low class conventioneers who will never return.  I won’t either!!! $300 checks must not have impressed the staff enough to be respectful.
Noisy atmosphere, slow service from all staff and mediocre food.

Phenomenal food, service and setting.   Everyone at our table of four ordered a different cut of steak and no one was disappointed.   Reluctantly skipped appetizers (as the options looked wonderful) because we weren't hungry enough.  Entrees, sides and desserts were fantastic.     Dined with three kids who asked for minor changes to the standard preparation of the entrees which were happily accommodated.   The food matches the amazing view.   Would definitely dine here again.

I had not been to this restaurant for several years.  We went for to celebrate Valentine's Day even though it was a couple days past.  I was pleasantly surprised.  It was excellent.  The food, service and ambiance were all perfect.  We will definitely be back!
Delicious steaks and great view! Always enjoy celebrating special times there with family.
We’ve been here before, but are still always amazed with the outstanding quality of the food and service.  The fantastic views and ambiance are a bonus as well.

We attended for Valentines.  Lovely evening,  we have been here many times but tonight was not up to standards.   Perhaps it was the rainy weather but the food didnt shine as it usually does.    Normally a very creative chef and phenomenal flavors, not tonight but maybe next time.  We will be back when the weather gets great.
Awesome all around
Awesome food & service too
I went to J&G for Fat Tuesday’s and a great feast.  I was hoping for a better view/table so I will request such next time.

Everything was perfect. My server, John was very professional and all smiles. I have no bemol!

Bravo!
Delightful evening. Food, service and ambiance were exceptional! I'll be back soon!

Probably the best steakhouse i’ve been too! Steak and the sauces were amazing as well as the appetizers of pork belly and beet risotto! Service was amazing and the view to die for! Would recommend for anyone visiting scottsdale and need a perfect date or special occassiom restaurant!
It was a pleasure to find a place w/good food & were able to carry on a conversation. Breath taking view as well. Thank you!
Great location. Great food. Great staff.
Excellent on all levels. Exactly what you would expect from a world class restaurant

Beautiful location on the 5th floor of the Phoenician Hotel, worth the view of the sunset, amazing!  Wait staff and presentation was impeccable, well spaced meal left time to enjoy the company and each course.

J&G is one of our favorite restaurants and we always ask for Candace as a server (she is outstanding).  However, last weekend we drew another server (wish I had gotten his name) because Candace was committed to serving a large party.  This guy did the worst job of serving I have ever experienced.  He argued with us when we sat down, ignored us for drinks for 10-15 minutes and was simply a miserable human being.  Luckily Candace stopped by the table several times and brought us a special treat on her own at the end of the meal.  We won't let this turn us off to J&G as this was a once in many visits bad experience, and we spoke with the size of our tip.  But in the future we both plan to be more vocal if this ever happens again and recommend that you are too.  There is no excuse for bad service.

Our party of 4 enjoyed the view, the ambiance, and the great service provided by John H.

Our wine and food were delicious.

The Birthday dessert made the evening even more special.

Would definitely recommend this restaurant.
Lovely and the ambiance was amazing
Perfect service. Food was good not great. Beautiful view.

Great ambiance and fantastic food. 
Service and attention to details: 5 star. 
Not inexpensive, but worth it. 
Will come again.
Our food was delicious and enjoyable as always at J&G

The food did not live up to the hype in this great venue. Chef infomercials advertise fresh and healthy, yet the 16 oz NY Strip was served with at least 5 oz of uneatable fat, and the wild mushrooms were really 'wild' making them less than enticing.  Manager stated all feedback is a learning opportunity; we think Chef should visit some of the other great restaurants in Scottsdale like we did to see what people actually like at a steakhouse. Most of the staff was friendly and courteous including the manager who resolved our complaint, although our waiter could have eaten some humble pie.  With the right food selection, this certainly can be a great option with a very nice view.
Great view!  Food is very good especially the Dover sole.  Staff is friendly and accommodating.  Really enjoy coming here!
Outstanding service and menu

The ambiance was much better than the food! The oysters were good. The squash soup was watery, good flavor but water consistency. Ordered the chicken and the cod and both were below average, as was the dessert. Wouldn’t return.

While we arrived later for some would say the later seating it seemed hectic!   Our service experience was good.  I did observe others not having good service.    Food was delicious.   Good cut of prime beef and yummy Tuna Tartar and heirloom tomatoes!    Will return!

Expected more.  Did not feel very welcomed by the hostesses.  Service was slow when we sat down.  The staff didn’t work together as a team.  Manager walked through the restaurant several times but did not interact with diners, or even make eye contact.   Our appetizer plates sat uncleared on the table 10-15 minutes, including a lobster carcass from the chilled lobster appetizer.  I finally flagged down the manager and he had to clear the table himself.  Service improved slightly after that, but then fell off again at the end of the dinner.

Food was good, but expensive for what you received.  We were able to get a window seat as we had requested, which made for a nice setting.

There was live music in the bar, which carried into the restaurant, plus the tables around us were fairly loud (bad accoustics?), so it was difficult for us to have a conversation.  There was also a screaming child at a nearby table, which you normally don’t encounter in a high-end restaurant like this, but the in-hotel location leads to a wide variety of diners.

Ironically we had breakfast the next day at a simple diner, and our experience there was better, because their staff worked as a team, and everyone who walked by our table was willing to take care of us.
Excellent restaurant!! I took my staff to this restaurant and it was very enjoyable.

Everything at J&G was outstanding.  Service was professional and prompt.  The courses were timed appropriately and service was non-intrusive.  Food was delicious.  We both had steaks--mine a filet medium rare, his NY Strip medium.  Both were cooked to perfection.  I love that they serve the steaks with four sauces on the side.  The pork belly appetizer was the best we've ever had.  We topped off the meal with baked alaska and it was a perfect end to a perfect dinner.
Pleasantly surprised with our experience.  Attentive service and the food was pretty remarkable.

We had such a great experience at J&G. We had a party of 10 and the accommodations and the effort that went into making us feel comfortable and welcome was evident from the arrival until the very end of the evening. Food was delicious, service exceptional, to the point of having kitchen staff make the extra trip to accommodate my non dairy diet and produce almond milk for my coffee. City views were spectacular and cherry on top for the fabulous meal and evening we had at this great Phoenix location.
From the food to the service to the ambiance this place was perfect. We loved it so much we came back again the second night!

Our experience here was nothing short of phenomenal.  The service was impeccable and the food was divine.  The view was breath-taking and the ambiance was intimate yet open.  Our server was incredibly attentive as was every staff member we encountered.  I highly, highly recommend this place.
Christmas Dinner....Wonderful!!
Always the best!

Carmen was extraordinary in her professional approach to serving our table.  She added to the dinner as much as the food, ambience and view.   Mostly steaks were ordered and each prepared perfectly, as were the delicious side dishes.  We go back - and this combination is why we go back.  Simply a flawless experience again and again.
Really pricey for the quality and quantity.  Really nice location, beautiful restaurant,  super nice staff.  But for a $60 steak — others do much better.

Service was the worst.   We were ignored all night and had to chase the server down multiple times to be served drinks and or order.      I would never recommend the place even though the food was great.

Love the newly renovated bar area in the lobby that takes advantage of the beautiful views.  It is elegant yet comfortable.  The out door patio has all new furniture with several fire pits which feels nice on a cool evening.  The J&G Steakhouse has awesome views with large windows which allows everyone to have a good view from their table.  I celebrated a special birthday and they presented me with a birthday card and delicious dessert to help celebrate my special occasion.  I ordered the filet, mushrooms and whipped potatoes which were all preserved perfectly.  The new Parkerhouse hot buttery rolls are a new addition for enjoying with appetizers.  Staff is so accommodating and friendly.  This is definelt a place to go for special occasions or during the holiday season.  Decorations are gorgeous.
.
Most of night was good. Service was spot on once seated. Hostess and lounge/bar, a little off-putting. Steak overcooked but not to the point of returning.

Went for my girlfriends 50th. The poor service at the bar and at dinner overshadowed the food. I wouldn’t recommend for a special occasion. Maybe for a drink if you are staying at the hotel but I would not go out of your way to come here. For how expensive it is, the service did not match the price point.

Our medium well steak was medium rare. We sent it back and all they did was microwave it and it still was rare. You don’t charge that much for a steak and not know how to cook it! Then microwave it? And we had requested outside dining but someone that evening rented the whole patio, so that didn’t happen. Overall shouldn’t the manager have been on duty checking to see if there were any problems! Not a good experience!
We had a nice quiet table until the live music started.  Then it was unbearably loud.

No aspect of our dinner could have been better, in any way, than it was tonight. What a perfect place in which to celebrate!.... to celebrate ANYTHING!  Also, it’s clearly a dependable place for dinner at any time! A perfect Ten !
We had Dinner on Thanksgiving and despite the crowd the service was excellent. Steaks were wonderful as were the side dishes and soups. Highly recommend.  And the view is incredible
Great food and service. Fantastic view!!! Highly recommend
High end food and service. As expected.

J and G Steakhouse is a fine restaurant—gorgeous warm minimalist space overlooking the pool complex at the Phoenician.  We arrived at largely deserted restaurant and were placed in a huge booth near the back, no view, and when we requested something closer to the windows or on the patio the hostess was rather put out (“well, I’ll have to see”)—but they made the accommodation to a lovely balcony table overlooking the grounds and pool.  The restaurant never had more than five tables the rest of the evening.  Service was quietly attentive and efficient but we were surprised that at a 5 star restaurant—with 5 star prices—they use paper placemats.  

Our server David was business-like at first but warmed as we got to know him.  Limited wines by the glass but high quality selections, same with Scotch—and alcohol throughout the resort is VERY overpriced.  Foie gras was superb, as was each course of the 5 course tasting menu and wine flights.  J and G is what it is--an ala carte steak restaurant--but well done and we would return.

Not worth the money.  Great view and the live music in the bar was great. 
Come for drinks and appetizers in the bar. Don’t waste money on dinner-the food was mediocre at best and service was average
Visiting Phoenix and went to J and G .  Experience was great, food outstanding and the service very good.
Highest marks - incredible views sitting outside looking over the valley, excellent food and service, very romantic.  One of the best dining experiences I've ever had.

Dinner was far less enjoyable than we hoped. The atmosphere was great and the servers were kind and professional, yet seemingly overworked and much less responsive than one would expect. The appetizer crab cake was excellent; the filet was dry and unseasoned; the Parmesan crusted chicken was tough and simply not good. When compared with other steakhouses in the Valley, it was very disappointing for us, despite being atop the beautiful Phoenician Resort (a favorite of ours.) Perhaps the Chef was away tonight—somehow, it missed the mark.
Steaks cooked to perfection, second time there . Was excellent . Would return again.
Service was not the greatest.  Had to flag down a server to order an appetizer.  Medium rare filet was more medium.  Wine we selected wasn't available.  View was fabulous!
Great Food with awesome service. Our server Jeffrey C was wonderful. When we visit Scottsdale again J&G Steakhouse will be on our list of places to dine.
Reservation system process not good. Did not appreciate how we were treated at check-in.

My husband and I celebrated our anniversary. This was our first time at this restaurant- we were impressed. The food quality was exceptional. Our service was wonderful but a little slow with food delivery. The ambiance of peaceful except when the restaurant is fulll- it is noisy. We sat inside, I would recommend requesting outside, and had a wonderful view. Overall, we would head back for a meal. I would recommend this place to anyone, even a local. The food was wonderful and staff was friendly!

Ambiance, food, and waiter service were terrific.  There was a problem with the hostess.  We arrived at 7 for a 7:30 reservation and asked if they would reserve a nice table with a view while we enjoy cocktails in their bar until 7:30.  The hostess said we can't do that.  I asked why...we are here at the restaurant...she said it's just what we do.  No smile, nothing.  The restaurant was pretty much empty.  So we sat in the bar area anyway...waited 25 minutes for our drinks...incredibly slow service...they said because some group just ordered 12 Moscow mules.  I gave up and decided to have dinner.  Very odd...their hostess seemed as though she had a sign on her forehead that read" "you're not welcome here."
Spectacular meal, as always. The first restaurant we visit whenever we’re in Phoenix.

We went here for an anniversary dinner. We sat on the outside terrace on a beautiful October evening. Beautiful view of the newly renovated pool area and surrounding mountains. After dinner walked around the grounds.  It was a weekend so there was live music near the bar. Nice atmosphere, waiter was excellent and food was very good.

On Friday the 13th I took a friend for her birthday to one of my favorite restaurants, J&G.  I have been dining there since they originally opened and also love many of Jean Georges restaurants in New York City.  As usual, the reception desk  personnel were extremely pleasant; the cocktails we ordered were also good.
From here on it was downhill.  Our server was inattentive and indifferent and never checked on the food he served.  We started with risotto that had the consistency of cream of wheat, lamb that was tasteless and not tender, and creamed spinach that was runny and tasted nothing like it should. Obvious no one in the kitchen cared about the preparation and no one was checking the appearance of the food.  We received a birthday dessert, their chocolate cake, which also was not good.
It’s always disappointing to have a favorite spot go so far downhill, especially since the remodel of the Phoenician looks so beautiful.  I hope someone pays attention and brings J&G back to what it was , particularly now so full of top steak houses.
Beautiful view, great service and good food with a modern feel

It was a really good experience. Pretty much loved everthing about it, except that my medium cooked steak came out medium well. My wife got the same, but hers was perfectly cooked. Great place for date night.  I reserved a table and we went there for our wedding anniversary, and on their own behalf set out a happy anniversary card as well as a free anniversary dessert . This was very cool and much appreciated.  Staff was awesome and attentive, decor was very nice. Scenic view over the city lights was worth every penny!
HIGH QUALITY FOOD AND AMBIANCE.GREAT PLACE FOR SPECIAL OCCAISON
Food was excellent, service was great.  Servers worked as a team in a timely and efficient manor.  Dined outside on the patio.  Had a beautiful view of the mountains and city at night.

Food was great!  
Chris was great!
Talia was great in the bar!  Thank you!
Lovely view. Great food. Friendly and efficient staff.

We have dined at many places in Phoenix and we have been to J & G twice -  this time was really terrific. We sat outside on the patio. It was very romantic and I felt like I was on vacation. Our waiter, unfortunately I don't remember his name, but was really excellent .  Our dishes came out and they were nicely prepared and flavorful. I had the salmon and I don't know how they prepared it exactly but it had a little bit of a kick to it and it was situated on a bed of spaghetti squash. Actually was really different and very delicious. We will definitely go back again soon especially with the weather being so lovely .

Our server Jeff was fantastic. He really made our experience special. His recommendations on food and wine were game changers. We have been to this restaurant a few times and this was one of the best. The only thing (and it's beyond the restaurant's control) was there was a lot of construction at the resort so sitting out on the balcony wasn't as nice as it was in the past with a view of construction and really bright lights for the workers. Other than that - amazing dinner and service.
The food didn't live up to expectation. Our wait staff wasn't the friendliest. The view on the patio was of the construction... experience could've been better especially for the price.

The restaurant is a very nice ambiance... Somewhat noisy, and chilly inside. We moved to the outside patio/balcony, much quieter, temperature outside was perfect for this time of year... The over all dynamics outside were a bit muted due to the view of the pool and such were dark and still under construction. Service was punctual, nothing really personable, but good. Food was good (quality I would expect) but nothing to write about. Not really worthy of the bill of fare.

Lovely evening.  The Chef's tasting menu was wonderful.  The service was great and quality of food fantastic.  The room was a bit cold and the server brought over shawls....nice touch.  Would definitely recommend.
Everything was great about our dinner. The food and the staff were both fantastic.
Excellent restaurant for steak, seafood and amazing views of the valley from atop the beautiful Phoenician Resort.

We had a very good dinner on a Saturday night. The veal chop was good as was the salmon dish. The waiter did an excellent job answering questions about the menu and how the dishes were prepared. He understood my need for gluten free dining. The ambience is nice but for us the Saturday night live music was a bit too loud as it carried over from the bar area. Right now, the entrance to the Phoenician is relocated and it makes it a bit more difficult to enter the hotel and get to the steakhouse, but overall the meal was worth the inconvenience.

Mix of Asian flavor and steaks, but not in a good way.  Took the tasting menu:
1- Tuna tartare:  not enough texture on the tuna. Tuna pretty much blends with the avocado.  A crunchy element is missing on this plate to bring a better harmony.
2- Corn ravioli: displayed in a bowl, ravioli paste is very well made, thin dough. Don't really get the plain corn inside the ravioli. A corn puree mixed with some cheese would have been better. Basil sauce was great.
3-Grilled swordfish: displayed on a bowl (again, start to wonder if there have real plates here). Fish was overcooked, lemongrass broth didn't really add anything. This one was not really good overall. Would have been better to simply grill the fish + mushroom and reduce a sauce around it.
4-Beef tenderloin: amazing steak for that price, not aged but great quality of meat. Spinach had no seasoning at all, the hot buttery sauce was way too spicy, not eatable. Thank god I did mix the steak with that sauce, it would have kill the flavor of the meat. This sauce is a rookie mistake.
5-Warm chocolate cake: I don't really have any interest in frozen dessert...
Overall, stick to what this restaurant knows the best: steak. Was surprised when I found out that the chef was from France; he wouldn't get away with a cuisine like that over there. Too bad also that the patio was not open. Service is too complicated for waiters; they remove all your utensils between plates but forgot (two times) to put new ones. Waiter tried to rip me off on the wine's year (2013 on the menu, brings a 2014). I had to insist to get the correct bottle...
The restaurant is not that bad, for Phoenix, but would I be back? probably not.
We chose the place for a special ocasión a birthday! The place is so beautiful with an amazing view of the city. We love it! Food was amazing
I can't say enough about the service, the ambience, the food and wine. Patrick  - the maitre 'd and his staff are on top of it and they made our anniversary dinner feel special. Cheers to J&G!

With the restaurant almost empty,  we were seated next to a very large group who were so noisy we could barely carry on a conversation.   When we said something to our waiter,  he said " this IS a restaurant ".   He also had to run our bill 3 times to get it right and let out an audible groan when we showed him our Preferred Dining cards         ( which we showed him before he rang up the bill)

We celebrated our 52th anniversary at J & G and it could not have been better. The view is to die for and the setting sun was spectacular.  It was a hard act to follow but the food - preparation and service - was a match.  We have been there many times and each time we keep saying "We have to go back  more often"
Great experience!! Awesome food!! Our waitor, Dave very knowledgeable!!
AWESOME meal. Awesome service. Great view. can't wait to go there again.
Great tasting steaks cooked to perfection.  Nice view of the east valley.

Beautiful restaurant with Ana amazing view, located on 5th floor of property. Love music was a nice touch, but quite loud so we sat on the other side so it was just background music. Service is impeccable. Opening salads were awesome - a large tastes Caesar and an incredible wedge were devoured at our table. The only disappointment was the steaks don't come out piping hot...they are served warm, and with the AC on, they cooled down quickly.   We sent back, but still came out only warm.  Too bad. Hostess said that's how they serve them. A big miss in our book. But the steak was tender.
My wife and I split the Sole and Filet while we enjoyed a bottle of Chilean Cab.  The food and service was top notch.  We will be back....Thank you for a great anniversary dinner!
Excellent food and service. This was a date night with my lovely wife if 19years so when we have an experience like this it makes our night!

The place was beautiful and tranquil.  We had a lovely view, although there was construction. The food was delicious and the prices very good for a high-end restaurant. The service was friendly, knowledgeable of the different meals and wine, and gave you just the right amount of attention.  Some of the better restaurants they seem to hover about you to the point you don't feel comfortable, but that didn't happen here.  The portions were very good, leaving plenty for either a fairly hefty midnight snack or upscale and pleasing lunch.  We look forward to going back again soon.
The ambiance was beautiful. The staff was outstanding. The food was unparalleled. It was an unforgettable evening. Thank you!
Stellar service and food! Gorgeous view of the city!
Great view! Small portions, not enough food choices. Waiter was professional and courteous. It was decent but expected more from the Phoenician.
The staff is so knowledgeable and friendly. The views are amazing it's a great place to go
We always come here on the last night of our yearly vacation to Scottsdale and are never disappointed.  The food and service is outstanding and the view amazing!

We were 5 couples celebrating 3 birthdays. Everything was fabulous including the half price bottles of wine. Instead of just giving 3 birthday desserts they gave the table 5 desserts to share: how nice.

Wonderful service and fabulous food!  We had our 10yr wedding anniversary here and the staff was wonderful.  They seated us in a nice romantic spot with a great view.  They also treated us with a complimentary dessert.  We had a great time!

Everything about my experience here exceeded my expectations. Honestly, I don't know if one's expectations can be set so high that they are simply "met" when dining here.

The food was amazing and was priceless. The salmon was so good that I do not expect to ever have a better piece of fish anywhere else for the rest of my life (and that is honesty, not hyperbole). The appetizer bread was light and airy and satisfying enough that it could be an entree of its own, the salad was filling enough that I almost feel it should be an entree itself rather than simply an appetizer, and the sorbet was to die for. I do not like fruit-based desserts—I think fruit is good on its own or in a salad, but that basing a dessert around it is cheating me out of a real dessert—but the blueberry, raspberry, and passionfruit sorbets were the best dessert I have had in a restaurant. Additionally, the house-made ginger ale was a fine addition to my meal.

The staff, too, was great. They were friendly, but professional, and they were human (as far as each being individual in mannerism and persona, and in connecting with me as not simply a "guest" but as a person).

In all honesty, I don't expect to ever have a better dining experience. The price, the flavors, the presentation of the dishes, the staff, the views, etc. all exceeded even my imagination. Any photos or videos cannot do this place justice, and the experience was so great that I cannot fully express it. Dining here is one of the things that must be experienced because there is no way to understand it otherwise.

Disappointing evening. I was really looking forward to eating here. In fairness, dinner was at the end of July when they must experience significantly decreased volumes. Possibly their core staff was on vacation?  Anyway, we waited 15 minutes at the table before anyone took a drink order. Drinks were nice, basic cocktail variants (a manhattan and a margarita) were good, although a bit weak and pricey ($13-15) for anything that isn't completely amazing. We expressed to our waiter that we were looking for a rich experience and he steered us to the tasting menu. We did the tasting menu at Kai last month so we certainly have no aversion to this kind of experience...but may be we should have ordered a la carte. Briefly: Tuna Tartare: Overworked and over seasoned. The Corn Ravioli was nice, but the sauce was under-flavored. The swordfish was either under or over cooked (depending if they were going for seared or cooked thru) although the rest of the dish was fantastic. The beef tenderloin: I really enjoyed this dish, but my date though the sauce was too spicy (it was a hot-pepper / hollandaise kind of thing). Although it was tasty, it was hot enough for me to break out in a sweat and I eat spicy food every day. The chocolate cake was standard hotel restaurant fare. Oh, and the bread (brioche roll) was bone dry. Perfect for making breadcrumbs but not for dinner. The wine parings were interesting. A clean riesling, to start it off followed by a few middle of the road whites. The paring for the tenderloin with the spicy sauce was a  sangiovese. On its own, a good wine, but a bit weak for a tenderloin with a  spicy sauce.  You can see that they have good ideas and concepts, but the execution was way off. Possible an effect of the Phoenix summer slump.
I enjoyed the Summer menu.  Our waiter was so kind and yet not overbearing.  The view was phenomenal.  One of the hostesses stopped by mid-meal to make sure all was good.
Always a great experience both with food and service
Birthday  dinner.

Consistently excellent. Pleasantly surprised by the 1/2 price bottles of wine!  Tasting menu is exceptional but spinach accomplishing the filet was overly spicy. Couldn't eat it.  Tuna tartare is the best!  
Love the mac and cheese. Raw bar never disappoints.  Missed seeing Patrick. Can't wait for the renovation to be complete.

Went for our anniversary. Food and service were excellent. The prime porterhouse was outstanding. We mentioned it was a special occasion beforehand and they brought out a complementary dessert. Nice as was the 50% off any bottle of wine under $99. A Tavel rose for $26 was an added bonus. Only negative was the espresso--very thin--as was the cappuccino. We'll still return to J&G.

We ate here twice.  The wagyu beef, on the second night, was outstanding and to be recommended to all comers; the cost was high, but divided by two (22 oz is a lot of steak) was acceptable. The Six peppercorn prime NY steak had a coating of large peppercorns and an uninterested flavor on the first night, but the filet mignon was well prepared, and the 4 ceramic containers that came with the steaks were interesting, especially the J&G BBQ sauce. The  grilled asperagus we had 2 nights running, crisp and flavorful.  

On the first night we were not given an amuse bouche, which is inappropriate in a restaurant where you are paying in the neighborhood of $500 for a two course dinner for two; the compte cheese fritters  on our second visit  were fantastic.   

On the second night we were also told we could not have a window seat in a section said to be closed. Five minutes later a couple was seated there. The manager (who is also the sommelière) apologized profusely, but made no gesture beyond that, not even offering to reseat us at the other window table in the same section (I would have thought that comp’ing one of us for a mixed drink would have been a good gesture). By that point I was so incensed I had difficulty enjoying my steak.

The  restaurant was above average for a resort hotel and the fifty percent reduction on wines priced under a hundred dollars meant that we drank some outstanding wines for under $50. This was possible because the wine list was also very reasonably priced to begin with, with some really excellent choices to boot. 

Many diners escaped briefly to the porch outside the restaurant, for photos of the expansive and attractive  vistas.

The restaurant is beautiful. The staff lacks congenial skills and is inattentive. The steak I ordered was over cooked. For the service and food quality this place is over priced. Would not recommend. The valet parker was the best part of the evening.

This was our first visit to J&G Steakhouse and it won't be our last, this was one of the best dining experiences we have had in a long time.  The service and food were superb and the timing of the meal was excellent,  We like to have a leisurely dining experience when we dine at a great restaurant and J&G definitely filled our expectations on this level and many more.  We moved to the bar after dining and completed an exceptional evening there.  Very friendly staff which always adds to the experience.  We will visit J&G every-time we are in the Phoenix area.

The Meal was Good .Great View, Great service, nice ambiance, Filet and side dishes were good,The Soup was good.The lobster appetizer in the shell was SMALL.The half price bottle of wine was nice -(Summer Special), 
Nice wine by the glass list also
Amazing restaurant, great view, amazing staff and unbelievably amazing food. Perfect experience from start to finish.
Very good service and fantastic view
J&G food and service is always excellent.  Going out to the balcony to watch the fireworks on the Fourth of July after our meal was a special treat.

We took advantage of their fixed price summer menu and half price wine special. Food and service were both very good. A little difficult to find the restaurant during the construction project at the Phoenician, but once inside J&G the environment and views were great.

I was not told the resort was under complete renovation.  The whole experience was a joke.  The service was a joke, piano player was a joke and level of the playing was so loud it was a joke.  The view from the deck of mud wholes that used to be pools was a joke.  The food was a joke, like road kill.  This was a first date and I looked like a joke.  I have eaten here about half dozen times and I won't go back.
Everything was phenomenal from beginning to end - the staff, the view, the food, EVERYTHING!  This was our first visit, but will definitely not be our last!

This is by far the best steak I have had in the Phoenix area.  The service was outstanding.  The side dishes go beyond the typical high-end steakhouse (try the roasted corn ravioli with basil fondue).  The wine list has a nice selection of well priced wines along with a healthy selection of some hard to find treasures.  If steak is not included in your diet, the fish was exceptional.  The Dover Sole was amazing; the tuna tartare was fresh and wonderful.  This place is truly worth a visit.

Food & service were great as always. Unfortunately music was as loud and inappropriate to a steak house as ever, but we ask to sit sheltered as best we can. Ear plugs would be recommended.

Hotel renovation means a long haul from parking to restaurant; no wheel chairs AGAIN. Unbelievable.
I had the Dover Sole and it was by far the best you can get in Phoenix.  The service was as impecable as always.

Very comfortable and tranquil dining area. Service was very hospitable and food and everything was exactly as expected, fantastic. Valet is validated and the area is wonderful for a date, romantic night, or special occasion.
Anniversary
Wonderful dining experience with excellent service!

The whole J&G staff made our anniversary such a nice one from the moment we walked in. The service was unmatched from many other restaurants we've been to in the area. Every detail from the entres to the live entertainment and especially the view at night was really enjoyable. I've recommended this place to my friends already and we'll definitely be back soon!
Excellent food, service and cocktails.

Consistently great food -- the tasting menu never disappoints.  The Tuna Tartare is outstanding and although i am not a Riesling fan, it pairs beautifully with this dish.   With the Phoenician under renovation - the view was rather disappointing but we look forward to the completion and returning to J&G in the fall.
You can't get any better than J&G in Arizona.  Being from NY I'm familiar with fine dining and this place ranks up there with the best of Manhattans restaurants if not better.
Such beautiful scenery.. filet was tender and moist..Wife loved her scallops ... great experience..👍
Great evening.   Food was delicious.  Exactly what we were looking for.   Seating comfortable with serene ambience.   Just a little difficult to find but a lot of staff were attentive and helpful.
Excellent views, ambience, service and food!  The menu is wonderful!!

I enjoyed the food and the service here very much! the servers were absolutely fantastic. however the sides were a little pricey. For ten dollars I have had better macaroni and cheese, and the french fries. On the other hand the entrees were delicious.
Great choice for our wedding anniversary dinner!  Excellent food and ambiance.

Food was really good! Scallops were a little undercooked, but the service was impeccable; the server took the time to get to know us and give great recommendations. I would definitely go back.  It is an ala carte menu, typical of steak houses. The options are definitely big enough to share and they did a great job of plating things for us to do so!

Very disappointing. Live music was too loud, filet mignon ordered rare came medium and waiter did not check to see how we were...my husband ate only a portion of it. Too long between courses, server tended to disappear. Disappointing as we were there for a fun weekend.

You can't help being disappointed when you're paying $44 for 8 ounces of steak and it arrives over cooked and you have to sit there and wait while your dining partner eats until they bring you a new one.  Then the one they bring you is practically raw and you have to send it back again.  A good steak house gets it right the first time but when our waiter apologized at the end of our meal it was with a shrug and a "sometimes it happens".   Everything was delicious...but most very pricey steak houses also have very good food.
Nice view. Great food and service  goooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooood

We came to celebrate a birthday and chose to sit on the patio to watch the sunset hit the hills. Dinner was amazing, delicious and perfect steaks and the sauce pairings took the flavor above and beyond. Wine was spectacular along with the sides. Upon entering back inside were pleasantly surprised to learn that the music we were listening too on the patio was not XM radio, but live in the bar, so we grabbed some seats and ordered another 2 bottles of wine. Great time and amazing food!

Steaks were cooked wrong twice, finally gave up. Shrimp add ons and sauces were missed twice.  Had to ask multiple times for bread.  Wine on the list was wrong vintage (off by 2 years).    Super disappointed as we wanted this to be our new neighborhood go-to place.. But they owned it all and comped our whole meal and brought us a nice Syrah for dessert.   Thats a lot more than I can say about other establishments who don't own their screw ups and still stick I work the bill. We will go back and try again, hoping this was a one-off with a bad Sous Chef screwing it up for everyone.
Would expect better service for the price. The server seemed to be just going through the motions
Excellent!
Everything was top notch from the moment we walked in the door.  A must experience!
The steak was amazing! The only hiccup was that my steak was over cooked.i sent it back, a manager tried to convince me a well done steak was cooked to a temp of medium. Stop it!

The ambience was great along with the food. Service was no question fantastic. Our waiter (john) was unbelievably great. Tend to our needs and kept checkinf in and out. This place was great from the start, from entering the hotel to going up on elevators to enter the restaurant including leaving. I would highly suggest this place to anyone looking for great food, service, and scenery. (As we sat on patio)
Great service and attentiveness, good food and wine selection.

My wife and I were celebrating our 55 wedding anniversary and decided to make a return visit to J & G. As always we were delighted with the food, ambiance and service. The whole experience was more than enjoyable. The waiter was most helpful in choosing a wine that was great with breaking the bank.

With three people in our party we had made dinner reservations for an outdoor table which worked out very well. Part of the terrace had been cordoned off for a larger festivity which was winding down shortly after we arrived which nicely reduced the noise level. The atmosphere on the terrace, helped by the great view over the city, was beautiful, service was attentive, food and drinks arrived for everybody at the same time. Specifically the tuna tartar as a starter was fabulous, steaks and halibut were flavorful and cooked to perfection, the asparagus was slightly charred but tasted well. The after dinner expresso came piping hot to the table. Despite the fact that the place was humming and looked fully booked inside the service was very at ease and did not seem rushed at all. The only thing to improve is how the table surface was cleaned after dinner, a piece of cloth is probably more suited than bare hands. Overall a very enjoyable evening.
Thank you for taking such good care of my girlfriend on her birthday.
Something's you have to experience and this is it,  the minute I left the restaurant I told everyone about this place
It is alright....

I'm not a regular but have gone about 5 or so times in 7 years.  When I go to J&G I go because I expect greatness and everything to be top notch.  Today the overall experience was below average.  Enough of a let down that I don't think I can convince myself to go there again.  The waiter was an ok guy but at one point made a comment when we were helping with the wine glasses "oh this is not my first rodeo...". Not sure what you say to that but was just strange attitude when we were just trying to help him.  2 of us in the table needed wine refills and he was nowhere close so I served us.  The food took forever... I mean I grill often and if it takes you more than 10 mins to cook a quality steak, you've over cooked it.  I should've seen the signs cause guess what, my steak was overcooked.  When I tell and show the waiter, he apologizes and tries to take it back but I had to go and because the service was so slow I couldn't wait more. Then he brings some person apparently to acknowledge and apologize they screwed up but doesn't introduce him so I have no idea who he is, a little awkward... Maybe that's who they show as a token when the kitchen screws up, again no idea... So I leave and I text my wife who stayed with my friends at dinner if they did either something to the bill and what not, and she tells me they comped a carrot cake... I start laughing.  Then to add she tells me the waiter, even though he knew I had left, took forever to bring the bill.  My wife is a nice person so she would never complain but I would've not let that go like that.  If I were at a regular steakhouse chain at less than half the price of J&G I'd let it slide but for those prices I expect and deserve better.  Too bad since that location is really great and I didn't expect this let down.  Oh well, that's how restaurants go down, they forget they're there because of customers.  There's definitely plenty to choose from in the Phoenix area.
The views were terrific. The service really good. Very attentive. The steaks were just ok. Kinda disappointing.
Wonderful view, excellence food, the service was great.   My daughter and I were visiting Scottsdale and  we always stay at the Phoenician. we Dined three times at J & G. It was perfect

the food was spectacular but the 3 Dover Soles  and spinach were cold.  We also had the large Porterhouse which was like butter: tender and flavorful.  We waited so long for the food we were not interested in sending it back.
The appetizers were terrific and light considering they were fried.  We would go back.
Service phenomenal.  We were never rushed; loved the pace.  Tuna tartare appetizer was lovely.  Very very disappointed in the stripped bass.

The food was only fair to begin with and some of it did not come out at the same time, with measurable delays between arrival of everyone's plates. Two of the four of our dinner party ordered the tasting menu. Their second entree did not come out for about 10 minutes after our full entrees arrived, so we had to eat without them so our food would not get cold. The celebration was for a birthday. While the complementary desert was a nice gesture, the birthday celebrant got her desert and the other two in our party who ordered the very same desert did not get theirs for another 10 minutes, so she had to eat hers alone so the ice cream would not melt. 

Twice, the bus boy poured sparkling water in glasses of those drinking flat water and vice versa.

Specific feedback on the food: the bread was terrible. What is so difficult about getting quality bread to accompany a $500 dinner for four? The tuna in the tuna tartare had no texture--rather than being diced or cubed, it was mushy and the sauce was nothing more than an over-powering vinegar that masked any other flavors. The Dover Sole--$66--was over cooked and the one person's filet was very rare instead of medium. The creamed spinach was good, as were the potatoes gratin.

Although the server's intentions were good, she talked too much and, as it turns out, at the expense of more important matters such as making sure everything was delivered at the same time. 

The views are incredible, but I recommend simply going for drinks on the balcony and eating someplace else in the Scottsdale area.

Every time I have dined here with my family it has been nearly perfect. The food is outstanding with non steak options for those who don't enjoy beef. Excellent wine list and very good service for the most part. I always have the salmon and it is perfection! My family enjoys a variety of beef options, all can be cut with a fork. Not your typical heavy steak house cuisine. The sides are from decadent to light, depending on what you are looking for. This place will never be taken off our list of dining when we are in the area!
excellent food and service for my Grandaughter's 13th Birthday
The food and service were top notch, as usual.

This place was a disaster. We were staying at the Phoenician(another disaster but separate story). The outdoor balcony had only a few chairs and no drink service. So get your own drink at the bar and go try to find a seat. When we were seated at the table, our waiter, Gregory, was inattentive. We finally placed our order, steaks priced at over $50 each, with sides extra. My steak and sides came, but my wife got hers 15 min. Later. By then, my meal was a greasy, congealed mess that had a strange mealy texture. I had to shout to get Gregory to stop by, and he explained that he forgot to place my wife's order. Make a long story short, they comped the meal but our anniversary dinner was ruined. Go instead to Steak 44, it is infinitely better in every way.

We loved the ambiance of this steakhouse. It was very vibrant and they had a live performer playing music in the bar area. The food was amazing and came out of the kitchen in a timely manner. The Au gratin potatoes were finely cut and light and the steaks were delicious. The only critique I would have is our seating. My husband and I were celebrating our 10 year wedding anniversary and were first seated at a table that could fit 8-10 people. We asked to move to something a little more intimate and closer to the windows so we could have a better view. We were sat at a table that could sit 4 which was better but the table directly in front of us faced us and we faced them. It was really awkward and we weren't exactly sure where to look. Either had to look right past them or to our right the entire time to enjoy the view. Other than that I would definitely recommend this steakhouse. I would also recommend that each server ask if you're celebrating anything special but since we weren't we didn't get any kind of special service or dessert like we would at other restaurants.

Great service. Food was horrible for the caliber steak house they advertise. Better off as Mastros or the other Scottsdale options. This is a hotel restaurant at best. It should not be advertising the celebrity chef experience. Overall food was bland and poorly cooked.
Great steaks and accompaniments! Wonderful sunset and city views from the veranda. Excellent service.

The only issue I have is when a restaurant of this caliber advertises "great views" I would expect "great views". Looking over the swimming pool and a bunch of "apartment like" building and the "view" behind all that, isn't  what I would call "great views".

My daughter and I go to different restaurants looking for great views, kid friendly, and great food. As far as views, I would not rate this at the top of my list. If I want to look at people swimming, I will go down by the pool and eat or I would rather eat beach side.
This place is awesome. Top notch.  I would recommend this place for all occasions.

We found ourselves in the neighborhood so my wife and I decided to make it an evening out. As always the food, service and everything else about the experience was first rate. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone wanting a special evening.
Great food and ambiance and server was very friendly and knowledgeably.
We had a fabulous experience. The food was outstanding and the wine selection was superior. It was a perfect way to end our  vacation in Phoenix, spectacular views of the valley.
What a disappointment.

Staying at the Phoenician and looking for an offsite dinner, we had a tire blow out and opted for a night in.  Great choice!  While not perfect, (in spite of my 5 star review), the food was outstanding.  I was leaning toward fish, but the waiter described the steak and I was in. One of THE best I've ever had.  I like a steak medium well and often I have chefs try to give me a lesser grade option thinking I do t know what I'm talking about.  But this was PERFECT!  Perfectly seasoned (not too salty), perfectly cooked.  And I LOVED the sauces.  LOVED!  I can't say I had a favorite.  So good. 

Other winners were snap peas (with mi t and ginger) which were other-worldly and beets.  My wife opted for Tina taretar as an entree and loved that.   Toffee pudding was ridiculous!  

The only "miss" was the four gras appetizer which was delicious but inexplicably served with a tart rhubarb purée.  The rhubarb sounded good but so over-powered and disappointed that we opted to forego it altogether Bd just do the pate with toast.  Really good. But in my humble opinion, a sweeter option would have made this as good as the rest of the meal.  

Drinks were great a an excellent wine menu.  The place is a must!  

Shoutout to bartender Brian, who made excellent drinks and listened to us.  And to Chris, who backed up our waiter and was just excellent!

J&G serves up one of the best eating experiences in the valley.  The views are great, the service is excellent and the food is flavorful and prepared to your liking.  Shout-out to Candace.  Always welcoming and a great credit to the restaurant.
Food was delicious. Service tonight was a little slow; however, it isn't always. We sat on the patio. The view was spectacular.

Great dinner - joint birthday celebration. Greg, our waiter, was very professional. He didn't rush us. We were there from 730 to 1030.
Definitely going back again.

J&G steakhouse  have the best Filet Minon that I have ever had. They always have great service and treat you so good. We go for special occasions like Birthday's and it is always the best food and service.
Loved the outside patio with great views and quiet enough to have good conversations.  Best steak in years!
The steak was amazing! The server treated us like we were not important. I would go back again but ask for a different server.

Sitting outside on the terrace was delightful!  The food did not disappoint.  My partner had the 12 oz. New York strip, ate every bit, and raved about it.  I ordered appetizers and sides.  The roasted beets with goat cheese were outstanding, as was the tuna tartare.

We have been to this restaurant many times. The view is outstanding. The restaurant is decorated very nicely and sleek. 
The last couple of times, though, the service has lacked. Although, the first introduction was great, it sort of lacked from there. The waiter rushed us taking our order. It is too nice of a venue to have this service. 
It took too long for the drinks. Salads were very late, after our appetizers, which the waiter finally caught, so had them bring them. The servers that dropped our food off, did not check to see if our steaks were cooked to our liking. They were not. 3 out of 5. My mother and guests were quiet and late in telling me, to make a change. 
It is a beautiful venue and the food is typically outstanding, but if you want to continue good business, you need to improve on these areas I mentioned above. 
*And, when the hostess calls to confirm your reservation and sees you mentioned outside or table by the window, handle it diplomatically. It was a turn off from the start, after twice she kept mentioning if someone comes in before me, they would be sitting there.
Our group loved it!!!

Food was good, however, they messed up the temperature on both my and my husband's steaks.  When paying 50+ for a meal, it should be done right.  The service was terrible.  waiter was inattentive, and it took us forever to even let them know our steaks were done right.   We wanted to order a bottle of wine with dinner, but our waiter was no where to be found.  We ended up not ordering one because it was too late when he finally came over.  Disappointing.

It was our 10th Anniversary and I wanted to find a romantic place in which I found J&G Steakhouse I made a reservation for the 5th of March , Everything was just beautiful there , the views are amazing ... but when the food came my wife's steak was under cooked had to send it back and the mushrooms were over cook  , They brought it back but still wasn't right she said it was chewy I advised her to send it back if she didn't like it but she didn't want to ruin our anniversary dinner so she ate some of it , I had the lamb which was pretty good that I shared and she ate my au gratin potatoes , would I recommend this place ? yeah for the views and the romantic atmosphere but unfortunately after our experience I would say not for the food .
Incredible view paired with amazing food. We came to celebrate my love's birthday and were completely satisfied. It's worth every penny for a special occasion.

A fantastic evening! Great dinner - the steak, the fish, and the chicken - with a great wine. Service was perfect as well. It was as if they knew we were wrapped in conversation and never disturbed us in those moments.
I thought it was a great night!
We love the atmosphere and the food has always been great!!! Highly recommend!!!
Very good, food and everything. Good service. Very nice decoration

The restaurant is beautiful. We were there on a Sunday night, so it was very quiet. We were a group of 5 gals who were having lots of fun, so we were a bit loud. Not really the place for that.
Food was good, although a bit pricey. Wine list is not very expansive, also very pricey. 
All in all it was good, and would have been very good if we had been looking for a very expensive quiet night out.
Very good service wish food was better because prefect place for a special occasion
We were amazed. The best dining experience we've had in Arizona!
Wonderful waiter and great views-Just had a great time with family on a special occasion.
Excellent experience. Food was great, atmosphere was great, setting was great.
Food, wine and service all excellent.  View of sunset and pool patio very good (from outdoor dining area).  After dinner drink next to outdoor fire capped a perfect experience.
Excellent.  Food was awesome staff attentive view was superb.   Highly recommend for those who want a fabulous dinning experience.
Birthday. Food is very good but inside dining is not very romantic. Outside may be better option but there was a large party so it was very noisy
Excellent experience. Waiter very friendly. Made my wife's birthday special
The Phoenician has spectacular service, outstanding customer service and the view is second to none. I would highly recommend going here for a nice date night or to take out of town guests

Disappointing lukewarm salmon, when returned we were unsure whose plate was who's.  It seems in a restaurant of this caliper they would re-do the fish, instead of bring heat-lamped fish back to the table unsure of which plate was who's.  I wrote them a letter and it has been over 3 weeks with NO response, which is code for we don't care.

Additionally after a very long wait we were informed our birthday dessert was sent to the wrong table, which caused another very long wait.  Not their best evening, but none the less a response to my letter would have been nice.
The waiter was very helpful and pleasant. But it took a very long time to get our food. Waiter apologized.

Have stayed at the Phoenician on numerous occasions and finally had dinner here.
Romantic ambiance with extraordinary city lights and has a outside patio with fire-pits which add to the views. Very nice long bar, well stocked with premium labels.  Martinis served in old fashioned round martini/champagne glasses. Perfect Sapphire dry martini.
The Jumbo prawn appetizer was a little limp, passable but expected better from this 5 star restaurant....maybe difficult to fly in fresh prawns on a daily basis.
However, everything else was perfect and the aged Ribeye exceeded my expectations. You will not be disappointed. Very flavorful, aged, grass fed and lean but very tender. Selected the Faust. A big red cab out of Napa.  Probably the best value on the extensive wine list and it came in a split so you can enjoy more than 1 wine label. BTW, If you are fan of Quintessa....its in the family.
The standard sides are shareable so just have each person order 1 side and share.  The cheese au gratin  is like candy.  The Cinnamon Apple Crumb was the coup de grau paired with a 10 yr old Port.
Kudos to Jeff........superb service.
Definitely go again......would have given 5 stars but the shrimp........
Outstanding filet mignon - very flavorful, perfectly cooked.  Salmon was not that tasty.  Asparagus tasted like they were picked that day.
The ambiance was nice, but the restaurant was too loud--beyond energetic.
Everything was amazing except our server. The timing slow between courses, and he rarley checked on our drinks. We were in no hurry for dinner, but the service could have been much more attentive.

The rib eye was prepared to perfection. Juicy and flavorful. Mushrooms were outstanding. Didn't care for the Bellini much - too reapberry-ish and not enough champagne. Christopher was very attentive and a great server. Very expensive but worth the experience.
Pricey but excellent

Good and ambiance was amazing. The server wasn't very communicative, especially when boxing up food. We had no idea that it was at the front and waited for awhile before realizing. We all got a bit lost in elevators too, since you couldn't push or read buttons inside of the elevator. Overall it was wonderful experience.
The AMAZING view and tasting menu! Awesome!

We enjoyed our dinner here.  Service was excellent and the food was very good.  We had the tasting menu and were very happy with the selection.  There was quite a lot of food and we enjoyed our evening at this lovely restaurant.
