We went there for my father in laws 88th birthday.I can't remember the waiters name, but the service we got was extraordinary  as one would expect from a restaurant of this caliber. We didnt want for anything. The food melted in your mouth. Couldn't have  been any better. We will definitely return for more!
Great atmosphere. Lighting, seating, sounds, views were all top notch. Food was great and service rocked. Would recommend as a special occassion dinner, or just an expensive date night.

Excellent food, service and views of the city lights. Salads and soups were excellent. Especially the French Onion soup! Everyone had stakes or lamb and all were prepared perfectly.  The sides are large enough to share and all three we had were very good. The carrot cake was superb and baked Alaska was excellent. This is and expensive restaurant and the wine list didn't have many wines under $50 and most were over $100 so don't go here on a budget. However, I would highly recommend JG if you want to have an outstanding un-rushed fine dining experience.

Positives: Food was delicious, service was excellent. Jeffrey, our waiter, did a great job.   Atmosphere was lovely and the view is fabulous

Negatives:  music was too loud, room was cold
Always a delight!  This time around, seemed more busier than usual, but still enjoyed my dining experience.  Clear night, and the view was beautiful!
Splendid servers contributed to the overall experience. Amazing bone-in ribeye steak for two.

It's hard to believe when someone gives every category 5 stars....but honestly, believe it!  We stayed at the Phoenician and only planned on eating at J&G Steakhouse one night.  Our dinner and the atmosphere were so perfect, we actually ate there two nights in a row and got different meals the second night.  Both meals were outstanding, both servers were absolute perfection!  Try the Dover Sole...it is pricey and so I hesitated...but it was the very best seafood I have ever had in my life.  Steak was amazing too.
Food was great, service superb, view spectacular,  only complaint was a table of ladies behind us being extremely loud.

Very nice upscale dining. The music although good/skillful was a bit loud. Talking was difficult. Great service. Be sure to ask for a window table as the view really enhances the experience. Sitting in the middle/back of the room is just not the same. The salmon and veal chop are great and better values. The New York peppercorn steak was excellent but pricey.

Parking is underground with a confusing elevator ride. You have to switch elevators and read the buttons outside the elevators carefully for instructions. Get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant or you will have to ride the elevators up and down  again.

Wonderful! Everything was terrific! Not your typical hotel dining room; an escape into decadent dining in Scottsdale! Highly recommended! The tasting menu is worth it's weight in gold; a culinary adventure!
First class in every sense!
Great service, food, ambiance, and scenery! Highly recommend.
A great steak house with a priceless view of the city of Phoenix!

Chose J&G for our anniversary dinner and we're very happy that we did. The city lights view is one of the best in Phoenix and combined with the excellent meal and service  we felt truly special.  Would highly recommend here for any special occasion.
The table we sat at was falling apart the  Formica top was  torn off on the sides .i was told it had been that way for  quite sometime . Unacceptable for a restaurant of these prices disappointing .
Great experience. Great service and food.
Excellent food and service.
Service was good and food was excellent for what we ordered... would go back.

I have eaten at this restaurant in excess of 30 times on a seasonal basis and this time the food was very poorly prepared. It is clearly a  new presentation and the overall quality is very subpar for the price and expectation. I would not recommend this restaurant.

Possibly the best meal I've ever had.  Hubby and I shared the Dover sole, roasted baby beets and mac & cheese.  Topped it off with sticky toffee pudding. The sole was filleted perfectly table-side.  Pre-dinner drinks were generous and really good -  cosmo for me and scotch & water for him.  Wonderful hot rolls were brought with our drinks.  Service was impeccable.  This is our go-to for special occasions.

We all had steak. Very enjoyable.  We split the soup between myself and my wife.  We had butternut squash soup which they split evenly at the table. Many times it is quite thick. It was very light. 

We also had asparagus which was quite a large portion. 


Overall outstanding. 

Great ambiance, food and service. Can not beat the combination.
Beautiful place ! Amazing service and delucious food!
Great restaurant food was delicious service was terrific the restaurant itself is beautiful.
We always enjoy our experience at J&G. The service is always impeccable and the food is so consistently delicious. We love to celebrate here and will do this again.

Ordered 2 filets and a porterhouse. Both fillets were overdone. Med well came out well done and well came out dry and crispy- so dry they took it back and replaced it.  Sides are not included. Calamari very oily. Food was tasty but for the money they charge and their reputation, they failed.  I've had better steaks elsewhere that were cooked correctly. Views by the window were terrific. Too bad the food did not live up to the hype.

Beautiful room and setting. The bar area was perfect for a pre-dinner cocktail. Steaks are the specialty but there were various excellent appetizers with the best being the steamed shrimp salad. The parmesan chicken didn't keep up to the peppercorn New York strip. Excellent wine selection. We will return.
The hostess Bree was rude.  Food was ok.  French onion soup was disappointing.  Brianne our server forgot about us a couple times.
Had a group of 4 and everyone had a different steak. Good, but nothing spectacular given the reputation.
Classy ambiance, professional service, outstanding kitchen, live music, holiday decorations, and world-class views combine to make the place and the experience a local gem!

A lovely dining space and spectacular vistas, even in the rain.  Nice choices of entrees and starters and a most impressive wine list.  We were not disappointed by the food, but the service was no where near what you would expect in such a classy restaurant.  Server was totally disinterested  (on a not so busy evening) and food servers did not 'present' food, the plates were merely placed in front of us.  Water was consumed but glasses were never replenished. The lack of basic attention to detail truly undermined our dining experience.
Excellent on all scores. Desert not as good a meal but as requested

The restaurant was fabulous. Thought the servers should have asked if wanted to take remaining filet mignon home instead of just clearing the table, especially at the prices for the steaks. Table service is professional but I wouldn't say it's warm or makes you feel special. This was true when my son wanted to order a side dish but server said one side would be enough for two. I think that should be our choice but it wasn't presented that way.

We always get treated so well there. Last night we had Christian as our server and he was so thorough in explaining about the menu, but not pushy! The crab cake appetizer was outstanding and both our steaks were really well seasoned. And may I suggest the potatoes gratin? All around an excellent choice for date night or a special celebration! Or if you're just in the mood for a very good steak with a spectacular view.
Great restaurant for a special occasion.  The service was great and the food very good.  We were able to have a nice dinner.. not rushed and would highly recommend J & G's.

We enjoyed service and scenic view but  food was not hot also plate,too. 

Thank you

Visited for a steak dinner for my friend's birthday. To remain terse, I'll simply say that my steak was entirely over cooked, and unevenly at that(nearly well done but I ordered medium rare), the waiter brought the wrong sauces over, and the sides were overpriced for the quality.
We loved it except the band playing in the bar was very loud and it was hard to talk at our table

Excellent food with a view of Camelback Mountain, a majestic site in spite of the rain. 
I experienced a very kind gesture by the general manager because I visited the restaurant for a celebration of life. That kindness was greatly appreciated!

The food was outstanding.
The resort is one of the most beautiful places in Phoenix.
And expensive but worth it...
We enjoyed dinner and view was very nice, as the service
From the front desk, bar to the entire wait staff a bravo performance.

The service here is top notch the moment you get out of the elevator. 
Our waiter was knowledgeable about each item on the menu (and we asked several questions). 
We did not order a bottle of wine since my wife is pregnant. Sometimes at high-end restaurants the staff can treat you with slightly less enthusiasm if you don't order wine. That did not happen here. We were treated perfectly. 
The food at this restaurant is outstanding. We had a beet risotto and oyster mushroom avocado carpaccio which were both excellent. The steak is cooked perfectly as you would expect at a high end steakhouse. 
The views at J&G are what gives the ambiance a step-up against the competition. It is hard to describe views but suffice to say they are spectacular. 
Dessert here is also worth mentioning as it was a delicious way to end off.
This is not a restaurant for someone on a tight budget, but definitely worth every dime.

I have been to J&G's many times, it was always a great dining experience. But this time, they couldn't catch up. Shrimp cocktail was below average, RibEye was ok but nothing special. They even messed up on the fries this time. Onion soup and filet mignon were both ok. Service was kinda cheap-steakhouse like, not what you expect from a top-dollar restaurant. There are many dining options in Scottsdale, like Dominick's or Capital Grille (both amazing). Would not recommend J&G anymore.

BOTH OF US WERE CELEBRATING BIRTHDAYS....SO THE SPECIAL CARD AND THE DESSERTS WERE FABULOUS...OF COURSE, THE FILETS, THE POTATOES AND ASPARAGUS WERE SUPERB...EVERYTHING WAS PERFECT...INCLUDING THE WAIT STAFF...

Our food was excellent  - grilled lobster and filets.
Our service was top notch, great customer service.
Would 100 percent return.
Absolutely the best restaurant that we have experienced.
Friend and I came for our birthday celebrations. We had the filet mignon, brussell sprouts and gratin....soooo good. The service was on point as well.

Unbelievable dining experience.   The food is a masterfully choreographed dance of flavor and texture.   Unbelievable.  The service was top notch.  Only criticism would be the wine list.   Could use a little more variety for the $$$ folks.

Wedding anniversary date, wife chose a tasting menu ($63) and I had Oysters and a 12 Oz Filet Mignon. Food was very poor, sub par and definitely not aligned with price.  The tasting menu was extremelly bland and forgetful, quite a disappointment, if that's the best the restaurant has to offer I can't foresee a bright future for this place. On top, the half/half (east/west coast) oysters weren't fresh and I had to leave one behind. Steaks were OK but had much better in Phoenix. The ambiance and service were fine and as expected but small details were just a bummer, eg, you pay $250 for a special meal and all you get is cheap paper towels under your plate... I won't be going back.
Awesome, I 😍 the ambiance.
Outstanding service, ambience, food.  Great for a special occasion.
Meal was excellent and the wait staff was outstanding.
Marginal food. Poor service. Waiter never shared the specials, gave attitude about the wine, we had issues with the order and the bill.
We loved celebrating our honeymoon here at J&G Steakhouse. Great food and great experience.

First - what a beautiful location.   The decor and ambiance were spot on - it is gorgeous and the view is spectacular.  

 As for the food - it was exquisite - our party all had steak but we did have tuna tartare and some west coast oysters to start and they will excellent.   The steaks were outstanding and oddly enough the mashed potatoes side was sublime.    We all were amazed at the texture and taste.    You know they are doing it right when the chef cares enough to go the extra mile over the mashed! 

Finally at a place this high end, the service should be impeccable.   And our server Laurent was superb.  Attentive without being overbearing,  appearing at the all the right times and when asked, selecting a outstanding bottle of wine.   Absolutely great...

Our return for anniversary celebration turned out to be more memorable than expected. My veal chop was stellar; 2" or so thick and delightful in every way.  I've had many over the years and this might have been #1.

My wife enjoyed her lamb chops but she's not as expressive as me.

This is a top notch pl;ace that never disappoints. We'll be back soon looking for something to celebrate.
Veal and lamb outstanding! View is breathtaking.
All around great restaurant...food, atmosphere & staff...worth a visit & a return visit.

If you have dined at any other Jean-George restaurants you may feel disappointed. It is not in the Vegas Jean-George category. But for the Phoenix metro area it is a great steakhouse. My wife and I made our own surf and turf. We split a 16 oz New York Strip and the grilled lobster tail. Both were cooked great. The steak is a 6 peppercorn so it has a nice spice. The highlight of the meal was the porkbelly appetizer. It was cooked perfectly with carmelized ginger on top. It was worth the trip.
Great food and service. If sitting outside, be careful not to sit over the cigar smoking area of the bar below.
Jeff was the best waiter we have ever had!!! The food was great, too!! Thanks for a memorable experience. Loved the ambience!
1st time to this restaurant. Very impressed overall. Excellent service, rare in AZ. Food was good, but the Chef needs to dial down the salt amount. Other than that great and we will be back
The food was very good and the service was excellent. The atmosphere was a bit stuffy for my liking but overall, a very nice experience.
Our waiter was so amazing I wish I could remember his name. He made it so enjoyable!
Elegant restaurant, high-end steakhouse for special dinners
Overall the experience was great. The food was wonderful and they had a great variety to choose from. Only thing is that I could not possibly afford to eat here as much as I would like
very efficient staff, attentive and excellent food made for a nice evening.

My wife and came to J & G to celebrate my birthday. Having eaten here many times for business and pleasure it has always been our first choice for special times. The atmosphere is nice, the food and service are outstanding. Not much else needs to be said.
Great location service and mood. All around a fantastic night!

My wife and I went  for our anniversary.  One of the best meals we have ever had! I ordered the filet and she ordered the lobster.  They split it ato the table for us for a nice surf and turf. We sat on the balcony  and  had an amazing view of Scottsdale at sunset. Zack our server was phenomenal and the other staff right on par with him.

The service deserves more than five stars!
Already looking forward to the next dining experience!
for price food quality is extremely poor on international  comparison
Fantastic in all respects.

My husband and I have been coming to Phoenician to stay, play, and enjoy good food for many years.  Our first visit was to Mary Elaine's.  Always have a wonderful time.  Especially enjoy the Heirloom Tomatoes.  Always brings us back -- don't ever change them.
The restaurant was fairly noisy until some of the crowd thinned out.

Was very happy with my overall experience here, the food and ambiance are spectacular.  However, the quality of food, while definitely very good, was lower quality than other comparably priced restaurants that I eat at frequently

The food is amazing, first class. The service is excellent. The atmosphere and view are incredible. I really couldn't find a complaint.

We had the prime ribeye Oscar style (which I would highly recommend) and it was the nicest cut of meat I think I've ever had, and the crab and asparagus just took it to the next level. We had a nice bottle of Merlot with our meal. And shared a sticky toffee pudding for dessert, which was also amazing.

There service was attentive without being intrusive. It was really fantastic, the entire dining experience.

This was my second visit to J&G and it was not as memorable as our first dinner experience. The waiter was initially attentive, but seemed to get side-tracked as more guests filled his area. The heirloom tomato appetizer was so-so, the steaks too well done. The sides of asparagus and potatoes were probably the only favorable selection. Dresser was served to us as we were celebrating a birthday, and was very good.  

The price was around $125 per person, which included 2 glasses of Rose champagne and a glass of wine each, every item was ala carte.   I love the location on upper level of The Phoenician, and the view is scenic.

Would recommend if have not been there, however you do have a choice of several other steak houses in the area.
I've dined at this restaurant four times, & everytime the service and food have been excellent! The restaurant overlooks Scottsdale; so romantic!

As always J & G took exceptional care of us.
We've never been disappointed by the food or service, a true gem!

The food was OK, not grand as we expected from a facility like the Phoenician. Service was good, again not as first class as we expected. Of course, the view is spectacular! This is in no way comparable to Mary Elaine's that it replaced. The resort is known as a first class resort and they need to upgrade this restaurant to those standards.
The service was phenomenal which made our special occasion even more special
The food was outstanding.  My husband ordered a steak that was perfectly grilled.  I ordered salmon which was moist and flavorful.  The views are amazing!

Most enjoyable experience, from entry to departure.  Very knowledgeable staff clearly dedicated to delivering informed service at a level not previously encountered in Scottsdale.  Yes,  the food was excellent, the ambiance exceptional and the martini startlingly crisp and cold, but all taken to  the next level by the staff.. Well done.  Dave and Sue Haney, Tucson
Very beautiful view atop a gorgeous resort. Pricey, but the 40 three course special was a good deal
We dined onJuly 4th. Great service. Delicious food! Lovely views.

Delightful evening with great food, good view of the fireworks in Tempe. The service team was attentive, but not hovering. Had a great time!!

They have recently implemented paid parking in the park yourself area, which proved to be a hassle. Coming in, the machine was not dispensing tickets, the gate was up so we went ahead and parked. Leaving, we had a parking validation from the restaurant, but it wouldn't work without a ticket. Finally a maintenance crew member came by and used his card to get us out. Just a heads up on what used to always be free parking.
Strip steak was very good, not the best I've had but enjoyable.  Service was fantastic

We have been to this restaurant numerous times. We were sorely disappointed this trip for both with the lack of great service and recommendation for meals as well as what we ordered and how it arrived as well as the lack of value.
This is one of my favorite steakhouses in Arizona. The view is incredibly breathtaking. The food is delicious as expected. The service is spectacular. Oh, and the bread is a MUST.
The view is outstanding, and the food and service were spectacular! We would definitely eat here again!
From start to finish, everything was absolutely top notch.  Truly enjoyed the whole experience!
Always delicious! Great view. Awesome service.

I had requested for a window seating with a view for my husband's birthday and father's day celebration when I made the reservation online, but the hostess wanted to seat us further back away from the window so we ended up asking to sit outside just so we can get the view. The temperature got pretty hot outside and we had to wait for 2 hours for our food to arrive. Would never recommend this place to anyone, we've never had to wait this long just to get my meals.

J&G was exceptional! The food and the service couldn't have been better. The only complaint I have is to parents with small children and infants. While I realize that children need to eat too, please remove them from the dining room when they start screaming or crying. The rest of us folks that are trying to enjoy a nice dinner, don't appreciate screaming babies!

This is by-far, one of the best restaurants Ever.  Anywhere.  We visit AZ 3 times each year and no visit is complete until we eat at J&G. The tasting menu and wine pairing is a must-try.  Never disappoints. The flavors and culinary excellence is beyond. The only thing missing from the raw bar is crab. That would make it perfect. The tuna tartare is my favorite. Deliciius doesn't begin to describe.
I liked their service! All servers were very kind.

Husband and I had a very good meal on a mid-week evening. Casual ambience, more so than I expected at the Phoenician, and enough menu choices. My filet was good; even better was my husbands lamb. Potato and asparagus sides were excellent. Excellent dessert as well. I noted to the hostess that the room felt very cold and she offered me a pashmina shawl. i have not ever had that offered before, and it certainly helped my comfort that evening. The service staff was exceptional, wait staff very helpful and knowledgeable. I would definitely return to this restaurant.

Came here for AZ restaurant week with some friends.  The cocktails were good although I like my cosmo to be quite a bit more chilled.  The great view of the city made it a really fun venue.  Wonderful food.  The beef tenderloin was excellent; medium rare truly was medium rare.  Sadly, my husband got the swordfish and it seemed a bit dry and not as flavorful.  Rave reviews on the steamed shrimp salad.   Will be coming back to try the Wagyu beef as our mouths were watering as our waiter described it.  Service was wonderful and the venue added to a fun evening with great friends.

First time at this restaurant which we discovered as participating in restaurant week. The waiter was very snooty and didn't stop by our table after we ordered from the abridged restaurant week menu. Very few choices on the menu. The swordfish was not good at all and had no flavor. The tenderloin was delicious however. Very small portions along with poor service didn't add up to an enjoyable evening. I was disappointed because I chose the restaurant for a group of five.

J&G never fails to deliver great food and a lovely experience. Excellent staff, great food, great cocktails. Went to dinner with a friend. Requested and received a window seat for the spectacular view.
Fish dish had very little flavor and Porterhouse was good, not great.  You can sit at the bar tables and enjoy the view, the best part of the night.
A+ for food , service , and ambiance.
Nice dinning experience great location food was very good
Love going to this restaurant whenever we are in AZ.  Food is very good and service is excellent. Would recommend to all

The restaurant has the best atvantage of the view, the menu looks great, unfortunately, the  food was not up to par for the prices.....
The halibut entrée came just a piece of fried fish on the plate, the ahi Tatar was mushy - it should be chopped and still have some texture, veal porterhouse was ok. Every  dish was just plainly put on the plate, no presentation at all. 
We ordered two sides, the  sugar snap peas, but what came was actually the snow peas NOT sugar snap peas, the mushrooms were just a handful, both swimming in the oil, and not enough to share as  we were told.  
Made  us wondered if there was a real chef, or just some kids in the kitchen. 
This is a famous luxury hotel, shocking to have had such disappointing dinner.
This is at the high end of the scale but for special occasions this is the best place to go for food, wine and impeccable service.

Our server, Jeff was absolutely outstanding. Excellent service, friendly and knowledgable about the menu. The truffle cheese ball things were quite unique and very delicious. If you're debating about a side, look no further than the potatoes au gratin. The views are fun to look at as well. All in all an excellent dinner.
Fantastic restaurant for very fine dining. Perfect ambiance with an attentive wait staff. Very accommodating. Will definitely go back.
Our waitress was so kind!! Loved the food!! Had the best date! My daughter!! Will definately be back!!
Top notch place, like no other in Arizona

Amazing experience and food!  My friend had bison and raved about it. I had a filet that was expertly prepared. We shared an outstanding orange shrimp appetizer and warm chocolate cake. 
Jeff and John, our wait staff, were top notch. Beautiful resort and restaurant. Loved every minute and were so glad we just decided to head there last minute.
I have a severe allergy and they did a wonderful job of suggestions and great food.  They never made me feel like I was a bother to have at their table.  Excellent experience.
Bone in filet was amazing.

The food was totally unimpressive. Salmon was "slow cooked" and had very little taste. Baked potato was so salty it was not edible. French fries were cold. Waiter had no idea how to serve the wine, and since it was not inexpensive, he should have known how to serve it. And the temperature of the wine was way too cold!

What an amazing location !!  We were seated right by the window and able to look outside without anyone else in our view.  It was a beautiful night with the sunset in the background.  The food was more than incredible and they made our birthday celebration something to remember !!  Will definitely be back for a special occasion !!

Took a foodie client here for a steak dinner.  Although the location and setting are above par, the service and food quality were not on the caliber of other steakhouses, i.e. Bourbon or Capital Grille.

food was good, we stuck to steaks, waiter was surly and had a problem that I ordered an Absolut and Bombay Sapphire martini , really for these prices he should have kept his mouth closed(he didn't know what to charge for it)

Ambience is lovely and the view was superb, however check wind conditions in advance if you are hoping to sit outside before or after dinner

Myself and 4 co-workers went here for Administration Day, the food was very good  and our waiter was very knowledgeable with the menu.  2 of us had the filet that you could cut with a butter knife and the others had Dove fish which they loved.  Next time I am in Scottsdale I will definitely be going back!

First time in Scottsdale and read good things about this restaurant so made the reservation. The food was great and are server was wonderful. We had a table with a great view. Will visit this restaurant next time we are in town.

The food was not as described by the waitress.  The waitress was poor but supporting help for her was great.  The menu was not updated at the time and changes were made.  We had gone for a specific meal and it was not available.  The waitress said it was the hotels doing.  The view was pretty good but of the city scape versus the mountains.  The furniture was extremely outdated.  Over priced and under delivered.  Spend you money somewhere else.

We've native New Englanders, and 30-year Phoenix transplants - our seafood dinner @ J&G was  simply spectacular, and our experience was equally flawless. I've traveled extensively for the past 30 years,and have been fortunate enough to have a vast frame of reference in this summary - the staff was accommodating to every detail, and David was the best wait-staff I can recall. 

Best fresh clams and oysters on the half-shell, my wife could not stop raving about the lobster dinner, and my filet of sole was just perfect.

The lounge is a perfect place to grab fresh raw bar and a few glasses of vino over the summer.

We'll be back!
The service was very good. Attention to details. The food was good but not served hot like the steak.

J&G Steakhouse is one of our go to places for special occasions or to entertain out-of-town visitors.  We have always felt that the steaks are the best in town and the overall ambiance is unmatched.  This time, while the food was still very good, I must say that it wasn't quite as exceptional as we remember in the past.  First of all, we ordered one bone-in ribeye to share and  while it was nice of our waiter to split the steak for us, unfortunately by the time he did so and served it, it was not piping hot.  Furthermore, the quality of the meat was not up to the standards of the past.  Again, it might still be the best steak around, but I would be remiss if I didn't report just a modicum of disappointment on our part.  We'll certainly be back and will be updating our assessment soon enough and hopefully the quality will be back to the exceptional level that we remember next time.

We are from the New York metro area and were surprised that on a Saturday night, some of the guests were wearing shorts and little more than beach wear.   The dining room was rather loud, especially with the amplified guitarist in the bar, who apparently thought he was giving a concert rather than music to accompany dinner.  In addition, there is no linen on the tables.  The food was well prepared and the service was excellent.

Best Dover Sole (real Dover Sole!) in the Valley.   Spectacular view.   Very professional staff.  Lovely location.     The food is the real draw.    Have never had a poor meal yet after several years of visiting J&G.   Highly recommended.
The $130.00 steak was rare and it had no flavor.  We ordered it medium rare and it was rare.  Never again will I ever order a Wagu steak or beef.  It was awful!

Beautiful setting and exquisite interior.   Appetizers of tuna tartare, Beet salad were good. Porterhouse steak was prepared to our liking and was very delicious.  Three sauces provided were a nice addition. Shared sides of mushrooms & potato gratin were very good. Service was helpful and unobtrusive. Full wine list. Elegant dining!

This was a great place to celebrate a birthday! We had drinks before dinner in the bar area and enjoyed the music. Wonderful atmosphere with a sunset view. My husband loved the ribeye. Cooked to perfection. My halibut with a mint and spicy pepper sauce with mushrooms was incredible. We especially loved the lava cake and caramel ice cream. The best service. Can't wait to go back again!
J & G has amazing atmosphere.  The service was wonderful and the food delicious.  We recommend a 6:00 reservation to watch the beautiful sunset.

Our server was chatting with everyone so we ended up waiting for our steak for 40 minutes and it came out cold. The server didn't even apologize. They took it back and warmed it up, but is that what you pay $52 for?

A wow experience from start to finish. The resort is absolutely gorgeous and this sets the tone. Employees are extremely courteous and attentive no matter their role. The GM even offered to hang my boyfriends suit jacket instead of it laying on the chair. We started with the calamari and it was the best we had both ever had. We shared the porterhouse and it was perfection. They come out and carve it off the bone for you which was a great touch. Their sauces are great as well with the steak. They have a beautiful balcony you can have drinks on and take in the views which are great at night and day. Validated valet parking is a great touch as well. Will definitely be back!!
The food waitress and overall experience was wonderful !

I hosted a birthday dinner for my wife which included our son and his girlfriend.  We had a moderate ($75) of wine with our meal, plus some apps and sides.  Total was over $400!  Most of the wines are overpriced as are the steaks.  My NY strip steak was good, but not as tender as it could have been.  Beautiful restaurant, fabulous views of the valley.
Fantastic place for a great steak dinner and an amazing sunset view.

Perfect restraunt but they took forever with our food. & the restraunt wasn't busy. No refills were made on time either.  Server brought out spoons said dessert was on the house never brought the dessert out. Poor service but still was tipped.
Last minute Valentines dinner in the bar.   For a very busy night service and steaks were surprisingly good.
I couldn't take my eyes off the all glass window in the back of the restaurant. Amazing view and awesome food!!! Definitely coming here again :)

Everything was wonderful. The only down-side is that the menu is A-la-Carte and super pricey (steak alone $62 - no side item). Although they have food for kids, unless you're celebrating something major, keep the kids at home as the setting and the prices are not for kids -more for the adults.
We get to J & G once or twice a year, to celebrate a special occasion. We really enjoy the food and service. Always great!

Great scenery/ambience and loved the food! Unfortunately paid a lot (which I fully expected to) to end up with fairly mediocre service... Server was SLOW and forgot almost every request and had to be reminded... Overall loved celebrating my wife's birthday and Valentine's Day there, but could have done with a different server...

Great outdoor dining view of the valley! The prime rib was unforgettable especially with the steak sauces offered. Service was very good and knowledgeable of menu items. Made you feel very welcomed and relaxed. Strongly recommend.

I expected this to be a high-end steakhouse on par with Del Friscos or Donovans.  Unfortunately, it does not perform.  While the food was ok, it was not fine dining.  The heirloom salad should not be refrigerated as the tomatoes lose their taste.  The filet was good, but not melt in your mouth like really great steakhouses.

While should not be an issue for me, value is.  When you charge prices commensurate with a fine steakhouse, you set expectations.  This place does not live up to its prices.  $150 for a bottle of wine that sells in the stores for an average price of $48 sets expectations.  $10 for a baked potato and $48 for an ala carte filet better be worth it.  It wasn't.

The service, again, was just ok.  You get the feeling that the waitress worked at an Outback Steakhouse at her last job.  My wife chose to keep her salad to eat with her dinner but no less than six times did one of the staff come to take it away.  You could call that attentive staff or you could call it lack of communication.  

There are lots of steakhouses in Phoenix so there is no need for me to come back.  I'd put the food at this one on par with Flemings and the service down with Outback.  Value is below both.

My son and I visited J&G Steakhouse on Saturday evening.  We were promptly seated outside overlooking the empty pool area  and enjoyed the incredible views of Phoenix/Scottsdale and an outstanding sunset.

We enjoyed the soups (squash & french onion), shared their fantastic risotto as a middle course,  then enjoyed absolutely tasty 12 oz bone in filets.  Desert and drinks followed - amazing dinner.

The service was excellent and we were not hurried at all; the staff achieved the right balance of attentiveness leaving us alone.  The wine list is extensive, by the glass, half bottle, or varietals from all over the world.

If you're in Phoenix and the weather permits, dine outside for a fantastic experience.
Good Food and Service buy WAY overpriced for what you get.

This is a fine steakhouse operating at a level similar to that of the prestige franchises found in most major US cities.  With that perspective, it is neither more nor less of the experience that is obtainable in many other locations.  The Phoenician hotel in which the restaurant resides is correctly considered a "destination", worthy of a long trip; in my view, the same cannot be said for J&G.  It's perfect for hotel guests who want this kind of predictable meal, but less so for those with more adventure in mind.

Had reservations...when they called to confirm I requested a quiet table or booth.  The young woman was so pleasant and When  we arrived she bent over to offer us the perfect seating.  It continued from there.  Service was greAt...my out of town guests were thrilled and impressed.  The Dover Sole was one choice and perfect.  Another choice was the tasting menu, which was also a hit.  We sat outside and the ambiance was perfect.
We eat here fairly often and always enjoy the food and the ambiance, service is always impeccable! Will be back again and again.

The food was mediocre at best. Very bland salmon dish with over cooked Brussels on the side. My GF ordered her filet medium rare which came out medium well. Took us 10 minutes to flag down our server who promptly replaced the steak with another that was also over cooked.   Meanwhile my salmon got cold as I waited for her entree to arrive. Didn't bother to get dessert as we were just disappointed with the experience. Ambience was cool - live guitarist that played very well although we did hear a rendition of Stairway to Heaven. Nevertheless, I wouldn't recommend J&G.

The view is superb
The service is incredible , very attentive 
The bread was amazing
The salad , appetizers and dessert were amazing.

Unfortunately , my wife's salmon was lacking in flavour and was return to the kitchen.

My rib steak was very average.  Nothing exceptional , and out of place at such a nice restaurant and at a $60+ price.
Not our first visit and the food is consistently very good

Our seating time was 9:30, dinner was served at 11:30.  Granted it was NYE and we expected them to be busy, so we remained flexible enjoying our friends and the occasion.  Steaks were ordered "medium" (NY strips & Filets) and were plated seared outside and rare on the inside.  We had to send them back twice to be cooked properly.  While we waited for the main dinner features, the servers decided to plate the sides (baked potatoes, veggies, etc.) and we ended up eating those with nothing else simply because we were starving at that time (11:45pm).  Upon the delivery of the 3rd plate (sent back twice to finish cooking), we had to get the manager (Alexandria) involved.  All four of us had issues with steaks being undercooked and the meal served out of sequence left us experiencing a much less than desirable meal.  Granted, they were busy and our server was actually doing a great job in spite of the kitchen mistakes.  He kept his composure and remained professional the whole evening.  After expressing our dissatisfaction with the management, we were pleased that the entire meal was comped.  We didn't ask for that, but were obviously satisfied with the outcome.  

I am disappointed the experience wasn't better.  The Phoenician is a beautiful property and this was our first overnight stay there with dinner and all the amenities.  But the J&G Steakhouse really missed with our meal and took the whole experience to a record low in our book.  Especially for the price (which we were willing and prepared to pay), the quality of food and overall experience didn't match the value on the menu.  Like I said our server was great and we left him a generous tip for all of his hard work to help redeem our experience.  Thankful the meal was covered overall by the management, but probably won't be back there.  We've had spectacular meals at other area restaurants in Phoenix such as: Ruth's Chris, Mortons, Flemmings and The Keg.  We'll most likely go to one of these places next time.
Very good food!   Lamb chops and tuna tartare were delicious.  Mac and cheese, French fries and baked potato great as well     Overall a very good meal

Everything at this restaurant was wonderful!  The wait staff, the atmosphere, the view, the meal was one of the best we have ever had.  We have already mentioned to our friends and family to go when they get the chance!  Thank you for a wonderful Christmas Eve dinner!!

We had a very pleasant evening, enchanced by the great service and knowledge about menu.  Especially enjoyed tuna tatar.  Actually liked this restaurant so much that we went there the next day and were not disappointed.
We had a fantastic experience! Not too rushed and the views at sunset are fantastic.

The food was overpriced, the restaurant was playing club music which was totally innapropriate for this type of dinning. The food came out cold and had to be served again, the service was slow and overall I would never visit the establishment again.
The food took longer than expected, but the atmosphere, food, and service made up for it.
We would not recommend this restaurant?  The service was extremely slow and very unattendive. The food was average.  The ambiance was excellent.

Return often for the extraordinary salt/pepper baked potato and will return again and again for the appetizing appetizers and their steak filet.  The servers are professional and attentive.  With the fabulous view and all my dining-out needs met, I recommend J & G Steakhouse to all with a generous pocketbook.  At J & G you get the gracious dining that you pay for.
The music and volume are not appropriate for a 4 star restaurant but rather for a sports bar. Conversation in a normal volume was difficult. Service is excellent and the food attractively presented.
Food was fantastic.  Loved thanksgiving menu and dover sole was awesome. Would definitely  go again.
This is our go-to restaurant for special occasions, especially Thanksgiving and Christmas.  Anyone I want to impress with the beauty of our city while dining on exceptional food, I take here.
Greet place for dinner meeting with business associates and great location

We sat outdoors, seems they weren't overly prepared or staffed for that even though crowded outside.  waiter was covering too many tables, bussing non existent including continually having to ask for water, many salt shakers empty, heaters propane tanks empty, etc.  only served one drink entire dinner and we would have gladly had 3 if asked.  Also steak ordered medium showed up very well done.  received replacement steak and manager came over etc but surprisingly no accommodation for this like a drink, a dessert, a side, or a comping the steak.  will go back as nice ambience but for sure will sit inside...
We had a impeccable dinner. The food and service were unequal.
Excellent food, the basic but with a new twist. Very enjoyable.

This was our third visit to J&G Steakhouse at the Phoenician. Our previous visits were quite good, but this time was less so. The appetizers were excellent but the fish, particularly the mahi-mahi, was overcooked and too firm. The salmon was good but I suspect both fish suffered from having been previously frozen. The view of the Phoenix valley at night was quite enjoyable and relaxing.
We were a group of ten.  The ambiance is great, the food is awesome, the service is professional and everything worked out perfectly.  Everyone from our party enjoyed their time.

Although the food and waitstaff were great the hostess and manager blew it, big time, almost ruining our evening.  They were not accommodating at all and did nothing to compensate for their bad service. We had a reservation, we're seated 15 minutes after the reservation and our request for a terrace table were ignored. Instead we were seated in the back of the restaurant next to a very loud event .  The worst of it all is that there were plenty of empty tables throughout the entire restaurant. Even on the terrace.  No one from the front even attempted to speak to us or apologize.  There's  no excuse for this.  We will not return nor recommend it to friends.

We expected more from a "high end" steakhouse. While the food was tasty, it was routine and no effort seemed to be made to bring the level up to the outstanding meal we expected. Having said that, the service was very good. There was a table of 10 people who were very, very noisy and our request to be moved was quickly and pleasantly complied with.
We had french onion soup and petite filet mignon and the food was ok--really nothing special. Thus, overall we were disappointed because we were expecting something special at what we had been led to believe was an outstanding steakhouse. J&G can do much better than this standard fare.
Beautiful decor and views of the sunset. Exemplary service and delicious food. Thoroughly enjoyed my bison ribeye!

Really solid experience with only a couple shortfalls.  My review always pay more (too much?) attention to the "opportunities".  Positives - perfect martini, made exactly as I requested and as good as I make at home (although I freeze my glass at home).  Service, ambiance, tempo, all top notch.  Water glasses always refilled, servers always available, knowledgeable, and helpful.  Split courses - salad, entree handled perfectly.  Negatives - the steak was cooked perfectly, and served/shared expertly, but just needed a little more seasoning.  The sauces made up for it, although the hot buttery sauce seems more suited to lobster/crab/shrimp.  Maybe J&G underseasons steaks because of their extensive sauce selection?  Speaking of the name, J&G, confuses me - Jean & Georges?  Also, we were let down by the sides - squash gratin (boring) and brussel sprouts (way undercooked and pecans were not glazed/candied as per menu).  We've been to two other JGV restaurants, Jean Georges in NYC and Prime in Vegas.  This JGV restaurant seems more geared to addressing it's competition (BTL Steak at Camelback Inn - we went there too).  Go to BTL Steak for happy hour/outdoor (the sides shine at BTL Steak) and make J&G your second choice for a steakhouse (but make it your first in Vegas - Prime was amazing).
Went for our 25th wedding anniversary on a sunday evening. Dined on the patio, very nice view at sunset, very friendly staff and the food and wine were excellent.

Great Food- Low lighting romantic atmosphere. Great Bar with dinning tables away from main dinning room if you are looking for a separate bar atmosphere. Great view from dinning room. Bar area was very attentive and service was wonderful. Only issue I had was the lack of pour in my wine. Is less then an inch acceptable.... :)

The food was ok but you expect more from a Jean George restaurant. The service was horible. Water never getting refilled, 10 minutes before someone said hello, and food took forever from the kitchen. Not sure what's going on but definitley not worth the trip

While searching for a romantic restaurant to celebrate our 7 year wedding anniversary J&G showed up on many of my searches so we decided to try it out. I wish I knew before hand that they have an amazing view and you could eat outside on the balcony but it was still nice being able to look at the view from the inside. Our waiter was great and kept on top of things. We both got steaks and a side dish each plus they brought over black truffle cheese fritters at the beginning which were delicious! At the end of the dinner we were served a molten chocolate cake and ice cream and a cookie that said Happy Anniversary on it. Everything was delicious and well worth the money when celebrating a special occasion.
The acoustics in the bar area and restaurant seem to magnify loud people noise. Our waiter was friendly and helpful.
We had a nice spot overlooking the city. Food was fantastic! Ordered the tasting menu. Loved it all, especially the tartar.
Great location and view. Average food for a hotel. Wait staff was awesome but a little slow out of the kitchen.
Consistantly exceed expectations. The fois gras was amazing.  As were the steak and halibut.

The food and the drinks were amazing. I've wanted to try this place for a while, I'm glad I decided to go. I took my parents for their 40th wedding anniversary. The only annoying thing was, that they were going to charge me a $10 cake cutting fee if I wanted to bring a cake from somewhere else. Being a special occasion, I wanted to present my parents with something special, not a plain dessert from a restaurant. The manager said he wanted to sell me dessert, but it was complimentary anyway. It was a kind gesture, but a cake would have been nicer for the occasion. Overall, great experience and I would definitely go back. Best salmon I've had out. I can't complain about a single dish served.
We go to J&G regularly and though the food is always excellent the service varies.  That being said I still think it's one of the best restaurants in town and the green apple cobbler is to die for!!

This is a high end restaurant and as such had high expectations.  We started off with great service but as the night wore on, the service got slower and sloppier.  I understand that our server had a large group to attend to but we felt that we should have been just as much a priority as the larger group but our food was delayed exponentially due to the large group. we were told.  Asked for the check which took a long time, which by then, my party was ready to just walk out.  On a positive note, the food was just as excellent as in the past.  No complaints there.  We will be back but just wanted to air my dissatisfaction since we have never had bad service in the past.

Crab cake was not tasty at all

Restaurant was loud.  Requested a 6:00 reservation and were told they were completely booked yet when we left after our 5:15 reservation the restaurant was less than 1/2 full

First time to Scottsdale & as a guest at the Phoenician we spent our first evening with a relaxing dinner with a great view. Loved the menu option for a Restaurant week our meal was cooked to perfection & our server was very friendly & attentive.

We have had better service in the past.  The waiter was slow, not really attentive, the food came out wrong and when it came out was not hot or cooked correctly.  I think this will be my last visit and we have been going here for years!
Went here for restaurant week with my girlfriends. It is a must for restaurant week. Delicious food, excellent service b

The views are great. The Dover Sole was superb, the Veal Chop was very tough!!
A group of 12 very noisy people was put behind us. That kind of a group should be in a separate room.

Food was good...that's consistent .  If you have 10 young, loud men, wearing shorts and some with baseball caps....maybe don't put them in the middle of the dining room.  The more they drank the louder they got.  We were dressed and expecting a lovely "dining" experience.  Instead of a waiter we had an order taker.  It was his feeling it was hard to find a nice bottle of wine at the $70 price point.
The manager saved the day.  He was efficient, smart and very helpful.  I realize this is summer and things are slower, but....this was an expensive meal and not a "dining experience".

We were seated at the loveliest table in the restaurant.  That was short lived by the family seated next to us with toddlers & babies. There were plenty of other tables where they could have been seated well out of the way of solitary adult dinners out for a nice evening. Our waiter started out great but then failed to fill our glasses with our $190.00 bottle of wine The appetizers were fair. The main course was brought before we could put down our forks. Our requests were simple but not fulfilled.   wanted a simply grilled steak, specifically requested no peppercorn crust as was advertised. The plating was the worst I've ever seen. Someone merely threw a piece of meat on a plate. This is not what I expected from this type of restaurant.  My steak was supposed to be medium.  There was no pink, no juices & was as dry as could be.  The staff offered to put another on, but my husband was already eating his steak meaning we weren't dining together.   And if he had waited for my steak to arrive his hockey puck of a fillet would have been ice cold.  They offered to take it off the check & did.  However, we were too embarrassed to also bring to their attention that my husband's filet was well done when he ordered it medium well.  It was a huge hunk of grey meat. The mashed potatoes were drowning in salt.  My husband has served as a sous chef & is not a stranger to the culinary arts.  We are the nicest couple to have as customers.  And through all of this our composure & friendliness never changed.  What was supposed to have been a nice birthday celebration turned into the most disappointing experience ever.  We were staying at the Phoenician for the first time & were excited to visit the J & G's.  Should we return, we will be heading out for Mastro's City Hall where we've had several wonderful meals.   I understand it was off season but that was no excuse for the horrible food.  If you need to hire short orders cooks for the summer, at least charge short order prices.
The Tomahawk steak was delicious. We did not enjoy the screaming baby through our entire meal.

Food, ambiance, view and service, all were great. This is our 4th time returning to this place and each time we feel we want to come back again. It is a pricey but well worth it and I like the fact that they have reasonably priced course menu during summer if you don't want to splurge. Service is efficient but not pretentious or too much. Love this place.

Great dining experience while overlooking Phoenix at night. Ordered from the Sunset menu, 3 courses for $40.  Our table tried all three entrees and everyone was happy. The flat iron steak was prepared perfectly with a beautiful presentation. They have àn extensive wine list. Service is outstanding. Phoenician is a beautiful hotel and J & G is a good choice for a special occasion dinner. Get the watermelon salad, delicious.
My hubby brought me here for my birthday.  Service was outstanding even going the extra mile to find me a "glass" of my preferred wine.  Everything was fabulous!

This was our second time to J&G in recent months and the experience continues to be highly enjoyable. The service is impeccable, the food fantastic, and the overall experience up there with the finest restaurants in the country. While this could easily be a "special occasion" restaurant, it works equally well for couples or families just wanting a good meal. The wine list is impressively deep and we also enjoyed a hand-crafted cocktail to begin with. Overall a memorable experience. Will be back soon!

This is a great location with pretty views of the Valley and mountains. The service was excellent and all the food was fantastic, except the steak. Especially for the price, the steak was moderate. It was good but not at the level of the appetizer, soup, side dishes or desert. We said we'd go back again and order anything but steak. The server was knowledgeable, helpful and friendly.
I wasn't impress with the steak, sides or appetizer.  Drinks were excellent and the view is like no other.  Beautiful view and restaurant.

The view is amazing of mountains. Very beautiful. Food was great. Service was a tad on the slower side but it was ok. It was a surprisingly loud restaurant. Feel bad for the Phoenician cause it seems to have fallen out of the good graces of the Scottsdale and Phoenix crowd.

After be seated at a two top table adjacent a large table 12+ that was extremely noisy we were reseated to a much better table and were able to hear one another talk. The hostess and manager were very accommaditive of our problem. The waiters were very knowledgeable of the menu and explained the menu very well. Service was very attentive. God was well prepared and excellent. The restaurant provided a complementary desert for our anniversary. Will definitely return for future occasions.
Have had good dinner experiences here before however this wasn't one of them. The food was very good but our server seemed to be pre-occupied somewhere else.
You can't find better than J&G in Arizona, from the food to the service and the scenery.
Once again the food was outstanding, atmosphere was delightful and the overall experience was great.  Our waiter could have been a little more attentive but not a major issue.

It is a very nice steak house with a couple special touches that allow it to really stand out.  First, is the scenery and the fact it is in the Phoenician resort.  Wonderful vies are worth a visit alone.  Second, is that the food is not run of the mill steakhouse, but a little special.  For example, the mushroom side - which you will find at every steakhouse - is comprised not of plain button mushroom, but an assortment of unique and interesting mushrooms.  The steaks come with a sampling of 4 or 5 sauces.  We found the black pepper sauce to special.  Overall, excellent food in a jaw dropping atmosphere.

We went for the Summer menu and unlike many other summer specials to get year round residents to dine in, the menu selection was excellent, and the portions good sized. Three appetizer choices started the menu, with 3 main courses ( a fish, a chicken, and a meat), and a good dessert selection. I have a gluten allergy, and the staff and kitchen were accommodating to my needs. My steak was perfectly cooked. To top it off, before 7 PM, all wines under $99 were 1/2 price. The wine list was extensive, giving us many options. Highly recommend. We will go back another time or two.
Birthday dinner for my wife.  Her comment sums it up, "This may be in contention for the best dinner that I've ever had!"

Food, ambiance, and the wine selection is great.  Unfortunately, our waiter was not good.  He basically neglected us all night.  This place has the potential to be a gem, but management definitely needs to monitor the customer service of the wait staff.  Our bill was $180 and I would have gladly paid over $300 if he would have even asked if we wanted a glass of wine, cocktail, etc.  He didn't even offer dessert!

Our waiter Christian was amazing!!! Very attentive and he didn't rush our decision making. Made our 1 year anniversary remarkable especially with the beautiful sitting in front of a break taking view of the city. Being from Florida the tuna tartare was by far amazing and fresh. In the words of one the waiter there who delivered our oysters which was also very very fresh "This is not an IHOP" lol. Will definitely be visiting again. Thank you all.

A beautiful restaurant and wonderful views.  We had a reservation but no one seemed to care.  Many fine (expensive) restaurants greet us by name, wish us a happy anniversary when we arrive and seat us with care.  The first table we were shown to did not have a view of the windows, even tho I had specifically asked for a window table.  

The service was adequate, NOT EXCEPTIONAL.  There were no GLUTEN FREE BREADS OR CRACKERS.  I think in  a restaurant serving $60 steaks, it should not be such a stretch for them to figure out some way to accommodate the special dietary needs of their customers. A loaf of frozen Udi brand bread,  toasted and served with the rolls to other guests would have been wonderful.  (Deseo even bakes gluten free rolls for all their guests) Instead I was made to feel like a problem child for even asking. The waiter was only able to suggest one appetizer (sliced tomatoes) to me even tho when asked, he acknowledged that quite a few could be made gluten and onion free for me. 

When the server brought the entrees, the steak sauces (for my $60 steak) were not gluten free and she placed the side dishes and sauces on the wrong side of the table and not even within reach of the guests.  She reached across the table to serve my steak even though there was no problem getting around the table.  When I asked her to serve my side dish to me she just slid it a little bit closer to me but it was still not within reach.  I asked about the sauces and she was surprised that I had a problem.  "Just don't use them if you aren't sure"  

The reservation said it was an anniversary celebration and we saw others getting a special treat for dessert but none came to us.  When I asked, the waiter offered to comp our coffees and my fruit salad.  That was a nice gesture but we didn't feel well cared for.  

I'm not so sure we will return.  Dinner was good, not GREAT, the service was OK, not great, and I felt I was a burden, not a welcome guest with a special need.

Overall we were not excited about  our dining experience at J&G Steakhouse.
We chose to dine on the patio, first mistake.  The lighting was so poor we could not read our menu.  We had to ask for more candles on the table and read with the lighting from a cell phone.  When we asked about the lighting issue, the hostess suggested lighting the fire pit next to us!  In 90+ conditions, we thought that was a bit rude.  Our waiter was not much better.  Very in-attentive and seemed distracted as he was waiting on a very large party at the same time.   Our steaks were delicious, they stood on their own.  Would not return to this restaurant.

Each dining experience is impeccable from the minute we step off the elevator.  The food and service is always top notch.  They have an extensive wine menu the sommelier was very helpful and we ended up with a great wine choice that is now one of our favorites.
For Scottsdale it is a winner! The food was very good and the view is always majestic.

Although the steak was great & the wine list plentiful the salad was below average. For the prices they charge here they should not be serving artificial bacon bits or microwaved food. Our dessert was a total disappointment......
We enjoyed the Sunset Menu along with a beautiful view and great service! As a added bonus they had live background music that was entertaining and enjoyable!

The tasting menu never disappoints.  The raw bar is scrumptuous.  Bottles of wine at 1/2 price in summer is a great bonus.  By far one of our favorite places to dine.  The Phoenician is beautiful and whenever in AZ, this is a must-go place.

Great view of Scottsdale from the outdoor covered terrace! The restaurant is one of your top end steakhouses with a typical steakhouse menu, but all of the food was very good. Service was professional and spot on! Very good wine list as well! Would definitely return!
delicious food - great service - nice ambiance - and a great view over the valley....
One of the best steakhouse experiences I have had in a while.

Enjoyed a very nice dinner at J&G Steakhouse during 2015 Restaurant Week.  Service was top notch from the very pleasant hostess to the professional servers and staff.  Food was prepared as requested and served straight to the table from the kitchen.  We definitely plan a return visit.
We appreciated the great food and excellent service.

This restaurant is special because of the wonderful views and the great seafood and steak.  I would recommend that everyone starts with the seafood tower appetizer.  It has mussels, shrimp, lobster, oysters and clams and it is so fresh and fun to share.  The steaks are great and they even offer a kids meal with many options if you are dining with kids.  Be prepared to share a couple of sides since the steaks are all a la carte.  I think the atmosphere is fun but very loud and the service is decent but nothing I was really impressed with overall.  I would only go here for special occasions but I love the Phoenician and think this restaurant fits nicely within the hotel offerings.
Wonderful service, great view, excellent menu.  Perfect for a special evening.

I ordered my steak medium rare and it came out over well done, I mean cooked grey all the way through. App 10 minutes after the food was brought the hostess stopped by and asked if everything was ok, I pointed out my uneaten steak was WAY over done and she immediately offered to have a new one prepared which was the correct thing to do but since I was dining with other people and they would have been long finished with their meals before the new steak arrived I declined the offer. Kitchen mistakes happen, everything else was excellent, they removed the steak from the bill and all was well. Overall it was a very good meal and the view is excellent. $250 for 3 people including 6 drinks and tip, very good deal.

Definitely an experience like no other. The staff was well educated in regards to the menu,  food was made with pride. We sat on the patio and had an amazing view of the pool area and night lights off in the distance. Would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a special night out.

The scenic view is amazing. Great place for a romantic dinner. If you tell them it is your birthday or anniversary celebration don't expect your waiter or waitress to remember until you have paid the bill that is was special celebration. Kind of disappointed.

Really enjoyed bringing my friends from out of town.   Great food, scenery and service.  Our waiter was exceptionally professional.  Jeff was terrific, made us feel welcome, attended to and entertain.  He is a keeper!  I will be back!

My husband loved his steak and loved being able to NOT have potatoes.  I not being a "meat
person" was thrilled with my choices in seafood and it was prepared to perfection.  There were
several large groups being attended to during our dining experience but it did not affect the
quality of our service or atmosphere; they handle it all extremely well.  A definite keeper for a
light meal as well as steak.

We dined at sunset and our table was outside on the patio.  Very romantic.  Tables were spaced nicely in that conversations were not overheard.  Service is very attentive.  Food was delicious.  The only disappointment was my dessert.  Bananas Foster prepared table side.  Final presentation was poor, didn't taste good at all.  However, this did not ruin my evening as the rest was all good.

From the service to the drinks to the food, J&G always delivers. Every bite was marvelous and the cocktails and wine were perfect. We enjoyed a lovely evening with the best steak in town. We will continue to go back again and again for this great experience.

As the sun sets over Phoenix the view is hard to beat looking directly at the Papago Buttes. The staff was exceptionally flexible. I got the exact table I requested until my guest changed her mind and wanted to sit outside which was immediately without question accommodated. The food was  very good and tasty. The Baked Alaskan was to die for. Give it a try even if you only go once go.

A memorable evening.  As requested, was given a table where we could enjoy the sunset and expansive view.  The food was fantastic.  Wine list was as good as you'll find featuring wines not often available at any restaurant in a variety of price ranges.  Refreshing to see many quality wines by the glass as well.  Service was excellent.  The waiter promptly handled excessive noise coming from the pool area which could have spoiled the dining experience.  Celebrated a retirement and last night in Scottsdale in style.

Celebrating many special moments through the years at J&G Steakhouse, it is always something we look forward to when we get to go back.  My mom was in town and we wanted to take her somewhere special for drinks the night before she left to go back home.  I had made reservations at a different place and decided to cancel them and go with J&G instead.  I wanted a special request for my mom and I felt like J&G would accommodate this and that I could trust that it would be done.  I wrote a note in the memo stating that I wanted to preorder a specific dessert and have a message written either on the plate, or a note for my mom.  We sat outside and as usual the food was amazing, the service was not the greatest.  Our server was good in the beginning and then became very neglectful when a couple came onto the patio as well.  He walked by us many times when we were doing nothing and wouldn't ask us if we were okay or wanted anything else.  My husband told him that we were ready for dessert thinking that he had seen the memo and instead he brought the dessert menu out.  My husband had to tell him in front of my mom that there was a "special note" where we preordered dessert and it ruined the surprise.  When the dessert came out, I was very disappointed to see no writing on the plate, and no note.  I cancelled at the previous place because I didn't trust that they would do this special thing for my mom and I was disappointed that it wasn't not only ignored but ruined the surprise by having us have to tell.  I should also mention that we spoke to J&G the day of our reservation and they indeed saw the memo and they would handle everything as requested.  Love the food, love the Phoenician, and after celebrating our wedding anniversary's there and other special memories, I was hoping this would be one as well.

Everything you would want in first class resturants. Problem with how patrons were seated ruined a great romantic dinner for two. We were seated in area that had 3 other couples enjoying a great meal when a four top with 4 four loud men were seated in the middle of area. Followed by a couple with two children playng video games on iPad. Sadly don't bother dressing up for the evening, apparently hiking shorts and a workout top are acceptable attire. Two classy of resturants to be spoiled by lack of dress code and poor management of seating.

This restaurant has it all.  It is one of the top places to dine in the valley.  The last time we were there our waiter went out of his way to please us.  An extra serving of modified mushroom risotto for the guest who did not like one type of mushroom.  We ordered a baked Alaska for desert. The waiter also brought a lava cake on the house because he felt the first desert was not adequate for our group. This is class act!
Amazing food and ambiance!  Made me feel special on my birthday.

We arrived at 6 PM on a Sunday evening.  The restaurant was not busy.  The service was very slow and notwithstanding that there were only four of us in the group, we waited impatiently to order and between courses, and finally were able to exit at 9:15 PM.  Most disappointing was the food.  It ranged from fair to poor.  None of us thought it was good enough to come back for; the fish was good but not great, the steaks were tough and over-cooked (really, the worst we have had in a restaurant in a long while) and one person had French fries which would certainly not have made the cut, even at McDonalds.  Overall a very poor experience, especially in Phoenix which has a huge number of excellent restaurant choices.
The supporting waiter staff was excellent.  The main waiter had an attitude and forgot our wine order refill that was on a nearby cart.

J&G was a great place to celebrate a birthday. Our waitress was very professional, providing suggestions without being overbearing. As we found throughout the Phoenician (a wonderful hotel), they like their heirloom tomatoes, and the salad with Russian dressing is very fine. It's also plenty to share. The Dover sole is expensive, but the fish was so fresh and perfectly prepared. It's also nicely presented at tableside. The grouper was a little disappointing. It was somewhat dry, and I did not find the accompanying peanut and chili sauce particularly compatible with the fish.
The server knew there was a birthday, and they provided a delicious, attractively presented molten chocolate cake, complete with a candle (one is enough!) to finish our meal.

Outstanding, knowledgeable service, amazing wine list and a diverse but unified menu. The roasted lobster was the most perfectly prepared lobster I've ever had--Risotto appetizer was just the right portion size. My husband had the filet, which was accompanied by a number of interesting sauces to experiment with. Our waiter made a lovely presentation of our wine service and even offered to save the bottle label for us.  Guests next to us shared the special bone in bison steak which truly had a 12-in bone in it. Table side split service was fun to watch all evening as many guests chose this option.
Really enjoyed the tasting menu with wine pairings.
This was for a special occasion and it met all of our expectations and more. I would highly recommend this restaurant.
We had an amazing dinner here for our 10th anniversary. Tee food was excellent and our waiter Jeff was amazing. Than you for making this a very special occasion for us!

Had to ask someone to serve us at the bar.  The bartender was slow and not very interested in the customers.  Dinner was poor and the waiter was borderline rude.  When I finally paid the bill, I was not provided a receipt, with no explanation.  When I asked for a receipt, the waiter acted like he couldn't be bothered.  This restaurant has great views of Phoenix, but poor service and the steaks were over cooked! Very disappointing!

disaster from the start we waited until after the Superbowl to make a reservation.. it took 20 mins for the waiter to ask about water and 20 mins to remind him we never got water- Table next to us was there for 2 hours and hadn't gotten entrees! Manager went to their table to explain they got a new sou chef things were slow...our waiter offered no explanation when he finally took our food order since we ordered a salad and ceviche didn't think much cooking was involved and it still took over 2 hours for our meal!! Finally the manager came over said these things happen shrugged his shoulders and handed me a business card???? No apology no come back invite,no voucher for a free appetizer or anything!!My daughter was visiting from New York she chose this restaurant Unbelievable they took nothing off the bill but did refill my glass of wine for a restaurant with high prices in a 5 star hotel they should be ashamed!!
Great atmosphere, very hip, really good food.  Went for our anniversary and it was the perfect decision.
Enjoyed the selection of menu options, the great view, beautiful property, and left w/ amazing memories and a full stomach
This place was amazing and.delicious, and i cant wait to go back
The food was disappointing from beginning to end. The management was classy and handled the situation well. Stick with he simple fare like the hamburger and you may do well.l

My husband and I celebrated our anniversary at J & G steakhouse. We had dinner on the patio. The view was fantastic, the food was amazing and the service was wonderful. It was a beautiful night to remember. Thank you for the lovely memories.

I was very impressed, all the way around.... Service was excellent; my filet was THE best I've ever had in Arizona, my friend's salmon was fantastic (from him) and I loved the surroundings.... I recommend HIGHLY!

We stayed on the property for three nights and saved J&G for New Years. It was great. The entire dining experience was wonderful and we moved to the bar to take in the music and a night cap. Stunning views of the city from our table.

The food and service were outstanding. The resort is lovely (we did not stay at the resort, just went for dinner), and was decorated beautifully for Christmas. In the summertime, plan for sunset as the view is very nice. Our server was exceptionally helpful, and everything we ordered was delicious. This was my second visit to J&G Steakhouse Scottsdale at The Phoenician, and I hope to go there every time I am in Phoenix.

We made reservations to spend Christmas Eve at J&G.  It was out 2nd time there. We thought it would be insanely busy and noisy. Wrong. It was terrific. The service was wonderful (we expected that) and the food was great (we expected that). My French Martini (not too strong, shaken well with foam on top) was one of the best that I have ever had. We were very impressed and will go back next year. This may be our new regular Christmas Eve dining spot. Very well done.

The food was, as usual, wonderful. Our waiter, bus staff and sommelier were attentive and helpful, yet  unintrusive . I wish we could have said the same about the live music that was anything but "in the backround."  The guitarist's selections were annoying, the amp was too high, and the music did nothing but detract from the J&G experience. Our party of three could not carry on a conversation without one of us having to repeat sentences for the others  and we were seated quite far from the musician.  SOFT  guitar or piano music would be fine in such an elegant atmosphere. We actually talked about the music rather than the fine food on our way home, which I am sure would not please your chef and manager.

Fabulous food, great service, great ambiance, a special occasion place, a bit pricy but worth
it.
Wanted a special evening and it definitely was that.  We had the 8 oz. filet and it was perfect.  Wine list included a broad price range and was reasonable.  Great evening!

Have been coming here for years and have enjoyed our evenings here.  A few years back, they did a anniversary dinner for the restaurant and it was hands down the best large scale banquet I ever attended. Food, service, ambience. All first class. So, they can perform at the top level. 
Sadly, our dinner Saturday was well below expectations. 
Ambience: Still arguably the prettiest dining room in the Valley. 
Service:The hostess and bar attendants were spot on. Our main waiter never showed up once after taking our order, except to deliver the bill. One of the runners thought he was on a track team, instead of the hospitality industry. Our tuna tartare was clanged down on the table, with the words thrown over his shoulder, 'tuna tartare'. The other half of the service team did just fine. So, half A for service, half F. 
Food: The food was just average. Mainly due to everything being underseasoned. Temperature and portions were fine. Plating was not as sharp as in the past. Portions were generous. 
Wine: a great wine list for anyone that knows wine. 

Time this place gets a little shake to reach its potential.
Great restaurant. Food and service were excellent. The view was spectacular.
Food was fabulous but we did feel a bit rushed. Would  have  preferred  more  time  between  courses.
Great menu!  Great views! Great experience from my first phone call to the restaurant.  EXCELLENT service.
The food was excellent and the service was great.

We had Thanksgiving dinner here and it was wonderful.  The turkey was perfectly cooked, the sides a great combination, and dessert was delicious, loved that ice cream on the side.  The only thing we missed was gravy.  First time to have Thanksgiving out, might just do it again next year.  There was so much turkey on our plates....light and dark meat...that we took some home for leftovers and it was great on sandwiches!

W expected the Phoenician to have a great restaurant. Instead it was a bit stark. We waited over an hour for our food because they had a party of 20 and 14. One of the groups came in after us. The food was average-not bad but not memorable.

My opinion of J and G is : the steak is mediocre with not a lot of flavor ( did not taste or cut like prime) and the other dishes (even the oysters on the half shell) just didn't taste extraordinary--which you would expect at these prices. Wine list is good though steakhouse pricey. It also is extremely loud throughout the restaurant. I sat at the bar while waiting for my table and a live guitar player made conversation difficult.
