It was just as loud in the dining room so if you are looking for a romantic dining spot with a date, this isn't the place.
On the plus side, my waiter was outstanding-attentive with out being snooty, friendly, perfect.

Have been there before many times, always a great spot for having a special dinner. Rib Eye medium rare was perfect, as well as the Jumbo Shrimp cocktail. Ayala Rose Champagne at$120 not cheap but worth it.
Service was disappointing this time. Slow, overall attitude, not at their normal standard.

Went there for an anniversary dinner and could not have been happier with the choice!  Great food, terrific wine list, and the service was friendly and professional.  The patio has a terrific view, definitely worth going!

I came to J&G Steakhouse for a birthday celebration for two and the service from the reservation, showing up to the resort, service to our table, private accommodations, waiter and food was PHENOMENAL!! The prices were really high but worth every penny!! The service really made it, our waiter was awesome, the people that refilled our water, supplied new forks and spoons every meal, we just felt important! Finally, the setting of the place was beautiful! Scenic, warm, music was awesome, I mean, I can't say anything disappointing about this place! Definitely coming again to celebrate more special events!

My Dad and I went here on a recent 3 day golf trip for dinner. 
Just an amazing well done experience all the way around.  
The food, waiters and servers were all top notch. 
Recommend the crab cake app and the peppercorn NY Strip. 
This is a steak house experience you are looking for when you go out. 
Only recommendation I'd make is to wear some nice clothes to fit in with the ambiance of the restaurant.
The food is wonderful, service is very awesome...the only thing I don't like that has a group behind my table and so noisy. We can't enjoy really much

Our annual stay at the Phoenician has included 2 to 3 dinners every years at J&G sine they opened at the Phoenician 6 years ago. We love to arrive early and sit in the deck to enjoy the view. This year was not up to par. Service was formal not friendly. The tuna tartare which we have always enjoyed  should now be renamed avocado tartare. Overall the food - drinks - service were not up to par. Unfortunate as we have been big fans and advocates of J&G.
A beautiful setting with mediocre food. Pricy would have expected exceptional food and was disappointed.
This was my second time here and better than the first ! Great food, ambiance, and service ! I would recommend it to anyone for a special occasion ! Great views as well !

Perfection! Dave our server was wonderful and Chris his expeditor was a culinary genius and explained the flavors and how they paired with brilliance, I wanted to take him home to Seattle as a personal chef! Live wonderful acoustic guitar in the lounge could hear gently at the table just perfect. Beautiful view of the city.  the manager even noticed when I put my wrap on and mentioned he turned down the air. just an example of the symphony of excellence in service and creative wonderful cuisine. I recommend the tasting menu it was one brilliant dish after the other the chef and pastry chef were one of the best I have experienced. Even our drinks were Perfection!

From beginning to end our experience was wonderful. While having a glass of wine in the bar prior to dinner, a bartender engaged in conversation with my husband and me while waiting for our neice to arrive. She provided information on the menu and discussed preparation techniques. Dinner was perfect. The dishes couldn't be beat and the services was excellent. The staff friendly and engaging and very competent. We would not have changed a thing.
Anniversary

We had originally decided to go to J&G Steakhouse during Arizona Restaurant Week on Sep. 27.  But due to the big rain storm, we cancelled our reservations and re-booked for Oct. 4.  We were so glad we did!  GREAT view from our patio table, which we heard was closed during the storm.  

We had calamari to start, it was awesome!  My husband had the Veal Porterhouse and I had the Lamb T-Bone.  Both were cooked perfect - so delicious!  We had grilled asparagus and mushrooms as our sides and shared.  They were both incredible - our whole dinner was WONDERFUL!  They brought a little chocolate cake with hot fudge inside and a scoop of vanilla ice cream for my birthday treat, which we shared.  Fantastic!!  This was a perfect birthday celebration!

Our salads were so over salted we could not eat them! Meat was very high quality and expertly cooked. View was beautiful. Service was spotty and inattentive. This is a beautiful venue and there is a superstar chefs name on this place so they should be able to deal with the details. Would not return as there are so many other places to get great steak in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area.
The service was impeccable and the ambience was gorgeous! It was an unforgettable evening and I enjoyed every moment of it! The restaurant is very pricey but worth every penny :)
Do yourself a favor and don't eat here. Go over to maestro's down the street and spend the same amount of money on dinner. You will get way better food, fabulous drinks, and exceptional service.

We were looking for a special dining experience and were very pleased with our choice to dine at J&S.
Food and atmosphere were wonderful.

We had the seafood platter, it was good. The french onion soup and the dessert (warm chocolate cake w caramel ice cream) were excellent. Surprisingly disappointed by the steaks. We had Filet Mignon and bone-in Filet Mignon, both ordered medium rare and both didn't came out the temperature we ordered. One at the rare side and the other at the medium side. We had to point out the filet was too rare and they put the meat back in the grill. It was very surprising J&G Steakhouse can't get the meat temperature right... looks like other diners had the same issues based on some of the reviews we seen here. Hopefully they will look into consistency and QA the food before bring it out of the kitchen.

We come to J&G somewhat often. The view is always wonderful and so is the service. We felt like the meal was not quite up to par this last time that we were there. Calamari was a little fishy and my chicken was kind of gummy. Wine list wasn't updated due to a printer issue and we got a different year than what we ordered.
This steakhouse had amazing service with an even better view. Highly recommend visiting this spot.

Celebrating my husband's 60th, the two of us chose to sit on the patio. The waiter was less than cordial until a table of two beautiful women was seated next to us (absolutely no one else on the patio, but they had to seat them right next to us). He suddenly came alive with a positive attitude for them. Later another couple was seated in front of us obstructing our view. Only 3 tables were filled on the patio!  Asked twice for bread - not delivered until after the salad and our filets took forever to come out. When they did, even though both were ordered medium rare, only one was medium rare, the other medium well. They did remember my husband's birthday with a free dessert - much appreciated for a less than expected evening of fine dining.
Very lovely restaurant with exquisite food! I would highly recommend for special occasions!

Our waiter did an outstanding job he opened a bottle of wine which had been corked, he noticed it and both he and the manager were extremely apologetic. My wife's filet had no flavor. She ordered it medium and it came out medium rare. I ordered the lamb chops medium with a char crust it came out med rare of which the server stated it would be no problem there but there was no char crust and it was loop warm at best. For the money I rate it below average. 
Maybe we caught the chef on a bad night. Would we go back probably not.

Second time to visit Scottsdale and our second trip to this restaurant.  They just do it correctly here--service, food, ambiance.  It's elite.  I doubt there are better places in the Phoenix area than J&G.  If so, I could count them on one hand.  If you're just visiting for a weekend, I would definitely eat at J&G one night.

we sat in the bar and shared the tasting menu
we had a great time and the service was excellent (very helpful and knowledge)
my fav of the menu was the swordfish and my guess loved the steak
we retuned the next night

Nice décor and wonderful view. Food mostly typical steakhouse fare, and while good, not particularly outstanding in my opinion. Started with the seafood tower with lobster, shrimp, oysters, mussels, and clams. Asked to leave off clams and mussels and add more oysters, which were very good. Cesar salad was one of the best, lemony with a hint of anchovy, but they used small croutons from a box rather than kitchen made. Steaks cooked as ordered and came with 3 sauces and condiments, which were all good. Asparagus cooked to perfection, mashed potatoes very good.
Lava cake dessert excellent, coffee good too, though refills not offered. Good wine selection. A splurge, but will go again.

Our experience at J&G was amazing from the minute we walked in. Staff was impeccable, friendly and knowledgeable. We had he tasting menu paired with wines which was outstanding and very reasonably priced. We will definitely go back!
Outstanding first time experience. View was a great starter. Service was top shelf Food was outstanding Wine list was friendly didn't feel rushed Overall top five restaurant for me in the Valley
Very Very slow service.  Average food, high prices and poor service --would not recommend and will not return
The hotel and restaurant were absolutely beautiful. However, parking was terrible. For the price the food was just okay; nothing over the top.  Cocktails very, very expensive.

We have eaten at the J&G Steakhouse several times over the past 5 years.  Our recent experience was fine, but not special.  The food and service were not up to the usual standards we have seen in the past.  We have noticed this over our last couple of time we have dined here.  If it were not for the incredible view, we would likely not come back.
View, food and waiter were spectacular. It was our 15th anniversary and it couldn't have been better!

My guest and I ordered from the Sunset menu.  The food was excellent and just the right amount.  Our server was warm yet professional.  The view was the reason I chose the restaurant.  I asked for a window seat and this was provided.  A wonderful experience.
Great romantic place, went for anniversary  and met 3 others for the same occasion. Pretty pricey for the not that greatest good but still good. Great scenic views though.

This restaurant has beautiful views and ambience as well as great service; however, the food is VERY overpriced for the quality. I got a filet mignon and it was so dry and over cooked. My boyfriends ribeye had so much fat that most of it couldn't be eaten. We were both very disappointed to pay that much for the food considering we didn't even enjoy it. If you want to get great service and a beautiful view then it's a great place but don't expect to be blown away by the food.

At the last minute the hubby wanted to have a date night on Friday. Looked up romantic rooftop restaurants in Phoenix and found J&G Steakhouse. Got a late reservation for 9:45 pm, which I made online thru Open Table, very easy and no hassle. I called J&G to make sure our reservation time was okay since they close at 10 pm. They were so nice and also put in my request for a scenic view..!!

We live in Surprise and had never heard of this Phoenecian place. AMAZING! This resort was well lit up and hidden in the mountains. 

So we get to J&G which is on the 5th floor and as soon as you step off the elevator I wad impressed.  We got our scenic view. It was quiet. EVERYBODY was amazing. The rolls, Steak, Service, view incredible. .!
Much too noisy for a quiet evening or a romantic evening.
J&g is fabulous. Always worth the splurge. The peekytoe crab cakes are amazing, as was the French onion soup. It almost can go with out saying that the steak was good we expect that there!
New sunset menu is a great value with great prefix choices. Live music was bit loud making dinner conversation strained. Service was excellent.
All was wonderful!  The views, the service, the food!  The Tuna Tartar is truly outstanding.
The food was delicious, the view spectacular, and our server was awesome!!

I made reservations specifically requesting a quiet, romantic table because it was our 31st anniversary.   We were seated at the smallest table sandwiched between two larger tables. The view was great until a family of 4 was seated next to us while we were eating our entrees.  The children proceeded to turn on their IPADS and since there backs were seated to the window, you could see the reflection of the IPAD screens in three of the windows.  The view was ruined. My husband mentioned the annoyance to the manager.  He couldn't tell the family to turn off the IPADS but would move us so we could have dessert. At that point we realized this was not the restaurant it claimed to be.  Not romantic and certainly not upscale. Lesson learned

We returned for a small party (4 guests) birthday celebration this past weekend.  We were seated at a cozy table by the window on a rare Phoenix rainy night.  Attentive service; the only suggestion is that the wait staff be more discrete when interrupting a conversation to take orders, ask questions. We chose the following menu items: Thrilled with the flavors of the French Onion Soup and Gazpacho Soup with Shrimp for appetizers.  Enjoyed the extra large cut of a Veal T-Bone Steak and Grilled Swordfish, both large enough for left overs to take home.  Mashed Potatoes were super creamy and delicious.  Crunchy Grilled Asparagus rounded out the menu.  Great wine list.  They always provide a special complimentary dessert for birthday guests.
Great view, romantic ambience, great music in bar nearby and perfect food and service. Everything was perfect.  Couldn't ask for better.
We went for my wife's birthday and took our 11 year old son.  Everything was perfect!  You will not be disappointed!

Prompt service. Nice setting overlooking the Phoenician resort and Scottsdale. Not too noisy. Food was just average especially for high end steakhouse prices. Flavor of lamb was good, but unusual cut made it difficult to remove from bone. Swordfish overcooked. Steak was fine but not extraordinary. Wine list good. Would only recommend if staying in the hotel and not feeling like going out.
Service and food was excellent.  I would recommend to anyone in the area to go there for dinner.

All four of us had the prix fixe, three course. Three of us were very pleased, the choices of risotto and pot stickers were exquisite, then we had salmon which got top marks and flat iron steak which was terrific. The problem was the pork belly which was atrocious. The potatoes needed an additional few minutes of cooking and the meat was not crispy enough which made it horribly un appealing. 
Deserts were great times three. They make a fabulous lava cake. The fourth was a bizarre concoction of water melon, fairly tasteless, accompanied by a tooth breaking praline type made with black sesame. A real flop which does not deserve to be on their menu. We have dined numerous times in the various J & G and this was bad.
Quiet atmosphere and great steak with amazing wine list.

Whenever my husband and I opt for a stay vacation J@G is always on one of our vacation days. We really enjoy visiting the Phoenician property. The view is spectacular from J@G's, the food is excellent, and service is always very accommodating.

Quite frankly, the food was great... But I was so disappointed because we went there specifically to watch the fireworks.  We were told they started at 9 pm so we made our reservations at 7:30.  I specifically asked for a table with a view, which we thought we had as we sat down.  We ordered our meals and right in the middle of the 1st course, the fireworks started (about 8:15).  We realized then... There was 0% view!  The waitress told us that perhaps the "real show" would start at 9 as planned, so we decided not to let our food get cold and waited for 9 pm.  No luck.  We missed the whole thing.  Very frustrating.

My wife and I had dinner on her birthday and we ordered from the 3 course 4th of July menu.  The appetizers and desserts were good but the entrée was disappointing.  Definitely was not worth the price.

It is a 100 mile round trip for us to visit this restaurant, but well worth it.    It is the only place in the Phoenix area we have found that has genuine Dover Sole on the menu - my husband's favorite fish.    We have been going to J & G for several years now and have yet to be disappointed.  The food is really good.   You can have a great steakhouse dinner, or a casual dinner or a real treat with some of their special dishes and appetizers.   Their Parker House bread rolls are outstanding.  Good wine list and cocktails too. You can dress up or go smart casual, everyone fits in and with the great view it is almost like a mini-vacation for us.   Highly recommended.

We went and sat at the bar before dinner.  The cocktails at the bar were made perfectly and the bartender was very friendly.  They seated us by the window and the view is to die for.  The wait staff was very knowledgeable and friendly and the dinner was exquisite.  I had the most wonderful mashed potatoes ever...

J&G is consistently outstanding.  From the excellent service, to the breath taking views, it's always an enjoyable experience.  Food on this visit wasn't quite as good as it normally is.  Tried the chicken entree instead of the usual steak.  The taste wasn't good, the texture wasn't good.  I was happy to have tried something different, but I wouldn't order this again.  Next time, it's back to the usual steak entree, which is consistently fantastic.

my husband's steak had to be returned - the rib eye. not cooked medium, was med rare. . so had to wait for filet , he switched to. seems they ca't get steaks cooked right at jg's had similar experience in a ny steak house of his. also should have gotten all new sides like they do in capitol grille. they did comp the desserts , though.

My wife and I had the pleasure of dining here recently and had a great time!  The food was very good!  Our server was well trained and knowledgeable in the food and wine offerings of the restaurant.  She suggested an excellent wine that complimented the meal we had.
The service was slow at the beginning, but picked up later. The food was excellent. Would recommend this restaurant  to anyone.

We eat here every time we are in Scottsdale.  The food and service are consistently very good.  The new summer menu has a roasted lobster dish which was outstanding. The steaks are of a high quality and are cooked to a diner's preference.

The food was overall good. We did a special wagyu beef and had tons of flavor. We personally liked the Mac and cheese, the mashed potatoes were just ok. Chili glaze was awesome. They were also were nice and provided a dessert for my mothers birthday. The only complaint we had was the server. Super nice but slow and not attentive in my opinion. After he took our order, never came back to even check if the food was ok. For fine dining the service needs improved upon. A few others helped and were very nice.

Highly recommend the tasting menu, each of the five courses was great and perfectly paired - it made for a fun and delicious experience!  Talia was performing in the bar area, first heard her about 10 years ago when she opened for Vienna Teng in Cave Creek, she's extremely talented. Downstairs at the Thirsty Camel, Anthony Mazzella - one of the world's great guitarists - was performing his usual incredible show. Overall a wonderful experience at the Phoenician!

This restaurant strikes the right balance between inventive and classic.  The architecture of the restaurant is beautiful.  The view over the Phoenician resort is beautiful.  The restaurant is not stuffy.  Our server was was knowledgeable without being snooty.  Our food was cooked to perfection.  My wife and I both had filet mignon as our main course.  Both were cooked to perfect temperature.  Flavor was amazing.  The appetizers were unique:  ravioli, and a honeydew gazpacho.  Waiter recommended a local wine.  It was excellent.  Deserts--lava cake and strawberry rhubarb pie--were sublime.  Very pleased.  We didn't get to enjoy it because we were in a rush, but the bar area had great live music.

This was beyond a simple dinner, though the restaurant itself was a bit confusing to find at first, but once it is found... the scenic view was breath taking, the food was delicious, and it was all in all a romantic experience.
Excellent steakhouse, excellent food, excellent staff, excellent views. The only issue...paper placemats??? Aside from that, J&G is a great steakhouse!

A warm and welcoming staff created a wonderful atmosphere.  The setting was very romantic and scenic.  We were seated at a table next to a firepit overlooking the Phoenician pools and Arizona skyline.  For starters, the peeky toe crab appetizer was the most amazing crab cake I have ever experienced.  The asparagus risotto appetizer was outstanding.  The black truffle comte fritters melted in your mouth.  The filet was cooked to perfection and complimented with a great selection of unique sauces. The warm chocolate dessert was the icing on the cake.  The only drawback was fitting in our bathing suits the next day.  That didn't stop us from dining at J&G 2 more evenings.  We look forward to returning.

Oh the view! Changing sunset light on rock formations of Papago Park and watching planes descending can't be beat. Tastebuds tantalized with creative honeydew gazpacho with mint, lime, and fiery shrimp: sweet, hot, tangy--perfect lead-in to the salmon with potato puree and basil vinaigrette with vegetables. Warm yeasty rolls with glistening crust were a nice surprise accompanying the meal. Partner's freshly made pea green ravioli with smoked bacon vinaigrette, and the filet mignon were perfect but the creamed basil and favas beans, although tasty, was disappointing because no beans were visible. Wish some local craft beer were on tap.
Strawberry rhubarb crumble with peppered pistachio ice-cream superb. Choc cake with caramel nicely rich.

If I'm spending $68 on a lobster I don't want to eat it on a paper place mat. (tacky)
 That said the salmon was cooked to perfection and the best I've ever had.  The noise level was so high as to interfere with dinner conversation.  All in all nice but not that great. I can think of several better choices for fine dining.
great customer service, wonderful view and excellent food!

I had recently dined here for the second time and have noticed a trend with my food. Let me say first that the service, ambience, and view were excellent! The appetizers were beyond delicious and the desserts were worth the trip alone. The desserts in particular the carrot cake was the most delicious thing I've ever tasted. That being said, the real disappointment came with the entrees. For such a classy and upscale restaurant the entrees were a real let down. The food itself was cooked well but between all of our entrée dishes the main proteins such as steak, fish, etc were surprisingly lacking in flavor. They were bland in short. I would have expected these to be seasoned at least but no the were not. This happened the first visit as well
Food wasn't bad, but not worthy of the prices. Dessert was the saving grace of the meal. View is great, but next time a drink at the bar will do the trick.

If you are fortunate to get an outside table on their patio you are in luck.  Watch the lights of the city and the airplanes flying in and out of Sky Harbor at night is much fun.  The food and service is always top notch.
As always, the Phoenician excels and its premier eatery does too.  One of the best.... and, very expensive.
Service good. Oysters very good? Meal portions small. Steaks could have been warmer.  It was 90 plus degrees and the fireplace outside by our table was on:(

Service was excellent, but food was just ordinary and over priced. There are to many excellent restaurants in Scottsdale that provide the same great service with much better food and reasonable prices!
We never had to leave the Phoenician.  It was great!!

I mean what can I say, Not the Greatest and not the Best. The View is Great so it s good place to have Dinner and watch the Sun set as its a Nice Clean place. The Food is not as good as the Cheesecake Factory but its decent not a place I would go to on a regular basis. But since this was a Birthday occasion for my Fiancé Why not. If you want over priced Single Dish items this is the place to go, Expect to pay about $45 per plate plus sides about another $25. 
To summarize Its a nice place where you don't see any regular Joe Shmo the view is fantastic, the food isn't all that that its claimed to be, But for a romantic evening its a Great place to Impress your date. If you have it then spend it. :).
Excellent service, great view, amazing food! We will return.
Our group came in for my moms bday dinner and we were greatly impressed! The atmosphere and service were top notch and the view was spectacular. We will definitely be visiting again! Thanks
The food was good, not great. There are many other fine steak dining places in the valley that I prefer, City Hall, Steak 44.
They made us feel very special and attention was first class.
Staff is very attentive and the service was exceptional.  Beef tenderloin was perfectly cooked.  Was very happy overall.

My wife and I decided to join J&G for their fifth anniversary and partake in their menu created for the event. The food, service and atmosphere were all grand. We also had their wine pairing with the dinner and all the selections were great also.
Altogether a wonderful evening.

Great place; however the lack of dress code enforcement is disappointing. It is very distracting when someone pays to go to a nice restaurant like this and other customers are in jean shorts and t-shirts. It takes away from an elegant or romantic evening.
Food and service was outstanding. We've been to JG many times and it is consistently superb!
Very nice dining experience. The restaurant should give something complimentary such as small after dinner drink or dessert simply because of the overall pricey meal

My husband and I believe this was the best restaurant we have ever been too. We are from Minneapolis and vacationed in Scottsdale, AZ. We wanted a good steakhouse restaurant during our visit. We were very happy. The service was perfect. The view was amazing. The steamed shrimp salad had the best shrimp we've ever tasted and the steak for 2 was the best cut rib-eye we've ever had. We are so pleased with our experience. Thank you J & G Steakhouse.
We had a great evening! The food was delicious & the service excellent. Loved it!

The ambiance was nice and atmosphere was pleasant. However, the food and service was a big disappointment. We were sat at 8:00 PM, right on time. When the main food arrived at 9:30, it was cold and average tasting. Yes that is correct the food arrived at 9:30 PM: My group sat for a least 30 minutes without a single server visiting our table after they brought us the salads. With the ratings this restaurant received on line, we expected to be served with an evening tempo and the food to be timely, warm and above average, with a memory that would carry us back to them in the future. This was not the case and I would not recommend this spot if you are in Scottsdale AZ.
Excellent Food. Great Location. Hard to Beat.
have been before but today filet temp was off and off again on recook
Great anniversary dinner - the menu and food was the highpoint
Snotty hostesses--I almost walked away. I am glad we stayed. I would fire the 3 and start over.
The cuisine here is amazing! Every course was a culinary delight! Romantic music, nice ambience were a bonus! We will be back!!

We were in town on vacation and stayed at The Phoenician, a beautiful resort! J&G is on top floor with beautiful views from outdoor terrace. Our meal was first class all the way. Service was top notch and staff made every effort to accommodate one person's health restrictions. Only mild complaint was the noise level. We had to speak loudly to be heard around the table. Otherwise it was a great experience!
I was looking for two things - great food and a great view for dinner our last night in Phoenix. This had both. The tasting menu was fantastic and the wine pairing was the best I ever experienced.
This is our second time dining at J&G. A wonderful experience. From arrival in the lobby to the after dinner drink on the balcony over looking the valley.

We usually really love the experience at J&G especially that classic meats and shrimp to-die-for-salad, but last time it was spoiled by the VERY LOUD band. While they set up in the bar, their amps were blaring in the main restaurant so loudly that diners shouted their orders to the fine wait staff. By the end of our dinner, it was better, but one could see that the first group of diners left quickly.

Music with dining is a wonderful treat, but it should be background volume, not interfering with dinner guest's conversations.

Beautiful atmosphere, amazing views overlooking the Valley. Excellent service and phenomenal food. Couldn't ask for more. Food is just wonderful and the potato side dishes are amazing. Highly recommend the Potatoes Au Gratin or the Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes.

shrimp salad...tomato salad were SOOO GOOD!!

carrot cake delicious
The food was so delicious! I had Salmon and my husband had Short Ribs. We loved this place and will definitely be back.
It was good. Service was slow. It was a Sunday night

Food was very good but the steaks--while very good--I've had better. The quality was there but either the over/grill is not hot enough or maybe the seasoning could have been better. Service was a bit weak for a high end restaurant--too may people involved in the service. Must have had 9-10 different people waiting on us depending on the course/beverage being served. They also got several drinks either totally worng or had incorrect garnishments. For the money, you don't expect or tolerate such silly errors. Restaurant is beautiful but service could use some improvement.

We would never return. Waiter inattentive. He built up the French Chef rating but frankly the only thing French about the
prep was presenting a few side sauces for us to share in a pick your own pot manner. Sides were small, veal rib chop dry, steaks and lamb chop so so and the rolls were like Tasty Bread boring.

Me and husband went to this restaurant in DC on our honeymoon and were hoping to find memories just like those. However when we were seated it took the waiter about 10 minutes to come out to us to give us menus. He never introduced himself. I'm not sure if the waiter messed up our order or if the chef messed it up but mine and my husbands steak preferences were switched. The medium well steak was too dry, but the medium cook was delicious. The broccoli was mediocre, but the mashed potatoes were divine. They offered complimentary bread that was a little dry and hard. The bus boy was more attentive to our needs than our waiter. Without his keen eye and willingness to give us our every need, the night would have been a total waste.

I made reservations at least a month in advance and requested for my husband and I to be seated near a window because I had heard the view was beautiful. Instead we were sat right next to weight staff area across the aisle from the window and near the door to the patio. Weight staff kept rushing down the stairs with trays of food and going in and out to patio. They also hovered around the area. I was very, very disappointed. Food was very good, but we were seated in a horrible spot.

This was our first visit to JG's. We went here on Valentine's Day. We have a few favorite steakhouses we like to frequent, but they all had a "special" menu, and not all of the offerings on the special menus at our favorite spots, thrilled us. JG's is a restaurant we had been meaning to try, and they offered both their regular menu, as well as a special menu.

The view is definitely the reason to spend the money to eat at this restaurant. compared to Mastros North Scottsdale (favorite), or Mortons, and Capital Grille, the food was just short, as was the service. Overall, the food was solid, with a few little missteps that made it not as nice as the other competitors I mentioned. The view however...excellent. Get a window seat if you go.
Jeff our waiter was very attentive and friendly how they should be. Overall an incredible experience with my wife tthanks to Jeff and the staff.

Dined at the steak house on Feb. 13th 2014. Nice place but the server had attitude and ruined our experience. Steak was very good but the sides were not. Salad very sharp dressing and mushrooms were not very good. Overall a little disappointed.

I had oysters and the veal t-bone. Oysters were good, no complaints. T-bone was ordered med-rare, came out blue rare. I questioned the waiter, he said that the meat is so good that it shouldn't be cooked more than rare and nothing would be done about it. I didn't like the waiters attitude, but the other staff (hostess, busboy) was pleasant.

Can't recommend this restaurant.

Great dishes and fantastic ambiance with this classy restaurant. A view of the valley from the side of Camelback Mountain. A lot of steaks but many other good dishes to please anyone. You can also eat on their patio. Very pleasant.
Great Restaurant, Great delicious food and great service. Not to mention a great view of Phoenix/Scottsdale.

We came here for our anniversary dinner. I heard it was one of the better steakhouses in the valley (with a gorgeous view if you got seated next to a window).

We started out with the french onion soup (I loved it).

It was followed by the tuna tartare (minus the chips like Bern's) and the crab cake (very mundane) as the appetizer.

The main dish was a the wonderfully dressed and tasting salmon (her, she loved it).

A grilled cheese and french fries (our daughter, she did not).

A 12oz filet mignon (me---just a hunk of meat. It was okay).

Our sides was the asparagus (bland) and potatoes au gratin (greasy). The restaurant gave us a complimentary piece of chocolate cake and some ice cream because it was our anniversary (meh).

This was my second visit, I came because the 1st had been great, so now I invited a high compromise but what a shame, the ser ice was horrible from the start, they didnt ask us for cocktails, I had to call our waitress to our table at least three times, the food wasnt served at the same time or on the same way, food temperature was wrong, so it was very dissappointing for me, specially as I had guests and had created great expectations, dont feel like going back
We had a great time and enjoyed the tasting menu!

We had a group of 10 at this high end restaurant. It was wonderful and we all felt very well taken care of by our server and the busing staff. We did not have an empty glass or a dirty plate to speak of. The waiter really knew his stuff and was very helpful to the two vegetarians in the group.

One of the members of the group forgot their card on the table and the hostess call me within minutes of us leaving the restaurant, again excellent service!
I love this place!! The service and the food is always fabulous

You go to J&G for steak - you will not be disappointed. Excellent steaks cooked exactly as expected with incredible flavor and texture. The room was a little noisy and it was not full, but we could talk and it was very pleasant. The French Onion soup was one of the best I have had and my wife's tuna appetizer was also excellent. It is a great dining experience.

Last Saturday night my wife & I were first seated near a table of 8 that were having a good time but were pretty loud. We asked that our table be moved to a quieter location and were told that may not be possible due to heavy reservations that evening. Eventually our table was changed but there was not much difference in the noise level due to a table of six nearby. I have been to all the non-hotel steakhouses in Scottsdale and have not encountered the same noise level in any of them. The service was good but the waiter did not put in an order for one of our sides. He probably didn't hear me order it because of all the noise. I did see guests at a table nearby move to outside seating where it was much quieter. Something we should have done.
Exceptional dining experience. Five women celebrating birthday were raving about service and food and special attention. Great wines too!

We tried again, for the sole?
As previously, the ambiance was none, the noise from the very mediocre band was more than annoying despite multiple requests to drop the speakers volume, the service was not friendly. The food was very good! but the overall experience is below standard.
Where is Marie-Helene ?? This used to be a first class restaurant, but now, only the price is.

Had the New Years menu which was outstanding. Unfortunately the kitchen had issues and took over 45' to deliver first plate. After talking to manager she expedited. Manager made us whole for the unfortunate service. I will go back again as the food is great and the situation was handled professionally.

My boyfriend and I did the tasting menu and each dish was perfect. One of the dishes was scallops and since my boyfriend does not eat scallops the chef replaced them with another fabulous dish. We both love steak and the carmelized beef tenderloin was delicious. The dishes arrived at a leisurely pace and the service was very friendly, attentive and knowledgeable. We sat facing the fireplace outside and the city of Phoenix. We even got lucky enough to see fireworks coming from the football stadium. A wonderful dining experience overall and we would both highly recommend it.

This was our first trip to J&G, but we plan to return. We began with the heirloom tomato salad with Russian dressing. We somewhat expected it to be OK, but it was wonderful. The tomatoes had body and very good flavor; the dressing was terrific and the onion rings and micro greens were a very nice touch. We both had steak. Both were prepared as requested. They were tender and had very good flavor. The sauces were delicious and fun to try. The cabernet selected by our waiter was the best wine I can remember. Now if I could only the name of the wine! The service was exceptional as well. We loved the experience and the food. Thank you for this evening.

Came here with my brothers as a Christmas gift and we couldn't have chosen a better restaurant. The staff was very friendly and walked us through the menu. The Lamb t-bone was cooked perfectly and the presentation of the baked Alaska is really neat.

our waiter was very fun and took perfect care of us.he suggested wine and described perfectly the dishes that we eventually chose.
The salmon was buttery and cooked perfectly.The sword fish was perfect.We had salad which was also wonderful.Greens tossed with apple,pecans and blue cheese in a wonderful dressing.You can't go wrong here.We have already sent friends here.
enjoyed our food, the service was personel and outstanding. Great job!
Jeff our server made the night memorable... as well as our bartender (Amanda - I think?) she made the best Manhattan ever!!

I Always dined at Mastro's , my favorite or Morton's. That is until Darden and Landry corps bought them out. Questions?
My wife and I arrived at J&G for our reservation and were seated on the patio overlooking the pool and views of the city. Perfect. We started with a half dozen Kumamoto oysters that came with a vinaigrette and cocktail sauce. The oysters were wonderful. Next came the wedge salad , loved their blue cheese dressing and four large strips of bacon, simple but perfect. We ordered the 24 oz prime porter house medium rare + to share. Steak came out cooked perfectly the 1st time and was truly a prime piece of meat. This Chicago boy has found his new favorite place for steak .

I was looking for an upscale, interesting and fun place for a Holiday dinner with a great friend and couldn't have picked a better spot. The restaurant is beautiful, the food was amazing and the service was very attentive. It's not inexpensive, but is worth the price of admission.

Our overall experience was a magnificent romantic meal!
The place was stunning. We had 2 excellent glasses of California Cabernet wine from the Sanctuary. Our appetizers were shrimp and avocado salad and Ceasar salad. The shrimps were the most deliciously prepared shrimps I ever had. The Ceasar salad was light, crispy and refreshing. Our main course was a bone in Wagyu steak for two. The most tender and flavorful beef I ever had. The scenic view from the wall to wall glass view was spectacular and breathtaking. Would definitely go there again on future trips. The place is pricey, but worth the memorable experience.

Atmosphere and food were good but the service was mediocre at best. Both in the bar and restaurant the servers were inattentive and not arround when you needed them. Also, we ordered Baked Alaska for desert and it was a disaster. The burner did not work and they went back to fix it and did not return for at least 10 minutes while the ice cream sat there and melted. We told them to get new ice cream and another 5 minutes went by and we told them to cancel the order and informed managemenmt of how bad the whole experience was.

We love trying the excellent steakhouses the Scottsdale area has to offer and had yet been to the J&G. We will be back for sure. From the time we were greeted until the time we left it was a great dining experience. The staff was polite and professional, the food was excellent and the 22oz Rib Steak (for 2) we ordered was among the finest steaks I have ever had. All of this and we had a very nice evening view to accompany the meal. The noise level was a bit higher than we are used to but I can only imagine this was due to the festive time of year and a few larger dining groups in the dining room. Not over the top or annoying by any means though. I'll say it again, it was a great dining experience for the both of us. Thanks J&G!

First time to J & Gs. We were staying at the Phoenician and the restaurant is located in the hotel so very convenient. Like most high-end resort restaurants, pricey and elegant. The view of the Phoenix downtown landscape was beautiful. We had their venison special and chicken parmesan which were both excellent. We also tried their wedge salad and tomato slices with basil, cheese. Both excellent but nothing we hadn't experienced before. Hard to mess those up!
Great food service and restaurant

Enjoyed the lovely view at the restaurant. The food was very good and flavorful. Some items were overpriced and the service was a bit slow. Expected a bit faster service, I think our food wait was a about an hour and 15 minutes. I eat at fine dining restaurants often and I think this was the slowest I've experienced thus far. Overall, friendly staff, good food, and great ambiance.

On a very rainy and cool day in Scottsdale we had reservations at J&G before the Buble concert, we were awed by the warmth and refinement of this treasure. The Phoenician staff is first class from the time you step out of your car to the last good bye upon departing to your next adventure. The food was outstanding and prepared to perfection. I know J&G is touted as a steakhouse, however two of my friends ordered seafood! The lobster and tuna tartare were some of the best we have tasted and they were visiting from Florida and the upper east coast! The atmosphere was perfect, views were sensational even on a rainy evening! Our server, Candice, was nothing less than perfection. She knew her menu exceptionally well and her delivery 5 stars.

We eat out a lot at very nice restaurants but J&G truly stood out. The food was excellent and the portions were generous. The service was truly exceptional from the water service to the recommendations on food and wine. There was live music playing in the bar area and the volume was appropriate so as to not overwhelm conversation. The views are beautiful and the entire experience was exceptional. We have already recommended it to several friends.

Everything was perfect from the initial seating to payment of the check. We were given the attention one would expect from a restaurant of this standing. Our waitress was outstanding and atmosphere phenomenal.
Always consistent, great food and service

We started the evening on the 3rd floor of the Phoenician (main lobby), had a cocktail and enjoyed the terrace overlooking the pool. As our reservation time approached, we headed up to J&G (5th floor) and had a drink at the bar as our table was prepared. There was live music in the bar area. Our table was ready on time for our reservation and we were quickly seated. The wait staff was very polite and were able to provide good input on the various menu selections. Our party had a variety of entree dishes and everyone enjoyed their respective items. Cost-wise, it came out to around ~$80/person which included a starter, main entree, a side, and a glass of wine.

We all enjoyed our evening and would definitely come again!

Everything was perfect.
I tried the tasting menu, along with the wine pairing option.
Food was great. wine too . ( Just was a bit sceptic about the food/wine match for the second dish, but frenchies are allways a bit piky when it comes to wine).
Wonderful location and setting.
I will certainly go back there on my next visit to phoenix.

After reading that J&G was ranked one of the top steak houses in all of Arizona - we had to try it. We excitedly went on a Friday night. Sadly we won't be back - ever. It seems the restaurant relies on its sauces to cover up what is otherwise poor cooking. My filet was ordered true medium and it came out near well done with a dot of pink in the center - others had doneness issues too. THe mac & cheese looked like it was from a Stouffers frozen entree complete in that little black tray they show on TV, brussel sprouts were under cooked - tough to cut and underseasoned. Entertainment was a lounge singer who was off key. I am not sure how it ranked so highly or by whom - but for the money we will instead go to Mastros Drinkwaters.

I am generally a little skeptical of resort restaurants. I am generally skeptical of celebrity chefs. This restaurant proves me wrong on both counts. This was our second time dining here and it was as good as the first time. We started with the seafood tower. Again, I am skeptical of ordering seafood in the desert, but my husband insisted. He was right! Fabulous!

My husband and son split the bone in rib eye for two special. I had ht e filet. Both were excellent and we enjoyed tasting the samples of all the different steak sauces they delivered with our food.

I decided to pick this resturant because of its scenic view, great looking menu, and had a modern look. I wanted something special since it was our one year anniversary. The first thing we noticed when stepping off the elevator, was how noisy it was. I was hoping for a more intimate quiet setting, but it was quite loud. Maybe it had to do with the time, since we went at 6:30pm. The food was amazing and most definitely worth the price. I will be returning for dinner, however I reserve a latter time so the noise won't be so loud.
SEVEN OF US CELEBRATED OUR SON'S 50TH BIRTHDAY THERE. ALL OF OUR REQUESTS WERE HONORED~~THE FOOD~~THE SERVICE~~THE AMBIANCE WAS WONDERFUL. A BEAUTIFUL EVENING AND A REAL TREAT.

Great food with great views of the Valley and city lights. The French onion soups with a side of oysters were perfect complements to a great steak dinner. The service staff were all very friendly and helpful in our selections.
Loved this place! Great atmosphere and food! I had salmon and mashed potatoes and it was to die for! Can't wait to go back.
A gorgeous location with cuisine to match.
Great food. Great company. Great service. And, last but not least, a great view...

What a special night we had with our son. Our first time to see our son after taking him to college. Great time to reconnect, great food, fantastic wait staff, wonderful atmosphere, from beginning of night to the end. Can't say enough about our evening. We will definitely be back.

Very creative presentation on salads. Main course presentation was basic but excellent meat. A little surprised had to send back one time to get cooked as ordered. Side dishes of creamed corn and au gratin potatoes were 5 star as was dessert of lava cake.

I love this place for the restaurant itself but I think more people need to know about the bar area! It's a really nice, relaxing atmosphere that is somewhat separated from the restaurant with lovely couches, tv's and a full bar! Great place to check out if you just happen to be in Scottsdale or live in the area!!

A small group went for dinner.

Not much to say, the view and the atmosphere is fantastic.

The food was very good. The drinks were outstanding.

The service from the bartenders is great!

The service from the dining room server was despicable!!

We had another wonderful meal at J&G. We started our evening dining inside but the tables around us were a little noisier than we preferred for our romantic dinner so we asked to move outside. Our waiter was very accomodating. He even offered to plate the lobster I ordered and the veal my husband ordered as surf 'n' turf since he knew we were going to share. It was a perfect presentation. The lobster was wonderful and didn't need any butter. The veal was tender and cooked perfectly.

Our first time dining here, since we were staying at the Phoenician. We were escorted to our table which had a fantastic view of the city. We ordered two Tuna Tartare's for the table. It was the best I have ever eaten I ordered a Caesar Salad, which had a bit of a lemon taste to it which was excellent and very different. We all ordered the Filets which were cooked to perfection. I would definately come back and highly recommend

The Food and Ambiance were top notch!!! The server that we had, had made about 3 errors during the meal(wrong food brought to table(2x), forgot to put in the order for a drink). He did make up for it by removing the food items from the check. I can understand that servers are not perfect, but 3 mistakes at a 4* place I don't think that that is a good representation of hiring the right people for the type of restaurant. He also was not very attentive, or not as attentive as he was with the table full of women next to us.
We so enjoy the change from the previous venue. So much more intimate, personable and a fabulous setting.
Restaurant was excellent, would definitely return. As far as service goes I would recommend Candace as a server. If you're in Phoenix, this steakhouse should be on your places to dine list.
Unfortunatly all our steaks were over cooked. Rest of the food was very good
Excellent food and service all with a view of half of the valley. And don't overlook the ginger margaritas.

Excellent, Fun Dining experience, amazing views, good food and one of the best wait staffs I've had. Our main waiter, John helped with our selections, and offered to move us to the patio after it cooled down (without us having to ask). The entire staff was top notch, they know how to make you comfortable &work together well. Try the cucumber martinis then try the salmon with snap peas, yum!

Had my birthday dinner and J&G pushed out the boat for us. Each course was well executed and beautifully presented. Te lobster entree was the best ever! The final touch the Chocolate Cake complete with a candle was outstanding! Thank you J&G for a memorable birthday dinner!

The word Steakhouse typically scares us off, especially my wife who only likes meat occasionally. The name Jean Georges Vongerichten convinced us to give it a try. First off, the food was great! We enjoyed the menu immensely. The charred corn ravioli was to die for! The steak sauces turned even my wife into a beef connoisseur. Overall a great experience and value. The only downside was our waiter, Kyle, who started with a tactless attempt at upselling the most expensive menu items and then forgot my wine pairing with the dessert course. Otherwise, the service was terrific.

The food at this restaurant was outstanding. Portions were large and sides were terrific. We enjoyed Veal Porterhouse, NY Steak and Hanger Steak with Frites ( which was the best that we had ever had) Definitely will return. Service was impeccable.

Our food was great but wine service needs improvement. We bought a bottle of wine and after glasses were drained, had to wait 20 minutes before refill. Wine bottle was out of reach so needed service to accommodate. Manager was nowhere to be found. Our waiter was attending half the room. Needs more help.
This was a wonderful experience.

While I'd go here any time, this establishment is phenomenal for special occasions. They really know how to pull out the red carpet for every guest, every time, but when they know you've got something to celebrate they go above and beyond. The food and service were amazing, as usual, as well as selections from the impressively extensive wine list. A restaurant not to be missed in the Valley!

We enjoyed an excellent dinner at J&G Steakhouse at the beautiful Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale during our 2 days in this area. The price may seem a little on the higher side, but well worth the price. Between three of us, we had filet, chicken and salmon - all delicious, and we shared two sides - garlic mashed potatoes and asparagus. We would definitely return when in the area. Also a great selection of wines - we found a new Riesling which we have never tried and it is now our favorite.
This was an experience I will never forget. Great food and service within a gorgeous setting.

Saw the waiter 3 times in 90 minute dinner period. Had to ask busboy for service.
Sides were terrible and entree's had been sitting under warmers for
An extended period.
Our 600.00 tab was the worst investment in a meal ever!
Since this steakhouse reopened we have been ther 2x before and
Will most definitely NEVER return. The only thing we enjoyed about
The evening was the view and atmosphere.
Amazing dinner. Great service. Loved the DIY cocktail kit. Looking forward to returning.

The food and service were awesome. The steaks were done to perfection and the au gratin potatoes were the absolute best either of us have ever tasted.
Can't wait to go back!

One of the worst meals I have ever had was Saturday evening at J&G Steakhouse. We asked for a table with a view, and despite their being many open tables (all night), we were seated next to the entrance. The noise level was so high that I could not have a comfortable conversation with the person across the table from me. I asked that the volume of the music be turned down, twice, and it was, but soon had climbed back to night club level. The next thing I know a band starts playing, loudly, at seven p.m. The dress code for the restaurant was "dressy" however there was a man at the next table in blue jeans, wearing a baseball cap. For several hundred dollars, this was a very disappointing experience. I will not return.

My wife and I were there on Saturday night. It was a terrible experience. It was the worse service from a un caring staff that we ever encountered. Food was quite mediocre. Our dinner lasted 3 hrs. No apologys from anyone. A big waste.Dont go there.

The food in general was very good. The only thing we missed was some red wine sauce with the beef fillet.
The ambience is great, with a beautiful view of the surroundings. From the terrace it is even better. Walking around the gardens was awesome as well.

As a first time patron I wasn't sure what to expect. Fine dining tends to be a little out my element. J&G Steakhouse, however, was a very comfortable fit. The noise level and ambiance allowed for a more casual feel without detracting at all from the elegance and dining experience.

The food was flawless and the wait staff was superb. The only thing I found to be mildly tedious was the music levels (which was live!). I think a more moderate level could have been accomplished to reduce overall noise level.

There were four in our party. Three of us enjoyed the three-course pairing menu, while the birthday guest splurged on the five- course tasting menu. Highlights of the dishes at the table included Popcorn Shrimp surrounding by freshly popped popcorn kernels (I don't know how they made that?), Tuna Tartare, Freshly made Corn Ravioli's, and a gooey Chocolate cake with Caramel Ice Cream. The wine list was excellent and we were thrilled to be able to purchase the last bottle in house of one of our favorite wines. Our waiter was outstanding.

The music playing in the lounge was lovely with the exception that it was a little loud. This was a great choice for a special occasion evening and we will definitely return.

Great steaks and a beautiful view of the camelback mountains. On days where temps are not soaring, would be great to be on balcony. Service staff cordial, could be a bit more personable. Did not care for how Cesar salad or wedge salad dressings were made and the French onion soup was made with "sweet" onions, which did not taste well, but main entrees and sides were very respectable.

We were at J&G in April We had one of the best meals ever. We returned with our friends to celebrate their anniversary and hoped for a a compmparable meal. W were all disappointed. The steak was fair for three of us.At 60dollars it should have been better. The tuna tartare which was superb the time before was mushy and the sauce was overpowering. The sides were good but the rolls were below par.
The service was decent but not as outstanding as it was for us when Anthony was our waiter. Unfortunately he wasn't there that night.
We had to wait for silverware after our steak arrived. We had to search for our waiter whenever we neded something.
The restaurant provided a dessert for our our anniversary celebration which was nice.
The food was good, but for the price to be honest I have had better. The service was great and beautiful views, I would go back more for the ambiance alone.
Beautiful setting and views. Food was very good, but quite expensive.

The decor was stunning and cocktails prepared just right.
The service in the bar was of a high standard and girls were friendly.
Crowd skews older 45-85... Pricing is high- but should be for what you get.
Food was cooked to perfection- we had asparagus and ribeye. We shared a meal - portions are sizeable.

All in all it was a very pleasant experience. We have only one suggestion. There were periods of waiting for serivce even though the restaurant was not crowded. A couple of times we had to flag someone down for water, etc. The serice was there and it was good.. It just could have been a little more timely.
Great scenic viewand delicious food and service make this an outstanding dining experience. Request a table by the window when making a reservation.

J G steakhouse atThe Phoenician was a great way to start our holiday. Cocktails were excellent, staff incredible and of course the food was excellent. The room is beautifully done with perfect lighting and spectacular views.
We always expect great food and service at J & G. Our last visit was the best service ever.

Great place for a Birthday celebration. Food highlights: melt-in-your-mouth comte cheese fritters; slow roasted salmon; flavorful sauces for filets esp. chardonney beurre blanc; delicious, lighter than normal cheesecake that pairs well with the tangy sweet rhubarb sorbet; very sweet and yummy passion fruit pavlova with excellent merengue.

Didn't love the asparagus risotto - did not have the rich creamy texture I expect, and the lemon was heavy-handed. Also the caramel ice cream had very little caramel taste, and was not as smooth and creamy as it should have been.

Scenery was beyond compare. Restaurant was filled with dark, rich tones with modern touches - especially liked the wall of wine bottles in lighted cubes.
Lovely for a more intimate or special occasion. I imagine the weekend nights are more lively; I'd love to see it then for a different ambience.
Wonderful! Thank you for looking after Leah on her birthday. -Bill

Really enjoyed dining here last night. Shrimp salad was outstanding as well as shrimp cocktail. Loved their sparkiling rose...from France..Greg and David are outstanding servers...very helpful and just so nice. Great place to go for an occasion.
I was looking forward to this steakhouse with its Prime cuts! Ordered the Rib Eye with peas and Mashed potatoes , the steak was fatty. What a let down!!

This is by far one of the best gems in Phoenix. Great for a celebration. The view is wonderful, the food fantastic. usually the service is top notch, though we were a little let down this last visit as our waiter spent a LONG time talking to the table next to us and not keeping our wine glasses full. That is, however, atypical!

Gorgeous setting, great service and when I put in the Open Table reservation that we were celebrating a birthday, they had a card and a beautiful dessert! Classy and romantic - and while it's a "steakhouse," their seafood dishes are amazing, especially crispy halibut. Very accommodating with any dietary restrictions too.
Probably the best patio (and inside at the windows) view in the Valley.

We always enjoy eating at this restaurant. The quality of the food is consistently good as ids the service. Whilst it is expensive, the setting for a restaurant in a hotel is excellent. I ate from the Arizona Restaurant Week menu whilst my dining partner ate a la carte. We both had a fantastic meal, they have perfected the hot chocolate cake recipe, perfect!

My husband and I tried J&G Steakhouse for Restaurant Week. We wanted to sit outside as I heard the view was great. It was a little warm but we enjoyed sitting outside, listening to the live band that played by the pool. The view IS great but the food was a bit of a disappointment to me. With the fixed menu options, I ordered the hanger steak. For being a steakhouse and paying $35+ dollars for a steak, you expect it to be really good. Unfortunately, I was left disappointed as I could barely cut up my steak it was so tough. I had to send it back. They handled it well but WAY too overpriced in my mind for a bad piece of steak.

The outside seating with gorgeous views cannot be beat, but the food wasn't anything to write home about. Next time I would go and sit outside just for a drink and MAYBE an appetizer. The waiters were all very nice and attentive, so I would recommend coming to see the place.

Wow! What a let down. Four of us went to J&G during Restaurant week as the regular prices are extremely high. What I didn't realize was that by getting a fixed price meal we would be treated as a lesser class of people. Our waiter was intrusive and unfriendly which was emphasized when he literally tossed the bill on to the table at the end of the meal. The food was hit and miss. The fish was under seasoned. The shrimp appetizer was excellent however. Desserts were okay. The ambiance was sort of a slightly upscale Sizzler Steakhouse. What really amazed me was they used disposable paper place mats and no tablecloths. There are many other steakhouses and better restaurants in Phoenix. Skip this one.

Beautiful restaurant. Notable wine/drink list with a spectaular menu selection. The oysters feature east/west coast; did not care for the west coast, however I loved the east coast oysters. We ordered the Filet which was undercooked as to how we ordered it. They rectified the situation immediately. The side selection offer a vast array of choices. Overall, it is nice restaurant with a great view. It is not my favorite place for a Steak/Filet.. fell on average. Would go back for app's and drinks with a great view.

We went to J & G for the restaurant week special. This is the first time we have been back to this venue since Mary Elaine's closed. We were disappointed with the ambience. Our first and third courses were excellent. The crispy shrimp and pea soup are worth coming back for. However, my bass was flavorless and mushy. Was it fresh or fresh frozen? I couldn't tell you. My husband's hanger steak was perfectly cooked but the green topping ( no other word for it) was unidentifiable. The whipping off of paper placemats between courses was distracting and more in line with a bbq diner. We were given rolls one at a time. What was the worry? It was not because the rolls were memorable. We are on the fence whether we'll come back.

BY far the best steak restaurant I have been to. Amazing service, steak cooked to perfection, and very tasty sauces to add to the steak. The side dishes were great, especially the potatoes au gratin. The shrimp salad is one of the best salads I have ever tasted wit the dressing they have. To top things off the wine list has a wide variety of different wines.
Excellent service and the meal was very good.
Pricey but great food, service and a fabulous view!

We had a birthday celebration during the week. it was quiet and we had a nice table by the window with an incredible view. We had the tuna tartare and it was good. My only comment was that the ginger sauce was too overpowering for the tuna. Only negative was bread that comes to table was not soft but rather hard and dry. Hubby had veal steak and it was great. I had the halibut and again a success--tender and cooked perfectly. Great place!
The food and service are only equaled by the ambiance
We had dinner in J&G many times and each time they do not disappoint. The service is great, the food is excellent the surroundings and view are wonderful. We shall certainly go back for more.

Excellent restaurant with the best service . Our server is amazing but then so was everyone else in the restaurant. They constantly want to make sure everything is done perfectly or they will correct it. The tasting menu was excellent and price was very reasonable. This restaurant is as good as any restaurant in NYC. The service is as good as Jean George in NYC.  We would go back every time we visit Scottsdale.

this is a wonderful place to dine. my husband and I came here to celebrate his birthday and we both couldn't have been happier with our choice. we shared the tuna tartar which was absolutely delicious and then each if us had the ribeye steaks. The meat was delicious. It was cooked perfectly. Our waiter Anthony was terrific and provided excellent service as did the rest of the staff. What a great evening
Awesome place. Sit on the patio for sure
Best steak i have had in a long time - excellent service and the food was outstanding. We sat on the patio which was amazing for April and the weather was perfect
Great for special occasions! The food was fantastic and the service was excellent. We were vising Scottsdale from out of town and had a fabulous evening at J&G.

This was our first visit to J&G and it was memorable. The rib eye that I had was perfectly prepared, juicy and flavorful. My wife had the dover sole, and it, too was outstanding. A memorable visit! Pricey, but worth it.

I was disappointed in the food.... Over priced and not great. Booth seating was very uncomfortable.... With my back toward the view. Based on the hotel and the luxury they try and portray - very over priced and disappointing. Won't go back and don't recommend

Not a great experience here! As it's been voted best steakhouse in Phoenix us say that's far from the truth. Steaks were good at best, have had much better at not-so-steakhouse restaurants, like District, and will-known steakhouses like Mastro's and Fleming's. Very expensive, was seated far from view and service and overall was very mediocre! Not what I expected from the old Mary Elaine's!
Don't waste your time or money. Enough said.

I truly enjoy the elegant feel of J&G Steakhouse. I am always greeted with compassion and I feel like they genuinely care about my dining experience. My meal is never short of delicious and I can see that so much care goes into the preparation.
Perfection! Overall our favorite restaurant in the Scottsdale/Phoenix area on all levels, every time. Just wished we lived in state, we would enjoy more often.
Wonderful restaurant, awesome food, great ambiance, BUT staff has an attitude.
By far the best dining experience I've had in my 13 years as an Arizona resident. Outstanding service, wonderful food with perfect portions. Plan to return. Highly recommended!
Food was OK. Prices were like Morton's.
Food was amazing. The view from this restaurant is awesome- make a reservation early so you can see the sun set!
Great food. We will return. Tasting menu with wine was excellent.

Well i will start off by saying that this steakhouse is not at all what i had in mind. The service was horrible you never know who is serving you for one and for two they are not friendly you would think being placed in supposedly a five star resort you would get better service and more people skills with your staff. for what you pay$$$$$ to dine here its not worth it i have had better food at much less expensive establishments. Very dissapointed for a five star place.

I think this place is just "phoning it in". Hard to believe John Georges has anything to do with this place and easy to believe that if he dined here he would be embarrassed. At a steakhouse of the cost and supposed quality of this one, you would expect a steak to be perfectly cooked. Mine was not. Twice. No fewer than 4 different people came by to apologize, but frankly, if you can't get it right twice, it's beyond apology. I did note their fawning apologies did nothing to reduce our bill. Not even a courtesy offer of a dessert. If you actually have the audacity to believe a steakhouse should actually cook a steak to order, I strongly suggest Mastro's. On their worst night, they are twice as good as this establishment.
Moderately expensive but worth it. I have traveled around the globe for 30 years and this is one of my favorite restaurants anywhere.

I guess I am spoiled being from Chicago.  Outside of the view and service, there wasn't much to harp about.  Very disappointed in the food, portion sizes and prices.  You would think they were the only steak house in the Phoenix area with the prices and portion sizes.  I could have ordered and received a better meal at half the price in Chicago, and those steak houses aren't run of the mill chain restaurants.  We did love the view and the outside patio, and the service was very good.

Generally excellent dishes in an upscale setting with a beautiful view. Only disappointment was our steaks (filet & NY strip): they were good but the filet was overdone at medium, and both tasted a little flat. You can find much better ones for less. Since this is supposed to be a steakhouse, one star off.
Our first time at this restaurant. Service and food were the best. Will go back again for another special treat.
Great restaurant for a special occasion. View was outstanding as was the food and the service.

Attended for my husbands birthday. The food was exquisite, service was great, and the view was extraordinary. There were suite a few parties and families so the noise level was much louder than expected but we will definetely go back.
You are paying for Ambiance.I cannot believe the food they serve for those prices.

When i have gone to other restaurants for a special
Day in my life, the restaurant employees have gone out of their way
To make it that much better. I felt that this was not accomplished here.
Although our waiter was respectfull, im not sure if we picked a bad night
As we felt it was really loud and not the romantic, quiet scene that i was going
For.
Had a wonderful time! The service was great, the server was very knowledgable!

The steak and wine were good. The Caesar salad was horrible. Old lettuce swimming in dressing, stale croutons. The French fries were cold and limp. I was very disappointed. You expect much more for $200. Honestly fast food restraunts do a better job in taste and presentation
Missed bringing my salad and served me a cold cup of coffee. Not impressed.

The service seemed false as if they were at a theme park. The sommelier knew nothing about the wines by the glass and could care less. There are many restaurants with a lot of heart and love what they do in Phoenix/scottsdale. J&G is not one of them.
A very comfortable restaurant. It has a lot going for it. Some of my companions think that the ginger margaritas are the best.

This is a classic, high quality steakhouse with a fabulous view. The steamed shrimp, butter lettuce salad was outstanding, and the steaks with bernaise were top quality a perfectly cooked. The service was very professional and attentive without being obtrusive. Didn't care for the thyme on the Brussels sprouts and the overdressing of the Caesar salad, but those were our only minor quibbles on an excellent dining experience.

J&G Steakhouse is an upscale modern take on the classic steakhouse. The dining room features stadium style terraced seating incorporating tables and rich leather lined booths. The main feature is the panoramic view of The Valley of the Sun.

+ Floor to ceiling windows offer a stunning view
+ Nice selection of wine
+ Complimentary valet parking

- Sent a steak back 3 times and in the end did not eat it at all
- Odd details like paper placemats and faux butcher block tables
- Side dishes are an afterthought at best

The question one must ask about J&G Steakhouse is, without the view is the cuisine good enough to come back? Sadly, the answer is no. Scottsdale offers many choices that offer superior food and service.
Had the best waiter in years!!! Loren I believe was his name; he couldn't have been more accommodating. Food was excellent!
Beautiful and scenic view; wonderful atmosphere; service was friendly; filet was dry despite asking for "medium" temperature. Cocktails "fair." I have had less expensive meals with better food.
EVERYTHING WAS HANDLED SEAMLESSLY. THE AMBIANCE, FOOD AND DECOR WERE OUTSTANDIG.THE SERVICE WAS SPECIAL.HIGHLY RECOMMENDED FOR A SPECIAL EVENING OR OCCASION.
Our out of town guests were very impressed and thoroughly enjoyed the food, service and ambience.
Food was great, but the service was not very good.
Our new favorite steakhouse. We love that it didn't just have traditional steakhouse items and loved the Asian infused Flavors.

Food was outstanding..particularly the shrimp salad side dish. Our waiter was Greg and he was delightful.

We have eaten here before...and the only criticism I could make is that you do not honor what you request..such as...a particular table outdoors when you request it 3 WEEKS in advance....AND ...you are a hotel overnight guest. We were informed there were no outdoor tables available to us at all...and it was our anniversary. This has happened to us twice. That's awfully strange. They couldn't all be taken. Saving them for????

This time it was January so we did not even request an outdoor table...and the evening was great.
The 5-course sample with wine pairing is highly recommended!

First. Visit for my Birthday and it won't be my last, everything from the service to the views to the food was exceptional! Looking forward to our next visit! The sauce they seve with the steaks were so wonderful on the tongue great flavors!
One minor disappointment was the buns that they serve to everyone found the presentation nice but it lacked in flavor!
Great food, great service and an excellent view of the city. But all this comes at a price! It was well worth it to me and my party of 6.

First time there. Ate early to see the sun set. Great wine, yummy warm rolls brought from the oven to your table, calamari app was perfect, 8 oz filets melted in your mouth, mac n cheese side was fun. Thanks to J&G for the on the house birthday cheesecake! Look forward to returning for another special occasion.
Excellent food and service.  Great views of city.  A fine dining experience.  Outstanding!
Excellent service and food.  Wonderful!  Gorgeous views of city.

Let me start by saying that we took a shot in the dark on this because we were traveling from out of town and thought we might like to have a nice steak dinner to celebrate New Years Eve. We thought of some of the more well known chain steak houses but they were already booked for the evening. We checked on Open Table and found we could go here at a appropriate time. We had no idea what to expect since we had never heard of this place before. We ordered off the special New Years Eve menu and it was terrific. The combination of flavors that were incorporated into every course was outstanding. The cut of meat was out of this world and very good. I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking for an extraordinary meal.
This is by far my favorite restaurant in the area. The food is sublime and the view is unparalleled.
great view, steaks and service!

Recommend for view only. Otherwise just average, especially considering the menu and wine prices. Plus, our experience included four unruly kids running around in the bar with their loud mother periodically hollering at them as she swigged back another drink!

The entire experience was very good from the service to food to scenery. I must say the Sole was a little chewy, more chewy than we had expected. We had hoped it would be more tender.

Other than than everything was good.

Thank you,
Will be sure ti go there again soon..it was fantastic!
It was okay, but we still really miss Mary Elaine's (the restaurant J&G replaced). J&G doesn't have the upscale ambiance, but it does have the upscale price. The food was very good, though.
Wonderful away from home Christmas dinner. We were not rushed or waiting for courses...just a perfect mix. Thank-you for a memorable experience!

Great evening with friends. Food was really delicious and service was good.My wife and I will go back there again.As a matter of fact we have eaten at J & G around 8 or 9 times with friends. It is a beautiful place to bring friends for a meal.
This is one of our favorite special occasion restaurants. We travel 35 miles to enjoy their wonderful dining experience.
Was memorable for business guset and their spouse.

We enjoyed our meal, although it was nothing exceptional considering the reviews. No complaints with the food or service. However, the weather had turned suddenly cold and the air conditioning was still running. It was frigid in the dining room and several requests to alter the temperature brought no improvement. I spent most of the evening bundled in my coat. AND, brown PAPER placemats....really??????

the food is very good but not so fantastic that I will tell everyone. My guest and I enjoyed most of what was offered but we found something lacking. The lamb chops were large but so fatty I could not eat 50% of the meat and at $40 for the entree, that was not acceptable. It did not appear the waiter noticed I left them. My guest had the same reaction to his steak.
Do try the mac and cheese. Yummy stuff and special.

Dined here two nights in a row because of the shrimp and avocado salad, the views and the service.
