Although I was stating at the Phoenician Hotel, I had reservations at different "best restaurants" around town. After my first bite of the salad, I knew I needed to cancel my next reservations and return. It was so good!

It was very nice and the food was perfect, if unimaginative. Tuna tartare, mushroom risotto, molten chocolate cake...been there, done that BUT it's the perfect execution of those dishes. For a solid "fancy" dinner with no surprises, J & G fits the bill. It was a birthday celebration and the card from the kitchen was a nice touch.

Fabulous views of the city. Very pretty dining space. The food and service were excellent. We were celebrating 2 birthdays so they gave us 2 outstanding desserts which the entire table (there were 7 of us) shared.

Although very tasty, I did not find the food to be extraordinary. I have had more palate pleasing experiences elsewhere. Would I return? No. Did I enjoy the evening? Yes. The service was absolutely outstanding, but the meal just did not compare to that level.

excellent ambiance-modern, but warm decor. sea bass was good, NY peppercorn steak was very good but the chocolate Soufflé with vanilla ice cream substituted was excellent. nice ending to a great evening dining al fresco.
Food was not nearly as good as New York.

We celebrated my wife's birthday here recently. I cannot overstate how perfect the evening was. The Phoenician is located right next to/ within Camelback Mountsin. The view is unmatched. The resort itself was immaculate and gorgeous as we drove up to the guardhouse. The security guard was extremely pleasant and helpful in letting us know how to get to valet parking and where the steakhouse was located once we entered the resort. The valets were also extremely pleasant and again discussed how to best access the steakhouse. The steakhouse was gorgeous. The staff was incredibly knowledgable. The food was outstanding. There was never a moment where we felt not taken care of. They went above and beyond for my wife's birthday. We will be back.
Always enjoyable. The ginger margaritas are a big hit.
The restaurant and view are beautiful. The food and the service are okay, but not at that price.
fillets not cooked to order initally and and upon second request. Medium well order cooker rare and mediam rare.
Great decor, outstanding food, superb view and pleasant/attentive service! highly recommended.

The place looks nice and views are wonderful but the food is just OK, desserts are uninspired. The seafood tower is nice. BLT and Mastro's are much better for the same prices.

FYI any hotel food and beverage credit cannot be used in there, this should be made clear to hotel guests.

Was working in Scottsdale and had my mother out for a weekend. We went to the J&G Steakhouse for dinner one night, outstanding! We both went with the tasting menu and wine pairing. It was one of the best meals of our lives! Great outdoor seating with a great view as well.

Too noisy, seating configures for mostly business groups more than quiet dinners with a lovely ambiance. Greet staff young, didn't offer better seating until asked. Server tentative when asked about wine even though he held himself out as knowledgable.

We had a lovely time at the restaurant---celebrate two birthdays and were surprised with cards and a dessert on behalf of the restaurant. The staff were very attentive. We really appreciated the lovely view and the ambiance---quiet. We could carry on a conversation without screaming:)
Beautiful view. Good food and drinks

Came alone this particular night. Would have loved to have my wife with me. Exquisite steak. Probably one of the best cuts I've had in a while. I'm not really sure what the other raters were complaining about the wait staff... To me, a single person in a rather nice steakhouse, they really treated me well. No issues to address and overall excellent experience. Highly recommend and especially nice if you have someone special to take with you there!

My daughter and I were treated royally our whole evening. It was my 75th Birthday, and I feel everything was done to make me feel special.
The birthday card was a special touch,our waiter Christopher was the absolute best, the whole experiece we had will have us returning at the next excuse for a dinner to remember!
Service was outstanding. Our waiter was very engaging and friendly. We always receive great service everytime we visit.

I wanted to have a nice anniversary meal with my boyfriend and this place hit the spot! We sat outside, and just in time for the sun set, it was amazingly romantic and calming. The service was fast and efficient, we never had to wait for anything and the food came at a reasonable time. Everything was delicious, cooked to perfection. I couldn't have asked for more.

Our server Christian was friendly and knowledgeable, as was the backwaiter. Oysters were delish; they had 6 or 7 types to choose from, including one i had never tried before. i eat a lot of oysters, so i was pleasantly surprised. my hubby and i shared the ribeye. it was cooked perfectly. we initially planned to only have drinks outside and watch the sunset and go elsewhere for dinner but i'm glad we ended up ordering some snacks.
Overall, great service but my wife and I shared a $110 steak and easily finished it--$110 should buy you more steak than you can eat in one sitting.

Beautiful restaurant, fabulous staff, excellent wine pairing, the food was hit or miss (did the tasting menu). First course - meh. Second course - amazing. Third course - meh. Fourth course - steak, better not mess that up ;). Fifth course - good.
Greg was an excellent server and he helped make our date a wonderful experience.

I had expected more. The most notable feature of this restaurant is the view of the city. The food was okay -- I had the lobster and my date had the filet mignon. The lobster was bland. The filet was quite good. The side dishes were mediocre -- sized well for sharing, but nothing exceptional.
The butternut squash soup was very good and was the highlight of my meal. The crispy calamari was average.
The menu selections for entrees were more limited than I had hoped. The wine list offered a wide range of options at various price points.
Overall, for a special night out, this would be a fine restaurant. However, I doubt that I'll be going back anytime soon.

Salads were served before our waiter could find the wine. Dinner served quickly thereafter. Not a relaxing meal. Waiter was attentive but too concerned with impressing us than meeting our needs, namely enjoying a meal on vacation that was very expensive.

Overall, a fine experience, however my steak came out way overlooked, but they graciously replaced it. The lighting is somewhat peculiar, an intense halogen bulb shining down on our booth, making it feel way too warm. If I were the manager I would have comped something given the wrong temperature of the first steak. By the time I received the correct one my wife was already finished with her meal.

J&G Steakhouse has an outstanding menu with an outstanding staff who were there for our every need. Our meals were delicious from the tuna tartare and steamed shrimp salad to the grilled beef tenderloin and finishing with their pear brown butter cake and warm chocolate cake. We couldn't have asked for a better evening.

We had dinner here during Restaurant Week and it was the highlight of our experiences. The service was so professional and non-intrusive. We were made to feel very welcome and were given just the right amount of assistance and attendance. The food was fabulous! The noise was a bit loud as there was a group of people close behind us who were having quite a good time without their spouses. I highly recommend the restaurant and look forward to our next visit.
One of the best steaks ever
Brought out of town guests for their anniversary and they loved the food!

It was our first time there and we would go back. The staff were very attentive, the food was well presented and well prepared but the atmosphere was lacking. Very few people were eating there, even though it was restaurant week here in Scottsdale.
This is a true fine dinning restaurant, service was gracious and personal.Food prep was spot on.Very enjoyable dinner. Will return many times.

It was a wonderful time, my husband celebrated his birthday and we truly enjoyed our experience. If I were to go again, I would probably avoid happy hour for a more romantic experience. The music (though wonderful) was a bit too loud and the people in the bar were trying to talk over the musicians, which made for a very loud environment. The staff were attentive and the food was exquisite. We won't wait so long between visits next time.
Perfect experience
Impeccable service delivered fresh ingredients superbly prepared. We had an outstanding dinner.

I often have difficulty in rating steak houses. Like breakfast places, with a limited menu there is less separation amongst the good ones. J and G is exceptional. The service was great, steaks cooked exactly as ordered, and the view simply the best in Phoenix. A good wine list is expected, but the half price second bottle was unbeatable! I'm not sure that program will be offered "in season".

This was a birthday celebration for my husband. The restaurant made this very special with a card and birthday wishes on his dessert plate. They went out of their way which was appreciated. We are very pleased with this restaurant.

J&G Steakhouse....BEST VIEW IN THE VALLEY. Its just located on the 5th Floor of The Phoenician Resort off of Camelback Mountain. The food is delicious, the service is outstainding, the mood is set for ANY occasion, and it's really the place to be. Our favorite dish as an appetizer is the heirloom tomato salad. We ALWAYS get the parmesan crusted chicken for our entree with a side of potato gratin with comte cheese...you have to try it!

We had an excellent dinner at J&G Steakhouse, from the ambiance to the entrees. First-rate, well-prepared steaks, excellent seafood and an appetizer -- corn ravioli -- that was a great way to start the evening. But, more than anything, the staff took care of every need possible throughout the two-hour meal. Plus, it was a special evening, and the staff made it a very memorable night. Anyone who enjoys great food, excellent service and scenic view of the Valley should check out J&G Steakhouse. However, I would strongly encourage diners to specify the patio or a table near the windows. Otherwise, it would be like going to SF for the first time and never looking at the Golden Gate. Nice, but not quite the same.

I normally order the prix fixe menu but if you want to just order a main dish and add sides that will also be a great way to go. Do yourself a favor and order the tuna tartare for an appetizer. It is exquisite. The service is perfect. No one hovers but you never have to ask for more water, etc. A super view as well!

J&G Steakhouse was fabulous! We couldn't have had a better anniversary. Our waiter was superb, and the food was even better. A few suggestions: try the sweet and sour pork belly, the BBQ flat iron steak, and the raspberry pavlova. Amazing dishes! Thanks J&G for the great memories!

We had the tasting menu, which is a great way to have a little bit of everything. We loved the corn ravioli dish. Every dish was layered with flavor. We did not care too much for the spinach side dish. We assume it to be a mint flavor that overpowered the flavor of the spinach.
They also have a neighborhood menu for the summer. Although we did not order from this menu, they allowed us to order the cucumber soup. It was delicious.
The service is very attentive. It offers a nice view of the city.

It was our anniversary, we asked for a window table. They were taken. We were seated next to where the servers get their supplies and stand waiting to clear plates. It was uncomfortable. The bread was one of those 99 cent for a dozen kind that are sold at the holidays, and it was hard and stale. The Caesar salad was terrible, way too much lemon.My husband's steak was fairly good. I was looking forward to going to this restaurant, but will not return. The view is spectacular though.

Great dining experience except there was a type of Journal Club going on that evening with a large number of people standing and drinking in the back of the restaurant. They were so loud that my party of 5 were actually yelling across the table to be heard. About halfway through dinner they began to dissipate.
Did not quite meet the expectations of a JG restaurant. Food was mediocre and needs to be improved to match the level of competition in Scottsdale.

Excellent food and gorgeous views to the south of Camelback mountain. As the resort is butted up against the mountain, it doesn't afford views to the north or to the west while dining to actually see the sunset which was what we were, admittedly maybe ignorantly, hoping to see while dining. Regardless, service was fantastic as was the overall ambiance. Mercedes was our server and she was very knowledgeable and provided spot-on recommendations. If there was one, a negative we experienced was the noise from the screaming kids at the huge pool down below that the outdoor seating sits directly atop and looks down over. They also happened to be playing a kids movie on a projector screen at the pool which didn't help our cause. Overall: A-/B+
A delitefull place to dine. A notch up from most places.

Overall the experience was nice. The tuna tartare was quite good but the asparagus risotto was fair. Risotto can be a challenge for even the finest kitchens. Theirs did not earn my adoration. The servers seemed awkward and our primary waiter was either new, not experienced, wasn't paying attention or something else was on his mind. He struggled to remember our orders and told my wife, when she ordered the hangar steak, that it was "gamey" tasting. Not a very appealing or accurate way to describe the cut, or the menu item. It was delicious and well cooked...and not gamey tasting. Wine list was pedestrian, and typically overpriced. Despite what may read as complaints, we had a nice meal and a very nice experience, including a beautiful view.
The service was superior and the food was excellent
it was a great place to take someone from out of town. the view was amzazing!
Wonderful atmosphere, excellent food and value.

Everything was amazing. Only issue we had, was that our sauteed spinach was sauteed in mint and basil, which was not explained on the menu. We sent it back, and they happily replaced it with regular sauteed spinach. Gorgeous view, must sit outside on the patio.

After reading prior reviews we were hesitant to make a reservation, many said the food/service was not good. Fortunately we made them. The food was spectacular & the service was excellent. We had the restaurant week menu & the tasting menu. The beef tenderloin served with the restaurant menu was the highlight but the tasting menu's variety was perfect. The pea soup & asparagus appetizer are also notable. We sat inside but they have a really nice patio/bar. The view of the sunset from inside or outside is beautiful. Regarding service it was excellent. The waiter was very polite & provided good wine pairing suggestions. The beef tenderloin was undercooked but before we could even say anything the manager was asking if it was too rare.

We go to J&G at least 5 times a year. Each is always a treat. The menu changes, the staff waits until there is a break in conversation before approaching the table. The food is prepared with a little twist and that makes it much better then 'home cooking' and they do not rush you out. Very nice.

As you expect Jean Georges delivers. The Steakhouse is no exception. Using the finest ingredients the chefs produce very good food which is matched by very good service make for a great dining experience. Worth a visit.

We visited J&G during restaurant week and they really impressed us! The food was outstanding and the view was magnificent. We would definitely go back again for dinner and we have plans to check out the Thursday night Happy Hour at the bar.
We tried all of the Restaurant Week menu items and all of them were very good. We will come back again to order off the regular menu - many items sound very good!
We went for Restaurant Week and enjoyed ourselves. There is always concern that standards will be lowered for RW, but we were quite satisfied, and would like to return.
Good food but barely acceptable service

One word - Disappointing.

I decided to take my husband here for his birthday and because they were also participating in restaurant week. Also, they have great happy hour specials on Thursdays. Perfect.

First, I had requested on my reservation to seat us in a great seat with a view since it was a special occasion. They sat us in the back of the restaurant. Next, I ask for the happy hour menu and our waiter says happy hour is only in the lounge. So we couldn't get any drink specials which was annoying. Then we were brought out some crusty old stale rolls that were cold and hard and I immediately sent them back and requested fresh ones.

I ordered from the restaurant week menu and my meal was great. It is the only reason I'm giving 2
totally enjoyed our dinner at your restaurant. We had a group of five and we all tried different items on the menu.
We enjoyed our whole dining experience.

We went to J & G Steakhouse because of Restaurant Week. We knew it would be very good and a special night out, however; it even exceed our expectations. The food was delicious and prepared perfectly, nice portions and beautifully presented. We ordered the Tuna Tartre as an appetizer. We all agreed, it was awesome. The service was excellent. We will definitely be back.

Our servers were friendly, welcoming and very attentive. My dessert was excellent and cappuccino was perfect (esp. temperature). Very relaxed yet romantic atmosphere. We would definitely come back on the next Restaurant Week.

I was disappointed. My steak was overdone and dry and I ordered my filet "medium" and the ambiance had a 1970's feel. I was truly looking forward to going to J&G as I had been to Mary Elaine's and had such wonderful memories of a culinary treat.

The dinner menu includes more than just standard steakhouse fare. We ordered 5 different entrees. There were no duds.

The night time view of the city is really pretty.

Desserts were good, but were very conventional (carrot cake, molten chocolate cake, etc).
The view could only be exceeded by wonderful food and service. PERFECT IN EVERY WAY!!!

Fabulous food, excellent service and great views.
J&G's is expensive but elegant and worth it especially for a special occasion.

Sides are very small and prices are higher than before. Not willing to accommodate customers requests. I made our reservation a week early and requested a table on the patio. The day of our reservation I called and was told 'we have walk-ins', so we can not reserve a table on the patio. I had a similar experience a few months ago when trying to plan a birthday party here. Lots of rules. For this type of restaurant, they should be more flexible.
Excellent service at a gorgeous resort. Everything was great except my bone in filet was a little under cooked

open table messed up! reservation for 11 was the 15th of April as stated in your conformation email, but you gave the rest. April 16th. They were very surprised to see 11 people. I doubt I will use you again
Exceptional service! We will definitely return and will recommend to our friends and family.

Our dinner for our group of four could have been perfect if we had been seated at a different table. Our table was at one end of the restaurant near the door to the patio. It was a round table with two chairs and a long bench for the other two diners. This geometry doesn't work, and the architect/designer should have to correct this problem. The dining experience for the two people on the bench was awful for two reasons. One is that they sit slightly lower than the two in the chairs. The other, much worse reason is that they had to keep their body at an angle to be able to eat their food. We all took turns sitting at these two seats and all agreed that it was an unacceptable level of discomfort.
The Steamed Shrimp Salad is to die for. I had my first bone-in filet, and it was the best steak I have ever tasted. I can't wait to go back!
We are JG fans from NYC - particularly Jo Jo - and this didn't disappoint. The tasting menu was very very good and a lot of food / good value.

The Porterhouse Steak and the Dover Sole were throughly enjoyed by my wife and myself.
Service is totally professional as is the entire operation of the reestaurant. A GREAT PLACE.
Excellent Jean-George steakhouse, with great valley views and superior quality food. Not cheap, however.

Amazing place and great food. Pricey but worth every penny. If you are able to snag the place around the sunset time, it is adoring. The Merlot that had on the menu was divine with the short ribs and salmon we ordered. The grilled mushrooms, porterhouse and the lamb chops my friends ordered were melting in my mouth as if i was eating them. Have to go back!
Have only gone to J&G once, and it really was outstanding. Ordered Dover Sole - delicious. Really, food, service, ambiance were all top.

Really disappointing. We have eaten at our JG resturants...the food was AWFUL. We are frequent diners of Flemings and Maestros so we do know our steakhouses. First of all, PAPER placemats. Same cocktail came in 3 different glasses. ---if you are going to charge a lot of money...get it right. The tuna tartar was the best thing of all of the items ordered. The caesar salad was blah and almost had a sour taste.. The Sea Bass was SO rubbery. It had to be frozen or maybe old or going bad. 3 of us had it and none of us could eat it. One in our party had the steak which he sent back to get cooked more. the side dishes were about the level you would expect at an olive garden or chilis. I would never go back. ever. bad.
Like all high end steak joints, it is expensive and the waiters are constantly talking and selling.
Our return visit was as good, if not better than our previous dinners here.

Beware the size of the Tasting Menu. Portion sizes are close to full size and amazing. Try not to fill up on the buttery bread, if you can. Ahi appetizer refreshing, ample, and delicious. I thought the ginger would be too strong but it gave enough kick. Sea bass needs to stay on the menu until the end of time. Perfectly cooked and tender. The only critique was the overwhelming noise level. Ask for a booth near the window.

Our dinner was excellent, the service was perfect, and the atmosphere was quite fun. Unfortunately, it was very expensive (though not unexpected) and my husband and I have gotten so good at this ourselves that we can prepare almost as good a meal at home for a fraction of the price.

We stayed at the Phoenician so it was easy and convenient. The service was good although we couldn't understand if our server was new or nervous about speaking in front of others. He was prompt and attentive though. The food was very good. The view was beautiful. It was a cool evening so we only stayed outside by the fire pit for a short time but I bet this is very enjoyable when the weather is warmer. The bar/lounge area is very comfortable and a great place for a drink before or after dinner. I think it's worth the drive out here for dinner whether or not you're staying at the hotel. The only issue we had is that some of the booths leave you almost eating in the dark. Low light is romantic but darkness not so much.
The place was outstanding except for unruly children running around out of control on the outdoor patio.

This restaurant is the perfect combination of delicious food, wonderful atmosphere & view and great service. We were celebrating my 50th birthday, and it couldn't have been more memorable. The heirloom tomato salad was the best I've had. My filet was perfectly cooked. The asparagus, broccoli & gratin potato sides were to die for. In addition to a fabulous wine list, the wine selection by the glass was more than ample. I only wish we lived closer to this amazing steakhouse!

VERY disappointed in the service. We felt we were invisible. Stood at the bar for over 20 minutes trying to get a drink before being seated with no luck. Another 10 mins at the table before anyone greeted us. Would have expected much more from a high end restaurant within a Starwood property. The food was very good, but the service killed it...
All four of us had the tasting choice on menu. The manager Andre came to table and one guest was not happy with starter so he let him try something else he loved.
Wonderful ambiance, creative and innovative menu, and attentive service!
Steak was excellent with a great sauce. The service was effecient but not overly freiendly. The atmosphere is wonderful with great views!

Celebrated my birthday here. Noted on my res and hostess greeted us wish a smile and wished me a happy birthday. Pastry chef created my favorite as a house standard, surprise, lava cake after dinner with candle and with the most amazing caramel ice cream. Fabulous menu, cocktails, view, staff and wine list. :))))))
Food was excellent. If a quite romantic ambiance is a priority look elsewhere. At capacity it takes on a cafeteria feel. However, if you want great views and have an group dinner this is the place.
We enjoyed it very much! Food was great. I really enjoyed the Ginger Margarita. The desserts were amazing! Don't miss trying the lava cake and carrot cake!

Best part of the meal was the steaks -- nicely prepared. Essentially what you'd expect of a good steakhouse. Salads (Caesar, wedge) and sIdes (roasted mushrooms, creamed spinach) were well below average. Roasted mushrooms had a strong vinegary flavor. Caesar left much to be desired. It was essentially chopped romaine with what tasted like a bottled Caesar dressing. Blue cheese dressing on wedge had an off, almost mustard-like flavor. Server was not particularly warm or helpful, responding to questions with mostly one-word answers and seeming a bit apathetic. This is, apparently, a Jean-Georges Vongerichten-affiliated restaurant. Perhaps Chef JG should stage a kitchen intervention.

Paper placemats, $40. steaks. While the staff set another table for the next days customer we waited having finished our meal, poorly trained staff. If you want to experience the top restaurant at the Phoenician you had better hurry...the management is killing this place. The management is not watching the uneven experience being given to its customers. Our meal lasted 3 hours...7:30-10:30, much of it waiting for someone to clear our plates. While ordering a pepper steak was told about the 5 sauces....ok that could be interesting, yet they only bought 3...I asked about the waiter stated 5. Several minutes later someone shows up with additional 2, interesting when he left it was not stated that another 2 would be brought out.
Everything was very one note on the tasting menu. The whole of the menu, including desert, tasted like ginger.
Great service, great menu, great wine list, great atmosphere, great people. You won't be disappointed!

Our experience at J&G was very amazing to say the least. The food was incredible as was the view. The only really downside which wasnt as bad as it may seem but enough to make a note of it was the service. Our waiter was very knowledgable on the food and specials but unfortunately was not very attentative to us at times. At point, I think we may have been sitting for at least 10 minutes with empty wine glasses not once but twice. Again, however, the ambiance and food definitely made up for it. Thanks J&G
Beautiful view and wonderful service!

I avoid most places on Valentines day, but not J&G's, Our Evening was wonderful as always! Chose J&G's for Valentines Day because I knew they would be the rare exception. In addition to the creative menu, they emphasize the dinning experience regardless of the holiday. While everyone else is focused on limited menues to streamline the evening in attempt to maximize their ability to turn tables sacrificing quality for profit, J&G's did not compromise their quality or the experience.
very good experience. food was good, service was adequate and the view was wonderful. Would do it again
Had a great anniversary dinner. Everything was perfect. Would highly recommend visiting this great restaurant.

I loved the ambiance of the restaurant! The interior decor was very modern and the scenic view was fabulous. The service was great - our servers were very attentive and friendly, but were not overbearing. And of course the food .. absolutely delicious. We had warm oysters with basil, potato and wasabi which had a nice kick to it and our filets were cooked so that it melted in your mouth. Overall great experience!

The atmosphere, service, and view were fantastic. The food was unimpressive, however, and the portion sizes lacking (we all ordered the Valentine's Day menu). Despite our disappointment with the food on that particular night, our overall experience was positive enough that we will return to J&G Steakhouse again in the future.
Great Restaurant food was excellent service was perfect.
We had a wonderful evening starting out in the lounge for happy hour and then moving into the dining room for dinner. Everything was exceptional.
Food good but not great. Steaks mediocre. Sides, soup and salad were very good.
Above average food. Horrific service. Totally ignored. Long wait between courses and no one ever checked on us to see if we needed everything or if the food was to our liking.

We had an amazing night because of the view, service and food. Very attentive service but never intrusive. Go early enough to sit outside and watch the sunset! we also were able to sit outside to eat and enjoy the wonderful weather and view. Presentation of the food was nice and timed perfectly. We will definitely be back.
This is constantly one of the best restaurants in Scottsdale. Everything is always perfectly executed with great attention to detail. The service is up there with the best in the city.

Beautiful setting. Second time there since it first opened. Both times it seemed as if we were trying to find our waiter. Service very slow even though place was less than half full. Other local steakhouses are more attentive to their tables

Having dined here before, our party of 4 was expecting a quality meal and unfortunately we were disappointed. All four of us had serious issues with the food and service. The onion soup was mushy, the crabcakes would have been good except that they were floating in a not so tasty liquid leaving the bottom 3rd of them soggy. One person's steak was burnt to a cinder. Even the baked potatoes were overcooked and dry. On top of this the service was lackluster at best and refills on wine and iced tea were hard to come by. This was suprising since on previous occasions the service had been outstanding. This restaurant has nice ambiance and a great view but it doesn't make up for poor food and inadequate service.

For some reason I expected more from a Jean-George reastaurant. My steak was slightly over cooked and for the price being charged that's not acceptable.

It was my wife's and my 22nd wedding anniversary. A complimentay desert would have been nice. Better experience the following night at "Kai Restaurant"

A Beautiful place at one of the city's top resorts. The ribeye was one of the best i've ever had! Some of the seating indoors is a little cramped. Some are the tables where there's a chair on one side and a booth on the other. I don't think that's the most ideal seating. We were initially seated right next to someone else & it's like we were all in the same conversation. We moved to the patio outdoors under patio heaters, and it was a delightful experience.

Excellent crab cake and lobster. Both were perfectly cooked and presented rather artfully. I'm not so keen on the ambiance when I can see/hear the tvs in the bar. That detracts from the wonderful view.

J&G was lovely and the steaks were excellent. However, the portions were rather small (except for the sized steaks), if one compares with Morton's and Ruth's Chris; both the latter have larger portions for sides and desserts which are ideal for sharing amongst a group. Nice restaurant and stunning view, but we would not dine again or recommend it. We would tell folks that better value is at Morton's or Ruth's Chris.

Things started out well. We were seated on the terrace with a gorgeous view of Scottsdale at night, and while there were other diners, everyone was spaced so that we felt like we had the place to ourselves. Our waiter dropped off menus and a wine list and then...disappeared. Fifteen minutes later, we ordered drinks. Thankfully we ordered our food while ordering our drinks. Ten minutes later, first drinks appeared. Food came in a fairly timely manne, and the back waiter was on his game, but while I saw our waiter chatting amiably with other customers, we barely saw him. Had to put a second drink order in with the water guy. Food was decent but not very excited and not worth the price. Not going back again.
You cant beat the view but there are many places that prepare a better steak.

Appetizers were fantastic, and main courses were excellent, although both my Wife and Son's filets were dry (and we ordered medium-rare for my Son). My only gripe, a common one for nice restaurants, is we get treated like second-class citizens when we bring our kids, especially when it comes to our tables.
Best meal we have ever had. Service was top notch.
This was a fantastic place to eat at. All aspects of the place were great. We will put this high on our list to return --- especially for special ocassions.

There is a menu item which is a sampler of their cuisine with a matched wine... this is an excellent offering... the wines are excellently matched with the course... they do a very good job of the courses and the presentation... one of the best I've experienced...
Service is always impeccable and the food is top-notch. If you are looking for an incredible steak, this is the place. If not, it's still the place, as there are plenty of other options on the menu.

Great bar selection and good food. Service not great. Waited for our reservation table for long time...despite few people in restaurant, for whatever reason. Greeter was not friendly. Table service was slow and not very kind or knowledgeable.
Food was one of the best I've ever had!

Hands down, best NY Strip I've ever had! That peppercorn sauce was OUTSTANDING! You could tell the high quality of ingredients used. The Mushroom dish was also out of this world!! Service was excellent and they accomodated an exchange without a question.
It is always a pleasure to dine here. The steaks are outstanding.
We had a wonderful meal and evening.

We had the absolute worst time on Thanksgiving!  We were promised earlier in the day a table with a view - in person we were promised - and we were put at a table in the flow of waiter traffic!  Yes, we complained.  Nothing.  AND we watched the table we were promised stay VACANT the entire time.  SHAME on the Phoenician!  We were guests at the very expensive hotel...we will never go back.
Outstanding flavors, service and ambience. A really outstanding restaurant - which as great fish as well as steaks.

I took my wife here for our anniversary after reading good reviews. We ordered the tasting menu with the matching wine pairings. The service was OK, our server forgot to give us wine and she was not around enough for us to ask her when we needed things. The food was OK, way overpriced. I wrote down that it was our anniversay in the notes section when I made the reservation online but my anniversary was not acknowledged at all! I even mentioned it to the hostess, no congratulations or anything! No comment from the server at all and nothing special done!! This is just unacceptable for a "high-end" place! I spent $200 for OK service and OK food, never again!

Went for our wedding anniversary and wasn't a very good experience. Stood at bar for 10 minutes and never got acknowledged or offered a drink. Noticed someone serving cocktails and didn't get asked for drink order or even said hello to while sitting at cocktail table. Sat in bar for 20 minutes and never got acknowledged or offered a drink. Asked to sit down early and explained to hostess we couldn't get bartenders service or cocktail waiters service and was rudley told that wasn't a cocktail waiter but rather the manager. Food was at par level and steak ordered medium and came out rare. Server never asked if steak was cooked properly. Left 3/4 of it on plate and when cleared never was asked how it was.

Celebrated my mom's birthday. This was my second time there. The view is outstanding. The food is great, service was a bit slow. Not sure why. I don't remember that happening the first time I dined there. Overall however, a great experience. Highly recommend it. We will return.
food was excellent, service was very good, nice presentation, view was awesome
We were disappointed in our food, we expected better. Also we sat for 25 minutes after the table was cleared for our check. We were celebrating our 48th wedding anniversary and were disappointed.

J&G has amazing food and ambiance. The service always leaves something to be desired!!
I have dined there at least 20 times and everytime the service is poor. Management is indifferent to the issue and never responds when I send a note to the restaurant.

AWESOME FOOD!!!!
One of our favorites!

Came to dinner on our last night in Scottsdale. Everything was wonderful from the service to the incredible food. The only disappointment was not getting to sit outside due to a dust storm that blew in right before we arrived. Of course this is no fault to the restaurant, we were just looking forward to the scenic view while dining.If you want an enjoyable first or last meal while on vacation, come here with your sweetie....you won't be disappointed.

The Phoenician is a top shelf restaurant in more ways than one, scenic beauty of the best views in Scottsdale, and incredible culinary art. Although my steak was exceptional, I tried my friend's lamb and I instantly realized I should have ordered that. Then I tried my wife's fish and felt the same way. Your biggest challenge will be having to pick something off the menu.

For a 4 diamond restaurant I found J&G Steakhouse to have poor service. Very little attention given to the table by the main server and it really bothers me that the server assistants are more attentive and they probably get a small fraction of the gratuity. I had to send my steak back as it was undercooked and had very little flavor. The manager did remove it from my bill.My wife did have the tasting menu and she did enjoy most of her food minus the steak.We were looking forward to a nice anniversary dinner all week and overall it was just not worth it.

I think I just had the greatest steak I ever had in my life. The whole dining experience was wonderful...great service...very friendly people..great views....just loved the whole experience. Very pricey however....

Great dinner at J&G. Restaurant is beautiful, with a terrific view of Scottsdale from its top floor perch. Food was excellent (we had filet mignon and lobster), and served by a very friendly staff. One of the highlights of our trip to Phoenix.
Had a dinner for group of 10.  The food and service was fabulous.  Will definitely go back

For Arizona Restaurant Week, we picked J&G because it's a place that we wouldn't ordinarily think about going. It's not really convenient to where we live and it's pricey. We were glad we did. It was a good way to sample the atmosphere and bar. The place is gorgeous, not at all what we expected at The Phoenician. Not stuffy. And tables were full at 10 p.m., not typical for Phoenix, where we're often the last people in a place because we like to dine late. The Restaurant Week menu was simple but elegant. I had salmon; my partner had the steak & frites. More memorable was the stellar service. We're already trying to figure out a date to go back and try the regular menu. Maybe before Christmas.

We went for AZ Restaurant Week. They offered a nice selection of foods off of their menu. Everything we had was delicious. The slices of rib-eye steak were cooked to a perfect medium, tender and flavorful. The wait staff were right there when you needed them. I happen to love dessert and the salted caramel ice cream sundae hit the spot. The view is spectacular!

We were very disappointed in the service we received. You should expect to high level of service at a restaurant of this caliber. The food and view were amazing. But, the poor service distracted from the total experience. When you are spending over $400.00 for dinner, you should not have to pour your own Champagne, hale your server for more wine, more water... The server assistants were loud, not smooth and not properly trained. We were not offered coffee or after dinner drinks... J&G should be the gold standard. They fall short!!

J&G Steakhouse has truly become one of my favorite restaraunts. It actually is the place that me and my fiance visited on our 2-year anniversary, and also where we went after he proposed (he proposed in the Orchid Garden of the Phoenician resort). So needless to say, J&G has a special place in my heart. We visited this weekend for my dad's birthday, and it was spectacular once again! Renee is the BEST waitress there! We were waited on once by someone else, and we asked the hostess to make a note that from now on we only want to sit in Renee's section. If you visit you MUST ask for her, she will make your experience unforgettable. There is nothing bad to say about this restaraunt...so for your next special occasion - go and check it out!

Unfortunately, this was just another example of a renowned chef putting his name on a very average resort/hotel steakhouse. Long gone are the glory days of formal dining at Mary Elaines -- replaced by a dark, overly casual steakhouse and bar. If I want to have a T.V. next to my dining area showing sports, I'll go to a sports bar. Tables adorned with paper place mats were reminiscent of Applebees or Chilis. Service was slow and relatively inattentive -- perhaps because of crowds for AZ restaurant week. While the steak was good, it was not memorable -- and many of the finer steakhouses in the Valley are better. The french fries were completely bland and over-salted -- we jokingly agreed they could have come from MacDonalds.
The view is spectacular! In cooler weather we would love to eat on the patio. Their Restaurant Week menu was very good and we have decided to return for our anniversary dinner.
Very nice; not really exceptional in any way, but definitely good food and decent service. Very loud bar area, too loud to stay there, but the dining area was a little quieter.
Great food, service and ambiance.
We went for restaurant week in Arizona

I love the menu!! The way the Chef's add herbs to make something simple so distinct is my favorite!!! Good and professional service and the new GM is very friendly! There was a family there with children that decided to cry and make a scene and I don't enjoy that...not the restaurants fault!

Love Love Love!!!

This quality of experience does not credit JG. His in house chef has credit deserving far more than this offering and I hope he finds that place. The Phoenician has lost of lot of my business over the year or so because of this and previoius visit gone poor...Loud party tables; babies screaming, customer in shorts, t-shirt and flip flops demanding the best tables (even though they were full!), captains dropping items constantly...all of this obstacle course to wend our way toward excellent food, No, not year anymore, there are very bettter atmostphere here in the valley that offer the same quality food or more. Let the JG menu flow here and move the steaks to the back. Let your chef excel and forget about the steak house fad!
An excellent selection of steaks and seafood. The desserts are delicious. The view is breathtaking.

Overall would rate it a "C". Really wanted to like the place. It started well...The location and the overall layout are excellent. The bartender offered us some unique options and we were off and running well. The disappointment was the food. I was there for restaurant week, so please take that with considerations for this review. BUT, you'd think restaurants would want their food to shine during that week. The best part of my meal was the soup. The steak i got for my meal looked like a cut from Denny's. We ended up spending quite a bit mainly because of drinks, but I won't be going back for the food. Maybe just drinks. Service was good to start, but once we were done with our meal it vanished. I ended up getting my own water.

We were dazzled by the ambiance and views of this restaurant! Watching the sunset and seeing the twinkling city lights in this gorgeous, upscale restaurant is an unforgettable experience! We were impressed by the pleasant, attentive wait staff. The delicious food, done to perfection, exceeded our expectations! My husband's ribeye steak was wonderful, and my salmon was excellent. The popcorn topped chocolate caramel ice cream sundae was amazing! This was a fantastic dining experience, and we will return! If you want to impress your guests, this is the place to come!

Although the food was excellent, the service was pompous and condescending. I was also disappointed that although we had informed the restaurant that we were there to celebrate our 35th wedding anniversary, there was no acknowledgement in terms of particularly nice table or a small food token (for example, when we celebrated our 25th at the exceptional Janos in Tucson, we were provided with a "Happy 25th Anniversary" cookie at the end of our meal - despite the fact that the date was the horrific 9/11/01).
Second time there perhaps more outstanding than the first.

Food was excellent as usual, the service was sadly lacking this evening. I felt the wait staff was stretched, (it was a busy night) but we felt the lack of attention, it just wasn't up to the usual standard, which was sad since we were there with out of town guests.
The noise level in the dining room was attrocious. For a resturaunt of this calibre, the parties should have been more seperated and the muzak should have been lower.
We originally went to just have a nice dinner out and it turned out to be one of our best dates. Everything was perfect about our experience at J&G Steakhouse.

We spent a lot of time planning our restaurant choices for our recent trip to Scottsdale. It was difficult to settle on a steakhouse, as there are many of them in the region. We chose J&G Steakhouse and were blown away. A great resort, a beautiful restaurant with top on the line service and outstanding food. Surprisingly, the item that blew us away that most was the cream corn. I think it's because we didn't expect much, but even the cream corn at J&G is amazing (combined with peppers and lime). Also, the Veal Porterhouse was exceptional. Thick cut, bone in and prepared perfectly. Try J&G without hesitation.

The food and service were great! My only complaint is that requesting a "medium well" steak yields more of a "medium" steak in terms of center pinkness. We had to send the steak back to the grill for a few minutes but the wait staff and management were apologetic and accommodating. We would eat here again and recommend it to friends.

It was a great place to celebrate our wedding anniversary. We had a billing issue, and the manager promised to follow up. The next day we had a phone call from him and were satisfied with the resolution. Great customer service.
Excellent dining. Beautiful spot for sunset dining. The whole valley is a panoramic view and an excellent full course meal to make a night to remember.
Everything was just ok. We didn't think it was anything special.
The food was absolutely delightful, there wasn't one thing I didn't absolutely love....and our service was wonderful...... a great place to be able to celebrate our anniversary!!!!

E'leece was our server and was terrific! Answered questions about the menu with knowledge and confidence. Polite and had perfect timing. The other service staff members that cleared and brought food/water etc, also very polite and attentive without being over the top or hovering.

Food was perfect. 5 star all the way.
Sweet Pea Soup, Parmesan foam was amazing! Pacific Halibut Summer Vegetable Vinaigrette - perfection! Plus, the desserts were flawless.
New York Strip was done perfect. Sides of Mac N Cheese and Potato Gratin were very good and portioned great for two.
We truly enjoyed this dining experience.

The service was very slow - had to ask for coffee three times. One person asked for scotch on the rocks and sent it back as it was mostly water. One of the side dishes ordered came as we were just about finished with dinner (even though the waitress was reminded). I also ask the waitress to package our steak (that we could not finish) so we could bring it home. I discovered when I took the container out of the bag that they sent me someone else's dinner. I want not happy about that.
Excellent dining experience in the best view room in Scottsdale.
Wow bad service and sub-par food was not what I expected from this beautiful scenic restaurant inside the Phoenician.  Hopefully they'll fail soon enough and someone else will make this beauty shine!

What a special romantic dining experience. The staff was very attentive and appreciative of our needs. The food was outstanding and each dish was beautifully presented. We will definitely return for another special occasion.

Very good food overall. The rolls were tasteless and hard.
Tuna tartar with ginger and avocado outstanding. Ginger cocktail was also great.
Steaks done perfectly. Lava cake underwhelming.
The best meal we had during our brief visit to Scottsdale. Just as you'd expect from a Jean George Restaurant. Excellent food, service, and great atmosphere. Best view in Paradise Valley, bar none.
All courses were wonderful and the presentations were fantastic. We ate outdoors and the view was spectacular.
Food excellent as I would expect for a JG. Room beautiful Only complaint would be the bread--not what you would expect from a high end restaurant--was like something you would buy in a supermarket.

Our experience was exceptional our waiter was courteous and attentive but not intrusive. The views are spectacular the service friendly and helpful. The tuna tartars was wonderful and of course the steaks were exceptional tast wonderful and melted like butter in your mouth would go again for especially for special occasions
we enjoyed the view, service, and food. Everything was lovely.
Outstanding food, great presentation...

Outstanding restaurant. One of the best meals I have had all year and I eat all across the country at least twice a week and often in places known for great food (like New York). Our appetizers (the corm ravioli and the crab cakes) were the absolute best. The most inventive and captivating of their kind I have ever had. And the sweet and sour carrot sauce that came with the salmon dish was awe inspiring. And who would imagine that a carrot cake could be done so well. World class!
A little too pricing for what you get
Trying to be a chic urban restaurant in a secluded quiet resort doesn't work. Bring back Mary Elaine's!

Second try. We were on a tight schedule to get to a play and we were seated 20 minutes late - we were the only ones seated.
The staff was taste testing the new menu so they did not want to seat us.
Ordered a veal chop - came over cooked and did not have time to hav redone due to time limitations.
JG is an impeccable culinary experience. I can't say enough good things about the food and the experience.

We have gone to the Phoenician for many years. Mary Elaines was exceptional. We had to stop at the guard house going in and told the guard we would park ourselves underneath. We were told the parking was full underneath and was told to use the valet parking. So we took his ticket but instead went into the underground parking and there was a ton of empty parking spaces. We parked right in from of the under ground entrance.
We were pleasantly greeted and shown to a table for two. For an upscale restaurant we did not expect ugly paper place mats. I have never been to an upscale restaaurant that did not have table cloths. The ambiance was very drab and uninviting. We frequent the Ocean Club, Donovans, Shulas, Capitol Grille.

J&G was a fine dining establishment. Emphasis on "was". The service was rushed. Servers came 4 times to clear plates. We were in and out in under one hour. Food was average at best. Sad that the premier location in Phoenix serves like a mall restaurant.

I will start by saying that this is not a cheap night out. If you dine here, bring a full wallet. But you do get what you pay for. First-rate service, excellent food and incredible views. If weather permits, ask for a table outside or have an after-dinner drink by one of the two outdoor fireplaces.

A step above your typical "steakhouse". No complaint or constructive advise can be provided. I eat out four nights a week and one or two nights a year go down as memorable. This restaurant made that cut.

Very swanky restaurant on the top floor of an amazing hotel, which makes for some spectacular views from the outdoor tables. I just had the asparagus risotto and mac & cheese, but they were really great. The risotto is green-colored and very creamy, and the mac & cheese is extremely smooth, not lumpy or stringy. The service is very polished and discreet, and the ambiance very romantic.

A good restaurant in a great setting. Not nearly as inventive as one would expect from the Jean George name even when noted as a "steakhouse". If they could match the food and service with the view it could be excellent.

A wonderful and romantic place. I asked my girlfriend to marry me on their patio, and was honored that she accepted. The service was superb, the food was amazing and the atmosphere was very romantic. We'll certainly be coming back!
AWESOME views! And if the weather is good, eat outside, its beautiful!

Having enjoyed Mary Elaine's a few years ago, we were anxious to have dinner at J&G Steakhouse. When making reservations we were asked if we had any special requests for the maitre'd and we asked for a table with the best possible view. We were seated at a table that was in the midst of a small busy area and throughout our entire meal looked at a lovely table next, to the window, that was never used. We were anxious to show off the view, but where we were located and because of the dividers throughout the restaurant, that was not possible. The food was delicious but the wonderful sole I had for $70. seemed overpriced. I wanted to be impressed, but I am sorry to say that my choice for a special event meal would be T.Cook's at Royal Palms
Exceptional dinner(Salmon & Sea Bass) with fantastic views
Great evening, Dover Sole was exquisite!

We had a delicious dinner and a miserable service experience. Apparently, according to the manager, it is tough to staff appropriately. This seems odd to me as the restaurant is fairly pricey and likely not a last minute decision for most guests. So, we would recommend it and hope that they are appropriately staffed on the night you go :)

The rolls were dry and hard. Steak was extremely salty. Creamed spinach was a puddle of milk.
This was a very disappointing experience. We have enjoyed the Phoenician for years. This was a "bust."

The food and service was good (nothing spectacular tho), but way more expensive than they justified. My $51 steak was not very large and with two sides (another $18.00) the meal price just seemed out of touch with reality. Great wine list but pricey and not much below $50 per bottle. I do suspect that if they were not an integral part of a very large hotel, they would soon be out of biz.

Started w/ foie gras terrine that was wonderful on toast points and calamari that almost melted in your mouth. Chilean sea bass and short ribs were outstanding but the burger and fries were comparatively disappointing. Mac and cheese was also very good but not the best. Grilled asparagus was perfect. Waitstaff was attentive and very helpful,esp. our waitress Renee. Very good wine list. Beautiful evening views w/ firepit on balcony.
Too expensive for what you get.

We had a great experience-from the food to the service everything was outstanding. Our server even let my husband do a wine tasting because he couldn't decide between 2 wines which was very helpful. Of course, the view was amazing and made for an all round great night. We have already made another reservation.

The Maitre'D very personalable and attentive. Our waiter, Justice was amazing! Our whole experience would have been also except for the fact that when I called for directions, Bridget, a hostest told me she had no idea how to drive to the restaurant. When I asked if someone there could give me directions, she suggested that I contact the front desk at my hotel and ask them for directions. I told her that I choose J&G to have dinner not my hotel restaurant and she replied, I'm sorry but I can't help you with that! I hung up! Waiting for the valeted car was bothersome.

Beautiful view from a dramatically decorated room. Very nice menu which is presented well. My server was excellent. Friendly and attentive but still professional. She made several excellent suggestions on menu choices.
The food was absolutely delicious, not to mention the out-of-this-world carrot cake. My God it was amazing! The view of Phoenix was a plus and the atmosphere and ambiance very relaxing.
I eat steak from Miami to Seattle, from New York to San Diego -- this is easily one of the top 3 steaks I have ever eaten (NY Strip).
as always the food is fabulous and the service stinks!!!

Our table was in the aisle and not very romantic due to people always passing by. Service was very slow. Be prepared for hotel guests to bring their kids. There was an upset infant seated next to us. Food was very good but the overall experience is less than the price deserves.
Rib Eye Steak was fatty. Flavor was less than desired. However, it is good food, with good sides.
This restaurant is a must visit. The food is delicious and the view is spectacular.

The only thing I could complain about is that I purchased 16 roses for my table as it was our 16th anniversary. The presentation was terrible as the roses looked like they were thrown in a vase with very ugly greenage and not arranged at all. I was embarassed to have them sitting on my table. Roses, as all flowers, should be arranged beautifully. These were not. But, that's not the doing of the restaurant. Everything else was terrific.

The service when entering the restaurant was not up to par for a restaurant in the Phoenician Hotel. The girls were scattered and harried. We were told to wait in the bar for our table and then were forgotten - we had to remind them or I'm not sure we would have been seated yet. There were not enough waiters to provide attentive service - our waiter tried, but just couldn't keep up. The staff bringing out the meals appeared to be running, which is not a great perception to create for a higher end restaurant. We will not return.

Too noisy. We had asked for a quiet table with a view. The one they held for us was in a very noisy area with about 100 people stanging at a bar next to the table.
We were then put at another table with no view. Service was terrible. We waited over one half hour to be given a dessert menu. Lastly, they added someone else's bar drinks to our final bill, that we spotted. Overall too noisey, terrible service, but good food
The food was outstanding!

The food was very good classical preparations. Calamari appetizer and shrimp salad are very tasty. Dover sole was ok, steaks and lobster were better. Friendly service but not top notch.. Waiter was stretched too thin keep the wine glasses full and the drinks delivered in a timely fashion. Wonderful views of the area
Wonderful decor and service, view is wonderful. However, the wine list is so overpriced. I really don't appreciate the 4x markup on wine.
food is amazing, but service is slow!!!

From the Lobby throughout the dining area, the view and the aesthetics are amazing. Very comfortable and spacious seating. Servers are attentive and maintain general professionalism but I'll note lacked a bit of sincerity, could use a bit more training, and should try to have some personality.

Early dishes were inventive and flavorful, the entrees (filet for my guest-great) and Strip steak (for me) were seasoned well. My steak though had a considerable amount of fat/sinew that made almost every bite difficult to chew or swallow. (I had to spit the remnants in my napkin twice after getting too tired to chew anymore. I was entertaining my client but don't THINK she noticed.)

Prices are exhorbant but the view might make it worth it!
Amazing location, impecable service, mediocre food.
Awesome food, but still issues with service
I would recommend this restaurant for its atmosphere. The food is good but for the cost, overly expensive. We would go back for appetizers and drinks.

The view from J&G is amazing!! Be sure to get to the restaurant early enough to enjoy the sunset. The food is always exquisite and well-prepared. The prices are moderate, but you must consider the amazing atmosphere!

Our waiter was off the mark for the prices this place commands. He could have been more attentive and made sure we didn't have to ask for things, like butter/rolls, another round of drinks, etc.

Also very disappointed they didn't address the smokers on the patio, which was a dining patio.

Fabulous!!!!
One of the best restaurants in Phoenix. Best Steak and Seafood for sure!!
Third time eating there and the food is perfect everytime.

Food was very average and not flavorful. The room was beautiful but had zero energy. The lack of engagement was prevalent throughout the restaurant and bar Service was cold and mechanical. For $200, not worth a return trip or a visit. We had two different bussers visit the table without ever uttering any sort of greeting. Bread showed up 30 minutes after our arrival.

This is our second time dining at J & G Steakhouse, and the food is fabulous as always. Ambiance is very nice and service is very attentive. My only drawback is that both times when we made reservations with a request for a window or scenic view, we were not able to sit per our initial request. Either the host staff or server will explain why when we got there, but if scenic seating wasn't going to be available when I made the reservations a week ahead of time, why wasn't that addressed in the first place? Or at least a courtesy call to let us know? Anyway, we were more disappointed than upset, no big deal. It was really lovely for them to make our anniversary special with a dessert, a nice touch. We will dine there again very soon.

Amazing! My husband and I were very impressed with the service and the food. The staff was so friendly and the atmosphere was upscale, but comfortable, not stuffy. The grounds of the property are magnificent and we enjoyed having an after dinner drink on the patio while sitting next to one of the fire pits.

Heirloom tomato salad with onion rings was as good as it gets. Short ribs with red wine was interesting and tasty. Service was smart and appropriate; always ready to help but not oppressively attentive.

Enjoyable and memorable.

Nice view and ambiance. Unfortunately service and food were VERY disappointing. Especially on a special occasion like new years eve.We had the risotto and tuna tartar for appetizers and those were nice.However the main course was greatly disappointing.After we complained about the sea bass Waiter said:"Its a good fish you should try it"-how ignorant! Luckily he took it back. The lobster serving was extremely small, not that great.When we ordered our second glass of wine from the waiter he poured half of what the bartender served us and still charged us a full glass. Once they left the bill at our table they were done with us.We were still having desserts and needed more coffee, etc.We love the pheonician and this wasn't up to its standard

We had a window table, overlooking the city lights. Food was good, nice sauces for steaks. Service was erratic - the waitress was attentive and friendly while we looked over the menu and wine list, and after our order, was hardly seen again. The kitchen was super fast - too fast almost. We felt rushed. Only one chocolate dessert - very good, but not best-ever. Steaks were good and cooked perfectly, but overall the meal was a disappointment for the price. Wouldn't go back.

Overall a wonderful meal. Each dish was executed well for the price point and the pacing fit in with the slow pace we set for the evening (over three hours). We arrived early and the room was nearly empty. The service was appropriately attentive without being smothering. The server might have had more wine know how. However, as the evening progressed several large parties arrived and our server became overwhelmed. At one point we were refraining from eating in the hopes that the we could place another wine order -- wanting to pair the wines with the remainder of our food. After nearly giving up, we flagged the manager, who took our order and checked in on use the rest of the evening. In spite of this service lull, the staff rebounded.
My sister wanted to go back, I didn't but it was Christmas and in the spirit of the season we went. Again, (3rd time) the food was good, the view awesome, but the service was, as usual, poor.

I went here for xmas eve and the service was deplorable. We arrived early and sat in the bar, the waitress told us that she was too busy to get us drinks and that we should go to the bartender if we wanted anything. Nothing says nice restuarant like the wait staff telling you they cant/wont serve you. I guess we should be grateful she at least told us. Then we waited 15 minutes after our reservation to be seated. We never actually got introduced to a waiter instead we had multiple people stop by our table to ask us what we wanted and a drop off stuff, all with 10-15 minutes delays in between any service. Initally waited 10 minutes for someone to take our initial order...which i believe was a expediater that took pity on us. Off night?

What a disappointment!! This restaurant definitely DOES NOT live up to the Phoenician's high standards. Service was slow and spotty. The waiter was far more interested in taking care of the larger parties and spent very little time with us (we were just a party of two.) He seemed more interested in "working his tip" at the larger tables. His "team partner" also treated us with nonchalance. The food was good, but not as good as we expected. We have had much better at other Phoenix area steakhouses. We were surprised at the paper place mats and the scratched stainless flatware. No Christmas decorations were anywhere in sight on Christmas Eve! This sterile restaurant left us cold!
Great service Justis

We have been here many times and the food is always outstanding - that's why we always go back. Service this time was not as polished as it has been in the past, but still very good. I downgraded the "ambiance" and upgraded the noise level because the restaurant was not very busy that night and yet all of the occupied tables were scrunched together so it felt crowded and was noisy when it really didn't need to be that way; might have made it easier on the server, but made it harder on the patrons! We will return though!
Great food. Be sure to try to steamed shrimp salad.
Nice restaurant, great food, nice view from patio.
Great dinner food service and ambiance.

We had a most enjoyable evening at the steakhouse recently. All of the food was tasty and served professionally. Each time we come into the restaurant, however, there are never many other people there. This was a Thursday night and we expected a larger, more energetic crowd.
Very good, great service, but extremely expensive, not sure if it's worth the price.

Food was amazing. Well prepared sides and the steaks were perfectly cooked and very fine beef. Our service however left much to be desired. We didn't connect with our server who wasn't very personable... I feel it should not always be about the food but also about the people who are sitting at the table. We sensed he had a lot going on... several groups, etc so at our table it was just about getting us in and out. The food however eclipsed the evening and we were very happy with our meal.

Food was very good and service was outstanding. It was our anniversary and the restaurant was aware of this when the reservation was made. They sat us at a table for two, not secluded, then after being there for 30 minutes they sit a family behind us with 3 screaming kids who were loud and could stay in their seats. We asked our waiter to move us, which he did, but you could still see and hear those kids in the whole restaurant. We felt like we were at Denny's. Probably will not go back.

This was my first visit to J&G and all I can say is that it won't be my last. We were pleasantly greated by the hostess and after a drink at the bar, shown to our table without wait from out reservation time. Our request for patio seating was accommodated and the view was spectacular. While the restaurant is tastefully designed and comfortable, it's the food that stands out here. The crab cakes are excellent. Our party of 4 had the shortribs, lobster, peppercorn steak, and filet. All were prepared exactly as requested and delicious. I will definitely recommend this restaurant to others.

Had an amazing romantic dinner for 2. Sat outside with an amazing view below. Have highly recommended this to others and found out about this restaurant from someone who has had the same experience. The steak I ad was cooked perfect, just the way I asked and wife's salmon was perfect as well.

This is the third time we have dined at J&G. Unfortunately each experience has not been as good or better than the past one. The sauces are great ... the overall meal was not.
The group rated it seven out of ten at best. The brown paper place mats seem out of place for such a well designed restaurant. We will stop in again by the end of the year!

We picked 6 restaurants - one for each evening of our 6 night stay in Scottsdale. We had eaten at Mary Elaine's at the top of the Phonecian before and loved it. This restaurant tho - was the pits! Our service was horrible. The waiter was NOT friendly, the service was very slow, and when we complained, he was absolutely rude. We will NEVER go back. The food was fairly good - but not nearly good enough for the prices they charged. What a waste of a good night!

My boyfriend and I went to J&G Steakhouse for his birthday, and it was definitely a night I will never forget. Both our waitress Renee and the maitre d' made our experience memorable with their outstanding service. Renee gave us tons of information about the menu and was also very tentative with our needs. The maitre d' was nice enough to take time out of her work and take several photos for us around the restaurant at the end of our dinner. My boyfriend and I chose to sit outside, and the view and ambiance was spectacular! It was very romantic. The food was cooked to perfection. I would definitely recommend the short ribs, as it is very tender and has a unique sauce that makes you crave for more! Over all, I couldn't ask for a better night
The may have been the best dining experience we have had in the City of Phoenix.

Our dinner was delicious. The view was beautiful and the ambiance of the restaurant was perfect for our celebratory restaurant. The restaurant was beautifully decorated and the food was wonderfully prepared on the plate. However, our server seemed to lack a pulse, and he didn't give any indication that he was aware that we were there to celebrate my mother's 50th birthday, although that had been in the reservation notes. The hostess had even asked for her name so they could properly wish her a "happy birthday" but all we got was a written message on her dessert plate brought to us by a food runner. A word of warning - the side dishes and desserts are small, close to being individual portions, for the price.

Lovely views over the city, from both inside the restaurant and the patio. The wait staff was first rate, very accommodating and attentive. Each course was timed perfectly. The food was delicious and great portions, especially the dinner salads. The chilled lobster was a great find and a "bargain". Very flavorful steaks cooked just right. The wine list is a nice selection, although the cabernets are very pricey. The half bottles are the way to go, even if you do two. A great dining experience!
stunning views, good food, lovely new restaurant.
I did not get the view that I had requested.
The food was excellent, and the steamed shrimp salad in particular wowed me with the tasty vinaigrette and great depth of flavor in the beautifully cooked shrimp.

this restaurant participated in Arizona restaurant week with a special menu that was not worthy of its previous quality. there were serious service issues, slowness and attitude, that were not related to the menu however.
Food and service was excellent. Good for special occasions.

An outstanding restaurant week menu. The boiled shrimp salad and slow cooked salmon came off the regular menu. The sirloin cap steak was tender. Everything was perfectly cooked. We will return to this restaurant.

The highlight was the service.
We are a younger couple but we were treated equally to the regulars.I honestly loved it and the men will appreciate the hearty portions.

Dinner was wonderful overall but the service was unnecessarily snobby. I rarely complain about service and always give the servers the benefit of the doubt as I waitressed through graduate school. But geez! This is Scottsdale and the wait staff could learn to smile a little and be more friendly. Good service doesn't need to be snooty!
Great food. tacky table settings,paper mats could have done without them. Dining room very noisy.

We ordered from the restaurant week menu.Service was slow/terrible.Our waiter seemed annoyed when we ordered water & no side dishes.Later on we asked if they had any other flavor margaritas besides ginger & he said No-we thought that was strange for a full bar.When our waiter asked how our steaks were,we told him they were chewy,he just said,"That's the cut."Someone else came by & we asked him for butter,but he never returned.When we finally got the bill,our waiter said we should return sometime to try the higher quality cuts of meat b/c they are much better than what we ordered.Customer satisfaction was not a priority.Overall a disappointment.
Food was amazing. Very cute, upscale spot perfect for a special occasion, nice meal out. Contemporary feel, beautiful views.
Beautiful view and plentiful portions. Get the chocolate cake with caramel ice cream for dessert.

The dining experience was lovely,mostly because of the atmosphere and the view. The food was very good, presented very artistically . Our main dishes of steak and chicken was good, but frankly could have been prepared at home, just as good. We would return only for a special occasion or if given the offer for restaurant week again.
The evening was perfect from the food to the service

Loved it! Convenient location. Great variety. Had 5 guests; 2 ate fish, 1 ate lamb, 2 ate beef. Perfect for veggy's too. Lots of vegetable side options. Raw "bar" made excellent appetizers. Carrot cake was my favorite dessert. We'd go back.

Great ambiance and cuisine.The view from the patio is amazing..an exceptional view of the PHX skyline!!! The only problem was the service...our waiter apparently was "cut" without telling other employess leaving us w/o service for more than 20 min. The bussers eventualy noticed and had another waiter help us..if not for them there is no telling when we would have eaten!!!

They had amazing service and everything was delicious. The server was very knowlegable about every dish and drink. He made us feel very special and welcome. They gave us a complimentary birthday cake for my boyfriend's birthday. I was very impressed with how polite everyone was. The woman always came first. The food was prompt and very delicious. Everything cooked and prepared to perfection. A bit pricey to bring a family or group but great for the romantic birthday dinner with your significant other. I definately want to go there again.

steak was acceptable but quality of 2 fish dishes was poor. Seabass was inedible and slow cooked salmon was mushy. We will not return for dinner. Bar was attractive and inviting. Appetizers (especially tuna tartar) was exceptional.

We were promptly seated and the hostess wished us a Happy Anniversary. However, after being seated we waited for about 3/4 minutes before anyone acknowledged us. I had to stop a waiter and ask him to get us a waiter. He promptly gave us menus and took our drink order tho he was not our waiter. (tall black man with pony tail) Our waiter finally came and did take care of us after that. Neither he nor anyone else mentioned our anniversary. Other restaurants, i.e. Fleming's, take great pride in mentioning special occasions. The food was good, but when served it was brought one plate at a time rather than all at once. Just a minor difference in what we are accustomed to. We would go again and hope the experience is better. Thanks.

I took my significant other here for a special occasion. The food was excellent; the filet perhaps the best I've ever had. The wine list was deep and fairly-priced. While the dining experinence itself was great, what followed impressed me even more. Evidently I left my credit card at the restaurant. No sooner had I left the place than I received I call on my cell with that message. I actually didn't pick up the message until the following day, and called back to leave my own that morning. I received another call quickly, and a women named Sharon advised me that she would hold my card in the safe until I arrived for it, which could be immediately, even thought the restaurant wouldn't open until 5 PM. Wow - that's execellent service!

This was a perfect 30th anniversary dinner because we are on an extreme budget. After making a reservation on Open Table, mentioning our budget anniversary - we were treated to complimentary bubbly and sat overlooking the entire valley at sunset - gorgeous. The hamburgers were delicious and it felt like a special event.

Very nice experience. All the staff were exceptionally gracious. Menu was varied and creative. They offer a price fixed menu that is an exceptional value and a wonderful option that I think all top end restaurants should offer. We chose it because the dishes looked great and such a good value - it was too tempting to deny . The menu steaks were to big for our taste (the rib steak is 18 ounces!) Food was very good.

I recommend people try J&G. You are guaranteed superb ambiance, service and, with the option of the price fixed menu, exceptional value.
